		self.destroyed
		or self.state ~= "chase"
		or not self.chaseStartedAt
		or (now or os.clock()) - self.chaseStartedAt < self.balance.monster_chase_windup_sec
	then
		return false
	end
	local delta = playerRoot.Position - self.root.Position
	if
		Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude > self.balance.monster_capture_radius
		or math.abs(delta.Y) > 7
	then
		return false
	end
	return self:CanSee(playerRoot)
end

function MonsterHunt:BeginCapture(playerPosition: Vector3): CFrame
	local at = self.root.Position
	local facing = Vector3.new(playerPosition.X - at.X, 0, playerPosition.Z - at.Z)
	if facing.Magnitude > 0.001 then
		self.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(at, at + facing))
	end
	self.goal = nil
	self.lostSince = nil
	self.lastSeenPosition = nil
	self:_state("capturing")
	return self.root.CFrame
end

function MonsterHunt:GetPosition(): Vector3?
	if self.destroyed or self.state == "dormant" or self.state == "stopped" then
		return nil
	end
	return self.root.Position
end

function MonsterHunt:Stun(now: number, duration: number): boolean
	if
		self.destroyed
		or (self.state ~= "patrol" and self.state ~= "chase")
		or typeof(now) ~= "number"
		or typeof(duration) ~= "number"
		or now ~= now
		or duration ~= duration
		or math.abs(now) == math.huge
		or duration <= 0
		or duration == math.huge
		or math.abs(now + duration) == math.huge
	then
		return false
	end
	self.stunnedUntil = now + duration
	self.goal = nil
	self.lostSince = nil
	self.lastSeenPosition = nil
	self.blockedSince = nil
	-- _state invalidates pending ComputeAsync jobs before they can restore a
	-- route for the chase that stepped into the trap.
	self:_state("trapped")
	return true
end

function MonsterHunt:_patrol(_playerPosition: Vector3): Vector3
	local slots = self.world.Slots
	local index = self.patrolIndex
	if index then
		index = (index - 1 + 7) % #slots + 1
	else
		local distance = math.huge
		for candidateIndex, slot in slots do
			local d = (slot.Position - self.root.Position).Magnitude
			if d < distance then
				index = candidateIndex
				distance = d
			end
		end
	end
	-- AuthoredWorld sorts the fifteen available slots by their unique slot_id.
	-- A stride of seven visits every slot once without using the player's position.
	self.patrolIndex = index or 1
	self.patrolSlot = slots[self.patrolIndex]
	return self.patrolSlot.Position
end

function MonsterHunt:_path(goal: Vector3, now: number)
	if self.pathBusy or now - self.pathAt < 1 then
		return
	end
	self.pathBusy = true
	self.pathAt = now
	local generation = self.generation
	local began = self.root.Position
	task.spawn(function()
		local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
			AgentRadius = 2,
			AgentHeight = 9,
			AgentCanJump = false,
			WaypointSpacing = 4,
		})
		local ok = pcall(function()
			path:ComputeAsync(began, goal)
		end)
		if self.destroyed or self.generation ~= generation then
			return
		end
		self.pathBusy = false
		if ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
			self.route = path:GetWaypoints()
			self.routeIndex = 2
		else
			self.route = nil
		end
	end)
end

function MonsterHunt:ResetHome()
	self.stunnedUntil = nil
	self.generation += 1
	self.pathBusy = false
	self.route = nil
	self.goal = nil
	self.lostSince = nil
	self.lastSeenPosition = nil
	self.patrolSlot = nil
	self.patrolIndex = nil
	self.blockedSince = nil
	self.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(self.home))
	self:_state("patrol")
end

function MonsterHunt:Step(
	dt: number,
	now: number,
	playerRoot: BasePart,
	protected: boolean
): (boolean, boolean)
	if self.destroyed or self.state == "capturing" then
		return false, false
	end
	if self.state == "trapped" then
		if now < self.stunnedUntil then
			return false, false
		end
		self.stunnedUntil = nil
		self:_state("patrol")
	end
	local awakened = false
	if self.state == "dormant" then
		if now - self.startedAt < self.balance.hunt_start_delay_sec then
			return false, false
		end
		for _, p in self.visuals do
			p.Transparency = 0
		end
		for _, item in self.world.Home:GetDescendants() do
			if item:IsA("BasePart") and item.Name ~= "Pole" then
				self.originalMarker[item] = item.Transparency
				item.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
		self:_state("patrol")
		awakened = true
	end
	local delta = playerRoot.Position - self.root.Position
	local distance = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
	local canSee = not protected and self:CanSee(playerRoot)
	if canSee and distance <= self.balance.monster_detect_radius then
		self:_state("chase", now)
		self.lostSince = nil
		self.lastSeenPosition = playerRoot.Position
	end
	if self.state == "chase" then
		if protected then
			self:_state("patrol")
			self.goal = nil
			self.lostSince = nil
			self.lastSeenPosition = nil
		else
			if canSee then
				self.lastSeenPosition = playerRoot.Position
			end
			if distance > self.balance.monster_lose_radius or not canSee then
				self.lostSince = self.lostSince or now
				if now - self.lostSince >= self.balance.monster_lose_delay_sec then
					self:_state("patrol")
					self.goal = nil
					self.lostSince = nil
					self.lastSeenPosition = nil
				end
			else
				self.lostSince = nil
			end
		end
	end
	if not protected and self:CanCapture(playerRoot, now) then
		return true, awakened
	end
	if self.state == "chase" then
		self.goal = self.lastSeenPosition or self.root.Position
	elseif
		not self.goal
		or (Vector3.new(self.goal.X, self.root.Position.Y, self.goal.Z) - self.root.Position).Magnitude
			< 3
	then
		self.goal = self:_patrol(playerRoot.Position)
	end
	local goal = Vector3.new(self.goal.X, self.home.Y, self.goal.Z)
	local params = self:_params(playerRoot.Parent :: Model)
	local direct = goal - self.root.Position
	local obstructed = workspace:Blockcast(
		self.root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0),
		Vector3.new(3, 5.4, 2),
		direct,
		params
	) ~= nil
	local target = goal
	if obstructed then
		self:_path(goal, now)
		local route = self.route
		if route then
			while self.routeIndex <= #route do
				local waypoint = Vector3.new(
					route[self.routeIndex].Position.X,
					self.home.Y,
					route[self.routeIndex].Position.Z
				)
				if (waypoint - self.root.Position).Magnitude > 1 then
					target = waypoint
					break
				end
				self.routeIndex += 1
			end
		end
	end
	local direction = target - self.root.Position
	local speed = if self.state == "chase"
			and self.chaseStartedAt
			and now - self.chaseStartedAt >= self.balance.monster_chase_windup_sec
		then self.balance.monster_chase_speed
		else self.balance.monster_patrol_speed
	if direction.Magnitude > 0.05 then
		local step = direction.Unit * math.min(direction.Magnitude, speed * math.clamp(dt, 0, 0.25))
		local hit = workspace:Blockcast(
			self.root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0),
			Vector3.new(3, 5.4, 2),
			step,
			params
		)
		if not hit then
			local position = self.root.Position + step
			self.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction))
			self.blockedSince = nil
		else
			self.blockedSince = self.blockedSince or now
			if self.state == "patrol" and now - self.blockedSince > 2 then
				self.goal = nil
				self.route = nil
				self.blockedSince = nil
			end
		end
	end
	self.model:SetAttribute("TargetDistance", distance)
	return not protected and self:CanCapture(playerRoot, now), awakened
end

function MonsterHunt:Destroy()
	self.destroyed = true
	self.stunnedUntil = nil
	self.generation += 1
	for p, transparency in self.originalMarker do
		if p.Parent then
			p.Transparency = transparency
		end
	end
	self.model:Destroy()
	self.state = "stopped"
end

return MonsterHunt

	if self.state == "chase" then
		self.goal = self.lastSeenPosition or self.root.Position
	elseif
		not self.goal
		or (Vector3.new(self.goal.X, self.root.Position.Y, self.goal.Z) - self.root.Position).Magnitude
			< 3
	then
		self.goal = self:_patrol(playerRoot.Position)
	end
	local goal = Vector3.new(self.goal.X, self.home.Y, self.goal.Z)
	local params = self:_params(playerRoot.Parent :: Model)
	local direct = goal - self.root.Position
	local obstructed = workspace:Blockcast(
		self.root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0),
		Vector3.new(3, 5.4, 2),
		direct,
		params
	) ~= nil
	local target = goal
	if obstructed then
		self:_path(goal, now)
		local route = self.route
		if route then
			while self.routeIndex <= #route do
				local waypoint = Vector3.new(
					route[self.routeIndex].Position.X,
					self.home.Y,
					route[self.routeIndex].Position.Z
				)
				if (waypoint - self.root.Position).Magnitude > 1 then
					target = waypoint
					break
				end
				self.routeIndex += 1
			end
		end
	end
	local direction = target - self.root.Position
	local speed = if self.state == "chase"
		then self:_chaseSpeed(playerRoot, now)
		else self.balance.monster_patrol_speed
	if direction.Magnitude > 0.05 then
		local step = direction.Unit * math.min(direction.Magnitude, speed * math.clamp(dt, 0, 0.25))
		local hit = workspace:Blockcast(
			self.root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0),
			Vector3.new(3, 5.4, 2),
			step,
			params
		)
		if not hit then
			local position = self.root.Position + step
			self.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction))
			self.blockedSince = nil
		else
			self.blockedSince = self.blockedSince or now
			if self.state == "patrol" and now - self.blockedSince > 2 then
				self.goal = nil
				self.route = nil
				self.blockedSince = nil
			end
		end
	end
	self.model:SetAttribute("TargetDistance", distance)
	return not protected and self:CanCapture(playerRoot, now), awakened
end

function MonsterHunt:Destroy()
	self.destroyed = true
	self.stunnedUntil = nil
	self.generation += 1
	for p, transparency in self.originalMarker do
		if p.Parent then
			p.Transparency = transparency
		end
	end
	self.model:Destroy()
	self.state = "stopped"
end

return MonsterHunt
--!strict
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Pose = require(
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
		:WaitForChild("GameShared")
		:WaitForChild("Game")
		:WaitForChild("MonsterPose")
)
local MonsterHunt = {}
MonsterHunt.__index = MonsterHunt

function MonsterHunt.new(
	world: any,
	balance: any,
	startedAt: number,
	targetUserId: number?,
	options: any?
)
	options = options or {}
	local index = options.index or 1
	assert(index == 1 or index == 2 or index == 3, "Unknown monster index")
	local modelName = if index == 1 then "Monster" else "Monster" .. index
	assert(not world.Runtime:FindFirstChild(modelName), "Monster name already occupied")
	local home = world.Home:FindFirstChild("Body") :: BasePart
	assert(home and home:IsA("BasePart"), "Scarecrow home body missing")
	local floor = world.Ground.Position.Y + world.Ground.Size.Y / 2
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = modelName
	model:SetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned", true)
	model:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	model:SetAttribute("MonsterRigVersion", 1)
	model:SetAttribute("MonsterIndex", index)
	model:SetAttribute("HuntState", "dormant")
	model:SetAttribute("ChaseTargetUserId", 0)
	local at = options.position or home.Position
	assert(typeof(at) == "Vector3", "Monster spawn position missing")
	local origin = Vector3.new(at.X, floor + 3, at.Z)
	local visuals = {}
	local function part(
		name: string,
		size: Vector3,
		offset: Vector3,
		color: Color3,
		hidden: boolean?
	): Part
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin + offset)
		p.Color = color
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.Transparency = 1
		p.Parent = model
		if not hidden then
			table.insert(visuals, p)
		end
		return p
	end
	local root = part("Root", Vector3.new(3, 6, 2), Vector3.zero, Color3.new(), true)
	for _, definition in Pose.Parts do
		local visual = part(
			definition.Name,
			definition.Size,
			Pose.Rest[definition.Name].Position,
			definition.Color
		)
		visual.Material = definition.Material
	end
	model:SetAttribute("MonsterHeightScale", Pose.HeightScale)
	model.PrimaryPart = root
	model.Parent = world.Runtime
	local self = setmetatable({
		world = world,
		balance = balance,
		startedAt = startedAt,
		model = model,
		root = root,
		visuals = visuals,
		home = origin,
		state = "dormant",
		chaseStartedAt = nil,
		firstChaseUsed = options.immediate == true,
		detectRadius = balance.monster_detect_radius,
		firstChaseUntil = nil,
		reacquireAt = -math.huge,
		targetUserId = if targetUserId
				and targetUserId > 0
				and targetUserId % 1 == 0
			then targetUserId
			else 0,
		stunnedUntil = nil,
		lostSince = nil,
		lastSeenPosition = nil,
		patrolSlot = nil,
		patrolIndex = nil,
		goal = nil,
		route = nil,
		routeIndex = 2,
		pathAt = -math.huge,
		pathBusy = false,
		generation = 0,
		destroyed = false,
		originalMarker = {},
		blockedSince = nil,
	}, MonsterHunt)
	if options.immediate then
		for _, visual in visuals do
			visual.Transparency = 0
		end
		self:_state("patrol", startedAt)
	end
	return self
end

function MonsterHunt:SetDetectionMultiplier(multiplier: number)
	assert(multiplier == 1 or multiplier == 2, "Invalid hunt detection multiplier")
	self.detectRadius = self.balance.monster_detect_radius * multiplier
	self.model:SetAttribute("DetectionRadius", self.detectRadius)
end

function MonsterHunt:_state(state: string, now: number?)
	if self.state == state then
		return
	end
	-- A completed path belongs to the state that requested it. Cancel stale work
	-- only on transitions; visible chase polls must preserve a current path.
	self.generation += 1
	self.route = nil
	self.routeIndex = 2
	self.pathBusy = false
	self.pathAt = -math.huge
	self.state = state
	self.chaseStartedAt = if state == "chase" then now or os.clock() else nil
	if state ~= "chase" then
		-- Consumption belongs to the round, not a capture, trap or home reset.
		self.firstChaseUntil = nil
	end
	self.model:SetAttribute("HuntState", state)
	self.model:SetAttribute("ChaseTargetUserId", if state == "chase" then self.targetUserId else 0)
end

function MonsterHunt:_params(character: Model?): RaycastParams
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = if character
		then { self.model, self.world.Home, character }
		else { self.model, self.world.Home }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	return params
end

function MonsterHunt:CanSee(playerRoot: BasePart): boolean
	local start = self.root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	return workspace:Raycast(
		start,
		playerRoot.Position - start,
		self:_params(playerRoot.Parent :: Model)
	) == nil
end

function MonsterHunt:CanCapture(playerRoot: BasePart, now: number?): boolean
	local at = now or os.clock()
	if
		self.destroyed
		or self.state ~= "chase"
		or not self.chaseStartedAt
		or at - self.chaseStartedAt < self.balance.monster_chase_windup_sec
		or (self.firstChaseUntil and at >= self.firstChaseUntil)
	then
		return false
	end
	local delta = playerRoot.Position - self.root.Position
	if
		Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude > self.balance.monster_capture_radius
		or math.abs(delta.Y) > 7
	then
		return false
	end
	return self:CanSee(playerRoot)
end

function MonsterHunt:_chaseSpeed(playerRoot: BasePart, now: number): number
	if self.firstChaseUntil then
		local character = playerRoot.Parent
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		local speed = if humanoid then humanoid.WalkSpeed else nil
		-- SoloRound writes this server value before Step. Never accept a client
		-- speed argument; invalid values fall back to normal walking. Energy's
		-- existing multiplier is two, including sprint+energy (18*2 = 36).
		local maxSpeed = math.max(self.balance.walk_speed, self.balance.sprint_speed) * 2
		return if typeof(speed) == "number"
				and speed == speed
				and speed > 0
				and speed < math.huge
			then math.min(speed, maxSpeed)
			else self.balance.walk_speed
	end
	return if self.chaseStartedAt
			and now - self.chaseStartedAt >= self.balance.monster_chase_windup_sec
		then self.balance.monster_chase_speed
		else self.balance.monster_patrol_speed
end

function MonsterHunt:BeginCapture(playerPosition: Vector3): CFrame
	local at = self.root.Position
	local facing = Vector3.new(playerPosition.X - at.X, 0, playerPosition.Z - at.Z)
	if facing.Magnitude > 0.001 then
		self.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(at, at + facing))
	end
	self.goal = nil
	self.lostSince = nil
	self.lastSeenPosition = nil
	self:_state("capturing")
	return self.root.CFrame
end

function MonsterHunt:GetPosition(): Vector3?
	if self.destroyed or self.state == "dormant" or self.state == "stopped" then
		return nil
	end
	return self.root.Position
end

function MonsterHunt:Stun(now: number, duration: number): boolean
	if
		self.destroyed
		or (self.state ~= "patrol" and self.state ~= "chase")
		or typeof(now) ~= "number"
		or typeof(duration) ~= "number"
		or now ~= now
		or duration ~= duration
		or math.abs(now) == math.huge
		or duration <= 0
		or duration == math.huge
		or math.abs(now + duration) == math.huge
	then
		return false
	end
	self.stunnedUntil = now + duration
	self.goal = nil
	self.lostSince = nil
	self.lastSeenPosition = nil
	self.blockedSince = nil
	-- _state invalidates pending ComputeAsync jobs before they can restore a
	-- route for the chase that stepped into the trap.
	self:_state("trapped")
	return true
end

function MonsterHunt:_patrol(_playerPosition: Vector3): Vector3
	local slots = self.world.Slots
	local index = self.patrolIndex
	if index then
		index = (index - 1 + 7) % #slots + 1
	else
		local distance = math.huge
		for candidateIndex, slot in slots do
			local d = (slot.Position - self.root.Position).Magnitude
			if d < distance then
				index = candidateIndex
				distance = d
			end
		end
	end
	-- AuthoredWorld sorts the fifteen available slots by their unique slot_id.
	-- A stride of seven visits every slot once without using the player's position.
	self.patrolIndex = index or 1
	self.patrolSlot = slots[self.patrolIndex]
	return self.patrolSlot.Position
end

function MonsterHunt:_path(goal: Vector3, now: number)
	if self.pathBusy or now - self.pathAt < 1 then
		return
	end
	self.pathBusy = true
	self.pathAt = now
	local generation = self.generation
	local began = self.root.Position
	task.spawn(function()
		local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
			AgentRadius = 2,
			AgentHeight = 9,
			AgentCanJump = false,
			WaypointSpacing = 4,
		})
		local ok = pcall(function()
			path:ComputeAsync(began, goal)
		end)
		if self.destroyed or self.generation ~= generation then
			return
		end
		self.pathBusy = false
		if ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
			self.route = path:GetWaypoints()
			self.routeIndex = 2
		else
			self.route = nil
		end
	end)
end

function MonsterHunt:ResetHome()
	self.stunnedUntil = nil
	self.generation += 1
	self.pathBusy = false
	self.route = nil
	self.goal = nil
	self.lostSince = nil
	self.lastSeenPosition = nil
	self.patrolSlot = nil
	self.patrolIndex = nil
	self.blockedSince = nil
	self.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(self.home))
	self:_state("patrol")
end

function MonsterHunt:Step(
	dt: number,
	now: number,
	playerRoot: BasePart,
	protected: boolean
): (boolean, boolean)
	if self.destroyed or self.state == "capturing" then
		return false, false
	end
	if self.state == "trapped" then
		if now < self.stunnedUntil then
			return false, false
		end
		self.stunnedUntil = nil
		self:_state("patrol")
	end
	local awakened = false
	if self.state == "dormant" then
		if now - self.startedAt < self.balance.hunt_start_delay_sec then
			return false, false
		end
		for _, p in self.visuals do
			p.Transparency = 0
		end
		for _, item in self.world.Home:GetDescendants() do
			if item:IsA("BasePart") and item.Name ~= "Pole" then
				self.originalMarker[item] = item.Transparency
				item.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
		self:_state("patrol")
		awakened = true
	end
	local delta = playerRoot.Position - self.root.Position
	local distance = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
	local canSee = not protected and self:CanSee(playerRoot)
	if self.state == "chase" and self.firstChaseUntil and now >= self.firstChaseUntil then
		-- The timed loss wins over capture even if the target is still visible
		-- and close. Transition cancels the old asynchronous route by epoch.
		self.reacquireAt = now + self.balance.monster_first_chase_reacquire_sec
		self:_state("patrol")
		self.goal = nil
		self.lostSince = nil
		self.lastSeenPosition = nil
		self.blockedSince = nil
	end
	if
		canSee
		and distance <= (self.detectRadius or self.balance.monster_detect_radius)
		and now >= self.reacquireAt
	then
		local newlyDetected = self.state ~= "chase"
		self:_state("chase", now)
		if newlyDetected then
			if not self.firstChaseUsed then
				self.firstChaseUntil = now + self.balance.monster_first_chase_duration_sec
			end
			self.firstChaseUsed = true
		end
		self.lostSince = nil
		self.lastSeenPosition = playerRoot.Position
	end
	if self.state == "chase" then
		if protected then
			self:_state("patrol")
			self.goal = nil
			self.lostSince = nil
			self.lastSeenPosition = nil
		else
			if canSee then
				self.lastSeenPosition = playerRoot.Position
			end
			if distance > self.balance.monster_lose_radius or not canSee then
				self.lostSince = self.lostSince or now
				if now - self.lostSince >= self.balance.monster_lose_delay_sec then
					self:_state("patrol")
					self.goal = nil
					self.lostSince = nil
					self.lastSeenPosition = nil
				end
			else
				self.lostSince = nil
			end
		end
	end
	if not protected and self:CanCapture(playerRoot, now) then
		return true, awakened
	end
	if self.state == "chase" then
		self.goal = self.lastSeenPosition or self.root.Position
	elseif
		not self.goal
		or (Vector3.new(self.goal.X, self.root.Position.Y, self.goal.Z) - self.root.Position).Magnitude
			< 3
	then
		self.goal = self:_patrol(playerRoot.Position)
	end
	local goal = Vector3.new(self.goal.X, self.home.Y, self.goal.Z)
	local params = self:_params(playerRoot.Parent :: Model)
	local direct = goal - self.root.Position
	local obstructed = workspace:Blockcast(
		self.root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0),
		Vector3.new(3, 5.4, 2),
		direct,
		params
	) ~= nil
	local target = goal
	if obstructed then
		self:_path(goal, now)
		local route = self.route
		if route then
			while self.routeIndex <= #route do
				local waypoint = Vector3.new(
					route[self.routeIndex].Position.X,
					self.home.Y,
					route[self.routeIndex].Position.Z
				)
				if (waypoint - self.root.Position).Magnitude > 1 then
					target = waypoint
					break
				end
				self.routeIndex += 1
			end
		end
	end
	local direction = target - self.root.Position
	local speed = if self.state == "chase"
		then self:_chaseSpeed(playerRoot, now)
		else self.balance.monster_patrol_speed
	if direction.Magnitude > 0.05 then
		local step = direction.Unit * math.min(direction.Magnitude, speed * math.clamp(dt, 0, 0.25))
		local hit = workspace:Blockcast(
			self.root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0),
			Vector3.new(3, 5.4, 2),
			step,
			params
		)
		if not hit then
			local position = self.root.Position + step
			self.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction))
			self.blockedSince = nil
		else
			self.blockedSince = self.blockedSince or now
			if self.state == "patrol" and now - self.blockedSince > 2 then
				self.goal = nil
				self.route = nil
				self.blockedSince = nil
			end
		end
	end
	self.model:SetAttribute("TargetDistance", distance)
	return not protected and self:CanCapture(playerRoot, now), awakened
end

function MonsterHunt:Destroy()
	self.destroyed = true
	self.stunnedUntil = nil
	self.generation += 1
	for p, transparency in self.originalMarker do
		if p.Parent then
			p.Transparency = transparency
		end
	end
	self.model:Destroy()
	self.state = "stopped"
end

return MonsterHunt

--!strict

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local GameShared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
local Endpoints = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Network"):WaitForChild("EndpointNames"))
local AuthoredWorld = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("AuthoredWorld"))
local MonsterHunt = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MonsterHunt"))
local MinimapState = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MinimapState"))
local Stamina = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("Stamina"))

local LightingModes = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("LightingModes"))

local SoloRound = {}
SoloRound.__index = SoloRound

function SoloRound.new(context: any)
	return setmetatable({
		context = context,
		balance = context.Config.CoreLoop,
		action = context.Services.NetworkService:GetEvent(Endpoints.RequestRoundAction),
		snapshot = context.Services.NetworkService:GetEvent(Endpoints.RoundSnapshot),
		sprintIntent = context.Services.NetworkService:GetEvent(Endpoints.RequestSprintIntent),
		stamina = Stamina.new(context.Config.CoreLoop.stamina_capacity, os.clock()),
		minimap = MinimapState.new(),
		world = nil :: any,
		selectedSpawn = nil :: BasePart?,
		player = nil :: Player?,
		phase = "ready",
		lightingMode = LightingModes.Default,
		lightingState = nil :: any,
		epoch = 0,
		hasKey = false,
		gateOpen = false,
		diamonds = 0,
		reward = 0,
		startedAt = nil :: number?,
		hunt = nil :: any,
		catches = 0,
		protectedUntil = 0,
		huntAt = 0,
		elapsed = 0,
		notice = "",
		random = Random.new(),
		connections = {} :: { RBXScriptConnection },
		characterConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
		characterRemovingConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
		deathConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
		keyConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
		roundCharacter = nil :: Model?,
		boundCharacter = nil :: Model?,
		controlledCharacter = nil :: Model?,
		jumpPower = 50,
		jumpHeight = 7.2,
		autoRotate = true,
		requestTokens = 2,
		requestAt = os.clock(),
		interactionAt = -math.huge,
		pollAt = 0,
		snapshotAt = 0,
	}, SoloRound)
end

function SoloRound:_send()
	local player = self.player
	if not player or player.Parent ~= Players then
		return
	end
	local facing = if self.selectedSpawn
		then self.selectedSpawn.CFrame.LookVector
		else Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	local horizontal = Vector3.new(facing.X, 0, facing.Z)
	local startLook = if horizontal.Magnitude > 0 then horizontal.Unit else Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	self.snapshot:FireClient(player, {
		phase = self.phase,
		lighting_mode = self.lightingMode,
		minimap = self.minimap:Snapshot(),
		has_key = self.hasKey,
		gate_open = self.gateOpen,
		session_diamonds = self.diamonds,
		reward_diamonds = self.reward,
		elapsed_sec = if self.phase == "active" and self.startedAt
			then os.clock() - self.startedAt
			else self.elapsed,
		notice = self.notice,
		stamina = self.stamina.value,
		stamina_capacity = self.balance.stamina_capacity,
		is_sprinting = self.stamina.sprinting,
		sprint_exhausted = self.stamina.exhausted,
		start_look = startLook,
		catches_remaining = math.max(0, self.balance.max_catches - self.catches),
		monster_state = if self.hunt then self.hunt.state else "stopped",
		protection_sec = math.max(0, self.protectedUntil - os.clock()),
	})
end

function SoloRound:_livingCharacter(): (Model?, Humanoid?, BasePart?)
	local player = self.player
	local character = if player then player.Character else nil
	if not character or not character.Parent then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end
	return character, humanoid, root
end

function SoloRound:_recordCharacterDeath(character: Model?)
	if
		not character
		or character ~= self.roundCharacter
		or (self.phase ~= "active" and self.phase ~= "caught")
	then
		return
	end
	-- Died runs after Health reaches zero, so _livingCharacter cannot supply this root.
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		self.minimap:RecordDeath(character, root.Position)
	end
end

function SoloRound:_controls(enabled: boolean)
	if not enabled then
		Stamina.Request(self.stamina, false, os.clock(), false)
	end
	local character, humanoid = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not character or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	if self.controlledCharacter ~= character then
		self.controlledCharacter = character
		self.jumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower
		self.jumpHeight = humanoid.JumpHeight
		self.autoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
	end
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = if enabled then self.balance.walk_speed else 0
	humanoid.JumpPower = if enabled then self.jumpPower else 0
	humanoid.JumpHeight = if enabled then self.jumpHeight else 0
	humanoid.AutoRotate = enabled and self.autoRotate
end

function SoloRound:_fallbackSpawn(): BasePart?
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
	then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(AuthoredWorld.FindSafeSpawn, map)
	if not ok then
		self.context.Log:Warn("Cannot find a safe CornMap spawn:", result)
		return nil
	end
	return result
end

function SoloRound:_setRespawnLocation()
	local player = self.player
	if not player then
		return
	end
	local spawn = self.selectedSpawn
	player.RespawnLocation = if spawn
			and spawn:IsA("SpawnLocation")
			and spawn:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)
		then spawn
		else nil
end

function SoloRound:_chooseSpawn()
	if self.world and self.world:IsValid() then
		self.selectedSpawn = self.world:SelectSpawn(self.random:NextInteger(1, #self.world.Spawns))
	else
		self.selectedSpawn = self:_fallbackSpawn()
	end
	self:_setRespawnLocation()
end

function SoloRound:_moveToStart(character: Model)
	local spawn = self.selectedSpawn
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not spawn
		or not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or not AuthoredWorld.IsSafeSpawn(map, spawn)
	then
		spawn = self:_fallbackSpawn()
		self.selectedSpawn = spawn
	end
	if not spawn then
		self.context.Log:Warn("No valid CornMap start; install or repair CornerSpawns")
		return
	end
	self:_setRespawnLocation()
	character:PivotTo(AuthoredWorld.SpawnCFrame(spawn))
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
end

function SoloRound:_clearKey()
	if self.keyConnection then
		self.keyConnection:Disconnect()
		self.keyConnection = nil
	end
	if self.world then
		self.world:ClearKey()
	end
end

function SoloRound:_finish(phase: string, notice: string)
	if self.phase ~= "active" and self.phase ~= "preparing" and self.phase ~= "caught" then
		return
	end
	-- Fix the terminal state before rewarding or notifying any client.
	self.elapsed = if self.startedAt then os.clock() - self.startedAt else 0
	self.phase = phase
	self.epoch += 1
	self.notice = notice
	self.reward = if phase == "escaped" then self.balance.escape_reward_diamonds else 0
	self.diamonds += self.reward
	self.hasKey = false
	self:_clearKey()
	if self.world then
		self.world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, self.gateOpen)
	end
	self:_stopHunt()
	self:_controls(false)
	self:_send()
	self.context.Log:Info("Round finished:", phase, "reward:", self.reward)
end

function SoloRound:_canInteract(
	player: Player,
	item: BasePart,
	itemPrompt: ProximityPrompt
): boolean
	if player ~= self.player or self.phase ~= "active" or not itemPrompt.Enabled then
		return false
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - self.interactionAt < 0.25 then
		return false
	end
	self.interactionAt = now
	local character, _, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not character or character ~= self.roundCharacter or not root then
		return false
	end
	if not self.world or not item:IsDescendantOf(self.world.Root) then
		return false
	end
	local direction = item.Position - root.Position
	if direction.Magnitude > self.balance.interaction_radius then
		return false
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local hit = Workspace:Raycast(root.Position, direction, params)
	return not hit or hit.Instance == item
end

function SoloRound:_openGate(player: Player)
	local world = self.world
	if
		not world
		or self.gateOpen
		or not self:_canInteract(player, world.GateAnchor, world.GatePrompt)
	then
		return
	end
	local _, _, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not root or not world:IsGateFront(root.Position) then
		return
	end
	if not self.hasKey then
		self.notice = "corn_loop_need_key"
		self:_send()
		return
	end
	self.hasKey = false
	self.gateOpen = true
	self.notice = ""
	world:SetGateOpen(true)
	self:_send()
end

function SoloRound:_ensureWorld(): boolean
	if self.world then
		return self.world:IsValid()
	end
	local ok, result =
		pcall(AuthoredWorld.new, self.balance.interaction_radius, self.balance.key_slot_count)
	if not ok then
		self.context.Log:Warn("Cannot bind editable CornMap:", result)
		return false
	end
	self.world = result
	if self.selectedSpawn and table.find(self.world.Spawns, self.selectedSpawn) then
		self.world.Spawn = self.selectedSpawn
	end
	table.insert(
		self.connections,
		self.world.GatePrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
			self:_openGate(player)
		end)
	)
	return true
end

function SoloRound:_stopHunt()
	if self.hunt then
		self.hunt:Destroy()
		self.hunt = nil
	end
end

function SoloRound:_bindKey(keyPrompt: ProximityPrompt)
	if self.keyConnection then
		self.keyConnection:Disconnect()
	end
	local epoch = self.epoch
	self.keyConnection = keyPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
		local key = self.world.Key
		if
			self.epoch ~= epoch
			or self.hasKey
			or self.gateOpen
			or not key
			or keyPrompt ~= self.world.KeyPrompt
		then
			return
		end
		if not self:_canInteract(player, key, keyPrompt) then
			return
		end
		self.hasKey = true
		self.notice = ""
		self:_clearKey()
		self:_send()
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_caught(root: BasePart)
	if self.phase ~= "active" then
		return
	end
	self.minimap:RecordCaught(root.Position)
	self.catches += 1
	if self.catches >= self.balance.max_catches then
		self:_finish("caught_out", "corn_hunt_defeat_notice")
		return
	end
	self.elapsed = if self.startedAt then os.clock() - self.startedAt else 0
	self.phase = "caught"
	self.notice = if self.hasKey then "corn_hunt_key_dropped" else "corn_hunt_first_catch"
	local epoch = self.epoch
	if self.hasKey then
		self.hasKey = false
		local prompt = self.world:DropKey(root.Position, self.balance.key_drop_adjust_radius)
		if not prompt then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_hunt_drop_error")
			return
		end
		self:_bindKey(prompt)
	end
	self.world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, self.gateOpen)
	self:_controls(false)
	self:_send()
	task.delay(self.balance.capture_transition_sec, function()
		if self.epoch ~= epoch or self.phase ~= "caught" then
			return
		end
		local character = self:_livingCharacter()
		if not character or character ~= self.roundCharacter then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
			return
		end
		self:_moveToStart(character)
		self.stamina = Stamina.new(self.balance.stamina_capacity, os.clock())
		self.protectedUntil = os.clock() + self.balance.respawn_protection_sec
		self.hunt:ResetHome()
		self.huntAt = os.clock()
		self.phase = "active"
		self.world:SetInteractionEnabled(true, self.gateOpen)
		self:_controls(true)
		self:_send()
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_restoreLighting()
	if self.lightingState then
		LightingModes.Restore(Lighting, self.lightingState)
		self.lightingState = nil
	end
end

function SoloRound:_startRound(mode: string)
	if
		self.phase ~= "ready"
		and self.phase ~= "escaped"
		and self.phase ~= "aborted"
		and self.phase ~= "caught_out"
	then
		return
	end
	if not LightingModes.IsValid(mode) then
		return
	end
	self.minimap:ResetHistory()
	self.lightingMode = mode
	if not self.lightingState then
		self.lightingState = LightingModes.Capture(Lighting)
	end
	LightingModes.Apply(Lighting, mode)
	self.epoch += 1
	self.stamina = Stamina.new(self.balance.stamina_capacity, os.clock())
	self:_stopHunt()
	self.catches = 0
	self.protectedUntil = 0
	local epoch = self.epoch
	self.phase = "preparing"
	self.startedAt = nil
	self.elapsed = 0
	self.reward = 0
	self.notice = ""
	self.hasKey = false
	self.gateOpen = false
	self.roundCharacter = nil
	self:_clearKey()
	self:_controls(false)
	self:_send()
	if not self:_ensureWorld() then
		self:_chooseSpawn()
		local character = self:_livingCharacter()
		if character then
			self:_moveToStart(character)
		end
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
		return
	end
	self:_chooseSpawn()
	self.world:SetGateOpen(false)
	self.world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, false)

	task.spawn(function()
		local deadline = os.clock() + 10
		local character: Model? = nil
		while
			self.epoch == epoch
			and self.phase == "preparing"
			and self.player
			and self.player.Parent == Players
		do
			character = self:_livingCharacter()
			if character or os.clock() >= deadline then
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		if self.epoch ~= epoch or self.phase ~= "preparing" then
			return
		end
		if not character then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
			return
		end
		if not self.world or not self.world:IsValid() then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
			return
		end
		self:_moveToStart(character)
		self.roundCharacter = character
		local slot = self.world.Slots[self.random:NextInteger(1, #self.world.Slots)]
		local keyPrompt = self.world:SpawnKey(slot)
		self:_bindKey(keyPrompt)
		self.startedAt = os.clock()
		local ok, hunt = pcall(MonsterHunt.new, self.world, self.balance, self.startedAt)
		if not ok then
			self.context.Log:Warn("Cannot start hunt:", hunt)
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
			return
		end
		self.hunt = hunt
		self.huntAt = self.startedAt
		self.phase = "active"
		self.world:SetInteractionEnabled(true, false)
		self:_controls(true)
		self:_send()
		self.context.Log:Info("Solo round started")
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_menu()
	if self.phase ~= "escaped" and self.phase ~= "aborted" and self.phase ~= "caught_out" then
		return
	end
	self.epoch += 1
	self.phase = "ready"
	self:_restoreLighting()
	self.reward = 0
	self.elapsed = 0
	self.startedAt = nil
	self.notice = ""
	self.hasKey = false
	self.gateOpen = false
	self:_clearKey()
	if self.world then
		self.world:SetGateOpen(false)
		self.world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, false)
	end
	local character = self:_livingCharacter()
	if character then
		self:_moveToStart(character)
	end
	self:_controls(false)
	self:_send()
end

function SoloRound:_request(player: Player, action: any, mode: any)
	if player ~= self.player then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	self.requestTokens = math.min(2, self.requestTokens + (now - self.requestAt) * 2)
	self.requestAt = now
	if self.requestTokens < 1 then
		return
	end
	self.requestTokens -= 1
	if type(action) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	if action == "sync" then
		self:_send()
	elseif
		(action == "start" and self.phase == "ready")
		or (
			action == "retry"
			and (self.phase == "escaped" or self.phase == "aborted" or self.phase == "caught_out")
		)
	then
		if LightingModes.IsValid(mode) then
			self:_startRound(mode)
		end
	elseif action == "abort" then
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
	elseif action == "menu" then
		self:_menu()
	end
end

function SoloRound:_bindCharacter(character: Model)
	if character == self.boundCharacter then
		return
	end
	self.boundCharacter = character
	if self.deathConnection then
		self.deathConnection:Disconnect()
		self.deathConnection = nil
	end
	if
		self.phase == "active"
		or self.phase == "caught"
		or (self.phase == "preparing" and self.roundCharacter ~= nil)
	then
		self:_recordCharacterDeath(self.roundCharacter)
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
		local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
		local player = self.player
		if not player or player.Character ~= character or self.boundCharacter ~= character then
			return
		end
		if not humanoid or not humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
			return
		end
		self.deathConnection = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			if self.player and self.player.Character == character then
				self:_recordCharacterDeath(character)
				self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
			end
		end)
		if self.phase ~= "active" and self.phase ~= "preparing" then
			self:_moveToStart(character)
		end
		self:_controls(self.phase == "active" and self.roundCharacter == character)
		self:_send()
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_addPlayer(player: Player)
	if self.player then
		return -- One owner, no multiplayer matchmaking in this prototype.
	end
	self.player = player
	self:_setRespawnLocation()
	self.requestTokens = 2
	self.requestAt = os.clock()
	self.characterConnection = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character: Model)
		self:_bindCharacter(character)
	end)
	self.characterRemovingConnection = player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character: Model)
		if
			player == self.player
			and (character == self.boundCharacter or character == player.Character)
		then
			self:_recordCharacterDeath(character)
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
		end
	end)
	if player.Character then
		self:_bindCharacter(player.Character)
	end
	self:_send()
end

function SoloRound:_removePlayer(player: Player)
	if player ~= self.player then
		return
	end
	self.epoch += 1
	self:_clearKey()
	if self.characterConnection then
		self.characterConnection:Disconnect()
		self.characterConnection = nil
	end
	if self.deathConnection then
		self.deathConnection:Disconnect()
		self.deathConnection = nil
	end
	if self.characterRemovingConnection then
		self.characterRemovingConnection:Disconnect()
		self.characterRemovingConnection = nil
	end
	self.player = nil
	self.minimap:ClearHistory()
	self:_restoreLighting()
	self.lightingMode = LightingModes.Default
	self:_stopHunt()
	self.catches = 0
	self.protectedUntil = 0
	self.stamina = Stamina.new(self.balance.stamina_capacity, os.clock())
	self.phase = "ready"
	self.hasKey = false
	self.gateOpen = false
	self.diamonds = 0
	self.reward = 0
	self.startedAt = nil
	self.elapsed = 0
	self.notice = ""
	self.roundCharacter = nil
	self.boundCharacter = nil
	self.controlledCharacter = nil
	if self.world then
		self.world:SetGateOpen(false)
		self.world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, false)
	end
end

function SoloRound:_poll(now: number)
	if self.phase ~= "active" then
		return
	end
	local character, _, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not character or character ~= self.roundCharacter or not root then
		local roundCharacter = self.roundCharacter
		local humanoid = if roundCharacter
			then roundCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			else nil
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			self:_recordCharacterDeath(roundCharacter)
		end
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
		return
	end
	if
		not self.world
		or not self.world:IsValid()
		or not self.world:IsOnPlayground(root.Position)
	then
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
		return
	end
	-- A visit and capture in the same tick both belong to this pre-teleport position.
	self.minimap:Poll(self.world, root.Position)
	if self.hunt then
		local caught, awakened =
			self.hunt:Step(now - self.huntAt, now, root, now < self.protectedUntil)
		self.huntAt = now
		if awakened then
			self.notice = "corn_hunt_awakened"
		end
		if caught then
			self:_caught(root)
			return
		end
	end
	if self.gateOpen and self.world:IsInExit(root.Position) then
		self:_finish("escaped", "")
		return
	end
	if now - self.snapshotAt >= 0.25 then
		self.snapshotAt = now
		self:_send()
	end
end

function SoloRound:_sprintRequest(player: Player, value: any)
	if player ~= self.player then
		return
	end
	local character = self:_livingCharacter()
	Stamina.Request(
		self.stamina,
		value,
		os.clock(),
		self.phase == "active" and character ~= nil and character == self.roundCharacter
	)
end

function SoloRound:_movement(dt: number)
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	local active = self.phase == "active" and character ~= nil and character == self.roundCharacter
	local velocity = if root then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity else Vector3.zero
	local moving = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude > 0.5
	Stamina.Step(self.stamina, dt, moving, active, self.balance)
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = if not active
			then 0
			elseif self.stamina.sprinting then self.balance.sprint_speed
			else self.balance.walk_speed
		humanoid:SetAttribute("corn_stamina", self.stamina.value)
		humanoid:SetAttribute("corn_sprinting", self.stamina.sprinting)
		humanoid:SetAttribute("corn_sprint_exhausted", self.stamina.exhausted)
	end
end

function SoloRound:Start()
	self:_ensureWorld()
	self:_chooseSpawn()
	table.insert(
		self.connections,
		self.sprintIntent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, value: any)
			self:_sprintRequest(player, value)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self.connections,
		self.action.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, action: any, mode: any)
			self:_request(player, action, mode)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self.connections,
		Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
			self:_addPlayer(player)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self.connections,
		Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
			self:_removePlayer(player)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self.connections,
		RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
			self:_movement(dt)
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - self.pollAt >= MinimapState.PollInterval then
				self.pollAt = now
				self:_poll(now)
			end
		end)
	)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		self:_addPlayer(player)
	end
end

return SoloRound
--!strict

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local GameShared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
local Endpoints = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Network"):WaitForChild("EndpointNames"))
local AuthoredWorld = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("AuthoredWorld"))
local MonsterHunt = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MonsterHunt"))
local MinimapState = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MinimapState"))
local Stamina = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("Stamina"))
local Inventory = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("Inventory"))
local InventoryWorld = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("InventoryWorld"))

local LightingModes = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("LightingModes"))

local SoloRound = {}
SoloRound.__index = SoloRound

function SoloRound.new(context: any)
	return setmetatable({
		context = context,
		balance = context.Config.CoreLoop,
		action = context.Services.NetworkService:GetEvent(Endpoints.RequestRoundAction),
		snapshot = context.Services.NetworkService:GetEvent(Endpoints.RoundSnapshot),
		sprintIntent = context.Services.NetworkService:GetEvent(Endpoints.RequestSprintIntent),
		inventoryAction = context.Services.NetworkService:GetEvent(
			Endpoints.RequestInventoryAction
		),
		inventory = Inventory.new(os.clock()),
		items = nil :: any,
		stamina = Stamina.new(context.Config.CoreLoop.stamina_capacity, os.clock()),
		minimap = MinimapState.new(),
		world = nil :: any,
		selectedSpawn = nil :: BasePart?,
		player = nil :: Player?,
		phase = "ready",
		lightingMode = LightingModes.Default,
		lightingState = nil :: any,
		epoch = 0,
		hasKey = false,
		gateOpen = false,
		diamonds = 0,
		reward = 0,
		startedAt = nil :: number?,
		hunt = nil :: any,
		catches = 0,
		protectedUntil = 0,
		huntAt = 0,
		elapsed = 0,
		notice = "",
		random = Random.new(),
		connections = {} :: { RBXScriptConnection },
		characterConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
		characterRemovingConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
		deathConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
		keyConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
		roundCharacter = nil :: Model?,
		boundCharacter = nil :: Model?,
		controlledCharacter = nil :: Model?,
		jumpPower = 50,
		jumpHeight = 7.2,
		autoRotate = true,
		requestTokens = 2,
		requestAt = os.clock(),
		interactionAt = -math.huge,
		pollAt = 0,
		snapshotAt = 0,
	}, SoloRound)
end

function SoloRound:_send()
	local player = self.player
	if not player or player.Parent ~= Players then
		return
	end
	local facing = if self.selectedSpawn
		then self.selectedSpawn.CFrame.LookVector
		else Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	local horizontal = Vector3.new(facing.X, 0, facing.Z)
	local startLook = if horizontal.Magnitude > 0 then horizontal.Unit else Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	self.snapshot:FireClient(player, {
		phase = self.phase,
		lighting_mode = self.lightingMode,
		minimap = self.minimap:Snapshot(),
		inventory = Inventory.Snapshot(self.inventory, os.clock()),
		has_key = self.hasKey,
		gate_open = self.gateOpen,
		session_diamonds = self.diamonds,
		reward_diamonds = self.reward,
		elapsed_sec = if self.phase == "active" and self.startedAt
			then os.clock() - self.startedAt
			else self.elapsed,
		notice = self.notice,
		stamina = self.stamina.value,
		stamina_capacity = self.balance.stamina_capacity,
		is_sprinting = self.stamina.sprinting,
		sprint_exhausted = self.stamina.exhausted,
		start_look = startLook,
		catches_remaining = math.max(0, self.balance.max_catches - self.catches),
		monster_state = if self.hunt then self.hunt.state else "stopped",
		protection_sec = math.max(0, self.protectedUntil - os.clock()),
	})
end

function SoloRound:_livingCharacter(): (Model?, Humanoid?, BasePart?)
	local player = self.player
	local character = if player then player.Character else nil
	if not character or not character.Parent then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end
	return character, humanoid, root
end

function SoloRound:_recordCharacterDeath(character: Model?)
	if
		not character
		or character ~= self.roundCharacter
		or (self.phase ~= "active" and self.phase ~= "caught")
	then
		return
	end
	-- Died runs after Health reaches zero, so _livingCharacter cannot supply this root.
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		self.minimap:RecordDeath(character, root.Position)
	end
end

function SoloRound:_controls(enabled: boolean)
	if not enabled then
		Stamina.Request(self.stamina, false, os.clock(), false)
	end
	local character, humanoid = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not character or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	if self.controlledCharacter ~= character then
		self.controlledCharacter = character
		self.jumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower
		self.jumpHeight = humanoid.JumpHeight
		self.autoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
	end
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = if enabled then self.balance.walk_speed else 0
	humanoid.JumpPower = if enabled then self.jumpPower else 0
	humanoid.JumpHeight = if enabled then self.jumpHeight else 0
	humanoid.AutoRotate = enabled and self.autoRotate
end

function SoloRound:_fallbackSpawn(): BasePart?
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
	then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(AuthoredWorld.FindSafeSpawn, map)
	if not ok then
		self.context.Log:Warn("Cannot find a safe CornMap spawn:", result)
		return nil
	end
	return result
end

function SoloRound:_setRespawnLocation()
	local player = self.player
	if not player then
		return
	end
	local spawn = self.selectedSpawn
	player.RespawnLocation = if spawn
			and spawn:IsA("SpawnLocation")
			and spawn:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)
		then spawn
		else nil
end

function SoloRound:_chooseSpawn()
	if self.world and self.world:IsValid() then
		self.selectedSpawn = self.world:SelectSpawn(self.random:NextInteger(1, #self.world.Spawns))
	else
		self.selectedSpawn = self:_fallbackSpawn()
	end
	self:_setRespawnLocation()
end

function SoloRound:_moveToStart(character: Model)
	local spawn = self.selectedSpawn
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not spawn
		or not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or not AuthoredWorld.IsSafeSpawn(map, spawn)
	then
		spawn = self:_fallbackSpawn()
		self.selectedSpawn = spawn
	end
	if not spawn then
		self.context.Log:Warn("No valid CornMap start; install or repair CornerSpawns")
		return
	end
	self:_setRespawnLocation()
	character:PivotTo(AuthoredWorld.SpawnCFrame(spawn))
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
end

function SoloRound:_clearKey()
	if self.keyConnection then
		self.keyConnection:Disconnect()
		self.keyConnection = nil
	end
	if self.world then
		self.world:ClearKey()
	end
end

function SoloRound:_clearInventory()
	if self.items then
		self.items:Destroy()
		self.items = nil
	end
	self.inventory = Inventory.new(os.clock())
end

function SoloRound:_promptNearby(
	root: BasePart,
	character: Model,
	item: BasePart?,
	itemPrompt: ProximityPrompt?
): boolean
	if not item or not itemPrompt or not itemPrompt.Enabled then
		return false
	end
	local direction = item.Position - root.Position
	if direction.Magnitude > self.balance.interaction_radius then
		return false
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local hit = Workspace:Raycast(root.Position, direction, params)
	return not hit or hit.Instance == item
end

function SoloRound:_inventoryRequest(player: Player, action: any, slot: any)
	if player ~= self.player or self.phase ~= "active" then
		return
	end
	local character, _, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not character or character ~= self.roundCharacter or not root then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if not Inventory.Request(self.inventory, action, slot, now) then
		return
	end
	if action == "select" then
		self:_send()
		return
	end
	if not self.world or not self.world:IsValid() or now - self.interactionAt < 0.35 then
		return
	end
	if
		self:_promptNearby(root, character, self.world.Key, self.world.KeyPrompt)
		or self:_promptNearby(root, character, self.world.GateAnchor, self.world.GatePrompt)
	then
		return
	end
	if self.items then
		for _, entry in self.items.pickups do
			if
				entry.model.Parent
				and self:_promptNearby(root, character, entry.anchor, entry.prompt)
			then
				return
			end
		end
	end
	local kind = self.inventory.slots[slot]
	if kind == "energy" then
		self.inventory.energyUntil = now + Inventory.EnergyDuration
	elseif kind == "trap" then
		if not self.items or not self.items:Place(root, character) then
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
	self.inventory.slots[slot] = "empty"
	self.interactionAt = now
	self.notice = ""
	self:_send()
end

function SoloRound:_finish(phase: string, notice: string)
	if self.phase ~= "active" and self.phase ~= "preparing" and self.phase ~= "caught" then
		return
	end
	-- Fix the terminal state before rewarding or notifying any client.
	self.elapsed = if self.startedAt then os.clock() - self.startedAt else 0
	self.phase = phase
	self.epoch += 1
	self.notice = notice
	self.reward = if phase == "escaped" then self.balance.escape_reward_diamonds else 0
	self.diamonds += self.reward
	self.hasKey = false
	self:_clearInventory()
	self:_clearKey()
	if self.world then
		self.world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, self.gateOpen)
	end
	self:_stopHunt()
	self:_controls(false)
	self:_send()
	self.context.Log:Info("Round finished:", phase, "reward:", self.reward)
end

function SoloRound:_canInteract(
	player: Player,
	item: BasePart,
	itemPrompt: ProximityPrompt
): boolean
	if player ~= self.player or self.phase ~= "active" or not itemPrompt.Enabled then
		return false
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - self.interactionAt < 0.25 then
		return false
	end
	self.interactionAt = now
	local character, _, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not character or character ~= self.roundCharacter or not root then
		return false
	end
	if not self.world or not item:IsDescendantOf(self.world.Root) then
		return false
	end
	local direction = item.Position - root.Position
	if direction.Magnitude > self.balance.interaction_radius then
		return false
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local hit = Workspace:Raycast(root.Position, direction, params)
	return not hit or hit.Instance == item
end

function SoloRound:_openGate(player: Player)
	local world = self.world
	if
		not world
		or self.gateOpen
		or not self:_canInteract(player, world.GateAnchor, world.GatePrompt)
	then
		return
	end
	local _, _, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not root or not world:IsGateFront(root.Position) then
		return
	end
	if not self.hasKey then
		self.notice = "corn_loop_need_key"
		self:_send()
		return
	end
	self.hasKey = false
	self.gateOpen = true
	Inventory.Remove(self.inventory, "key")
	self.notice = ""
	world:SetGateOpen(true)
	self:_send()
end

function SoloRound:_ensureWorld(): boolean
	if self.world then
		return self.world:IsValid()
	end
	local ok, result =
		pcall(AuthoredWorld.new, self.balance.interaction_radius, self.balance.key_slot_count)
	if not ok then
		self.context.Log:Warn("Cannot bind editable CornMap:", result)
		return false
	end
	self.world = result
	if self.selectedSpawn and table.find(self.world.Spawns, self.selectedSpawn) then
		self.world.Spawn = self.selectedSpawn
	end
	table.insert(
		self.connections,
		self.world.GatePrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
			self:_openGate(player)
		end)
	)
	return true
end

function SoloRound:_stopHunt()
	if self.hunt then
		self.hunt:Destroy()
		self.hunt = nil
	end
end

function SoloRound:_bindKey(keyPrompt: ProximityPrompt)
	if self.keyConnection then
		self.keyConnection:Disconnect()
	end
	local epoch = self.epoch
	self.keyConnection = keyPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
		local key = self.world.Key
		if
			self.epoch ~= epoch
			or self.hasKey
			or self.gateOpen
			or not key
			or keyPrompt ~= self.world.KeyPrompt
		then
			return
		end
		if not self:_canInteract(player, key, keyPrompt) then
			return
		end
		if not Inventory.Add(self.inventory, "key") then
			self.notice = "corn_inventory_full"
			self:_send()
			return
		end
		self.hasKey = true
		self.notice = ""
		self:_clearKey()
		self:_send()
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_caught(root: BasePart)
	if self.phase ~= "active" then
		return
	end
	self.minimap:RecordCaught(root.Position)
	self.catches += 1
	if self.catches >= self.balance.max_catches then
		self:_finish("caught_out", "corn_hunt_defeat_notice")
		return
	end
	self.elapsed = if self.startedAt then os.clock() - self.startedAt else 0
	self.phase = "caught"
	self.inventory.energyUntil = 0
	if self.items then
		self.items:SetEnabled(false)
	end
	self.notice = if self.hasKey then "corn_hunt_key_dropped" else "corn_hunt_first_catch"
	local epoch = self.epoch
	if self.hasKey then
		self.hasKey = false
		Inventory.Remove(self.inventory, "key")
		local prompt = self.world:DropKey(root.Position, self.balance.key_drop_adjust_radius)
		if not prompt then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_hunt_drop_error")
			return
		end
		self:_bindKey(prompt)
	end
	self.world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, self.gateOpen)
	self:_controls(false)
	self:_send()
	task.delay(self.balance.capture_transition_sec, function()
		if self.epoch ~= epoch or self.phase ~= "caught" then
			return
		end
		local character = self:_livingCharacter()
		if not character or character ~= self.roundCharacter then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
			return
		end
		self:_moveToStart(character)
		self.stamina = Stamina.new(self.balance.stamina_capacity, os.clock())
		self.protectedUntil = os.clock() + self.balance.respawn_protection_sec
		self.hunt:ResetHome()
		self.huntAt = os.clock()
		self.phase = "active"
		if self.items then
			self.items:SetEnabled(true)
		end
		self.world:SetInteractionEnabled(true, self.gateOpen)
		self:_controls(true)
		self:_send()
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_restoreLighting()
	if self.lightingState then
		LightingModes.Restore(Lighting, self.lightingState)
		self.lightingState = nil
	end
end

function SoloRound:_startRound(mode: string)
	if
		self.phase ~= "ready"
		and self.phase ~= "escaped"
		and self.phase ~= "aborted"
		and self.phase ~= "caught_out"
	then
		return
	end
	if not LightingModes.IsValid(mode) then
		return
	end
	self.minimap:ResetHistory()
	self.lightingMode = mode
	if not self.lightingState then
		self.lightingState = LightingModes.Capture(Lighting)
	end
	LightingModes.Apply(Lighting, mode)
	self.epoch += 1
	self.stamina = Stamina.new(self.balance.stamina_capacity, os.clock())
	self:_stopHunt()
	self:_clearInventory()
	self.catches = 0
	self.protectedUntil = 0
	local epoch = self.epoch
	self.phase = "preparing"
	self.startedAt = nil
	self.elapsed = 0
	self.reward = 0
	self.notice = ""
	self.hasKey = false
	self.gateOpen = false
	self.roundCharacter = nil
	self:_clearKey()
	self:_controls(false)
	self:_send()
	if not self:_ensureWorld() then
		self:_chooseSpawn()
		local character = self:_livingCharacter()
		if character then
			self:_moveToStart(character)
		end
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
		return
	end
	self:_chooseSpawn()
	self.world:SetGateOpen(false)
	self.world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, false)

	task.spawn(function()
		local deadline = os.clock() + 10
		local character: Model? = nil
		while
			self.epoch == epoch
			and self.phase == "preparing"
			and self.player
			and self.player.Parent == Players
		do
			character = self:_livingCharacter()
			if character or os.clock() >= deadline then
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		if self.epoch ~= epoch or self.phase ~= "preparing" then
			return
		end
		if not character then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
			return
		end
		if not self.world or not self.world:IsValid() then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
			return
		end
		self:_moveToStart(character)
		self.roundCharacter = character
		local slot = self.world.Slots[self.random:NextInteger(1, #self.world.Slots)]
		local keyPrompt = self.world:SpawnKey(slot)
		self:_bindKey(keyPrompt)
		self.items = InventoryWorld.new(self.world, self.random, slot, function(player, entry)
			if
				self.epoch ~= epoch
				or not self.items
				or entry.model.Parent ~= self.items.folder
				or not self:_canInteract(player, entry.anchor, entry.prompt)
			then
				return
			end
			if not Inventory.Add(self.inventory, entry.kind) then
				self.notice = "corn_inventory_full"
				self:_send()
				return
			end
			assert(self.items:Take(entry), "Pickup invalidated during server transaction")
			self.notice = ""
			self:_send()
		end)
		self.startedAt = os.clock()
		local ok, hunt = pcall(MonsterHunt.new, self.world, self.balance, self.startedAt)
		if not ok then
			self.context.Log:Warn("Cannot start hunt:", hunt)
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
			return
		end
		self.hunt = hunt
		self.huntAt = self.startedAt
		self.phase = "active"
		self.world:SetInteractionEnabled(true, false)
		self:_controls(true)
		self:_send()
		self.context.Log:Info("Solo round started")
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_menu()
	if self.phase ~= "escaped" and self.phase ~= "aborted" and self.phase ~= "caught_out" then
		return
	end
	self.epoch += 1
	self.phase = "ready"
	self:_restoreLighting()
	self.reward = 0
	self.elapsed = 0
	self.startedAt = nil
	self.notice = ""
	self.hasKey = false
	self.gateOpen = false
	self:_clearKey()
	self:_clearInventory()
	if self.world then
		self.world:SetGateOpen(false)
		self.world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, false)
	end
	local character = self:_livingCharacter()
	if character then
		self:_moveToStart(character)
	end
	self:_controls(false)
	self:_send()
end

function SoloRound:_request(player: Player, action: any, mode: any)
	if player ~= self.player then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	self.requestTokens = math.min(2, self.requestTokens + (now - self.requestAt) * 2)
	self.requestAt = now
	if self.requestTokens < 1 then
		return
	end
	self.requestTokens -= 1
	if type(action) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	if action == "sync" then
		self:_send()
	elseif
		(action == "start" and self.phase == "ready")
		or (
			action == "retry"
			and (self.phase == "escaped" or self.phase == "aborted" or self.phase == "caught_out")
		)
	then
		if LightingModes.IsValid(mode) then
			self:_startRound(mode)
		end
	elseif action == "abort" then
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
	elseif action == "menu" then
		self:_menu()
	end
end

function SoloRound:_bindCharacter(character: Model)
	if character == self.boundCharacter then
		return
	end
	self.boundCharacter = character
	if self.deathConnection then
		self.deathConnection:Disconnect()
		self.deathConnection = nil
	end
	if
		self.phase == "active"
		or self.phase == "caught"
		or (self.phase == "preparing" and self.roundCharacter ~= nil)
	then
		self:_recordCharacterDeath(self.roundCharacter)
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
		local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
		local player = self.player
		if not player or player.Character ~= character or self.boundCharacter ~= character then
			return
		end
		if not humanoid or not humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
			return
		end
		self.deathConnection = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			if self.player and self.player.Character == character then
				self:_recordCharacterDeath(character)
				self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
			end
		end)
		if self.phase ~= "active" and self.phase ~= "preparing" then
			self:_moveToStart(character)
		end
		self:_controls(self.phase == "active" and self.roundCharacter == character)
		self:_send()
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_addPlayer(player: Player)
	if self.player then
		return -- One owner, no multiplayer matchmaking in this prototype.
	end
	self.player = player
	self:_setRespawnLocation()
	self.requestTokens = 2
	self.requestAt = os.clock()
	self.characterConnection = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character: Model)
		self:_bindCharacter(character)
	end)
	self.characterRemovingConnection = player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character: Model)
		if
			player == self.player
			and (character == self.boundCharacter or character == player.Character)
		then
			self:_recordCharacterDeath(character)
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
		end
	end)
	if player.Character then
		self:_bindCharacter(player.Character)
	end
	self:_send()
end

function SoloRound:_removePlayer(player: Player)
	if player ~= self.player then
		return
	end
	self.epoch += 1
	self:_clearKey()
	self:_clearInventory()
	if self.characterConnection then
		self.characterConnection:Disconnect()
		self.characterConnection = nil
	end
	if self.deathConnection then
		self.deathConnection:Disconnect()
		self.deathConnection = nil
	end
	if self.characterRemovingConnection then
		self.characterRemovingConnection:Disconnect()
		self.characterRemovingConnection = nil
	end
	self.player = nil
	self.minimap:ClearHistory()
	self:_restoreLighting()
	self.lightingMode = LightingModes.Default
	self:_stopHunt()
	self.catches = 0
	self.protectedUntil = 0
	self.stamina = Stamina.new(self.balance.stamina_capacity, os.clock())
	self.phase = "ready"
	self.hasKey = false
	self.gateOpen = false
	self.diamonds = 0
	self.reward = 0
	self.startedAt = nil
	self.elapsed = 0
	self.notice = ""
	self.roundCharacter = nil
	self.boundCharacter = nil
	self.controlledCharacter = nil
	if self.world then
		self.world:SetGateOpen(false)
		self.world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, false)
	end
end

function SoloRound:_poll(now: number)
	if self.phase ~= "active" then
		return
	end
	local character, _, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not character or character ~= self.roundCharacter or not root then
		local roundCharacter = self.roundCharacter
		local humanoid = if roundCharacter
			then roundCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			else nil
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			self:_recordCharacterDeath(roundCharacter)
		end
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
		return
	end
	if
		not self.world
		or not self.world:IsValid()
		or not self.world:IsOnPlayground(root.Position)
	then
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
		return
	end
	-- A visit and capture in the same tick both belong to this pre-teleport position.
	self.minimap:Poll(self.world, root.Position)
	if self.hunt then
		local previous = self.hunt:GetPosition()
		if self.items then
			self.items:CheckTraps(self.hunt, previous, now)
		end
		local caught, awakened =
			self.hunt:Step(now - self.huntAt, now, root, now < self.protectedUntil)
		self.huntAt = now
		if self.items and self.items:CheckTraps(self.hunt, previous, now) then
			caught = false
		end
		if awakened then
			self.notice = "corn_hunt_awakened"
		end
		if caught then
			self:_caught(root)
			return
		end
	end
	if self.gateOpen and self.world:IsInExit(root.Position) then
		self:_finish("escaped", "")
		return
	end
	if now - self.snapshotAt >= 0.25 then
		self.snapshotAt = now
		self:_send()
	end
end

function SoloRound:_sprintRequest(player: Player, value: any)
	if player ~= self.player then
		return
	end
	local character = self:_livingCharacter()
	Stamina.Request(
		self.stamina,
		value,
		os.clock(),
		self.phase == "active" and character ~= nil and character == self.roundCharacter
	)
end

function SoloRound:_movement(dt: number)
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	local active = self.phase == "active" and character ~= nil and character == self.roundCharacter
	local velocity = if root then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity else Vector3.zero
	local moving = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude > 0.5
	Stamina.Step(self.stamina, dt, moving, active, self.balance)
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = if not active
			then 0
			elseif self.stamina.sprinting then self.balance.sprint_speed * Inventory.Multiplier(
				self.inventory,
				os.clock()
			)
			else self.balance.walk_speed * Inventory.Multiplier(self.inventory, os.clock())
		humanoid:SetAttribute(
			"corn_energy_remaining",
			Inventory.Snapshot(self.inventory, os.clock()).energy_remaining
		)
		humanoid:SetAttribute("corn_stamina", self.stamina.value)
		humanoid:SetAttribute("corn_sprinting", self.stamina.sprinting)
		humanoid:SetAttribute("corn_sprint_exhausted", self.stamina.exhausted)
	end
end

function SoloRound:Start()
	self:_ensureWorld()
	self:_chooseSpawn()
	table.insert(
		self.connections,
		self.inventoryAction.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, action: any, slot: any)
			self:_inventoryRequest(player, action, slot)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self.connections,
		self.sprintIntent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, value: any)
			self:_sprintRequest(player, value)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self.connections,
		self.action.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, action: any, mode: any)
			self:_request(player, action, mode)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self.connections,
		Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
			self:_addPlayer(player)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self.connections,
		Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
			self:_removePlayer(player)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self.connections,
		RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
			self:_movement(dt)
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - self.pollAt >= MinimapState.PollInterval then
				self.pollAt = now
				self:_poll(now)
			end
		end)
	)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		self:_addPlayer(player)
	end
end

return SoloRound
--!strict

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local GameShared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
local Endpoints = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Network"):WaitForChild("EndpointNames"))
local AuthoredWorld = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("AuthoredWorld"))
local MonsterHunt = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MonsterHunt"))
local MinimapState = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MinimapState"))
local Stamina = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("Stamina"))
local Inventory = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("Inventory"))
local InventoryWorld = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("InventoryWorld"))

local LightingModes = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("LightingModes"))

local SoloRound = {}
SoloRound.__index = SoloRound

function SoloRound.new(context: any)
	return setmetatable({
		context = context,
		balance = context.Config.CoreLoop,
		action = context.Services.NetworkService:GetEvent(Endpoints.RequestRoundAction),
		snapshot = context.Services.NetworkService:GetEvent(Endpoints.RoundSnapshot),
		sprintIntent = context.Services.NetworkService:GetEvent(Endpoints.RequestSprintIntent),
		inventoryAction = context.Services.NetworkService:GetEvent(
			Endpoints.RequestInventoryAction
		),
		inventory = Inventory.new(os.clock()),
		items = nil :: any,
		stamina = Stamina.new(context.Config.CoreLoop.stamina_capacity, os.clock()),
		minimap = MinimapState.new(),
		world = nil :: any,
		selectedSpawn = nil :: BasePart?,
		player = nil :: Player?,
		phase = "ready",
		lightingMode = LightingModes.Default,
		lightingState = nil :: any,
		epoch = 0,
		hasKey = false,
		gateOpen = false,
		diamonds = 0,
		reward = 0,
		startedAt = nil :: number?,
		hunt = nil :: any,
		catches = 0,
		captureFrame = CFrame.identity,
		captureUntil = 0,
		protectedUntil = 0,
		huntAt = 0,
		elapsed = 0,
		notice = "",
		random = Random.new(),
		connections = {} :: { RBXScriptConnection },
		characterConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
		characterRemovingConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
		deathConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
		keyConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
		roundCharacter = nil :: Model?,
		boundCharacter = nil :: Model?,
		controlledCharacter = nil :: Model?,
		jumpPower = 50,
		jumpHeight = 7.2,
		autoRotate = true,
		requestTokens = 2,
		requestAt = os.clock(),
		interactionAt = -math.huge,
		pollAt = 0,
		snapshotAt = 0,
	}, SoloRound)
end

function SoloRound:_send()
	local player = self.player
	if not player or player.Parent ~= Players then
		return
	end
	local facing = if self.selectedSpawn
		then self.selectedSpawn.CFrame.LookVector
		else Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	local horizontal = Vector3.new(facing.X, 0, facing.Z)
	local startLook = if horizontal.Magnitude > 0 then horizontal.Unit else Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	self.snapshot:FireClient(player, {
		phase = self.phase,
		lighting_mode = self.lightingMode,
		minimap = self.minimap:Snapshot(),
		inventory = Inventory.Snapshot(self.inventory, os.clock()),
		has_key = self.hasKey,
		gate_open = self.gateOpen,
		session_diamonds = self.diamonds,
		reward_diamonds = self.reward,
		elapsed_sec = if self.phase == "active" and self.startedAt
			then os.clock() - self.startedAt
			else self.elapsed,
		notice = self.notice,
		stamina = self.stamina.value,
		stamina_capacity = self.balance.stamina_capacity,
		is_sprinting = self.stamina.sprinting,
		sprint_exhausted = self.stamina.exhausted,
		start_look = startLook,
		catches_remaining = math.max(0, self.balance.max_catches - self.catches),
		capture = {
			id = self.catches,
			remaining = math.clamp(self.captureUntil - os.clock(), 0, 1),
			frame = self.captureFrame,
		},
		monster_state = if self.hunt then self.hunt.state else "stopped",
		protection_sec = math.max(0, self.protectedUntil - os.clock()),
	})
end

function SoloRound:_livingCharacter(): (Model?, Humanoid?, BasePart?)
	local player = self.player
	local character = if player then player.Character else nil
	if not character or not character.Parent then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end
	return character, humanoid, root
end

function SoloRound:_recordCharacterDeath(character: Model?)
	if
		not character
		or character ~= self.roundCharacter
		or (self.phase ~= "active" and self.phase ~= "caught")
	then
		return
	end
	-- Died runs after Health reaches zero, so _livingCharacter cannot supply this root.
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		self.minimap:RecordDeath(character, root.Position)
	end
end

function SoloRound:_controls(enabled: boolean)
	if not enabled then
		Stamina.Request(self.stamina, false, os.clock(), false)
	end
	local character, humanoid = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not character or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	if self.controlledCharacter ~= character then
		self.controlledCharacter = character
		self.jumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower
		self.jumpHeight = humanoid.JumpHeight
		self.autoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
	end
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = if enabled then self.balance.walk_speed else 0
	humanoid.JumpPower = if enabled then self.jumpPower else 0
	humanoid.JumpHeight = if enabled then self.jumpHeight else 0
	humanoid.AutoRotate = enabled and self.autoRotate
end

function SoloRound:_fallbackSpawn(): BasePart?
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
	then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(AuthoredWorld.FindSafeSpawn, map)
	if not ok then
		self.context.Log:Warn("Cannot find a safe CornMap spawn:", result)
		return nil
	end
	return result
end

function SoloRound:_setRespawnLocation()
	local player = self.player
	if not player then
		return
	end
	local spawn = self.selectedSpawn
	player.RespawnLocation = if spawn
			and spawn:IsA("SpawnLocation")
			and spawn:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)
		then spawn
		else nil
end

function SoloRound:_chooseSpawn()
	if self.world and self.world:IsValid() then
		self.selectedSpawn = self.world:SelectSpawn(self.random:NextInteger(1, #self.world.Spawns))
	else
		self.selectedSpawn = self:_fallbackSpawn()
	end
	self:_setRespawnLocation()
end

function SoloRound:_moveToStart(character: Model)
	local spawn = self.selectedSpawn
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not spawn
		or not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or not AuthoredWorld.IsSafeSpawn(map, spawn)
	then
		spawn = self:_fallbackSpawn()
		self.selectedSpawn = spawn
	end
	if not spawn then
		self.context.Log:Warn("No valid CornMap start; install or repair CornerSpawns")
		return
	end
	self:_setRespawnLocation()
