end

function MinimapHud:SetVisible(visible: boolean)
	self._gui.Enabled = visible
end

function MinimapHud:SetExpanded(expanded: boolean)
	self._overlay.Visible = expanded
	self._compact.Visible = not expanded
end

function MinimapHud:SetViewport(size: Vector2)
	self._expandedScale.Scale =
		math.min(1, math.max(0.1, math.min((size.X - 32) / 640, (size.Y - 32) / 700)))
	self._compactScale.Scale =
		math.min(1, math.max(0.25, (size.Y - 84) / (Geometry.CompactSize + 68)))
end

function MinimapHud:SetSnapshot(snapshot: any)
	self._visited = snapshot.minimap.visited
	self._deaths = snapshot.minimap.deaths
	self._count.Text = string.format("Проверено: %d / 18", #self._visited)
	for _, view in self._views do
		local visitedIds = {}
		for _, entry in self._visited do
			visitedIds[entry.id] = true
			if not view.Visited[entry.id] then
				local marker = label(
					view.Field,
					"Visited_" .. entry.id,
					UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
					UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					"×",
					if view.Expanded then 22 else 17
				)
				marker.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				marker.ZIndex = 4
				view.Visited[entry.id] = marker
			end
		end
		for id, marker in view.Visited do
			if not visitedIds[id] then
				marker:Destroy()
				view.Visited[id] = nil
			end
		end
		local deathIds = {}
		for _, entry in self._deaths do
			deathIds[entry.id] = true
			if not view.Deaths[entry.id] then
				view.Deaths[entry.id] =
					skull(view.Field, "Death_" .. entry.id, if view.Expanded then 1.2 else 1)
			end
		end
		for id, marker in view.Deaths do
			if not deathIds[id] then
				marker:Destroy()
				view.Deaths[id] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

function MinimapHud:Update(
	fieldFrame: CFrame,
	fieldSize: Vector3,
	playerPosition: Vector3?,
	direction: Vector3?
)
	local ratio = fieldSize.X / math.max(0.001, fieldSize.Z)
	for _, view in self._views do
		view.Field.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.min(1, ratio), math.min(1, 1 / ratio))
		for _, entry in self._visited do
			place(
				view.Visited[entry.id],
				view.Field,
				Geometry.Project(fieldFrame, fieldSize, entry.position)
			)
		end
		for _, entry in self._deaths do
			place(
				view.Deaths[entry.id],
				view.Field,
				Geometry.Project(fieldFrame, fieldSize, entry.position)
			)
		end
		view.Arrow.Visible = playerPosition ~= nil and direction ~= nil
		if playerPosition and direction then
			place(view.Arrow, view.Field, Geometry.Project(fieldFrame, fieldSize, playerPosition))
			view.Arrow.Rotation = Geometry.Heading(fieldFrame, direction)
		end
	end
end

function MinimapHud:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self._onExpand = nil
	self._onClose = nil
	self._gui:Destroy()
end

return MinimapHud

local GATE = Color3.fromRGB(61, 121, 255)

local function round(parent: Instance, radius: number)
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	corner.Parent = parent
end

local function frame(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2,
	color: Color3
): Frame
	local result = Instance.new("Frame")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundColor3 = color
	result.BorderSizePixel = 0
	result.Parent = parent
	return result
end

local function label(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2,
	text: string,
	textSize: number
): TextLabel
	local result = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	result.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	result.TextColor3 = CREAM
	result.TextSize = textSize
	result.Text = text
	result.Parent = parent
	return result
end

local function skull(parent: Instance, name: string, scale: number): Frame
	local marker = frame(
		parent,
		name,
		UDim2.fromOffset(16 * scale, 18 * scale),
		UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		RED
	)
	marker.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	marker.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	marker.ZIndex = 5
	local function part(
		partName: string,
		width: number,
		height: number,
		x: number,
		y: number,
		color: Color3,
		radius: number?
	)
		local item = frame(
			marker,
			partName,
			UDim2.fromOffset(width * scale, height * scale),
			UDim2.fromOffset(x * scale, y * scale),
			color
		)
		item.ZIndex = 6
		if radius then
			round(item, radius * scale)
		end
		return item
	end
	part("Head", 16, 13, 0, 0, RED, 6)
	part("Jaw", 10, 7, 3, 10, RED, 2)
	part("LeftEye", 4, 4, 2, 5, DARK, 1)
	part("RightEye", 4, 4, 10, 5, DARK, 1)
	part("Nose", 2, 3, 7, 8, DARK, 1)
	for x = 5, 11, 3 do
		part("Tooth" .. x, 1, 4, x, 13, DARK)
	end
	return marker
end

local function mapView(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	side: number,
	position: UDim2,
	expanded: boolean
): any
	local box = frame(parent, name, UDim2.fromOffset(side, side), position, PANEL)
	local field = frame(box, "Field", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), FIELD)
	field.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	border.Color = GRID
	border.Thickness = 1
	border.Parent = field
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local fraction = i / 5
		local vertical = frame(
			field,
			"GridColumn" .. i,
			UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0),
			UDim2.fromScale(fraction, 0),
			GRID
		)
		vertical.BackgroundTransparency = 0.68
		local horizontal =
			frame(field, "GridRow" .. i, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0, fraction), GRID)
		horizontal.BackgroundTransparency = 0.68
	end
	local north = label(
		field,
		"North",
		UDim2.fromOffset(24, 20),
		UDim2.new(0.5, -12, 0, 2),
		"С",
		if expanded then 14 else 11
	)
	north.TextColor3 = MUTED
	local scale = if expanded then 1.25 else 1
	local arrow = frame(
		field,
		"PlayerArrow",
		UDim2.fromOffset(16 * scale, 30 * scale),
		UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		PLAYER
	)
	arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	arrow.ZIndex = 7
	arrow.Visible = false
	local shaft = frame(
		arrow,
		"Shaft",
		UDim2.fromOffset(7 * scale, 20 * scale),
		UDim2.fromOffset(4.5 * scale, 8 * scale),
		PLAYER
	)
	shaft.ZIndex = 8
	local shaftBorder = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	shaftBorder.Color = PANEL
	shaftBorder.Thickness = 1
	shaftBorder.Parent = shaft
	-- Solid GUI rows keep the direction tip triangular at every arrow Rotation.
	local tip = frame(
		arrow,
		"Tip",
		UDim2.fromOffset(16 * scale, 10 * scale),
		UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
		PLAYER
	)
	tip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tip.ZIndex = 9
	for row = 1, 7 do
		local slice = frame(
			tip,
			"Slice" .. row,
			UDim2.fromOffset(row * 2 * scale, 1.25 * scale),
			UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, (row + 1) * scale),
			PLAYER
		)
		slice.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		slice.ZIndex = 9
	end
	local gateSide = if expanded then 15 else 10
	local gate = frame(
		field,
		"ExitGate",
		UDim2.fromOffset(gateSide, gateSide),
		UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		GATE
	)
	gate.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	gate.ZIndex = 3
	gate.Visible = false
	local gateBorder = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	gateBorder.Color = CREAM
	gateBorder.Transparency = 0.2
	gateBorder.Thickness = 1
	gateBorder.Parent = gate
	return {
		Field = field,
		Arrow = arrow,
		Gate = gate,
		Visited = {},
		Deaths = {},
		Expanded = expanded,
	}
end

local function place(marker: GuiObject, field: Frame, point: Vector2, padding: number?)
	local dimensions = field.AbsoluteSize
	local inset = padding or 13
	local padX = math.min(0.49, inset / math.max(1, dimensions.X))
	local padY = math.min(0.49, inset / math.max(1, dimensions.Y))
	marker.Position =
		UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(point.X, padX, 1 - padX), math.clamp(point.Y, padY, 1 - padY))
end

function MinimapHud:SetOnExpand(callback: () -> ())
	self._onExpand = callback
end

function MinimapHud:SetOnClose(callback: () -> ())
	self._onClose = callback
end

function MinimapHud:SetVisible(visible: boolean)
	self._gui.Enabled = visible
end

function MinimapHud:SetExpanded(expanded: boolean)
	self._overlay.Visible = expanded
	self._compact.Visible = not expanded
end

function MinimapHud:SetViewport(size: Vector2)
	self._expandedScale.Scale =
		math.min(1, math.max(0.1, math.min((size.X - 32) / 640, (size.Y - 32) / 700)))
	self._compactScale.Scale =
		math.min(1, math.max(0.25, (size.Y - 84) / (Geometry.CompactSize + 68)))
end

function MinimapHud:SetSnapshot(snapshot: any)
	self._visited = snapshot.minimap.visited
	self._deaths = snapshot.minimap.deaths
	self._count.Text = string.format("Проверено: %d / 18", #self._visited)
	for _, view in self._views do
		local visitedIds = {}
		for _, entry in self._visited do
			visitedIds[entry.id] = true
			if not view.Visited[entry.id] then
				local marker = label(
					view.Field,
					"Visited_" .. entry.id,
					UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
					UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					"×",
					if view.Expanded then 22 else 17
				)
				marker.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				marker.ZIndex = 4
				view.Visited[entry.id] = marker
			end
		end
		for id, marker in view.Visited do
			if not visitedIds[id] then
				marker:Destroy()
				view.Visited[id] = nil
			end
		end
		local deathIds = {}
		for _, entry in self._deaths do
			deathIds[entry.id] = true
			if not view.Deaths[entry.id] then
				view.Deaths[entry.id] =
					skull(view.Field, "Death_" .. entry.id, if view.Expanded then 1.2 else 1)
			end
		end
		for id, marker in view.Deaths do
			if not deathIds[id] then
				marker:Destroy()
				view.Deaths[id] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

function MinimapHud:Update(
	fieldFrame: CFrame,
	fieldSize: Vector3,
	playerPosition: Vector3?,
	direction: Vector3?,
	gatePosition: Vector3?
)
	local ratio = fieldSize.X / math.max(0.001, fieldSize.Z)
	for _, view in self._views do
		view.Field.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.min(1, ratio), math.min(1, 1 / ratio))
		for _, entry in self._visited do
			place(
				view.Visited[entry.id],
				view.Field,
				Geometry.Project(fieldFrame, fieldSize, entry.position)
			)
		end
		for _, entry in self._deaths do
			place(
				view.Deaths[entry.id],
				view.Field,
				Geometry.Project(fieldFrame, fieldSize, entry.position)
			)
		end
		view.Gate.Visible = gatePosition ~= nil
		if gatePosition then
			place(
				view.Gate,
				view.Field,
				Geometry.Project(fieldFrame, fieldSize, gatePosition),
				if view.Expanded then 10 else 7
			)
		end
		view.Arrow.Visible = playerPosition ~= nil and direction ~= nil
		if playerPosition and direction then
			place(
				view.Arrow,
				view.Field,
				Geometry.Project(fieldFrame, fieldSize, playerPosition),
				if view.Expanded then 22 else 18
			)
			view.Arrow.Rotation = Geometry.Heading(fieldFrame, direction)
		end
	end
end

function MinimapHud:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self._onExpand = nil
	self._onClose = nil
	self._gui:Destroy()
end

return MinimapHud

local PANEL_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(27, 32, 28)
local TEXT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(239, 242, 233)
local MUTED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(190, 199, 186)
local BUTTON_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(84, 109, 67)
local DISABLED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(63, 69, 61)

local function text(key: string, values: { [string]: string | number }?): string
	local template = RoundText[key] or ""
	return (
		string.gsub(template, "{([%w_]+)}", function(name)
			local value = if values then values[name] else nil
			return if value ~= nil then tostring(value) else "{" .. name .. "}"
		end)
	)
end

local function elapsedText(seconds: number): string
	local whole = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(whole / 60), whole % 60)
end

local function label(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2,
	fontSize: number
): TextLabel
	local result = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	result.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	result.TextSize = fontSize
	result.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
	result.TextWrapped = true
	result.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	result.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	result.Text = ""
	result.Parent = parent
	return result
end

local function button(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	key: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2
): TextButton
	local result = Instance.new("TextButton")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundColor3 = BUTTON_COLOR
	result.BorderSizePixel = 0
	result.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium

	corner.Parent = result

end

local function modePreview(parent: Instance, mode: string)
	local profile = (LightingModes.Profiles :: any)[mode]
	local sky = Instance.new("Frame")
	sky.Name = "LightingPreview"
	sky.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 112)
	sky.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
	sky.BorderSizePixel = 0
	sky.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	sky.ClipsDescendants = true
	sky.Parent = parent
	local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(profile.SkyTop, profile.SkyBottom)
	gradient.Rotation = 90
	gradient.Parent = sky
	local sun = Instance.new("Frame")
	sun.Name = if mode == "hard" then "Moon" else "Sun"
	sun.Size =
		UDim2.fromOffset(if mode == "hard" then 12 else 22, if mode == "hard" then 12 else 22)
	sun.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.76, if mode == "medium" then 0.46 else 0.16)
	sun.BackgroundColor3 = if mode == "hard"
		then Color3.fromRGB(185, 203, 220)
		else Color3.fromRGB(255, 224, 158)
	sun.BorderSizePixel = 0
	sun.Parent = sky
	local circle = Instance.new("UICorner")
	circle.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	circle.Parent = sun
	local view = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	view.Name = "FieldImage"
	view.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	view.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	view.Ambient = profile.Ambient
	view.LightColor = if mode == "easy"
		then Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 204)
		elseif mode == "medium" then Color3.fromRGB(182, 126, 90)
		else Color3.fromRGB(65, 80, 110)
	view.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.5, -1, -0.3)
	view.Parent = sky
	local world = Instance.new("WorldModel")
	world.Parent = view
	local function part(
		name: string,
		size: Vector3,
		frame: CFrame,
		color: Color3,
		neon: boolean?
	): Part
		local item = Instance.new("Part")
		item.Name = name
		item.Size = size
		item.CFrame = frame
		item.Color = color
		item.Anchored = true
		item.CanCollide = false
		item.CastShadow = false
		item.Material = if neon then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		item.Parent = world
		return item
	end
	part("Ground", Vector3.new(28, 0.4, 28), CFrame.new(0, -0.2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(74, 70, 39))
	for row = 1, 4 do
		for column = 1, 6 do
			local x, z = (column - 3.5) * 3.4, (row - 2.5) * 3.4
			if math.abs(x) > 2.5 or row > 2 then
				local height = 4.5 + ((row + column) % 3) * 0.35
				part(
					"Stalk",
					Vector3.new(0.15, height, 0.15),
					CFrame.new(x, height / 2, z),
					Color3.fromRGB(120, 126, 53)
				)
				for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
					part(
						"Leaf",
						Vector3.new(2, 0.25, 0.7),
						CFrame.new(x + side * 0.65, height * 0.6, z)
							* CFrame.Angles(0, row * 0.4, side * 0.4),
						Color3.fromRGB(99, 119, 43)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	part("House", Vector3.new(5, 4, 4), CFrame.new(-8, 2, -9), Color3.fromRGB(84, 60, 46))
	part("Roof", Vector3.new(6, 0.5, 5), CFrame.new(-8, 4.2, -9), Color3.fromRGB(51, 42, 40))
	part("TorchPole", Vector3.new(0.3, 7, 0.3), CFrame.new(2.4, 3.5, 1), Color3.fromRGB(86, 60, 38))
	if profile.Torches then
		part(
			"TorchFlame",
			Vector3.new(0.7, 1.2, 0.7),
			CFrame.new(2.4, 7.3, 1),
			Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 51),
			true
		)
	end
	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 48
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(16, 12, 23), Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0))
	camera.Parent = view
	view.CurrentCamera = camera
	if mode == "hard" then
		local fog = Instance.new("Frame")
		fog.Name = "Mist"
		fog.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		fog.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fog.BackgroundColor3 = profile.FogColor
		fog.BackgroundTransparency = 0.65
		fog.Parent = sky
		local fade = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		fade.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 0.7),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
		fade.Parent = fog
	end
end

					self:_render()
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			self:_fitCard()
		end)
	)
	self:_render()
	return self
end

function RoundHud:_fitCard()
	local viewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		self._cardScale.Scale = math.min(
			1,
			(viewport.X - 36) / self._card.Size.X.Offset,
			(viewport.Y - 36) / self._card.Size.Y.Offset
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:SetOnAction(callback: (string, string?) -> ())
	local bindings = {
		{ button = self._start, action = "start" },
		{ button = self._retry, action = "retry" },
		{ button = self._menu, action = "menu" },
		{ button = self._preparingLeave, action = "abort" },
		{ button = self._activeLeave, action = "abort" },
	}
	for _, binding in bindings do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			binding.button.Activated:Connect(function()
				if not self._busy and not self._unavailable and self._snapshot ~= nil then
					callback(
						binding.action,
						if binding.action == "start" or binding.action == "retry"
							then self._selectedMode
							else nil
					)
				end
			end)
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_render()
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local phase = if snapshot then snapshot.phase else "loading"
	local isActive = phase == "active"
	local isResult = phase == "escaped" or phase == "aborted" or phase == "caught_out"
	local expanded = phase == "ready" or isResult
	self._card.Size = if expanded then UDim2.fromOffset(780, 510) else UDim2.fromOffset(460, 320)
	self._modeCards.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Visible = expanded
	self._modeHint.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Text =
		text("corn_modes_selected", { mode = text("corn_modes_" .. self._selectedMode) })
	self._modeHint.Text = text("corn_modes_hint")
	self._message.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 62 else 68)
	self._message.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 32 else 52)
	self._time.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 96 else 124)
	self._time.Visible = not expanded or isResult
	self._time.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 22 else 26)
	self._chooseMode.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if isResult then 118 else 110)
	self._balance.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 420 else 154)
	self._notice.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 392 else 186)
	self._notice.Visible = not expanded
	for _, control in { self._start, self._retry, self._menu, self._preparingLeave } do
		control.Position = UDim2.new(
			control.Position.X.Scale,
			control.Position.X.Offset,
			0,
			if expanded then 456 else 250
		)
	end
	for mode, control in self._modeButtons do
		local enabled = expanded and snapshot ~= nil and not self._busy and not self._unavailable
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		local selected = mode == self._selectedMode
		control.Text = text(if selected then "corn_modes_selected_button" else "corn_modes_select")
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled
			then (if selected then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR)
			else DISABLED_COLOR
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Color = if selected
			then Color3.fromRGB(204, 190, 114)
			else Color3.fromRGB(61, 71, 60)
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Transparency = if selected then 0 else 0.6
	end
	self:_fitCard()
	self._card.Visible = not isActive
	self._active.Visible = isActive
	self._activeLeave.Visible = isActive
	self._start.Visible = phase == "ready" or phase == "loading"
	self._retry.Visible = isResult
	self._menu.Visible = isResult
	self._preparingLeave.Visible = phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught"
	for _, control in self._buttons do
		local enabled = snapshot ~= nil and not self._busy and not self._unavailable
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.TextTransparency = if enabled then 0 else 0.35
	end

	self._title.Text = text("corn_loop_title")
	self._time.Text = ""
	self._notice.Text = if snapshot then text(snapshot.notice) else ""
	self._balance.Visible = snapshot ~= nil
	self._balance.Text = text(
		"corn_loop_test_balance",
		{ count = if snapshot then snapshot.session_diamonds else 0 }
	)
	if self._unavailable then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_loop_connection_error")
	elseif phase == "loading" or phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught" then
		self._message.Text = if phase == "caught"
			then text(snapshot and snapshot.notice or "corn_hunt_first_catch")
			else text("corn_loop_loading")
	elseif phase == "ready" then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_modes_choose")
	elseif snapshot and isResult then
		self._title.Text = text(
			if phase == "escaped"
				then "corn_loop_result_escape"
				elseif phase == "caught_out" then "corn_hunt_defeat"
				else "corn_loop_result_aborted"
		)
		self._message.Text = if phase == "escaped"
			then text("corn_loop_reward", { count = snapshot.reward_diamonds })
			else ""
		self._time.Text = text("corn_loop_round_time", { time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) })
	end

	if snapshot and isActive then
		local objectiveKey = if snapshot.gate_open
			then "corn_loop_objective_exit"
			elseif snapshot.has_key then "corn_loop_objective_return"
			else "corn_loop_objective_search"
		self._objective.Text = text(objectiveKey)
		self._activeTime.Text = text(
			"corn_loop_round_time",
			{ time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) }
		) .. " · " .. text(
			"corn_modes_active",
			{ mode = text("corn_modes_" .. snapshot.lighting_mode) }
		)
		self._activeBalance.Text = self._balance.Text
		self._activeNotice.Text = if snapshot.protection_sec > 0
			then text("corn_hunt_protected", { seconds = math.ceil(snapshot.protection_sec) })
			else text(snapshot.notice)
		self._activeBalance.Text ..= " · " .. text(
			"corn_hunt_attempts",
			{ count = snapshot.catches_remaining }
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:Render(snapshot: Snapshot)
	self._unavailable = false
	if snapshot.phase ~= self._lastPhase and snapshot.phase ~= "ready" then
		self._selectedMode = snapshot.lighting_mode
	end
	self._lastPhase = snapshot.phase
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetBusy(busy: boolean)
	self._busy = busy
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:ShowUnavailable()
	self._unavailable = true
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._root:Destroy()
end

return RoundHud

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RoundText: { [string]: string } = require(
	ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("RoundText")
)

local LightingModes = require(ReplicatedStorage.GameShared.Game.LightingModes)

local MinimapGeometry = require(ReplicatedStorage.GameShared.Game.MinimapGeometry)

export type Snapshot = {
	minimap: MinimapGeometry.History,
	lighting_mode: string,
	phase: string,
	has_key: boolean,
	gate_open: boolean,
	session_diamonds: number,
	reward_diamonds: number,
	elapsed_sec: number,
	notice: string,
	stamina: number,
	stamina_capacity: number,
	is_sprinting: boolean,
	sprint_exhausted: boolean,
	start_look: Vector3,
	catches_remaining: number,
	monster_state: string,
	protection_sec: number,
}

local RoundHud = {}
RoundHud.__index = RoundHud

local PANEL_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(27, 32, 28)
local TEXT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(239, 242, 233)
local MUTED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(190, 199, 186)
local BUTTON_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(84, 109, 67)
local DISABLED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(63, 69, 61)
local NOTICE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(233, 209, 142)
local CHASE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(233, 94, 83)

local function text(key: string, values: { [string]: string | number }?): string
	local template = RoundText[key] or ""
	return (
		string.gsub(template, "{([%w_]+)}", function(name)
			local value = if values then values[name] else nil
			return if value ~= nil then tostring(value) else "{" .. name .. "}"
		end)
	)
end

local function elapsedText(seconds: number): string
	local whole = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(whole / 60), whole % 60)
end

local function label(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2,
	fontSize: number
): TextLabel
	local result = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	result.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	result.TextSize = fontSize
	result.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
	result.TextWrapped = true
	result.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	result.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	result.Text = ""
	result.Parent = parent
	return result
end

local function button(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	key: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2
): TextButton
	local result = Instance.new("TextButton")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundColor3 = BUTTON_COLOR
	result.BorderSizePixel = 0
	result.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	result.TextSize = 17
	result.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
	result.Text = text(key)
	result.Modal = parent.Name == "RoundCard"
	result.Parent = parent
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = result
	return result
end

local function panel(parent: Instance, name: string, size: UDim2, position: UDim2): Frame
	local result = Instance.new("Frame")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_COLOR
	result.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
	result.BorderSizePixel = 0
	result.Parent = parent
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = result
	return result
end

local function modePreview(parent: Instance, mode: string)
	local profile = (LightingModes.Profiles :: any)[mode]
	local sky = Instance.new("Frame")
	sky.Name = "LightingPreview"
	sky.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 112)
	sky.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
	sky.BorderSizePixel = 0
	sky.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	sky.ClipsDescendants = true
	sky.Parent = parent
	local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(profile.SkyTop, profile.SkyBottom)
	gradient.Rotation = 90
	gradient.Parent = sky
	local sun = Instance.new("Frame")
	sun.Name = if mode == "hard" then "Moon" else "Sun"
	sun.Size =
		UDim2.fromOffset(if mode == "hard" then 12 else 22, if mode == "hard" then 12 else 22)
	sun.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.76, if mode == "medium" then 0.46 else 0.16)
	sun.BackgroundColor3 = if mode == "hard"
		then Color3.fromRGB(185, 203, 220)
		else Color3.fromRGB(255, 224, 158)
	sun.BorderSizePixel = 0
	sun.Parent = sky
	local circle = Instance.new("UICorner")
	circle.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	circle.Parent = sun
	local view = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	view.Name = "FieldImage"
	view.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	view.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	view.Ambient = profile.Ambient
	view.LightColor = if mode == "easy"
		then Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 204)
		elseif mode == "medium" then Color3.fromRGB(182, 126, 90)
		else Color3.fromRGB(65, 80, 110)
	view.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.5, -1, -0.3)
	view.Parent = sky
	local world = Instance.new("WorldModel")
	world.Parent = view
	local function part(
		name: string,
		size: Vector3,
		frame: CFrame,
		color: Color3,
		neon: boolean?
	): Part
		local item = Instance.new("Part")
		item.Name = name
		item.Size = size
		item.CFrame = frame
		item.Color = color
		item.Anchored = true
		item.CanCollide = false
		item.CastShadow = false
		item.Material = if neon then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		item.Parent = world
		return item
	end
	part("Ground", Vector3.new(28, 0.4, 28), CFrame.new(0, -0.2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(74, 70, 39))
	for row = 1, 4 do
		for column = 1, 6 do
			local x, z = (column - 3.5) * 3.4, (row - 2.5) * 3.4
			if math.abs(x) > 2.5 or row > 2 then
				local height = 4.5 + ((row + column) % 3) * 0.35
				part(
					"Stalk",
					Vector3.new(0.15, height, 0.15),
					CFrame.new(x, height / 2, z),
					Color3.fromRGB(120, 126, 53)
				)
				for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
					part(
						"Leaf",
						Vector3.new(2, 0.25, 0.7),
						CFrame.new(x + side * 0.65, height * 0.6, z)
							* CFrame.Angles(0, row * 0.4, side * 0.4),
						Color3.fromRGB(99, 119, 43)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	part("House", Vector3.new(5, 4, 4), CFrame.new(-8, 2, -9), Color3.fromRGB(84, 60, 46))
	part("Roof", Vector3.new(6, 0.5, 5), CFrame.new(-8, 4.2, -9), Color3.fromRGB(51, 42, 40))
	part("TorchPole", Vector3.new(0.3, 7, 0.3), CFrame.new(2.4, 3.5, 1), Color3.fromRGB(86, 60, 38))
	if profile.Torches then
		part(
			"TorchFlame",
			Vector3.new(0.7, 1.2, 0.7),
			CFrame.new(2.4, 7.3, 1),
			Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 51),
			true
		)
	end
	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 48
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(16, 12, 23), Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0))
	camera.Parent = view
	view.CurrentCamera = camera
	if mode == "hard" then
		local fog = Instance.new("Frame")
		fog.Name = "Mist"
		fog.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		fog.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fog.BackgroundColor3 = profile.FogColor
		fog.BackgroundTransparency = 0.65
		fog.Parent = sky
		local fade = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		fade.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 0.7),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
		fade.Parent = fog
	end
end

			modeCards,
			mode,
			UDim2.new(1 / 3, -8, 1, 0),
			UDim2.new((index - 1) / 3, (index - 1) * 4, 0, 0)
		)
		option.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 45, 38)
		local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Thickness = 2
		stroke.Parent = option
		modeStrokes[mode] = stroke
		modePreview(option, mode)
		local name = label(option, "Name", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28), UDim2.fromOffset(10, 128), 21)
		name.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		name.Text = text("corn_modes_" .. mode)
		local description =
			label(option, "Description", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30), UDim2.fromOffset(10, 160), 15)
		description.TextColor3 = MUTED_COLOR
		description.Text = text("corn_modes_" .. mode .. "_desc")
		local select = button(
			option,
			"Select",
			"corn_modes_select",
			UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 32),
			UDim2.fromOffset(10, 200)
		)
		select.Modal = true
		modeButtons[mode] = select
	end

	local active = panel(root, "ActiveStatus", UDim2.new(0.64, 0, 0, 128), UDim2.fromOffset(20, 16))
	local activeConstraint = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
	activeConstraint.MaxSize = Vector2.new(690, 128)
	activeConstraint.Parent = active
	local objective =
		label(active, "Objective", UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 32), UDim2.fromOffset(16, 8), 19)
	objective.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	local activeTime =
		label(active, "Elapsed", UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(16, 42), 15)
	activeTime.TextColor3 = MUTED_COLOR
	local activeBalance =
		label(active, "Balance", UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(16, 66), 15)
	activeBalance.TextColor3 = MUTED_COLOR
	local activeNotice =
		label(active, "Notice", UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(16, 94), 16)
	activeNotice.TextColor3 = notice.TextColor3
	local activeLeave = button(
		root,
		"LeaveRound",
		"corn_loop_leave",
		UDim2.fromOffset(185, 40),
		UDim2.new(1, -205, 0, 16)
	)

	local self = setmetatable({
		_root = root,
		_card = card,
		_cardScale = cardScale,
		_modeCards = modeCards,
		_chooseMode = choose,
		_modeHint = modeHint,
		_modeButtons = modeButtons,
		_modeStrokes = modeStrokes,
		_selectedMode = LightingModes.Default,
		_lastPhase = "loading",
		_title = title,
		_message = message,
		_time = resultTime,
		_balance = balance,
		_notice = notice,
		_active = active,
		_objective = objective,
		_activeTime = activeTime,
		_activeBalance = activeBalance,
		_activeNotice = activeNotice,
		_start = start,
		_retry = retry,
		_menu = menu,
		_preparingLeave = preparingLeave,
		_activeLeave = activeLeave,
		_buttons = { start, retry, menu, preparingLeave, activeLeave },
		_connections = {} :: { RBXScriptConnection },
		_snapshot = nil :: Snapshot?,
		_busy = false,
		_unavailable = false,
	}, RoundHud)
	for mode, select in modeButtons do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			select.Activated:Connect(function()
				if not self._busy and not self._unavailable and self._snapshot then
					self._selectedMode = mode
					self:_render()
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			self:_fitCard()
		end)
	)
	self:_render()
	return self
end

function RoundHud:_fitCard()
	local viewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		self._cardScale.Scale = math.min(
			1,
			(viewport.X - 36) / self._card.Size.X.Offset,
			(viewport.Y - 36) / self._card.Size.Y.Offset
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:SetOnAction(callback: (string, string?) -> ())
	local bindings = {
		{ button = self._start, action = "start" },
		{ button = self._retry, action = "retry" },
		{ button = self._menu, action = "menu" },
		{ button = self._preparingLeave, action = "abort" },
		{ button = self._activeLeave, action = "abort" },
	}
	for _, binding in bindings do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			binding.button.Activated:Connect(function()
				if not self._busy and not self._unavailable and self._snapshot ~= nil then
					callback(
						binding.action,
						if binding.action == "start" or binding.action == "retry"
							then self._selectedMode
							else nil
					)
				end
			end)
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_render()
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local phase = if snapshot then snapshot.phase else "loading"
	local isActive = phase == "active"
	local isResult = phase == "escaped" or phase == "aborted" or phase == "caught_out"
	local expanded = phase == "ready" or isResult
	self._card.Size = if expanded then UDim2.fromOffset(780, 510) else UDim2.fromOffset(460, 320)
	self._modeCards.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Visible = expanded
	self._modeHint.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Text =
		text("corn_modes_selected", { mode = text("corn_modes_" .. self._selectedMode) })
	self._modeHint.Text = text("corn_modes_hint")
	self._message.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 62 else 68)
	self._message.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 32 else 52)
	self._time.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 96 else 124)
	self._time.Visible = not expanded or isResult
	self._time.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 22 else 26)
	self._chooseMode.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if isResult then 118 else 110)
	self._balance.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 420 else 154)
	self._notice.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 392 else 186)
	self._notice.Visible = not expanded
	for _, control in { self._start, self._retry, self._menu, self._preparingLeave } do
		control.Position = UDim2.new(
			control.Position.X.Scale,
			control.Position.X.Offset,
			0,
			if expanded then 456 else 250
		)
	end
	for mode, control in self._modeButtons do
		local enabled = expanded and snapshot ~= nil and not self._busy and not self._unavailable
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		local selected = mode == self._selectedMode
		control.Text = text(if selected then "corn_modes_selected_button" else "corn_modes_select")
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled
			then (if selected then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR)
			else DISABLED_COLOR
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Color = if selected
			then Color3.fromRGB(204, 190, 114)
			else Color3.fromRGB(61, 71, 60)
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Transparency = if selected then 0 else 0.6
	end
	self:_fitCard()
	self._card.Visible = not isActive
	self._active.Visible = isActive
	self._activeLeave.Visible = isActive
	self._start.Visible = phase == "ready" or phase == "loading"
	self._retry.Visible = isResult
	self._menu.Visible = isResult
	self._preparingLeave.Visible = phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught"
	for _, control in self._buttons do
		local enabled = snapshot ~= nil and not self._busy and not self._unavailable
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.TextTransparency = if enabled then 0 else 0.35
	end

	self._title.Text = text("corn_loop_title")
	self._time.Text = ""
	self._notice.Text = if snapshot then text(snapshot.notice) else ""
	self._balance.Visible = snapshot ~= nil
	self._balance.Text = text(
		"corn_loop_test_balance",
		{ count = if snapshot then snapshot.session_diamonds else 0 }
	)
	if self._unavailable then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_loop_connection_error")
	elseif phase == "loading" or phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught" then
		self._message.Text = if phase == "caught"
			then text(snapshot and snapshot.notice or "corn_hunt_first_catch")
			else text("corn_loop_loading")
	elseif phase == "ready" then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_modes_choose")
	elseif snapshot and isResult then
		self._title.Text = text(
			if phase == "escaped"
				then "corn_loop_result_escape"
				elseif phase == "caught_out" then "corn_hunt_defeat"
				else "corn_loop_result_aborted"
		)
		self._message.Text = if phase == "escaped"
			then text("corn_loop_reward", { count = snapshot.reward_diamonds })
			else ""
		self._time.Text = text("corn_loop_round_time", { time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) })
	end

	-- Clear inactive/stale warning styling before rendering this confirmed state.
	self._activeNotice.Text = ""
	self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = NOTICE_COLOR
	self._activeNotice.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	if snapshot and isActive then
		local objectiveKey = if snapshot.gate_open
			then "corn_loop_objective_exit"
			elseif snapshot.has_key then "corn_loop_objective_return"
			else "corn_loop_objective_search"
		self._objective.Text = text(objectiveKey)
		self._activeTime.Text = text(
			"corn_loop_round_time",
			{ time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) }
		) .. " · " .. text(
			"corn_modes_active",
			{ mode = text("corn_modes_" .. snapshot.lighting_mode) }
		)
		self._activeBalance.Text = self._balance.Text
		local chasing = snapshot.protection_sec <= 0 and snapshot.monster_state == "chase"
		self._activeNotice.Text = if snapshot.protection_sec > 0
			then text("corn_hunt_protected", { seconds = math.ceil(snapshot.protection_sec) })
			elseif chasing then text("corn_hunt_chase")
			else text(snapshot.notice)
		self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = if chasing then CHASE_COLOR else NOTICE_COLOR
		self._activeNotice.Font = if chasing then Enum.Font.GothamBold else Enum.Font.Gotham
		self._activeBalance.Text ..= " · " .. text(
			"corn_hunt_attempts",
			{ count = snapshot.catches_remaining }
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:Render(snapshot: Snapshot)
	self._unavailable = false
	if snapshot.phase ~= self._lastPhase and snapshot.phase ~= "ready" then
		self._selectedMode = snapshot.lighting_mode
	end
	self._lastPhase = snapshot.phase
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetBusy(busy: boolean)
	self._busy = busy
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:ShowUnavailable()
	self._unavailable = true
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._root:Destroy()
end

return RoundHud
--!strict

	ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("RoundText")
)

local MinimapGeometry = require(ReplicatedStorage.GameShared.Game.MinimapGeometry)

export type Snapshot = {
	minimap: MinimapGeometry.History,
	lighting_mode: string,
	phase: string,
	has_key: boolean,
	gate_open: boolean,
	session_diamonds: number,
	reward_diamonds: number,
	elapsed_sec: number,
	notice: string,
	stamina: number,
	stamina_capacity: number,
	is_sprinting: boolean,
	sprint_exhausted: boolean,
	start_look: Vector3,
	catches_remaining: number,
	monster_state: string,
	protection_sec: number,
}

local RoundHud = {}
RoundHud.__index = RoundHud

local PANEL_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(27, 32, 28)
local TEXT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(239, 242, 233)
local MUTED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(190, 199, 186)
local BUTTON_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(84, 109, 67)
local DISABLED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(63, 69, 61)
local NOTICE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(233, 209, 142)
local CHASE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(233, 94, 83)

local function text(key: string, values: { [string]: string | number }?): string
	local template = RoundText[key] or ""
	return (
		string.gsub(template, "{([%w_]+)}", function(name)
			local value = if values then values[name] else nil
			return if value ~= nil then tostring(value) else "{" .. name .. "}"
		end)
	)
end

local function elapsedText(seconds: number): string
	local whole = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(whole / 60), whole % 60)
end

local function label(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2,
	fontSize: number
): TextLabel
	local result = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	result.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	result.TextSize = fontSize
	result.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
	result.TextWrapped = true
	result.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	result.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	result.Text = ""
	result.Parent = parent
	return result
end

local function button(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	key: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2
): TextButton
	local result = Instance.new("TextButton")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundColor3 = BUTTON_COLOR
	result.BorderSizePixel = 0
	result.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	result.TextSize = 17
	result.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
	result.Text = text(key)
	result.Modal = parent.Name == "RoundCard"
	result.Parent = parent
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = result
	return result
end

local function panel(parent: Instance, name: string, size: UDim2, position: UDim2): Frame
	local result = Instance.new("Frame")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_COLOR
	result.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
	result.BorderSizePixel = 0
	result.Parent = parent
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = result
	return result
end

local function modePreview(parent: Instance, mode: string)
	local profile = (LightingModes.Profiles :: any)[mode]
	local sky = Instance.new("Frame")
	sky.Name = "LightingPreview"
	sky.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 112)
	sky.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
	sky.BorderSizePixel = 0
	sky.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	sky.ClipsDescendants = true
	sky.Parent = parent
	local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(profile.SkyTop, profile.SkyBottom)
	gradient.Rotation = 90
	gradient.Parent = sky
	local sun = Instance.new("Frame")
	sun.Name = if mode == "hard" then "Moon" else "Sun"
	sun.Size =
		UDim2.fromOffset(if mode == "hard" then 12 else 22, if mode == "hard" then 12 else 22)
	sun.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.76, if mode == "medium" then 0.46 else 0.16)
	sun.BackgroundColor3 = if mode == "hard"
		then Color3.fromRGB(185, 203, 220)
		else Color3.fromRGB(255, 224, 158)
	sun.BorderSizePixel = 0
	sun.Parent = sky
	local circle = Instance.new("UICorner")
	circle.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	circle.Parent = sun
	local view = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	view.Name = "FieldImage"
	view.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	view.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	view.Ambient = profile.Ambient
	view.LightColor = if mode == "easy"
		then Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 204)
		elseif mode == "medium" then Color3.fromRGB(182, 126, 90)
		else Color3.fromRGB(65, 80, 110)
	view.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.5, -1, -0.3)
	view.Parent = sky
	local world = Instance.new("WorldModel")
	world.Parent = view
	local function part(
		name: string,
		size: Vector3,
		frame: CFrame,
		color: Color3,
		neon: boolean?
	): Part
		local item = Instance.new("Part")
		item.Name = name
		item.Size = size
		item.CFrame = frame
		item.Color = color
		item.Anchored = true
		item.CanCollide = false
		item.CastShadow = false
		item.Material = if neon then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		item.Parent = world
		return item
	end
	part("Ground", Vector3.new(28, 0.4, 28), CFrame.new(0, -0.2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(74, 70, 39))
	for row = 1, 4 do
		for column = 1, 6 do
			local x, z = (column - 3.5) * 3.4, (row - 2.5) * 3.4
			if math.abs(x) > 2.5 or row > 2 then
				local height = 4.5 + ((row + column) % 3) * 0.35
				part(
					"Stalk",
					Vector3.new(0.15, height, 0.15),
					CFrame.new(x, height / 2, z),
					if mode == "easy"
						then Color3.fromRGB(120, 126, 53)
						else Color3.fromRGB(186, 144, 67)
				)
				for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
					part(
						"Leaf",
						Vector3.new(2, 0.25, 0.7),
						CFrame.new(x + side * 0.65, height * 0.6, z)
							* CFrame.Angles(0, row * 0.4, side * 0.4),
						if mode == "easy"
							then Color3.fromRGB(99, 119, 43)
							else Color3.fromRGB(218, 183, 98)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	part("House", Vector3.new(5, 4, 4), CFrame.new(-8, 2, -9), Color3.fromRGB(84, 60, 46))
	part("Roof", Vector3.new(6, 0.5, 5), CFrame.new(-8, 4.2, -9), Color3.fromRGB(51, 42, 40))
	part("TorchPole", Vector3.new(0.3, 7, 0.3), CFrame.new(2.4, 3.5, 1), Color3.fromRGB(86, 60, 38))
	if profile.Torches then
		part(
			"TorchFlame",
			Vector3.new(0.7, 1.2, 0.7),
			CFrame.new(2.4, 7.3, 1),
			Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 51),
			true
		)
	end
	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 48
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(16, 12, 23), Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0))
	camera.Parent = view
	view.CurrentCamera = camera
	if mode == "hard" then
		local fog = Instance.new("Frame")
		fog.Name = "Mist"
		fog.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		fog.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fog.BackgroundColor3 = profile.FogColor
		fog.BackgroundTransparency = 0.65
		fog.Parent = sky
		local fade = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		fade.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 0.7),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
		fade.Parent = fog
	end
end

function RoundHud:_fitCard()
	local viewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		self._cardScale.Scale = math.min(
			1,
			(viewport.X - 36) / self._card.Size.X.Offset,
			(viewport.Y - 36) / self._card.Size.Y.Offset
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:SetOnAction(callback: (string, string?) -> ())
	local bindings = {
		{ button = self._start, action = "start" },
		{ button = self._retry, action = "retry" },
		{ button = self._menu, action = "menu" },
		{ button = self._preparingLeave, action = "abort" },
		{ button = self._activeLeave, action = "abort" },
	}
	for _, binding in bindings do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			binding.button.Activated:Connect(function()
				if not self._busy and not self._unavailable and self._snapshot ~= nil then
					callback(
						binding.action,
						if binding.action == "start" or binding.action == "retry"
							then self._selectedMode
							else nil
					)
				end
			end)
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_render()
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local phase = if snapshot then snapshot.phase else "loading"
	local isActive = phase == "active"
	local isResult = phase == "escaped" or phase == "aborted" or phase == "caught_out"
	local expanded = phase == "ready" or isResult
	self._card.Size = if expanded then UDim2.fromOffset(780, 510) else UDim2.fromOffset(460, 320)
	self._modeCards.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Visible = expanded
	self._modeHint.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Text =
		text("corn_modes_selected", { mode = text("corn_modes_" .. self._selectedMode) })
	self._modeHint.Text = text("corn_modes_hint")
	self._message.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 62 else 68)
	self._message.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 32 else 52)
	self._time.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 96 else 124)
	self._time.Visible = not expanded or isResult
	self._time.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 22 else 26)
	self._chooseMode.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if isResult then 118 else 110)
	self._balance.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 420 else 154)
	self._notice.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 392 else 186)
	self._notice.Visible = not expanded
	for _, control in { self._start, self._retry, self._menu, self._preparingLeave } do
		control.Position = UDim2.new(
			control.Position.X.Scale,
			control.Position.X.Offset,
			0,
			if expanded then 456 else 250
		)
	end
	for mode, control in self._modeButtons do
		local enabled = expanded and snapshot ~= nil and not self._busy and not self._unavailable
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		local selected = mode == self._selectedMode
		control.Text = text(if selected then "corn_modes_selected_button" else "corn_modes_select")
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled
			then (if selected then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR)
			else DISABLED_COLOR
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Color = if selected
			then Color3.fromRGB(204, 190, 114)
			else Color3.fromRGB(61, 71, 60)
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Transparency = if selected then 0 else 0.6
	end
	self:_fitCard()
	self._card.Visible = not isActive
	self._active.Visible = isActive
	self._activeLeave.Visible = isActive
	self._start.Visible = phase == "ready" or phase == "loading"
	self._retry.Visible = isResult
	self._menu.Visible = isResult
	self._preparingLeave.Visible = phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught"
	for _, control in self._buttons do
		local enabled = snapshot ~= nil and not self._busy and not self._unavailable
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.TextTransparency = if enabled then 0 else 0.35
	end

	self._title.Text = text("corn_loop_title")
	self._time.Text = ""
	self._notice.Text = if snapshot then text(snapshot.notice) else ""
	self._balance.Visible = snapshot ~= nil
	self._balance.Text = text(
		"corn_loop_test_balance",
		{ count = if snapshot then snapshot.session_diamonds else 0 }
	)
	if self._unavailable then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_loop_connection_error")
	elseif phase == "loading" or phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught" then
		self._message.Text = if phase == "caught"
			then text(snapshot and snapshot.notice or "corn_hunt_first_catch")
			else text("corn_loop_loading")
	elseif phase == "ready" then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_modes_choose")
	elseif snapshot and isResult then
		self._title.Text = text(
			if phase == "escaped"
				then "corn_loop_result_escape"
				elseif phase == "caught_out" then "corn_hunt_defeat"
				else "corn_loop_result_aborted"
		)
		self._message.Text = if phase == "escaped"
			then text("corn_loop_reward", { count = snapshot.reward_diamonds })
			else ""
		self._time.Text = text("corn_loop_round_time", { time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) })
	end

	-- Clear inactive/stale warning styling before rendering this confirmed state.
	self._activeNotice.Text = ""
	self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = NOTICE_COLOR
	self._activeNotice.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	if snapshot and isActive then
		local objectiveKey = if snapshot.gate_open
			then "corn_loop_objective_exit"
			elseif snapshot.has_key then "corn_loop_objective_return"
			else "corn_loop_objective_search"
		self._objective.Text = text(objectiveKey)
		self._activeTime.Text = text(
			"corn_loop_round_time",
			{ time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) }
		) .. " · " .. text(
			"corn_modes_active",
			{ mode = text("corn_modes_" .. snapshot.lighting_mode) }
		)
		self._activeBalance.Text = self._balance.Text
		local chasing = snapshot.protection_sec <= 0 and snapshot.monster_state == "chase"
		self._activeNotice.Text = if snapshot.protection_sec > 0
			then text("corn_hunt_protected", { seconds = math.ceil(snapshot.protection_sec) })
			elseif chasing then text("corn_hunt_chase")
			else text(snapshot.notice)
		self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = if chasing then CHASE_COLOR else NOTICE_COLOR
		self._activeNotice.Font = if chasing then Enum.Font.GothamBold else Enum.Font.Gotham
		self._activeBalance.Text ..= " · " .. text(
			"corn_hunt_attempts",
			{ count = snapshot.catches_remaining }
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:Render(snapshot: Snapshot)
	self._unavailable = false
	if snapshot.phase ~= self._lastPhase and snapshot.phase ~= "ready" then
		self._selectedMode = snapshot.lighting_mode
	end
	self._lastPhase = snapshot.phase
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetBusy(busy: boolean)
	self._busy = busy
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:ShowUnavailable()
	self._unavailable = true
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._root:Destroy()
end

return RoundHud

local function text(key: string, values: { [string]: string | number }?): string
	local template = RoundText[key] or ""
	return (
		string.gsub(template, "{([%w_]+)}", function(name)
			local value = if values then values[name] else nil
			return if value ~= nil then tostring(value) else "{" .. name .. "}"
		end)
	)
end

local function elapsedText(seconds: number): string
	local whole = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(whole / 60), whole % 60)
end

local function text(key: string, values: { [string]: string | number }?): string
	local template = RoundText[key] or ""
	return (
		string.gsub(template, "{([%w_]+)}", function(name)
			local value = if values then values[name] else nil
			return if value ~= nil then tostring(value) else "{" .. name .. "}"
		end)
	)
end

local function elapsedText(seconds: number): string
	local whole = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(whole / 60), whole % 60)
end

	parent: Instance,

	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2,
	fontSize: number
): TextLabel

	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	result.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	result.TextSize = fontSize
	result.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
	result.TextWrapped = true
	result.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	result.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	result.Text = ""
	result.Parent = parent
	return result
end

function RoundHud:_fitCard()
	local viewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		self._cardScale.Scale = math.min(
			1,
			(viewport.X - 36) / self._card.Size.X.Offset,
			(viewport.Y - 36) / self._card.Size.Y.Offset
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:SetOnAction(callback: (string, string?) -> ())
	local bindings = {
		{ button = self._start, action = "start" },
		{ button = self._retry, action = "retry" },
		{ button = self._menu, action = "menu" },
		{ button = self._preparingLeave, action = "abort" },
		{ button = self._activeLeave, action = "abort" },
	}
	for _, binding in bindings do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			binding.button.Activated:Connect(function()
				if not self._busy and not self._unavailable and self._snapshot ~= nil then
					callback(
						binding.action,
						if binding.action == "start" or binding.action == "retry"
							then self._selectedMode
							else nil
					)
				end
			end)
		)
	end
end

local BUTTON_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(84, 109, 67)
local DISABLED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(63, 69, 61)
local NOTICE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(233, 209, 142)
local CHASE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(233, 94, 83)

local function text(key: string, values: { [string]: string | number }?): string
	local template = RoundText[key] or ""
	return (
		string.gsub(template, "{([%w_]+)}", function(name)
			local value = if values then values[name] else nil
			return if value ~= nil then tostring(value) else "{" .. name .. "}"
		end)
	)
end

local function elapsedText(seconds: number): string
	local whole = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(whole / 60), whole % 60)
end

local function label(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2,
	fontSize: number
): TextLabel
	local result = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	result.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	result.TextSize = fontSize
	result.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
	result.TextWrapped = true
	result.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	result.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	result.Text = ""
	result.Parent = parent
	return result
end

					self:_render()
				end
			end)
		)
	end

		self._connections,
		root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			self:_fitCard()
		end)
	)
	self:_render()
	return self
end

function RoundHud:_fitCard()
	local viewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		self._cardScale.Scale = math.min(
			1,
			(viewport.X - 36) / self._card.Size.X.Offset,
			(viewport.Y - 36) / self._card.Size.Y.Offset
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:SetOnAction(callback: (string, string?) -> ())
	local bindings = {
		{ button = self._start, action = "start" },
		{ button = self._retry, action = "retry" },
		{ button = self._menu, action = "menu" },
		{ button = self._preparingLeave, action = "abort" },
		{ button = self._activeLeave, action = "abort" },
	}
	for _, binding in bindings do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			binding.button.Activated:Connect(function()
				if not self._busy and not self._unavailable and self._snapshot ~= nil then
					callback(
						binding.action,
						if binding.action == "start" or binding.action == "retry"
							then self._selectedMode
							else nil
					)
				end
			end)
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_render()
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local phase = if snapshot then snapshot.phase else "loading"
	local isActive = phase == "active"
	local isResult = phase == "escaped" or phase == "aborted" or phase == "caught_out"
	local expanded = phase == "ready" or isResult
	self._card.Size = if expanded then UDim2.fromOffset(780, 530) else UDim2.fromOffset(460, 320)
	self._modeCards.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Visible = expanded
	self._modeHint.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Text =
		text("corn_modes_selected", { mode = text("corn_modes_" .. self._selectedMode) })
	self._modeHint.Text = text("corn_modes_hint")
	self._message.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 62 else 68)
	self._message.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 32 else 52)
	self._time.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 96 else 124)
	self._time.Visible = not expanded or isResult
	self._time.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 22 else 26)
	self._chooseMode.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if isResult then 118 else 110)
	self._balance.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 440 else 154)
	self._notice.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 392 else 186)
	self._notice.Visible = not expanded
	for _, control in { self._start, self._retry, self._menu, self._preparingLeave } do
		control.Position = UDim2.new(
			control.Position.X.Scale,
			control.Position.X.Offset,
			0,
			if expanded then 476 else 250
		)
	end
	for mode, control in self._modeButtons do
		local enabled = expanded and snapshot ~= nil and not self._busy and not self._unavailable
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		local selected = mode == self._selectedMode
		control.Text = text(if selected then "corn_modes_selected_button" else "corn_modes_select")
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled
			then (if selected then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR)
			else DISABLED_COLOR
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Color = if selected
			then Color3.fromRGB(204, 190, 114)
			else Color3.fromRGB(61, 71, 60)
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Transparency = if selected then 0 else 0.6
	end
	self:_fitCard()
	self._card.Visible = not isActive and not (phase == "caught" and self._captureActive)
	self._active.Visible = isActive
	self._activeLeave.Visible = isActive
	self._start.Visible = phase == "ready" or phase == "loading"
	self._retry.Visible = isResult
	self._menu.Visible = isResult
	self._preparingLeave.Visible = phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught"
	for _, control in self._buttons do
		local enabled = snapshot ~= nil and not self._busy and not self._unavailable
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.TextTransparency = if enabled then 0 else 0.35
	end

	self._title.Text = text("corn_loop_title")
	self._time.Text = ""
	self._notice.Text = if snapshot then text(snapshot.notice) else ""
	self._balance.Visible = snapshot ~= nil
	self._balance.Text = text(
		"corn_loop_test_balance",
		{ count = if snapshot then snapshot.session_diamonds else 0 }
	)
	if self._unavailable then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_loop_connection_error")
	elseif phase == "loading" or phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught" then
		self._message.Text = if phase == "caught"
			then text(snapshot and snapshot.notice or "corn_hunt_first_catch")
			else text("corn_loop_loading")
	elseif phase == "ready" then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_modes_choose")
	elseif snapshot and isResult then
		self._title.Text = text(
			if phase == "escaped"
				then "corn_loop_result_escape"
				elseif phase == "caught_out" then "corn_hunt_defeat"
				else "corn_loop_result_aborted"
		)
		self._message.Text = if phase == "escaped"
			then text("corn_loop_reward", { count = snapshot.reward_diamonds })
			else ""
		self._time.Text = text("corn_loop_round_time", { time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) })
	end

	-- Clear inactive/stale warning styling before rendering this confirmed state.
	self._activeNotice.Text = ""
	self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = NOTICE_COLOR
	self._activeNotice.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	if snapshot and isActive then
		local objectiveKey = if snapshot.gate_open
			then "corn_loop_objective_exit"
			elseif snapshot.has_key then "corn_loop_objective_return"
			else "corn_loop_objective_search"
		self._objective.Text = text(objectiveKey)
		self._activeTime.Text = text(
			"corn_loop_round_time",
			{ time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) }
		) .. " · " .. text(
			"corn_modes_active",
			{ mode = text("corn_modes_" .. snapshot.lighting_mode) }
		)
		self._activeBalance.Text = self._balance.Text
		local chasing = snapshot.protection_sec <= 0 and snapshot.monster_state == "chase"
		self._activeNotice.Text = if snapshot.protection_sec > 0
			then text("corn_hunt_protected", { seconds = math.ceil(snapshot.protection_sec) })
			elseif chasing then text("corn_hunt_chase")
			else text(snapshot.notice)
		self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = if chasing then CHASE_COLOR else NOTICE_COLOR
		self._activeNotice.Font = if chasing then Enum.Font.GothamBold else Enum.Font.Gotham
		self._activeBalance.Text ..= " · " .. text(
			"corn_hunt_attempts",
			{ count = snapshot.catches_remaining }
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:Render(snapshot: Snapshot)
	self._unavailable = false
	if snapshot.phase ~= self._lastPhase and snapshot.phase ~= "ready" then
		self._selectedMode = snapshot.lighting_mode
	end
	self._lastPhase = snapshot.phase
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetBusy(busy: boolean)
	self._busy = busy
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetCaptureActive(active: boolean)
	self._captureActive = active
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:ShowUnavailable()
	self._unavailable = true
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._root:Destroy()
end

return RoundHud

function RoundHud:_fitCard()
	local viewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		self._cardScale.Scale = math.min(
			1,
			(viewport.X - 36) / self._card.Size.X.Offset,
			(viewport.Y - 36) / self._card.Size.Y.Offset
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:SetOnAction(callback: (string, string?) -> ())
	local bindings = {
		{ button = self._start, action = "start" },
		{ button = self._retry, action = "retry" },
		{ button = self._menu, action = "menu" },
		{ button = self._preparingLeave, action = "abort" },
		{ button = self._activeLeave, action = "abort" },
	}
	for _, binding in bindings do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			binding.button.Activated:Connect(function()
				if not self._busy and not self._unavailable and self._snapshot ~= nil then
					callback(
						binding.action,
						if binding.action == "start" or binding.action == "retry"
							then self._selectedMode
							else nil
					)
				end
			end)
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_render()
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local phase = if snapshot then snapshot.phase else "loading"
	local isActive = phase == "active"
	local isResult = phase == "escaped" or phase == "aborted" or phase == "caught_out"
	local expanded = phase == "ready" or isResult
	self._card.Size = if expanded then UDim2.fromOffset(780, 530) else UDim2.fromOffset(460, 320)
	self._modeCards.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Visible = expanded
	self._modeHint.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Text =
		text("corn_modes_selected", { mode = text("corn_modes_" .. self._selectedMode) })
	self._modeHint.Text = text("corn_modes_hint")
	self._message.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 62 else 68)
	self._message.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 32 else 52)
	self._time.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 96 else 124)
	self._time.Visible = not expanded or isResult
	self._time.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 22 else 26)
	self._chooseMode.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if isResult then 118 else 110)
	self._balance.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 440 else 154)
	self._notice.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 392 else 186)
	self._notice.Visible = not expanded
	for _, control in { self._start, self._retry, self._menu, self._preparingLeave } do
		control.Position = UDim2.new(
			control.Position.X.Scale,
			control.Position.X.Offset,
			0,
			if expanded then 476 else 250
		)
	end
	for mode, control in self._modeButtons do
		local enabled = expanded and snapshot ~= nil and not self._busy and not self._unavailable
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		local selected = mode == self._selectedMode
		control.Text = text(if selected then "corn_modes_selected_button" else "corn_modes_select")
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled
			then (if selected then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR)
			else DISABLED_COLOR
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Color = if selected
			then Color3.fromRGB(204, 190, 114)
			else Color3.fromRGB(61, 71, 60)
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Transparency = if selected then 0 else 0.6
	end
	self:_fitCard()
	self._card.Visible = not isActive and not (phase == "caught" and self._captureActive)
	self._active.Visible = isActive
	self._activeLeave.Visible = isActive
	self._start.Visible = phase == "ready" or phase == "loading"
	self._retry.Visible = isResult
	self._menu.Visible = isResult
	self._preparingLeave.Visible = phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught"
	for _, control in self._buttons do
		local enabled = snapshot ~= nil and not self._busy and not self._unavailable
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.TextTransparency = if enabled then 0 else 0.35
	end

	self._title.Text = text("corn_loop_title")
	self._time.Text = ""
	self._notice.Text = if snapshot then text(snapshot.notice) else ""
	self._balance.Visible = snapshot ~= nil
	self._balance.Text = text(
		"corn_loop_test_balance",
		{ count = if snapshot then snapshot.session_diamonds else 0 }
	)
	if self._unavailable then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_loop_connection_error")
	elseif phase == "loading" or phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught" then
		self._message.Text = if phase == "caught"
			then text(snapshot and snapshot.notice or "corn_hunt_first_catch")
			else text("corn_loop_loading")
	elseif phase == "ready" then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_modes_choose")
	elseif snapshot and isResult then
		self._title.Text = text(
			if phase == "escaped"
				then "corn_loop_result_escape"
				elseif phase == "caught_out" then "corn_hunt_defeat"
				else "corn_loop_result_aborted"
		)
		self._message.Text = if phase == "escaped"
			then text("corn_loop_reward", { count = snapshot.reward_diamonds })
			else ""
		self._time.Text = text("corn_loop_round_time", { time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) })
	end

	-- Clear inactive/stale warning styling before rendering this confirmed state.
	self._activeNotice.Text = ""
	self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = NOTICE_COLOR
	self._activeNotice.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	if snapshot and isActive then
		local objectiveKey = if snapshot.gate_open
			then "corn_loop_objective_exit"
			elseif snapshot.has_key then "corn_loop_objective_return"
			else "corn_loop_objective_search"
		self._objective.Text = text(objectiveKey)
		self._activeTime.Text = text(
			"corn_loop_round_time",
			{ time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) }
		) .. " · " .. text(
			"corn_modes_active",
			{ mode = text("corn_modes_" .. snapshot.lighting_mode) }
		)
		self._activeBalance.Text = self._balance.Text
		local chasing = snapshot.protection_sec <= 0 and snapshot.monster_state == "chase"
		self._activeNotice.Text = if snapshot.protection_sec > 0
			then text("corn_hunt_protected", { seconds = math.ceil(snapshot.protection_sec) })
			elseif chasing then text("corn_hunt_chase")
			else text(snapshot.notice)
		self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = if chasing then CHASE_COLOR else NOTICE_COLOR
		self._activeNotice.Font = if chasing then Enum.Font.GothamBold else Enum.Font.Gotham
		self._activeBalance.Text ..= " · " .. text(
			"corn_hunt_attempts",
			{ count = snapshot.catches_remaining }
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:Render(snapshot: Snapshot)
	self._unavailable = false
	if snapshot.phase ~= self._lastPhase and snapshot.phase ~= "ready" then
		self._selectedMode = snapshot.lighting_mode
	end
	self._lastPhase = snapshot.phase
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetBusy(busy: boolean)
	self._busy = busy
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetCaptureActive(active: boolean)
	self._captureActive = active
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:ShowUnavailable()
	self._unavailable = true
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._root:Destroy()
end

return RoundHud

local function text(key: string, values: { [string]: string | number }?): string
	local template = RoundText[key] or ""
	return (
		string.gsub(template, "{([%w_]+)}", function(name)
			local value = if values then values[name] else nil
			return if value ~= nil then tostring(value) else "{" .. name .. "}"
		end)
	)
end

local function elapsedText(seconds: number): string
	local whole = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(whole / 60), whole % 60)
end

local function label(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2,
	fontSize: number

	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	result.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	result.TextSize = fontSize
	result.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
	result.TextWrapped = true
	result.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

	result.Parent = parent
