		label(introPanel, "Objective", UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 168), UDim2.fromOffset(16, 70), 32)
	introMessage.Text = text("corn_loop_intro_objective")
	introMessage.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	introMessage.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	local introMode =
		label(introPanel, "Mode", UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 28), UDim2.fromOffset(16, 244), 17)
	introMode.TextColor3 = MUTED_COLOR
	introMode.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	local introConfirm = button(
		introPanel,
		"Confirm",
		"corn_loop_intro_confirm",
		UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 48),
		UDim2.fromOffset(16, 278)
	)
	local introBack = button(
		introPanel,
		"Back",
		"corn_loop_intro_back",
		UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 36),
		UDim2.fromOffset(16, 336)
	)
	introConfirm.Modal, introBack.Modal = true, true
	introConfirm.SelectionOrder, introBack.SelectionOrder = 0, 1
	introConfirm.NextSelectionDown, introBack.NextSelectionUp = introBack, introConfirm

	local self = setmetatable({
		_root = root,
		_card = card,
		_cardScale = cardScale,
		_modeCards = modeCards,
		_chooseMode = choose,
		_modeHint = modeHint,
		_modeButtons = modeButtons,
		_modeStrokes = modeStrokes,
		_selectedMode = LightingModes.Default,
		_lastPhase = "loading",
		_title = title,
		_message = message,
		_time = resultTime,
		_balance = balance,
		_notice = notice,
		_active = active,
		_objective = objective,
		_activeTime = activeTime,
		_activeBalance = activeBalance,
		_activeNotice = activeNotice,
		_start = start,
		_retry = retry,
		_menu = menu,
		_preparingLeave = preparingLeave,
		_activeLeave = activeLeave,
		_waking = waking,
		_wakingMessage = wakingMessage,
		_wakingSeconds = wakingSeconds,
		_introRoot = introRoot,
		_introPanel = introPanel,
		_introMessage = introMessage,
		_introMode = introMode,
		_introConfirm = introConfirm,
		_introBack = introBack,
		_introPending = nil,
		_introVisible = false,
		_savedSelection = nil,
		_onAction = nil,
		_actionBound = false,
		_destroyed = false,
		_buttons = { start, retry, menu, preparingLeave, activeLeave },
		_connections = {} :: { RBXScriptConnection },
		_snapshot = nil :: Snapshot?,
		_busy = false,
		_captureActive = false,
		_unavailable = false,
	}, RoundHud)
	for mode, select in modeButtons do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			select.Activated:Connect(function()
				if
					not self._busy
					and not self._unavailable
					and not self._introPending
					and not self._destroyed
					and self._snapshot
				then
					self._selectedMode = mode
					self:_render()
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			self:_fitCard()
			self:_fitOverlays()
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		introRoot:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			self:_fitOverlays()
		end)
	)
	self:_render()
	return self
end

function RoundHud:_fitCard()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	local viewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		self._cardScale.Scale = math.min(
			1,
			(viewport.X - 36) / self._card.Size.X.Offset,
			(viewport.Y - 36) / self._card.Size.Y.Offset
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_fitOverlays()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	local viewport = self._introRoot.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		local width, height = math.min(640, viewport.X - 36), math.min(390, viewport.Y - 36)
		self._introPanel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1, width), math.max(1, height))
		local bodyHeight = math.max(40, height - 222)
		self._introMessage.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, bodyHeight)
		self._introMessage.TextSize =
			math.min(if width < 390 then 24 else 32, math.max(18, bodyHeight / 3))
		self._introMode.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, height - 146)
		self._introConfirm.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, height - 112)
		self._introBack.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, height - 54)
	end
	local hudViewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if hudViewport.X > 0 and hudViewport.Y > 0 then
		local width = math.min(600, math.max(1, hudViewport.X - 36))
		self._waking.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 120)
		self._waking.Position =
			UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, math.max(0, math.min(150, hudViewport.Y - 144)))
		self._wakingMessage.TextSize = if width < 390 then 17 else 21
	end
end

function RoundHud:_canAct(): boolean
	return not self._destroyed
		and not self._busy
		and not self._unavailable
		and self._snapshot ~= nil
end

function RoundHud:_introValid(): boolean
	local pending, snapshot = self._introPending, self._snapshot
	return pending ~= nil
		and snapshot ~= nil
		and snapshot.phase == pending.phase
		and snapshot.minimap.round_id == pending.roundId
		and LightingModes.IsValid(pending.mode)
end

function RoundHud:_introVisibility(visible: boolean)
	self._introRoot.Enabled = visible
	if visible == self._introVisible then
		return
	end
	self._introVisible = visible
	if visible then
		self._savedSelection = GuiService.SelectedObject
		GuiService.SelectedObject = self._introConfirm
	elseif
		GuiService.SelectedObject == self._introConfirm
		or GuiService.SelectedObject == self._introBack
	then
		local saved = self._savedSelection
		GuiService.SelectedObject = if saved and saved.Parent and saved.Visible then saved else nil
	end
	if not visible then
		self._savedSelection = nil
	end
end

function RoundHud:ShowObjective(action: string)
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	if not self:_canAct() or not snapshot or self._captureActive or self._introPending then
		return
	end
	local allowed = (action == "start" and snapshot.phase == "ready")
		or (
			action == "retry"
			and (
				snapshot.phase == "escaped"
				or snapshot.phase == "aborted"
				or snapshot.phase == "caught_out"
			)
		)
	if not allowed or not LightingModes.IsValid(self._selectedMode) then
		return
	end
	self._introPending = {
		action = action,
		mode = self._selectedMode,
		phase = snapshot.phase,
		roundId = snapshot.minimap.round_id,
	}
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:CloseObjective()
	self._introPending = nil
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:ConfirmObjective()
	if
		not self:_canAct()
		or self._captureActive
		or not self:_introValid()
		or not self._onAction
	then
		return
	end
	local pending = self._introPending
	self._introPending = nil
	self:_render()
	self._onAction(pending.action, pending.mode)
end

function RoundHud:SetOnAction(callback: (string, string?) -> ())
	self._onAction = callback
	if self._actionBound then
		return
	end
	self._actionBound = true
	local bindings = {
		{ button = self._start, action = "start" },
		{ button = self._retry, action = "retry" },
		{ button = self._menu, action = "menu" },
		{ button = self._preparingLeave, action = "abort" },
		{ button = self._activeLeave, action = "abort" },
	}
	for _, binding in bindings do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			binding.button.Activated:Connect(function()
				if self:_canAct() and not self._introPending and self._onAction then
					if binding.action == "start" or binding.action == "retry" then
						self:ShowObjective(binding.action)
					else
						self._onAction(binding.action, nil)
					end
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		self._introConfirm.Activated:Connect(function()
			self:ConfirmObjective()
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		self._introBack.Activated:Connect(function()
			if self:_canAct() then
				self:CloseObjective()
			end
		end)
	)
end

function RoundHud:_render()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	if not self:_introValid() or self._unavailable or self._captureActive then
		self._introPending = nil
	end
	local intro = self._introPending ~= nil
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local phase = if snapshot then snapshot.phase else "loading"
	local isActive = phase == "active"
	local isResult = phase == "escaped" or phase == "aborted" or phase == "caught_out"
	local expanded = phase == "ready" or isResult
	self._card.Size = if expanded then UDim2.fromOffset(780, 530) else UDim2.fromOffset(460, 320)
	self._modeCards.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Visible = expanded
	self._modeHint.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Text =
		text("corn_modes_selected", { mode = text("corn_modes_" .. self._selectedMode) })
	self._modeHint.Text = text("corn_modes_hint")
	self._message.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 62 else 68)
	self._message.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 32 else 52)
	self._time.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 96 else 124)
	self._time.Visible = not expanded or isResult
	self._time.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 22 else 26)
	self._chooseMode.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if isResult then 118 else 110)
	self._balance.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 440 else 154)
	self._notice.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 392 else 186)
	self._notice.Visible = not expanded
	for _, control in { self._start, self._retry, self._menu, self._preparingLeave } do
		control.Position = UDim2.new(
			control.Position.X.Scale,
			control.Position.X.Offset,
			0,
			if expanded then 476 else 250
		)
	end
	for mode, control in self._modeButtons do
		local enabled = expanded
			and snapshot ~= nil
			and not self._busy
			and not self._unavailable
			and not intro
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		local selected = mode == self._selectedMode
		control.Text = text(if selected then "corn_modes_selected_button" else "corn_modes_select")
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled
			then (if selected then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR)
			else DISABLED_COLOR
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Color = if selected
			then Color3.fromRGB(204, 190, 114)
			else Color3.fromRGB(61, 71, 60)
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Transparency = if selected then 0 else 0.6
	end
	self:_fitCard()
	self._card.Visible = not intro
		and not isActive
		and not (phase == "caught" and self._captureActive)
	self._active.Visible = isActive
	self._activeLeave.Visible = isActive
	self._start.Visible = phase == "ready" or phase == "loading"
	self._retry.Visible = isResult
	self._menu.Visible = isResult
	self._preparingLeave.Visible = phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught"
	for _, control in self._buttons do
		local enabled = snapshot ~= nil and not self._busy and not self._unavailable and not intro
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.TextTransparency = if enabled then 0 else 0.35
	end
	for _, control in { self._introConfirm, self._introBack } do
		control.Active = intro and self:_canAct()
		control.AutoButtonColor = control.Active
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if control.Active then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.Modal = intro
	end
	if self._introPending then
		self._introMode.Text =
			text("corn_modes_selected", { mode = text("corn_modes_" .. self._introPending.mode) })
	else
		self._introMode.Text = ""
	end

	self._title.Text = text("corn_loop_title")
	self._time.Text = ""
	self._notice.Text = if snapshot then text(snapshot.notice) else ""
	self._balance.Visible = snapshot ~= nil
	self._balance.Text = text(
		"corn_loop_test_balance",
		{ count = if snapshot then snapshot.session_diamonds else 0 }
	)
	if self._unavailable then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_loop_connection_error")
	elseif phase == "loading" or phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught" then
		self._message.Text = if phase == "caught"
			then text(snapshot and snapshot.notice or "corn_hunt_first_catch")
			else text("corn_loop_loading")
	elseif phase == "ready" then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_modes_choose")
	elseif snapshot and isResult then
		self._title.Text = text(
			if phase == "escaped"
				then "corn_loop_result_escape"
				elseif phase == "caught_out" then "corn_hunt_defeat"
				else "corn_loop_result_aborted"
		)
		self._message.Text = if phase == "escaped"
			then text("corn_loop_reward", { count = snapshot.reward_diamonds })
			else ""
		self._time.Text = text("corn_loop_round_time", { time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) })
	end

	-- Clear inactive/stale warning styling before rendering this confirmed state.
	self._activeNotice.Text = ""
	self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = NOTICE_COLOR
	self._activeNotice.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	if snapshot and isActive then
		local objectiveKey = if snapshot.gate_open
			then "corn_loop_objective_exit"
			elseif snapshot.has_key then "corn_loop_objective_return"
			else "corn_loop_objective_search"
		self._objective.Text = text(objectiveKey)
		self._activeTime.Text = text(
			"corn_loop_round_time",
			{ time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) }
		) .. " · " .. text(
			"corn_modes_active",
			{ mode = text("corn_modes_" .. snapshot.lighting_mode) }
		)
		self._activeBalance.Text = self._balance.Text
		local chasing = snapshot.protection_sec <= 0 and snapshot.monster_state == "chase"
		self._activeNotice.Text = if snapshot.protection_sec > 0
			then text("corn_hunt_protected", { seconds = math.ceil(snapshot.protection_sec) })
			elseif chasing then text("corn_hunt_chase")
			else text(snapshot.notice)
		self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = if chasing then CHASE_COLOR else NOTICE_COLOR
		self._activeNotice.Font = if chasing then Enum.Font.GothamBold else Enum.Font.Gotham
		self._activeBalance.Text ..= " · " .. text(
			"corn_hunt_attempts",
			{ count = snapshot.catches_remaining }
		)
	end
	local remaining = if snapshot
		then math.ceil(Balance.hunt_start_delay_sec - snapshot.elapsed_sec)
		else 0
	local waking = snapshot ~= nil
		and isActive
		and not self._unavailable
		and not self._captureActive
		and snapshot.monster_state == "dormant"
		and remaining >= 1
		and remaining <= 5
		and snapshot.elapsed_sec < Balance.hunt_start_delay_sec
	self._waking.Visible = waking
	self._wakingMessage.Text = if waking then text("corn_hunt_waking_warning") else ""
	self._wakingSeconds.Text = if waking
		then text("corn_hunt_waking_seconds", { seconds = remaining })
		else ""
	self:_fitOverlays()
	self:_introVisibility(intro)
end

function RoundHud:Render(snapshot: Snapshot)
	self._unavailable = false
	if snapshot.phase ~= self._lastPhase and snapshot.phase ~= "ready" then
		self._selectedMode = snapshot.lighting_mode
	end
	self._lastPhase = snapshot.phase
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetBusy(busy: boolean)
	self._busy = busy
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetCaptureActive(active: boolean)
	self._captureActive = active
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:ShowUnavailable()
	self._unavailable = true
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:Destroy()
	self._introPending = nil
	self:_introVisibility(false)
	self._destroyed = true
	self._snapshot, self._onAction = nil, nil
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._root:Destroy()
	self._introRoot:Destroy()
end

return RoundHud
--!strict

	notice: string,
	stamina: number,

RoundHud.__index = RoundHud

local PANEL_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(27, 32, 28)
local TEXT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(239, 242, 233)
local MUTED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(190, 199, 186)
local BUTTON_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(84, 109, 67)
local DISABLED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(63, 69, 61)
local NOTICE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(233, 209, 142)
local CHASE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(233, 94, 83)

local function text(key: string, values: { [string]: string | number }?): string
	local template = RoundText[key] or ""
	return (
		string.gsub(template, "{([%w_]+)}", function(name)
			local value = if values then values[name] else nil
			return if value ~= nil then tostring(value) else "{" .. name .. "}"
		end)
	)
end

local function elapsedText(seconds: number): string
	local whole = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(whole / 60), whole % 60)
end

local function label(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2,
	fontSize: number
): TextLabel
	local result = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	result.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	result.TextSize = fontSize
	result.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
	result.TextWrapped = true
	result.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	result.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	result.Text = ""
	result.Parent = parent
	return result
end

local function button(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	key: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2
): TextButton
	local result = Instance.new("TextButton")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundColor3 = BUTTON_COLOR
	result.BorderSizePixel = 0
	result.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	result.TextSize = 17
	result.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
	result.Text = text(key)
	result.Modal = parent.Name == "RoundCard"
	result.Parent = parent
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = result
	return result
end

local function panel(parent: Instance, name: string, size: UDim2, position: UDim2): Frame
	local result = Instance.new("Frame")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_COLOR
	result.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
	result.BorderSizePixel = 0
	result.Parent = parent
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = result
	return result
end

	photo.ClipsDescendants = true

	corner.Parent = photo

function RoundHud:_fitCard()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	local viewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		self._cardScale.Scale = math.min(
			1,
			(viewport.X - 36) / self._card.Size.X.Offset,
			(viewport.Y - 36) / self._card.Size.Y.Offset
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_fitOverlays()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	local viewport = self._introRoot.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		local width, height = math.min(640, viewport.X - 36), math.min(390, viewport.Y - 36)
		self._introPanel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1, width), math.max(1, height))
		local bodyHeight = math.max(40, height - 222)
		self._introMessage.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, bodyHeight)
		self._introMessage.TextSize =
			math.min(if width < 390 then 24 else 32, math.max(18, bodyHeight / 3))
		self._introMode.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, height - 146)
		self._introConfirm.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, height - 112)
		self._introBack.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, height - 54)
	end
	local hudViewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if hudViewport.X > 0 and hudViewport.Y > 0 then
		local width = math.min(600, math.max(1, hudViewport.X - 36))
		self._waking.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 120)
		self._waking.Position =
			UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, math.max(0, math.min(150, hudViewport.Y - 144)))
		self._wakingMessage.TextSize = if width < 390 then 17 else 21
		self._captureScale.Scale =
			math.min(1, (hudViewport.X - 36) / 380, (hudViewport.Y - 36) / 244)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_captureReady(): boolean
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	return snapshot ~= nil
		and snapshot.capture ~= nil
		and snapshot.capture.remaining == 0
		and (
			snapshot.phase == "caught_out"
			or (snapshot.phase == "caught" and snapshot.catches_remaining == 1)
		)
end

function RoundHud:_captureChoicesVisibility(visible: boolean)
	self._captureChoices.Visible = visible
	if visible == self._captureChoicesVisible then
		return
	end
	self._captureChoicesVisible = visible
	if visible then
		self._captureSavedSelection = GuiService.SelectedObject
		GuiService.SelectedObject = self._captureRevive
	elseif
		GuiService.SelectedObject == self._captureRevive
		or GuiService.SelectedObject == self._captureExit
	then
		local saved = self._captureSavedSelection
		GuiService.SelectedObject = if saved and saved.Parent and saved.Visible then saved else nil
	end
	if not visible then
		self._captureSavedSelection = nil
	end
end

function RoundHud:ChooseCapture(action: string)
	if
		not self:_canAct()
		or not self:_captureReady()
		or self._captureActive
		or self._introPending
		or not self._onAction
	then
		return
	end
	if action == "revive" and self._snapshot.phase == "caught_out" then
		self:ShowObjective("retry")
	elseif action == "revive" or action == "menu" then
		self:SetBusy(true)
		self._onAction(action, nil)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_canAct(): boolean
	return not self._destroyed
		and not self._busy
		and not self._unavailable
		and self._snapshot ~= nil
end

function RoundHud:_introValid(): boolean
	local pending, snapshot = self._introPending, self._snapshot
	return pending ~= nil
		and snapshot ~= nil
		and snapshot.phase == pending.phase
		and snapshot.minimap.round_id == pending.roundId
		and LightingModes.IsValid(pending.mode)
		and (pending.phase ~= "caught_out" or self:_captureReady())
end

function RoundHud:_introVisibility(visible: boolean)
	self._introRoot.Enabled = visible
	if visible == self._introVisible then
		return
	end
	self._introVisible = visible
	if visible then
		self._savedSelection = GuiService.SelectedObject
		GuiService.SelectedObject = self._introConfirm
	elseif
		GuiService.SelectedObject == self._introConfirm
		or GuiService.SelectedObject == self._introBack
	then
		local saved = self._savedSelection
		GuiService.SelectedObject = if saved and saved.Parent and saved.Visible then saved else nil
	end
	if not visible then
		self._savedSelection = nil
	end
end

function RoundHud:ShowObjective(action: string)
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	if not self:_canAct() or not snapshot or self._captureActive or self._introPending then
		return
	end
	local allowed = (action == "start" and snapshot.phase == "ready")
		or (
			action == "retry"
			and (
				snapshot.phase == "escaped"
				or snapshot.phase == "aborted"
				or snapshot.phase == "caught_out"
			)
		)
	if
		not allowed
		or not LightingModes.IsValid(self._selectedMode)
		or (snapshot.phase == "caught_out" and not self:_captureReady())
	then
		return
	end
	if snapshot.phase == "caught_out" then
		self._selectedMode = snapshot.lighting_mode
	end
	self._introPending = {
		action = action,
		mode = self._selectedMode,
		phase = snapshot.phase,
		roundId = snapshot.minimap.round_id,
	}
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:CloseObjective()
	self._introPending = nil
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:ConfirmObjective()
	if
		not self:_canAct()
		or self._captureActive
		or not self:_introValid()
		or not self._onAction
	then
		return
	end
	local pending = self._introPending
	self._introPending = nil
	self:_render()
	self._onAction(pending.action, pending.mode)
end

function RoundHud:SetOnAction(callback: (string, string?) -> ())
	self._onAction = callback
	if self._actionBound then
		return
	end
	self._actionBound = true
	local bindings = {
		{ button = self._start, action = "start" },
		{ button = self._retry, action = "retry" },
		{ button = self._menu, action = "menu" },
		{ button = self._preparingLeave, action = "abort" },
		{ button = self._activeLeave, action = "abort" },
	}
	for _, binding in bindings do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			binding.button.Activated:Connect(function()
				if
					self:_canAct()
					and binding.button.Visible
					and binding.button.Active
					and not self._captureActive
					and not self._introPending
					and self._onAction
				then
					if binding.action == "start" or binding.action == "retry" then
						self:ShowObjective(binding.action)
					else
						self._onAction(binding.action, nil)
					end
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	for _, binding in
		{
			{ button = self._captureRevive, action = "revive" },
			{ button = self._captureExit, action = "menu" },
		}
	do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			binding.button.Activated:Connect(function()
				self:ChooseCapture(binding.action)
			end)
		)
	end
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		self._introConfirm.Activated:Connect(function()
			self:ConfirmObjective()
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		self._introBack.Activated:Connect(function()
			if self:_canAct() then
				self:CloseObjective()
			end
		end)
	)
end

function RoundHud:_render()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	if not self:_introValid() or self._unavailable or self._captureActive then
		self._introPending = nil
	end
	local intro = self._introPending ~= nil
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local phase = if snapshot then snapshot.phase else "loading"
	local isActive = phase == "active"
	local isResult = phase == "escaped" or phase == "aborted" or phase == "caught_out"
	local capturePhase = phase == "caught" or phase == "caught_out"
	local captureChoices = self:_captureReady()
		and not self._captureActive
		and not self._unavailable
		and not intro
	local expanded = phase == "ready" or phase == "escaped" or phase == "aborted"
	self._card.Size = if expanded then UDim2.fromOffset(780, 530) else UDim2.fromOffset(460, 320)
	self._modeCards.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Visible = expanded
	self._modeHint.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Text =
		text("corn_modes_selected", { mode = text("corn_modes_" .. self._selectedMode) })
	self._modeHint.Text = text("corn_modes_hint")
	self._message.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 62 else 68)
	self._message.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 32 else 52)
	self._time.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 96 else 124)
	self._time.Visible = not expanded or isResult
	self._time.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 22 else 26)
	self._chooseMode.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if isResult then 118 else 110)
	self._balance.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 440 else 154)
	self._notice.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 392 else 186)
	self._notice.Visible = not expanded
	for _, control in { self._start, self._retry, self._menu, self._preparingLeave } do
		control.Position = UDim2.new(
			control.Position.X.Scale,
			control.Position.X.Offset,
			0,
			if expanded then 476 else 250
		)
	end
	for mode, control in self._modeButtons do
		local enabled = expanded
			and snapshot ~= nil
			and not self._busy
			and not self._unavailable
			and not intro
			and not self._captureActive
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		local selected = mode == self._selectedMode
		control.Text = text(if selected then "corn_modes_selected_button" else "corn_modes_select")
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled
			then (if selected then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR)
			else DISABLED_COLOR
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Color = if selected
			then Color3.fromRGB(204, 190, 114)
			else Color3.fromRGB(61, 71, 60)
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Transparency = if selected then 0 else 0.6
	end
	self:_fitCard()
	self._card.Visible = not intro
		and not self._captureActive
		and (self._unavailable or (not isActive and not capturePhase))
	self._active.Visible = isActive
	self._activeLeave.Visible = isActive
	self._start.Visible = phase == "ready" or phase == "loading"
	self._retry.Visible = isResult and not capturePhase
	self._menu.Visible = isResult and not capturePhase
	self._preparingLeave.Visible = phase == "preparing"
	for _, control in self._buttons do
		local enabled = control.Visible
			and snapshot ~= nil
			and not self._busy
			and not self._unavailable
			and not intro
			and not self._captureActive
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.TextTransparency = if enabled then 0 else 0.35
	end
	for _, control in { self._captureRevive, self._captureExit } do
		control.Active = captureChoices and self:_canAct()
		control.AutoButtonColor = control.Active
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if control.Active then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.Modal = captureChoices
	end
	self._captureMessage.Text =
		text(if phase == "caught_out" then "corn_capture_retry" else "corn_capture_continue")
	self._introBack.Text = text(
		if self._introPending and self._introPending.phase == "caught_out"
			then "corn_capture_back"
			else "corn_loop_intro_back"
	)
	for _, control in { self._introConfirm, self._introBack } do
		control.Active = intro and self:_canAct()
		control.AutoButtonColor = control.Active
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if control.Active then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.Modal = intro
	end
	if self._introPending then
		self._introMode.Text =
			text("corn_modes_selected", { mode = text("corn_modes_" .. self._introPending.mode) })
	else
		self._introMode.Text = ""
	end

	self._title.Text = text("corn_loop_title")
	self._time.Text = ""
	self._notice.Text = if snapshot then text(snapshot.notice) else ""
	self._balance.Visible = snapshot ~= nil
	self._balance.Text = text(
		"corn_loop_test_balance",
		{ count = if snapshot then snapshot.session_diamonds else 0 }
	)
	if self._unavailable then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_loop_connection_error")
	elseif phase == "loading" or phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught" then
		self._message.Text = if phase == "caught"
			then text(snapshot and snapshot.notice or "corn_hunt_first_catch")
			else text("corn_loop_loading")
	elseif phase == "ready" then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_modes_choose")
	elseif snapshot and isResult then
		self._title.Text = text(
			if phase == "escaped"
				then "corn_loop_result_escape"
				elseif phase == "caught_out" then "corn_hunt_defeat"
				else "corn_loop_result_aborted"
		)
		self._message.Text = if phase == "escaped"
			then text("corn_loop_reward", { count = snapshot.reward_diamonds })
			else ""
		self._time.Text = text("corn_loop_round_time", { time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) })
	end

	-- Clear inactive/stale warning styling before rendering this confirmed state.
	self._activeNotice.Text = ""
	self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = NOTICE_COLOR
	self._activeNotice.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	if snapshot and isActive then
		local objectiveKey = if snapshot.gate_open
			then "corn_loop_objective_exit"
			elseif snapshot.has_key then "corn_loop_objective_return"
			else "corn_loop_objective_search"
		self._objective.Text = text(objectiveKey)
		self._activeTime.Text = text(
			"corn_loop_round_time",
			{ time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) }
		) .. " · " .. text(
			"corn_modes_active",
			{ mode = text("corn_modes_" .. snapshot.lighting_mode) }
		)
		self._activeBalance.Text = self._balance.Text
		local chasing = snapshot.protection_sec <= 0 and snapshot.monster_state == "chase"
		self._activeNotice.Text = if snapshot.protection_sec > 0
			then text("corn_hunt_protected", { seconds = math.ceil(snapshot.protection_sec) })
			elseif chasing then text("corn_hunt_chase")
			else text(snapshot.notice)
		self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = if chasing then CHASE_COLOR else NOTICE_COLOR
		self._activeNotice.Font = if chasing then Enum.Font.GothamBold else Enum.Font.Gotham
		self._activeBalance.Text ..= " · " .. text(
			"corn_hunt_attempts",
			{ count = snapshot.catches_remaining }
		)
	end
	local remaining = if snapshot
		then math.ceil(Balance.hunt_start_delay_sec - snapshot.elapsed_sec)
		else 0
	local waking = snapshot ~= nil
		and isActive
		and not self._unavailable
		and not self._captureActive
		and snapshot.monster_state == "dormant"
		and remaining >= 1
		and remaining <= 5
		and snapshot.elapsed_sec < Balance.hunt_start_delay_sec
	self._waking.Visible = waking
	self._wakingMessage.Text = if waking then text("corn_hunt_waking_warning") else ""
	self._wakingSeconds.Text = if waking
		then text("corn_hunt_waking_seconds", { seconds = remaining })
		else ""
	self:_fitOverlays()
	if intro then
		self:_captureChoicesVisibility(false)
		self:_introVisibility(true)
	else
		self:_introVisibility(false)
		self:_captureChoicesVisibility(captureChoices)
	end
end

function RoundHud:Render(snapshot: Snapshot)
	self._unavailable = false
	if snapshot.phase ~= self._lastPhase and snapshot.phase ~= "ready" then
		self._selectedMode = snapshot.lighting_mode
	end
	self._lastPhase = snapshot.phase
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetBusy(busy: boolean)
	self._busy = busy
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetCaptureActive(active: boolean)
	self._captureActive = active
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:ShowUnavailable()
	self._unavailable = true
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:Destroy()
	self._introPending = nil
	self:_introVisibility(false)
	self:_captureChoicesVisibility(false)
	if
		GuiService.SelectedObject == self._captureRevive
		or GuiService.SelectedObject == self._captureExit
	then
		GuiService.SelectedObject = nil
	end
	self._destroyed = true
	self._snapshot, self._onAction = nil, nil
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._root:Destroy()
	self._introRoot:Destroy()
end

return RoundHud

local function text(key: string, values: { [string]: string | number }?): string
	local template = RoundText[key] or ""
	return (
		string.gsub(template, "{([%w_]+)}", function(name)
			local value = if values then values[name] else nil
			return if value ~= nil then tostring(value) else "{" .. name .. "}"
		end)
	)
end

local function elapsedText(seconds: number): string
	local whole = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(whole / 60), whole % 60)
end

					self:_stepEvacuation(os.clock())
				end
			end)
		)
	end

function RoundHud:_stepEvacuation(now: number)
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local state = snapshot and snapshot.evacuation
	local visible = not self._unavailable
		and state
		and state.active
		and (snapshot.phase == "active" or snapshot.phase == "caught")
	self._evacuation.Visible = visible == true
	if not visible then
		return
	end
	local remaining = math.max(0, (self._evacuationUntil or now) - now)
	self._evacuationClock.Text = elapsedText(math.ceil(remaining))
	self._evacuationClock.TextTransparency = 0.08
		+ 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(now * math.pi * 1.5))
end

function RoundHud:_fitCard()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	local viewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		self._cardScale.Scale = math.min(
			1,
			(viewport.X - 36) / self._card.Size.X.Offset,
			(viewport.Y - 36) / self._card.Size.Y.Offset
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_fitOverlays()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	local viewport = self._introRoot.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		local width, height = math.min(640, viewport.X - 36), math.min(390, viewport.Y - 36)
		self._introPanel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1, width), math.max(1, height))
		local bodyHeight = math.max(40, height - 222)
		self._introMessage.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, bodyHeight)
		self._introMessage.TextSize =
			math.min(if width < 390 then 24 else 32, math.max(18, bodyHeight / 3))
		self._introMode.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, height - 146)
		self._introConfirm.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, height - 112)
		self._introBack.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, height - 54)
	end
	local hudViewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if hudViewport.X > 0 and hudViewport.Y > 0 then
		local width = math.min(600, math.max(1, hudViewport.X - 36))
		self._waking.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 120)
		self._waking.Position =
			UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, math.max(0, math.min(150, hudViewport.Y - 144)))
		self._wakingMessage.TextSize = if width < 390 then 17 else 21
		self._captureScale.Scale =
			math.min(1, (hudViewport.X - 36) / 380, (hudViewport.Y - 36) / 244)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_captureReady(): boolean
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	return snapshot ~= nil
		and snapshot.capture ~= nil
		and snapshot.capture.remaining == 0
		and (
			snapshot.phase == "caught_out"
			or (snapshot.phase == "caught" and snapshot.catches_remaining == 1)
		)
end

function RoundHud:_captureChoicesVisibility(visible: boolean)
	self._captureChoices.Visible = visible
	if visible == self._captureChoicesVisible then
		return
	end
	self._captureChoicesVisible = visible
	if visible then
		self._captureSavedSelection = GuiService.SelectedObject
		GuiService.SelectedObject = self._captureRevive
	elseif
		GuiService.SelectedObject == self._captureRevive
		or GuiService.SelectedObject == self._captureExit
	then
		local saved = self._captureSavedSelection
		GuiService.SelectedObject = if saved and saved.Parent and saved.Visible then saved else nil
	end
	if not visible then
		self._captureSavedSelection = nil
	end
end

function RoundHud:ChooseCapture(action: string)
	if
		not self:_canAct()
		or not self:_captureReady()
		or self._captureActive
		or self._introPending
		or not self._onAction
	then
		return
	end
	if action == "revive" and self._snapshot.phase == "caught_out" then
		self:ShowObjective("retry")
	elseif action == "revive" or action == "menu" then
		self:SetBusy(true)
		self._onAction(action, nil)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_canAct(): boolean
	return not self._destroyed
		and not self._busy
		and not self._unavailable
		and self._snapshot ~= nil
end

function RoundHud:_introValid(): boolean
	local pending, snapshot = self._introPending, self._snapshot
	return pending ~= nil
		and snapshot ~= nil
		and snapshot.phase == pending.phase
		and snapshot.minimap.round_id == pending.roundId
		and LightingModes.IsValid(pending.mode)
		and (pending.phase ~= "caught_out" or self:_captureReady())
end

function RoundHud:_introVisibility(visible: boolean)
	self._introRoot.Enabled = visible
	if visible == self._introVisible then
		return
	end
	self._introVisible = visible
	if visible then
		self._savedSelection = GuiService.SelectedObject
		GuiService.SelectedObject = self._introConfirm
	elseif
		GuiService.SelectedObject == self._introConfirm
		or GuiService.SelectedObject == self._introBack
	then
		local saved = self._savedSelection
		GuiService.SelectedObject = if saved and saved.Parent and saved.Visible then saved else nil
	end
	if not visible then
		self._savedSelection = nil
	end
end

function RoundHud:ShowObjective(action: string)
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	if not self:_canAct() or not snapshot or self._captureActive or self._introPending then
		return
	end
	local allowed = (action == "start" and snapshot.phase == "ready")
		or (
			action == "retry"
			and (
				snapshot.phase == "escaped"
				or snapshot.phase == "aborted"
				or snapshot.phase == "caught_out"
			)
		)
	if
		not allowed
		or not LightingModes.IsValid(self._selectedMode)
		or (snapshot.phase == "caught_out" and not self:_captureReady())
	then
		return
	end
	if snapshot.phase == "caught_out" then
		self._selectedMode = snapshot.lighting_mode
	end
	self._introPending = {
		action = action,
		mode = self._selectedMode,
		phase = snapshot.phase,
		roundId = snapshot.minimap.round_id,
	}
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:CloseObjective()
	self._introPending = nil
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:ConfirmObjective()
	if
		not self:_canAct()
		or self._captureActive
		or not self:_introValid()
		or not self._onAction
	then
		return
	end
	local pending = self._introPending
	self._introPending = nil
	self:_render()
	self._onAction(pending.action, pending.mode)
end

function RoundHud:SetOnAction(callback: (string, string?) -> ())
	self._onAction = callback
	if self._actionBound then
		return
	end
	self._actionBound = true
	local bindings = {
		{ button = self._start, action = "start" },
		{ button = self._retry, action = "retry" },
		{ button = self._menu, action = "menu" },
		{ button = self._preparingLeave, action = "abort" },
		{ button = self._activeLeave, action = "abort" },
	}
	for _, binding in bindings do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			binding.button.Activated:Connect(function()
				if
					self:_canAct()
					and binding.button.Visible
					and binding.button.Active
					and not self._captureActive
					and not self._introPending
					and self._onAction
				then
					if binding.action == "start" or binding.action == "retry" then
						self:ShowObjective(binding.action)
					else
						self._onAction(binding.action, nil)
					end
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	for _, binding in
		{
			{ button = self._captureRevive, action = "revive" },
			{ button = self._captureExit, action = "menu" },
		}
	do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			binding.button.Activated:Connect(function()
				self:ChooseCapture(binding.action)
			end)
		)
	end
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		self._introConfirm.Activated:Connect(function()
			self:ConfirmObjective()
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		self._introBack.Activated:Connect(function()
			if self:_canAct() then
				self:CloseObjective()
			end
		end)
	)
end

function RoundHud:_render()
	self:_stepEvacuation(os.clock())
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	if not self:_introValid() or self._unavailable or self._captureActive then
		self._introPending = nil
	end
	local intro = self._introPending ~= nil
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local phase = if snapshot then snapshot.phase else "loading"
	local isActive = phase == "active"
	local isResult = phase == "escaped" or phase == "aborted" or phase == "caught_out"
	local capturePhase = phase == "caught" or phase == "caught_out"
	local captureChoices = self:_captureReady()
		and not self._captureActive
		and not self._unavailable
		and not intro
	local expanded = phase == "ready" or phase == "escaped" or phase == "aborted"
	self._card.Size = if expanded then UDim2.fromOffset(780, 530) else UDim2.fromOffset(460, 320)
	self._modeCards.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Visible = expanded
	self._modeHint.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Text =
		text("corn_modes_selected", { mode = text("corn_modes_" .. self._selectedMode) })
	self._modeHint.Text = text("corn_modes_hint")
	self._message.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 62 else 68)
	self._message.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 32 else 52)
	self._time.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 96 else 124)
	self._time.Visible = not expanded or isResult
	self._time.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 22 else 26)
	self._chooseMode.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if isResult then 118 else 110)
	self._balance.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 440 else 154)
	self._notice.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 392 else 186)
	self._notice.Visible = not expanded
	for _, control in { self._start, self._retry, self._menu, self._preparingLeave } do
		control.Position = UDim2.new(
			control.Position.X.Scale,
			control.Position.X.Offset,
			0,
			if expanded then 476 else 250
		)
	end
	for mode, control in self._modeButtons do
		local enabled = expanded
			and snapshot ~= nil
			and not self._busy
			and not self._unavailable
			and not intro
			and not self._captureActive
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		local selected = mode == self._selectedMode
		control.Text = text(if selected then "corn_modes_selected_button" else "corn_modes_select")
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled
			then (if selected then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR)
			else DISABLED_COLOR
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Color = if selected
			then Color3.fromRGB(204, 190, 114)
			else Color3.fromRGB(61, 71, 60)
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Transparency = if selected then 0 else 0.6
	end
	self:_fitCard()
	self._card.Visible = not intro
		and not self._captureActive
		and (self._unavailable or (not isActive and not capturePhase))
	self._active.Visible = isActive
	self._activeLeave.Visible = isActive
	self._start.Visible = phase == "ready" or phase == "loading"
	self._retry.Visible = isResult and not capturePhase
	self._menu.Visible = isResult and not capturePhase
	self._preparingLeave.Visible = phase == "preparing"
	for _, control in self._buttons do
		local enabled = control.Visible
			and snapshot ~= nil
			and not self._busy
			and not self._unavailable
			and not intro
			and not self._captureActive
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.TextTransparency = if enabled then 0 else 0.35
	end
	for _, control in { self._captureRevive, self._captureExit } do
		control.Active = captureChoices and self:_canAct()
		control.AutoButtonColor = control.Active
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if control.Active then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.Modal = captureChoices
	end
	local expired = snapshot and snapshot.notice == "corn_evacuation_expired"
	self._captureTitle.Text = if expired then "Время вышло" else text("corn_hunt_defeat")
	self._captureMessage.Text = text(
		if expired
			then "corn_evacuation_expired"
			elseif phase == "caught_out" then "corn_capture_retry"
			else "corn_capture_continue"
	)
	self._introBack.Text = text(
		if self._introPending and self._introPending.phase == "caught_out"
			then "corn_capture_back"
			else "corn_loop_intro_back"
	)
	for _, control in { self._introConfirm, self._introBack } do
		control.Active = intro and self:_canAct()
		control.AutoButtonColor = control.Active
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if control.Active then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.Modal = intro
	end
	if self._introPending then
		self._introMode.Text =
			text("corn_modes_selected", { mode = text("corn_modes_" .. self._introPending.mode) })
	else
		self._introMode.Text = ""
	end

	self._title.Text = text("corn_loop_title")
	self._time.Text = ""
	self._notice.Text = if snapshot then text(snapshot.notice) else ""
	self._balance.Visible = snapshot ~= nil
	self._balance.Text = text(
		"corn_loop_test_balance",
		{ count = if snapshot then snapshot.session_diamonds else 0 }
	)
	if self._unavailable then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_loop_connection_error")
	elseif phase == "loading" or phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught" then
		self._message.Text = if phase == "caught"
			then text(snapshot and snapshot.notice or "corn_hunt_first_catch")
			else text("corn_loop_loading")
	elseif phase == "ready" then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_modes_choose")
	elseif snapshot and isResult then
		self._title.Text = text(
			if phase == "escaped"
				then "corn_loop_result_escape"
				elseif phase == "caught_out" then "corn_hunt_defeat"
				else "corn_loop_result_aborted"
		)
		self._message.Text = if phase == "escaped"
			then text("corn_loop_reward", { count = snapshot.reward_diamonds })
			else ""
		self._time.Text = text("corn_loop_round_time", { time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) })
	end

	-- Clear inactive/stale warning styling before rendering this confirmed state.
	self._activeNotice.Text = ""
	self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = NOTICE_COLOR
	self._activeNotice.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	if snapshot and isActive then
		local objectiveKey = if snapshot.gate_open
			then "corn_loop_objective_exit"
			elseif snapshot.has_key then "corn_loop_objective_return"
			else "corn_loop_objective_search"
		self._objective.Text = text(objectiveKey)
		self._activeTime.Text = text(
			"corn_loop_round_time",
			{ time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) }
		) .. " · " .. text(
			"corn_modes_active",
			{ mode = text("corn_modes_" .. snapshot.lighting_mode) }
		)
		self._activeBalance.Text = self._balance.Text
		local chasing = snapshot.protection_sec <= 0 and snapshot.monster_state == "chase"
		self._activeNotice.Text = if snapshot.protection_sec > 0
			then text("corn_hunt_protected", { seconds = math.ceil(snapshot.protection_sec) })
			elseif chasing then text("corn_hunt_chase")
			else text(snapshot.notice)
		self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = if chasing then CHASE_COLOR else NOTICE_COLOR
		self._activeNotice.Font = if chasing then Enum.Font.GothamBold else Enum.Font.Gotham
		self._activeBalance.Text ..= " · " .. text(
			"corn_hunt_attempts",
			{ count = snapshot.catches_remaining }
		)
	end
	local remaining = if snapshot
		then math.ceil(Balance.hunt_start_delay_sec - snapshot.elapsed_sec)
		else 0
	local waking = snapshot ~= nil
		and isActive
		and not self._unavailable
		and not self._captureActive
		and snapshot.monster_state == "dormant"
		and remaining >= 1
		and remaining <= 5
		and snapshot.elapsed_sec < Balance.hunt_start_delay_sec
	self._waking.Visible = waking
	self._wakingMessage.Text = if waking then text("corn_hunt_waking_warning") else ""
	self._wakingSeconds.Text = if waking
		then text("corn_hunt_waking_seconds", { seconds = remaining })
		else ""
	self:_fitOverlays()
	if intro then
		self:_captureChoicesVisibility(false)
		self:_introVisibility(true)
	else
		self:_introVisibility(false)
		self:_captureChoicesVisibility(captureChoices)
	end
end

function RoundHud:Render(snapshot: Snapshot)
	self._evacuationUntil = if snapshot.evacuation and snapshot.evacuation.active
		then os.clock() + snapshot.evacuation.remaining
		else nil
	self._unavailable = false
	if snapshot.phase ~= self._lastPhase and snapshot.phase ~= "ready" then
		self._selectedMode = snapshot.lighting_mode
	end
	self._lastPhase = snapshot.phase
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetBusy(busy: boolean)
	self._busy = busy
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetCaptureActive(active: boolean)
	self._captureActive = active
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:ShowUnavailable()
	self._unavailable = true
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:Destroy()
	self._introPending = nil
	self:_introVisibility(false)
	self:_captureChoicesVisibility(false)
	if
		GuiService.SelectedObject == self._captureRevive
		or GuiService.SelectedObject == self._captureExit
	then
		GuiService.SelectedObject = nil
	end
	self._destroyed = true
	self._snapshot, self._onAction = nil, nil
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._root:Destroy()
	self._introRoot:Destroy()
end

return RoundHud

local BUTTON_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(84, 109, 67)
local DISABLED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(63, 69, 61)
local NOTICE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(233, 209, 142)

local function text(key: string, values: { [string]: string | number }?): string
	local template = RoundText[key] or ""
	return (
		string.gsub(template, "{([%w_]+)}", function(name)
			local value = if values then values[name] else nil
			return if value ~= nil then tostring(value) else "{" .. name .. "}"
		end)
	)
end

local function elapsedText(seconds: number): string
	local whole = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(whole / 60), whole % 60)
end

local function label(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2,
	fontSize: number
): TextLabel
	local result = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	result.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	result.TextSize = fontSize
	result.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
	result.TextWrapped = true
	result.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	result.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	result.Text = ""
	result.Parent = parent
	return result
end

local function button(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	key: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2
): TextButton
	local result = Instance.new("TextButton")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundColor3 = BUTTON_COLOR
	result.BorderSizePixel = 0
	result.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	result.TextSize = 17
	result.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
	result.Text = text(key)
	result.Modal = parent.Name == "RoundCard"
	result.Parent = parent
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = result
	return result
end

local function panel(parent: Instance, name: string, size: UDim2, position: UDim2): Frame
	local result = Instance.new("Frame")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_COLOR
	result.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
	result.BorderSizePixel = 0
	result.Parent = parent
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = result
	return result
end

		_actionBound = false,

		_buttons = { start, retry, menu, preparingLeave, activeLeave },
		_connections = {} :: { RBXScriptConnection },
		_snapshot = nil :: Snapshot?,
		_busy = false,
		_captureActive = false,

		_captureMessage = captureMessage,

	}, RoundHud)

		self._connections,
		root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			self:_fitCard()
			self:_fitOverlays()
		end)
	)

		self._connections,
		introRoot:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			self:_fitOverlays()
		end)
	)
	self:_render()
	if RunService and RunService.RenderStepped then
		local elapsed = 0
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
				elapsed += dt
				if elapsed >= 0.1 then
					elapsed = 0
					self:_stepEvacuation(os.clock())
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	return self
end

function RoundHud:_stepEvacuation(now: number)
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local state = snapshot and snapshot.evacuation
	local visible = not self._unavailable
		and state
		and state.active
		and (snapshot.phase == "active" or snapshot.phase == "caught")
	self._evacuation.Visible = visible == true
	if not visible then
		return
	end
	local remaining = math.max(0, (self._evacuationUntil or now) - now)
	self._evacuationClock.Text = elapsedText(math.ceil(remaining))
	self._evacuationClock.TextTransparency = 0.08
		+ 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(now * math.pi * 1.5))
end

function RoundHud:_fitCard()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	local viewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		self._cardScale.Scale = math.min(
			1,
			(viewport.X - 36) / self._card.Size.X.Offset,
			(viewport.Y - 36) / self._card.Size.Y.Offset
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_fitOverlays()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	local viewport = self._introRoot.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		local width, height = math.min(640, viewport.X - 36), math.min(390, viewport.Y - 36)
		self._introPanel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1, width), math.max(1, height))
		local bodyHeight = math.max(40, height - 222)
		self._introMessage.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, bodyHeight)
		self._introMessage.TextSize =
			math.min(if width < 390 then 24 else 32, math.max(18, bodyHeight / 3))
		self._introConfirm.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, height - 112)
		self._introBack.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, height - 54)
	end
	local hudViewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if hudViewport.X > 0 and hudViewport.Y > 0 then
		local width = math.min(600, math.max(1, hudViewport.X - 36))
		self._waking.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 120)
		self._waking.Position =
			UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, math.max(0, math.min(150, hudViewport.Y - 144)))
		self._wakingMessage.TextSize = if width < 390 then 17 else 21
		self._captureScale.Scale =
			math.min(1, (hudViewport.X - 36) / 380, (hudViewport.Y - 36) / 244)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_captureReady(): boolean
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	return snapshot ~= nil
		and snapshot.capture ~= nil
		and snapshot.capture.remaining == 0
		and (
			snapshot.phase == "caught_out"
			or (snapshot.phase == "caught" and snapshot.catches_remaining == 1)
		)
end

function RoundHud:_captureChoicesVisibility(visible: boolean)
	self._captureChoices.Visible = visible
	if visible == self._captureChoicesVisible then
		return
	end
	self._captureChoicesVisible = visible
	if visible then
		self._captureSavedSelection = GuiService.SelectedObject
		GuiService.SelectedObject = self._captureRevive
	elseif
		GuiService.SelectedObject == self._captureRevive
		or GuiService.SelectedObject == self._captureExit
	then
		local saved = self._captureSavedSelection
		GuiService.SelectedObject = if saved and saved.Parent and saved.Visible then saved else nil
	end
	if not visible then
		self._captureSavedSelection = nil
	end
end

function RoundHud:ChooseCapture(action: string)
	if
		not self:_canAct()
		or not self:_captureReady()
		or self._captureActive
		or self._introPending
		or not self._onAction
	then
		return
	end
	if action == "revive" and self._snapshot.phase == "caught_out" then
		self:ShowObjective("retry")
	elseif action == "revive" or action == "menu" then
		self:SetBusy(true)
		self._onAction(action, nil)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_canAct(): boolean
	return not self._destroyed
		and not self._busy
		and not self._unavailable
		and self._snapshot ~= nil
end

function RoundHud:_introValid(): boolean
	local pending, snapshot = self._introPending, self._snapshot
	return pending ~= nil
		and snapshot ~= nil
		and snapshot.phase == pending.phase
		and snapshot.minimap.round_id == pending.roundId
		and LightingModes.IsValid(pending.mode)
		and (pending.phase ~= "caught_out" or self:_captureReady())
end

function RoundHud:_introVisibility(visible: boolean)
	self._introRoot.Enabled = visible
	if visible == self._introVisible then
		return
	end
	self._introVisible = visible
	if visible then
		self._savedSelection = GuiService.SelectedObject
		GuiService.SelectedObject = self._introConfirm
	elseif
		GuiService.SelectedObject == self._introConfirm
		or GuiService.SelectedObject == self._introBack
	then
		local saved = self._savedSelection
		GuiService.SelectedObject = if saved and saved.Parent and saved.Visible then saved else nil
	end
	if not visible then
		self._savedSelection = nil
	end
end

function RoundHud:ShowObjective(action: string)
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	if not self:_canAct() or not snapshot or self._captureActive or self._introPending then
		return
	end
	local allowed = (action == "start" and snapshot.phase == "ready")
		or (
			action == "retry"
			and (
				snapshot.phase == "escaped"
				or snapshot.phase == "aborted"
				or snapshot.phase == "caught_out"
			)
		)
	if not allowed or (snapshot.phase == "caught_out" and not self:_captureReady()) then
		return
	end
	self._introPending = {
		action = action,
		mode = LightingModes.Default,
		phase = snapshot.phase,
		roundId = snapshot.minimap.round_id,
	}
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:CloseObjective()
	self._introPending = nil
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:ConfirmObjective()
	if
		not self:_canAct()
		or self._captureActive
		or not self:_introValid()
		or not self._onAction
	then
		return
	end
	local pending = self._introPending
	self._introPending = nil
	self:_render()
	self._onAction(pending.action, pending.mode)
end

function RoundHud:SetOnAction(callback: (string, string?) -> ())
	self._onAction = callback
	if self._actionBound then
		return
	end
	self._actionBound = true
	local bindings = {
		{ button = self._start, action = "start" },
		{ button = self._retry, action = "retry" },
		{ button = self._menu, action = "menu" },
		{ button = self._preparingLeave, action = "abort" },
		{ button = self._activeLeave, action = "abort" },
	}
	for _, binding in bindings do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			binding.button.Activated:Connect(function()
				if
					self:_canAct()
					and binding.button.Visible
					and binding.button.Active
					and not self._captureActive
					and not self._introPending
					and self._onAction
				then
					if binding.action == "start" or binding.action == "retry" then
						self:ShowObjective(binding.action)
					else
						self._onAction(binding.action, nil)
					end
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	for _, binding in
		{
			{ button = self._captureRevive, action = "revive" },
			{ button = self._captureExit, action = "menu" },
		}
	do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			binding.button.Activated:Connect(function()
				self:ChooseCapture(binding.action)
			end)
		)
	end
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		self._introConfirm.Activated:Connect(function()
			self:ConfirmObjective()
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		self._introBack.Activated:Connect(function()
			if self:_canAct() then
				self:CloseObjective()
			end
		end)
	)
end

function RoundHud:_render()
	self:_stepEvacuation(os.clock())
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	if not self:_introValid() or self._unavailable or self._captureActive then
		self._introPending = nil
	end
	local intro = self._introPending ~= nil
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local phase = if snapshot then snapshot.phase else "loading"
	local isActive = phase == "active"
	local isResult = phase == "escaped" or phase == "aborted" or phase == "caught_out"
	local capturePhase = phase == "caught" or phase == "caught_out"
	local captureChoices = self:_captureReady()
		and not self._captureActive
		and not self._unavailable
		and not intro
	self._time.Visible = isResult
	self:_fitCard()
	self._card.Visible = not intro
		and not self._captureActive
		and (self._unavailable or (not isActive and not capturePhase))
	self._active.Visible = isActive
	self._activeLeave.Visible = isActive
	self._start.Visible = phase == "ready" or phase == "loading"
	self._retry.Visible = isResult and not capturePhase
	self._menu.Visible = isResult and not capturePhase
	self._preparingLeave.Visible = phase == "preparing"
	for _, control in self._buttons do
		local enabled = control.Visible
			and snapshot ~= nil
			and not self._busy
			and not self._unavailable
			and not intro
			and not self._captureActive
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.TextTransparency = if enabled then 0 else 0.35
	end
	for _, control in { self._captureRevive, self._captureExit } do
		control.Active = captureChoices and self:_canAct()
		control.AutoButtonColor = control.Active
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if control.Active then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.Modal = captureChoices
	end
	local expired = snapshot and snapshot.notice == "corn_evacuation_expired"
	self._captureTitle.Text = if expired then "Время вышло" else text("corn_hunt_defeat")
	self._captureMessage.Text = text(
		if expired
			then "corn_evacuation_expired"
			elseif phase == "caught_out" then "corn_capture_retry"
			else "corn_capture_continue"
	)
	self._introBack.Text = text(
		if self._introPending and self._introPending.phase == "caught_out"
			then "corn_capture_back"
			else "corn_loop_intro_back"
	)
	for _, control in { self._introConfirm, self._introBack } do
		control.Active = intro and self:_canAct()
		control.AutoButtonColor = control.Active
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if control.Active then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.Modal = intro
	end
	self._title.Text = text("corn_loop_title")
	self._time.Text = ""
	self._notice.Text = if snapshot then text(snapshot.notice) else ""
	self._balance.Visible = snapshot ~= nil
	self._balance.Text = text(
		"corn_loop_test_balance",
		{ count = if snapshot then snapshot.session_diamonds else 0 }
	)
	if self._unavailable then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_loop_connection_error")
	elseif phase == "loading" or phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught" then
		self._message.Text = if phase == "caught"
			then text(snapshot and snapshot.notice or "corn_hunt_first_catch")
			else text("corn_loop_loading")
	elseif phase == "ready" then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_loop_objective_search")
	elseif snapshot and isResult then
		self._title.Text = text(
			if phase == "escaped"
				then "corn_loop_result_escape"
				elseif phase == "caught_out" then "corn_hunt_defeat"
				else "corn_loop_result_aborted"
		)
		self._message.Text = if phase == "escaped"
			then text("corn_loop_reward", { count = snapshot.reward_diamonds })
			else ""
		self._time.Text = text("corn_loop_round_time", { time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) })
	end

	-- Clear inactive/stale warning styling before rendering this confirmed state.
	self._activeNotice.Text = ""
	self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = NOTICE_COLOR
	self._activeNotice.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	if snapshot and isActive then
		local objectiveKey = if snapshot.gate_open
			then "corn_loop_objective_exit"
			elseif snapshot.has_key then "corn_loop_objective_return"
			else "corn_loop_objective_search"
		self._objective.Text = text(objectiveKey)
		self._activeTime.Text =
			text("corn_loop_round_time", { time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) })
		self._activeBalance.Text = self._balance.Text
		local chasing = snapshot.protection_sec <= 0 and snapshot.monster_state == "chase"
		self._activeNotice.Text = if snapshot.protection_sec > 0
			then text("corn_hunt_protected", { seconds = math.ceil(snapshot.protection_sec) })
			elseif chasing then text("corn_hunt_chase")
			else text(snapshot.notice)
		self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = if chasing then CHASE_COLOR else NOTICE_COLOR
		self._activeNotice.Font = if chasing then Enum.Font.GothamBold else Enum.Font.Gotham
		self._activeBalance.Text ..= " · " .. text(
			"corn_hunt_attempts",
			{ count = snapshot.catches_remaining }
		)
	end
	local remaining = if snapshot
		then math.ceil(Balance.hunt_start_delay_sec - snapshot.elapsed_sec)
		else 0
	local waking = snapshot ~= nil
		and isActive
		and not self._unavailable
		and not self._captureActive
		and snapshot.monster_state == "dormant"
		and remaining >= 1
		and remaining <= 5
		and snapshot.elapsed_sec < Balance.hunt_start_delay_sec
	self._waking.Visible = waking
	self._wakingMessage.Text = if waking then text("corn_hunt_waking_warning") else ""
	self._wakingSeconds.Text = if waking
		then text("corn_hunt_waking_seconds", { seconds = remaining })
		else ""
	self:_fitOverlays()
	if intro then
		self:_captureChoicesVisibility(false)
		self:_introVisibility(true)
	else
		self:_introVisibility(false)
		self:_captureChoicesVisibility(captureChoices)
	end
end

function RoundHud:Render(snapshot: Snapshot)
	self._evacuationUntil = if snapshot.evacuation and snapshot.evacuation.active
		then os.clock() + snapshot.evacuation.remaining
		else nil
	self._unavailable = false
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetBusy(busy: boolean)
	self._busy = busy
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetCaptureActive(active: boolean)
	self._captureActive = active
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:ShowUnavailable()
	self._unavailable = true
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:Destroy()
	self._introPending = nil
	self:_introVisibility(false)
	self:_captureChoicesVisibility(false)
	if
		GuiService.SelectedObject == self._captureRevive
		or GuiService.SelectedObject == self._captureExit
	then
		GuiService.SelectedObject = nil
	end
	self._destroyed = true
	self._snapshot, self._onAction = nil, nil
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._root:Destroy()
	self._introRoot:Destroy()
end

return RoundHud

--!strict

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local CornLayout = require(
	ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CornLayout")
)

local CornBackdropController = { Name = "CornBackdropController", Order = 45 }
local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"
local FOLDER_NAME = "CornClientBackdrop"
local STRIDE = 2 -- CornLayout.Spacing * 2 = 6 studs; tune only after foreground engine QA.
local MAX_PLANTS = 20000
local CLONE_BUDGET = 18
local TIME_BUDGET = 0.002
local POLL_SEC = 1

local function owned(item: Instance): boolean
	return item:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") == true
		and item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
end

local function ownedTree(folder: Instance): boolean
	if not owned(folder) then
		return false
	end
	for _, item in folder:GetDescendants() do
		if not owned(item) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function staticArt(template: Instance): boolean
	for _, item in template:GetDescendants() do
		if
			item:IsA("LuaSourceContainer")
			or item:IsA("Sound")
			or item:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
			or item:IsA("Beam")
			or item:IsA("Trail")
			or item:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
			or item:IsA("ClickDetector")
			or item:IsA("RemoteEvent")
			or item:IsA("RemoteFunction")
		then
			return false
		end
	end
	return template.Archivable
end

function CornBackdropController:_warn(message: string)
	if self._lastWarning ~= message then
		self._lastWarning = message
		warn("[CornBackdropController] " .. message)
	end
end

function CornBackdropController:_bridge(folder: Folder): boolean
	local renderer = self._renderer
	return renderer ~= nil
		and typeof(renderer.UseBackdropReady) == "function"
		and renderer:UseBackdropReady(folder) == true
end

function CornBackdropController:_restoreOriginals()
	for part, previous in self._originals do
		if part.Parent then
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = previous
		end
	end
	table.clear(self._originals)
end

function CornBackdropController:_clear()
	self._epoch += 1
	local folder = self._folder
	if folder and owned(folder) then
		self:_bridge(folder)
		folder:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
	end
	self:_restoreOriginals()
	if folder then
		if ownedTree(folder) then
			folder:Destroy()
		else
			self:_warn(
				"Changed ownership or foreign backdrop content was preserved; saved overview restored"
			)
		end
	end
	self._folder = nil
	self._map = nil
	self._field = nil
	self._template = nil
	self._exclusions = nil
	self._signature = nil
	self._ready = false
	self._count = 0
end

function CornBackdropController:_publish(): boolean
	local folder, map = self._folder, self._map
	if not folder or not map or folder.Parent ~= map or not owned(folder) then
		return false
	end
	local overview = map:FindFirstChild("EditorFieldOverview")
	if
		not overview
		or not overview:IsA("Folder")
		or overview:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or overview:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_warn("Unrecognized saved overview was preserved; backdrop not published")
		return false
	end
	local originals = overview:GetChildren()
	for _, part in originals do
		if
			not part:IsA("BasePart")
			or part:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_warn("Foreign saved overview content was preserved; backdrop not published")
			return false
		end
	end
	-- Bridge clears the old near-field mask before we capture its exact original LTM.
	-- No yield between bridge, capture/hide and publication.
	if not self:_bridge(folder) then
		self:_warn("Near-field backdrop bridge unavailable; saved overview preserved")
		return false
	end
	for _, item in originals do
		local part = item :: BasePart
		self._originals[part] = part.LocalTransparencyModifier
		part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
	end
	self._ready = true

		or not field:IsA("BasePart")
		or field.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) < 0.9999
		or field.Size.X <= 0
		or field.Size.Z <= 0
		or not art
		or not art:IsA("Folder")

		or art:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not template

		.. "/template/"

		.. tostring(size)

		self._folder, self._field, self._template, self._exclusions
	if not folder or not field or not template or not exclusions or self._ready then
		return
	end
	if
		folder.Parent ~= self._map
		or not owned(folder)
		or field.CFrame ~= self._fieldFrame
		or field.Size ~= self._fieldSize
	then
		self:_clear()
		self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
		return
	end
	local epoch, start = self._epoch, self._clock()
	local created = 0
	while
		self._epoch == epoch
		and self._row <= self._maxRow
		and created < CLONE_BUDGET
		and self._count < MAX_PLANTS
		and self._clock() - start < TIME_BUDGET

		local column, row = self._column, self._row
		self:_advance()

		if CornLayout.IsExcluded(position, exclusions) then
			continue

		if not plant then

		end

		table.insert(parts, plant)
		for _, item in parts do
			item:SetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned", true)
			item:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
			item:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
			item:SetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned", nil)
			if item:IsA("BasePart") then
				item.Anchored = true
				item.CanCollide = false
				item.CanTouch = false
				item.CanQuery = false
				item.CastShadow = false
				if item:IsA("MeshPart") then
					item.RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Performance
				end

		end

		plant:PivotTo(

		end
	end

--!strict

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Appearance = require(
	ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CornAppearance")
)

local Controller = { Name = "CornAppearanceController", Order = 54 }
local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local BATCH = 384
local TIME_BUDGET = 0.002
local MAP_ROOTS = {
	EditorFieldOverview = "CornEditorOverview",
	CornClientPlants = "CornClientRendererOwned",
	CornClientBackdrop = "CornClientBackdropOwned",
}

local function recognized(root: Instance, flag: string): boolean
	return root:GetAttribute(flag) == true and root:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
end

local function ownedPart(root: any, part: MeshPart): boolean
	local folder = root.folder
	if
		not recognized(folder, root.flag)
		or not part.Anchored
		or part.CanCollide
		or part.CanTouch
		or part.CanQuery
	then
		return false
	end
	if root.flag == "CornRuntimeArtOwned" then
		return part.Parent == folder
			and part.Name == "CornPlantTemplate"
			and part:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") == true
	elseif root.flag == "CornClientRendererOwned" then
		local group = part.Parent
		return group ~= nil
			and group:IsA("Folder")
			and group.Parent == folder
			and part.Name == "Corn"
			and part:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") == true
	end
	return part.Parent == folder
		and part:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		and part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		and (
			root.flag ~= "CornClientBackdropOwned"
			or part:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") == true
		)
end

function Controller:_queue(part: MeshPart)
	if not self._queued[part] then
		self._queued[part] = true
		table.insert(self._queue, part)
	end
end

function Controller:_restore(part: MeshPart, entry: any)
	-- Preserve an unrelated manual texture change rather than overwriting it.
	if entry.applied and part.TextureID == Appearance.DryTextureId then
		part.TextureID = entry.texture
	end
	entry.applied = false
end

function Controller:_forget(part: MeshPart)
	local entry = self._entries[part]
	if entry then
		self:_restore(part, entry)
		entry.root.parts[part] = nil
		self._entries[part] = nil
	end
	self._queued[part] = nil
end

function Controller:_register(root: any, item: Instance)
	if
		not item:IsA("MeshPart")
		or item.MeshId ~= Appearance.MeshId
		or self._entries[item]
		or not ownedPart(root, item)
	then
		return
	end
	if item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
		return
	end
	local texture = item.TextureID
	if texture ~= Appearance.GreenTextureId and texture ~= Appearance.DryTextureId then
		return
	end
	-- New clones can inherit the locally dry template; their original is green.
	local entry = {
		root = root,
		texture = if texture == Appearance.DryTextureId then Appearance.GreenTextureId else texture,
		applied = texture == Appearance.DryTextureId,
	}
	self._entries[item] = entry
	root.parts[item] = true
	self:_queue(item)
end

function Controller:_bind(folder: Instance, flag: string)
	if self._roots[folder] then

	local root = { folder = folder, flag = flag, parts = {}, connections = {} }

	table.insert(
		root.connections,
		folder.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(item)
			self:_register(root, item)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		root.connections,
		folder.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(item)
			if item:IsA("MeshPart") then

			end
		end)
	)
	for _, item in folder:GetDescendants() do

	end

function Controller:_unbind(root: any)
	for _, connection in root.connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end

	self._roots[root.folder] = nil
end

	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local validMap = map and map:IsA("Model") and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
	local desired = {}
	if
		validMap

		and not Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models")
	then
		for name, flag in MAP_ROOTS do
			local folder = map:FindFirstChild(name)
			if folder and folder:IsA("Folder") and recognized(folder, flag) then
				desired[folder] = flag
			end
		end
		local art = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornRuntimeArt")
		if art and art:IsA("Folder") and recognized(art, "CornRuntimeArtOwned") then
			desired[art] = "CornRuntimeArtOwned"
		end
	end
	for folder, root in self._roots do
		if not desired[folder] then
			self:_unbind(root)
		end
	end
	for folder, flag in desired do
		self:_bind(folder, flag)
	end
end

function Controller:_apply(part: MeshPart)
	local entry = self._entries[part]
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	local root = entry.root
	if
		not part:IsDescendantOf(root.folder)
		or not ownedPart(root, part)
		or part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceAppearance")
	then
		self:_forget(part)
		return
	end
	local expected = if entry.applied then Appearance.DryTextureId else entry.texture
	if part.TextureID ~= expected or part.MeshId ~= Appearance.MeshId then
		-- Drop ownership of this appearance; the author changed the runtime copy.
		root.parts[part] = nil
		self._entries[part] = nil
		return
	end
	if Appearance.IsDry(self._mode) then
		part.TextureID = Appearance.DryTextureId
		entry.applied = true
	else
		self:_restore(part, entry)
	end
end

			self:_refresh()
		end
		local began, count = os.clock(), 0
		while self._head <= #self._queue and count < BATCH and os.clock() - began < TIME_BUDGET do
			local part = self._queue[self._head]
			self._head += 1
			self._queued[part] = nil
			self:_apply(part)
			count += 1
		end
		if self._head > #self._queue then
			table.clear(self._queue)
			self._head = 1
		end
	end)
end

function Controller:Destroy()
	if self._heartbeat then
		self._heartbeat:Disconnect()
		self._heartbeat = nil
	end
	for _, root in self._roots do

	end

	table.clear(self._queued)
end

return Controller

	return root:GetAttribute(flag) == true and root:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT

local function ownedPart(root: any, part: MeshPart): boolean
	local folder = root.folder
	if
		not recognized(folder, root.flag)
		or not part.Anchored
		or part.CanCollide
		or part.CanTouch
		or part.CanQuery
	then
		return false

		and part:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		and part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT

			or part:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") == true
		)

	-- Preserve an unrelated manual texture change rather than overwriting it.

	end
