--!strict
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local CornWindController = { Name = "CornWindController", Order = 55 }
local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"
local BUCKET_SIZE = 24
local RADIUS = 60
local UPDATE_SEC = 1 / 12
local SELECT_SEC = 0.35
local RESOLVE_SEC = 0.5
local INDEX_BUDGET = 64
local INDEX_SECONDS = 0.001
local NEAR_LIMIT = 384
local FAR_LIMIT = 128
local PART_LIMIT = 512
local ANIMATE_SECONDS = 0.0015
local MAX_PARTS_PER_PLANT = 8
local ANGLE = math.rad(1.2)

local function disconnect(connections: { RBXScriptConnection })
	for _, connection in connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)
end

local function decorative(part: BasePart): boolean
	return part.Anchored and not part.CanCollide and not part.CanTouch and not part.CanQuery
end

local function bucketKey(x: number, z: number): string
	return tostring(x) .. ":" .. tostring(z)
end

function CornWindController:_ownedLayer(folder: Instance, kind: string): boolean
	return folder:IsA("Folder")
		and folder.Parent == self._map
		and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
		and (
			if kind == "near"
				then folder.Name == "CornClientPlants" and folder:GetAttribute(
					"CornClientRendererOwned"
				) == true
				else folder.Name == "CornClientBackdrop" and folder:GetAttribute(
					"CornClientBackdropOwned"
				) == true and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		)
end

function CornWindController:_validEntry(entry: any): boolean
	local layer = entry.Layer
	if
		self._layers[layer.Kind] ~= layer
		or not self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, layer.Kind)
		or entry.Plant.Parent ~= entry.Parent
	then
		return false
	end
	if layer.Kind == "near" then
		if
			entry.Parent.Parent ~= layer.Folder
			or entry.Plant.Name ~= "Corn"
			or entry.Plant:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		then
			return false
		end
	elseif
		entry.Plant:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") ~= true
		or entry.Plant:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		return false
	end
	for _, saved in entry.Parts do
		if not decorative(saved.Part) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function CornWindController:_restore(entry: any)
	if not entry.Moved then
		return
	end
	-- Removed copies can still be unparented Instances. Restore their exact frames
	-- before forgetting them; destroyed copies need no recovery.
	for _, saved in entry.Parts do
		pcall(function()
			saved.Part.CFrame = saved.Frame
		end)
	end
	entry.Moved = false
end

function CornWindController:_restoreActive()
	for entry in self._active do
		self:_restore(entry)
	end
	self._active = {}
	self._selected = {}
end

function CornWindController:_remove(layer: any, plant: Instance)
	local entry = layer.Entries[plant]
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	self:_restore(entry)
	self._active[entry] = nil
	layer.Entries[plant] = nil
	layer.Count -= 1
	local bucket = layer.Buckets[entry.Bucket]
	if bucket then
		bucket[entry] = nil
		if next(bucket) == nil then
			layer.Buckets[entry.Bucket] = nil
		end
	end
	local group = layer.Groups[entry.Parent]
	if group then
		group.Entries[plant] = nil
	end
	self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_enqueue(layer: any, plant: Instance, parent: Instance)
	self._pendingTail += 1
	self._pending[self._pendingTail] = { Layer = layer, Plant = plant, Parent = parent }
end

function CornWindController:_register(job: any)
	local layer, plant, parent = job.Layer, job.Plant, job.Parent
	if
		self._layers[layer.Kind] ~= layer
		or layer.Entries[plant]
		or not self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, layer.Kind)
		or plant.Parent ~= parent
	then
		return
	end
	if layer.Kind == "near" then
		if
			not layer.Groups[parent]
			or plant.Name ~= "Corn"
			or plant:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		then
			return
		end
	elseif
		not plant.Name:match("^Far_%-?%d+_%-?%d+$")
		or plant:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") ~= true
		or plant:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		return
	end
	if layer.Count >= (if layer.Kind == "near" then 4096 else 20000) then
		return
	end
	local parts, frame, size = {}, nil, nil
	if plant:IsA("BasePart") then
		if not decorative(plant) then
			return
		end
		table.insert(parts, { Part = plant, Frame = plant.CFrame })
		frame, size = plant.CFrame, plant.Size
	elseif plant:IsA("Model") then
		for _, part in plant:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				if not decorative(part) or #parts >= MAX_PARTS_PER_PLANT then
					return
				end
				table.insert(parts, { Part = part, Frame = part.CFrame })
			end
		end
		if #parts == 0 then
			return
		end
		frame, size = plant:GetBoundingBox()
	else
		return
	end
	local position = frame.Position
	local key =
		bucketKey(math.floor(position.X / BUCKET_SIZE), math.floor(position.Z / BUCKET_SIZE))
	local entry = {
		Layer = layer,
		Plant = plant,
		Parent = parent,
		Parts = parts,
		Position = position,
		Base = position - Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0),
		Bucket = key,
		Phase = (position.X * 0.17 + position.Z * 0.11) % (math.pi * 2),
		Moved = false,
	}
	layer.Entries[plant] = entry
	layer.Count += 1
	if not layer.Buckets[key] then
		layer.Buckets[key] = {}
	end
	layer.Buckets[key][entry] = true
	if layer.Kind == "near" then
		layer.Groups[parent].Entries[plant] = true
	end
	self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_indexBatch()
	local began, count = self._clock(), 0
	while
		self._pendingHead <= self._pendingTail
		and count < INDEX_BUDGET
		and self._clock() - began < INDEX_SECONDS
	do
		local job = self._pending[self._pendingHead]
		self._pending[self._pendingHead] = nil
		self._pendingHead += 1
		self:_register(job)
		count += 1
	end
	if self._pendingHead > self._pendingTail then
		self._pending, self._pendingHead, self._pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	end
end

function CornWindController:_removeGroup(layer: any, folder: Instance)
	local group = layer.Groups[folder]
	if not group then
		return
	end
	disconnect(group.Connections)
	for plant in group.Entries do
		self:_remove(layer, plant)
	end
	layer.Groups[folder] = nil
end

function CornWindController:_bindGroup(layer: any, folder: Instance)
	if
		layer.Groups[folder]
		or not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or folder.Parent ~= layer.Folder
		or not folder.Name:match("^Chunk_")
	then
		return
	end
	local group = { Connections = {}, Entries = {} }
	layer.Groups[folder] = group
	table.insert(
		group.Connections,
		folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(plant)
			self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		group.Connections,
		folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(plant)
			self:_remove(layer, plant)
		end)
	)
	for _, plant in folder:GetChildren() do
		self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
	end
end

function CornWindController:_detachLayer(kind: string)
	local layer = self._layers[kind]
	if not layer then
		return
	end
	for _, group in layer.Groups do
		disconnect(group.Connections)
	end
	disconnect(layer.Connections)
	for _, entry in layer.Entries do
		self:_restore(entry)
		self._active[entry] = nil
	end
	self._layers[kind] = nil
	self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_bindLayer(folder: Instance?, kind: string)
	local previous = self._layers[kind]
	if previous and previous.Folder == folder and self:_ownedLayer(previous.Folder, kind) then
		return
	end
	self:_detachLayer(kind)
	if not folder or not self:_ownedLayer(folder, kind) then
		return
	end
	local layer = {
		Kind = kind,
		Folder = folder,
		Connections = {},
		Entries = {},
		Buckets = {},
		Groups = {},
		Count = 0,
	}
	self._layers[kind] = layer
	table.insert(
		layer.Connections,
		folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(plant)
			if kind == "near" then
				self:_bindGroup(layer, plant)
			else
				self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
			end
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		layer.Connections,
		folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(plant)
			if kind == "near" then
				self:_removeGroup(layer, plant)
			else
				self:_remove(layer, plant)
			end
		end)
	)
	for _, attribute in
		{
			"corn_project_id",
			if kind == "near" then "CornClientRendererOwned" else "CornClientBackdropOwned",
			"Ready",
		}
	do
		table.insert(
			layer.Connections,
			folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
				if not self:_ownedLayer(folder, kind) then
					self:_detachLayer(kind)
				elseif kind == "far" and folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true then
					folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", 0)
					for _, entry in layer.Entries do
						self:_restore(entry)
						self._active[entry] = nil
					end
				end
				self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
			end)
		)
	end
	for _, plant in folder:GetChildren() do
		if kind == "near" then
			self:_bindGroup(layer, plant)
		else
			self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:_clearMap()
	self:_detachLayer("near")
	self:_detachLayer("far")
	disconnect(self._mapConnections)
	self._map = nil
	self._pending, self._pendingHead, self._pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	self:_restoreActive()
end

function CornWindController:_resolveMap()
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models")
	then
		self:_clearMap()
		return
	end
	if map ~= self._map then
		self:_clearMap()
		self._map = map
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				if self._map == map and map.Parent ~= Workspace then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"):Connect(function()
				if self._map == map and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.ChildAdded:Connect(function(item)
				if item.Name == "CornClientPlants" then
					self:_bindLayer(item, "near")
				elseif item.Name == "CornClientBackdrop" then
					self:_bindLayer(item, "far")
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(item)
				for kind, layer in self._layers do
					if layer.Folder == item then
						self:_detachLayer(kind)
					end
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	self:_bindLayer(map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants"), "near")
	self:_bindLayer(map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop"), "far")
end

local function visible(entry: any, camera: Camera, position: Vector3): boolean
	local delta = entry.Position - position
	if delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z > RADIUS * RADIUS then
		return false
	end
	local shown = false
	for _, saved in entry.Parts do
		if saved.Part.Transparency < 0.99 and saved.Part.LocalTransparencyModifier < 0.99 then
			shown = true
			break
		end
	end
	if not shown then
		return false
	end
	local screen, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(entry.Position)
	return onScreen and screen.Z > 0
end

function CornWindController:_candidates(
	layer: any,
	camera: Camera,
	position: Vector3,
	limit: number
): { any }
	local result, scanned = {}, 0
	local scanLimit = if layer.Kind == "near" then 4096 else 1024
	for x = math.floor((position.X - RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE), math.floor((position.X + RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE) do
		for z = math.floor((position.Z - RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE), math.floor((position.Z + RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE) do
			for entry in layer.Buckets[bucketKey(x, z)] or {} do
				scanned += 1
				if scanned > scanLimit then
					break
				end
				if self:_validEntry(entry) and visible(entry, camera, position) then
					local delta = entry.Position - position
					table.insert(
						result,
						{ Entry = entry, Distance = delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z }
					)
				end
			end
			if scanned > scanLimit then
				break
			end
		end
		if scanned > scanLimit then
			break
		end
	end
	self._lastScanned += math.min(scanned, scanLimit)
	table.sort(result, function(a, b)
		return a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	local selected = {}
	for index = 1, math.min(limit, #result) do
		table.insert(selected, result[index].Entry)
	end
	return selected
end

function CornWindController:_select(camera: Camera)
	local chosen, active = {}, {}
	self._lastScanned = 0
	for _, kind in { "near", "far" } do
		local layer = self._layers[kind]
		if
			layer
			and self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, kind)
			and (kind == "near" or layer.Folder:GetAttribute("Ready") == true)
		then
			for _, entry in
				self:_candidates(
					layer,
					camera,
					camera.CFrame.Position,
					if kind == "near" then NEAR_LIMIT else FAR_LIMIT
				)
			do
				table.insert(chosen, entry)
				active[entry] = true
			end
		end
	end
	for entry in self._active do
		if not active[entry] then
			self:_restore(entry)
		end
	end
	self._active, self._selected = active, chosen
end

function CornWindController:_animate(camera: Camera)
	local began, writes, near, far = self._clock(), 0, 0, 0
	local count = #self._selected
	local cursor = self._animateCursor
	for offset = 0, count - 1 do
		local index = (cursor - 1 + offset) % count + 1
		local entry = self._selected[index]
		if self._clock() - began >= ANIMATE_SECONDS or writes + #entry.Parts > PART_LIMIT then
			break
		end
		-- Resume after the last examined entry on the next tick. A tight time
		-- budget must not starve distant visible plants behind the near batch.
		self._animateCursor = index % count + 1
		if
			not self:_validEntry(entry)
			or (entry.Layer.Kind == "far" and entry.Layer.Folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
			or not visible(entry, camera, camera.CFrame.Position)
		then
			self:_restore(entry)
			continue
		end
		local phase = entry.Phase
		local displacement = entry.Position - camera.CFrame.Position
		local strength = math.clamp(
			(RADIUS - math.sqrt(displacement.X * displacement.X + displacement.Z * displacement.Z))
				/ 12,
			0,
			1
		)
		local x = ANGLE
			* 0.82
			* strength
			* (
				0.72 * math.sin(self._time * 1.3 + phase)
				+ 0.28 * math.sin(self._time * 2.1 + phase * 0.7)
			)
		local z = ANGLE * 0.5 * strength * math.sin(self._time * 0.9 + phase * 1.4)
		local transform = CFrame.new(entry.Base) * CFrame.Angles(x, 0, z) * CFrame.new(-entry.Base)
		for _, saved in entry.Parts do
			saved.Part.CFrame = transform * saved.Frame
		end
		entry.Moved = true
		writes += #entry.Parts
		if entry.Layer.Kind == "near" then
			near += 1
		else
			far += 1
		end
	end
	self._lastWrites, self._lastNear, self._lastFar = writes, near, far
	for kind, layer in self._layers do
		if self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, kind) then
			layer.Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", if kind == "near" then near else far)
			layer.Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindMode", self._mode or "off")
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:SetMode(mode: string?)
	local nextMode = if mode == "hard" then "hard" else nil
	if self._mode == nextMode then
		return
	end
	self._mode = nextMode
	self._animateCursor = 1
	self._updateElapsed, self._selectElapsed = UPDATE_SEC, SELECT_SEC
	if nextMode == nil then
		self:_restoreActive()
		self._lastWrites, self._lastNear, self._lastFar = 0, 0, 0
		for _, layer in self._layers do
			if self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, layer.Kind) then
				layer.Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", 0)
				layer.Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindMode", "off")
			end
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:_step(delta: number)
	self._time += math.clamp(delta, 0, 0.25)
	self._resolveElapsed += delta
	if self._resolveElapsed >= RESOLVE_SEC then
		self._resolveElapsed = 0
		self:_resolveMap()
	end
	self:_indexBatch()
	if self._mode ~= "hard" then
		return
	end
	self._updateElapsed += delta
	self._selectElapsed += delta
	if self._updateElapsed < UPDATE_SEC then
		return
	end
	self._updateElapsed = 0
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if
		not camera
		or not self._map
		or self._map.Parent ~= Workspace
		or self._map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_restoreActive()
		return
	end
	if self._selectElapsed >= SELECT_SEC then
		self._selectElapsed = 0
		self:_select(camera)
	end
	self:_animate(camera)
end

function CornWindController:Init(context: any)
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
	self._animateCursor = 1
	self._connection = nil
	self._clock = os.clock
	self._map, self._mode = nil, nil
	self._layers, self._mapConnections, self._active, self._selected = {}, {}, {}, {}
	self._pending, self._pendingHead, self._pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	self._time, self._resolveElapsed, self._updateElapsed, self._selectElapsed =
		0, RESOLVE_SEC, UPDATE_SEC, SELECT_SEC
	self._lastWrites, self._lastNear, self._lastFar, self._lastScanned = 0, 0, 0, 0
end

function CornWindController:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self:_resolveMap()
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function CornWindController:Destroy()
	self:SetMode(nil)
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearMap()
end

return CornWindController
--!strict
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local CornWindController = { Name = "CornWindController", Order = 55 }
local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"
local BUCKET_SIZE = 6
local RADIUS = 5
local MONSTER_VIEW_RADIUS = 70
local UPDATE_SEC = 1 / 12
local SELECT_SEC = 0.2
local RESOLVE_SEC = 0.5
local INDEX_BUDGET = 64
local INDEX_SECONDS = 0.001
local ACTOR_LIMIT = 2
local SCAN_LIMIT = 128
local PART_LIMIT = 32
local TRAIL_SEC = 0.3
local MAX_PARTS_PER_PLANT = 8
local ANGLE = math.rad(3)

local function disconnect(connections: { RBXScriptConnection })
	for _, connection in connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)
end

local function decorative(part: BasePart): boolean
	return part.Anchored and not part.CanCollide and not part.CanTouch and not part.CanQuery
end

local function bucketKey(x: number, z: number): string
	return tostring(x) .. ":" .. tostring(z)
end

function CornWindController:_ownedLayer(folder: Instance, kind: string): boolean
	return folder:IsA("Folder")
		and folder.Parent == self._map
		and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
		and (
			if kind == "near"
				then folder.Name == "CornClientPlants" and folder:GetAttribute(
					"CornClientRendererOwned"
				) == true
				else folder.Name == "CornClientBackdrop" and folder:GetAttribute(
					"CornClientBackdropOwned"
				) == true and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		)
end

function CornWindController:_validEntry(entry: any): boolean
	local layer = entry.Layer
	if
		self._layers[layer.Kind] ~= layer
		or not self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, layer.Kind)
		or entry.Plant.Parent ~= entry.Parent
	then
		return false
	end
	if layer.Kind == "near" then
		if
			entry.Parent.Parent ~= layer.Folder
			or entry.Plant.Name ~= "Corn"
			or entry.Plant:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		then
			return false
		end
	elseif
		entry.Plant:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") ~= true
		or entry.Plant:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		return false
	end
	for _, saved in entry.Parts do
		if not decorative(saved.Part) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function CornWindController:_restore(entry: any)
	if not entry.Moved then
		return
	end
	-- Removed copies can still be unparented Instances. Restore their exact frames
	-- before forgetting them; destroyed copies need no recovery.
	for _, saved in entry.Parts do
		pcall(function()
			saved.Part.CFrame = saved.Frame
		end)
	end
	entry.Moved = false
end

function CornWindController:_restoreActive()
	for entry in self._active do
		self:_restore(entry)
	end
	self._active = {}
	self._selected = {}
end

function CornWindController:_remove(layer: any, plant: Instance)
	local entry = layer.Entries[plant]
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	self:_restore(entry)
	self._active[entry] = nil
	layer.Entries[plant] = nil
	layer.Count -= 1
	local bucket = layer.Buckets[entry.Bucket]
	if bucket then
		bucket[entry] = nil
		if next(bucket) == nil then
			layer.Buckets[entry.Bucket] = nil
		end
	end
	local group = layer.Groups[entry.Parent]
	if group then
		group.Entries[plant] = nil
	end
	self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_enqueue(layer: any, plant: Instance, parent: Instance)
	self._pendingTail += 1
	self._pending[self._pendingTail] = { Layer = layer, Plant = plant, Parent = parent }
end

function CornWindController:_register(job: any)
	local layer, plant, parent = job.Layer, job.Plant, job.Parent
	if
		self._layers[layer.Kind] ~= layer
		or layer.Entries[plant]
		or not self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, layer.Kind)
		or plant.Parent ~= parent
	then
		return
	end
	if layer.Kind == "near" then
		if
			not layer.Groups[parent]
			or plant.Name ~= "Corn"
			or plant:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		then
			return
		end
	elseif
		not plant.Name:match("^Far_%-?%d+_%-?%d+$")
		or plant:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") ~= true
		or plant:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		return
	end
	if layer.Count >= (if layer.Kind == "near" then 4096 else 20000) then
		return
	end
	local parts, frame, size = {}, nil, nil
	if plant:IsA("BasePart") then
		if not decorative(plant) then
			return
		end
		table.insert(parts, { Part = plant, Frame = plant.CFrame })
		frame, size = plant.CFrame, plant.Size
	elseif plant:IsA("Model") then
		for _, part in plant:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				if not decorative(part) or #parts >= MAX_PARTS_PER_PLANT then
					return
				end
				table.insert(parts, { Part = part, Frame = part.CFrame })
			end
		end
		if #parts == 0 then
			return
		end
		frame, size = plant:GetBoundingBox()
	else
		return
	end
	local position = frame.Position
	local key =
		bucketKey(math.floor(position.X / BUCKET_SIZE), math.floor(position.Z / BUCKET_SIZE))
	local entry = {
		Layer = layer,
		Plant = plant,
		Parent = parent,
		Parts = parts,
		Position = position,
		Base = position - Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0),
		Bucket = key,
		Phase = (position.X * 0.17 + position.Z * 0.11) % (math.pi * 2),
		Moved = false,
	}
	layer.Entries[plant] = entry
	layer.Count += 1
	if not layer.Buckets[key] then
		layer.Buckets[key] = {}
	end
	layer.Buckets[key][entry] = true
	if layer.Kind == "near" then
		layer.Groups[parent].Entries[plant] = true
	end
	self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_indexBatch()
	local began, count = self._clock(), 0
	while
		self._pendingHead <= self._pendingTail
		and count < INDEX_BUDGET
		and self._clock() - began < INDEX_SECONDS
	do
		local job = self._pending[self._pendingHead]
		self._pending[self._pendingHead] = nil
		self._pendingHead += 1
		self:_register(job)
		count += 1
	end
	if self._pendingHead > self._pendingTail then
		self._pending, self._pendingHead, self._pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	end
end

function CornWindController:_removeGroup(layer: any, folder: Instance)
	local group = layer.Groups[folder]
	if not group then
		return
	end
	disconnect(group.Connections)
	for plant in group.Entries do
		self:_remove(layer, plant)
	end
	layer.Groups[folder] = nil
end

function CornWindController:_bindGroup(layer: any, folder: Instance)
	if
		layer.Groups[folder]
		or not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or folder.Parent ~= layer.Folder
		or not folder.Name:match("^Chunk_")
	then
		return
	end
	local group = { Connections = {}, Entries = {} }
	layer.Groups[folder] = group
	table.insert(
		group.Connections,
		folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(plant)
			self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		group.Connections,
		folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(plant)
			self:_remove(layer, plant)
		end)
	)
	for _, plant in folder:GetChildren() do
		self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
	end
end

function CornWindController:_detachLayer(kind: string)
	local layer = self._layers[kind]
	if not layer then
		return
	end
	for _, group in layer.Groups do
		disconnect(group.Connections)
	end
	disconnect(layer.Connections)
	for _, entry in layer.Entries do
		self:_restore(entry)
		self._active[entry] = nil
	end
	self._layers[kind] = nil
	self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_bindLayer(folder: Instance?, kind: string)
	local previous = self._layers[kind]
	if previous and previous.Folder == folder and self:_ownedLayer(previous.Folder, kind) then
		return
	end
	self:_detachLayer(kind)
	if not folder or not self:_ownedLayer(folder, kind) then
		return
	end
	local layer = {
		Kind = kind,
		Folder = folder,
		Connections = {},
		Entries = {},
		Buckets = {},
		Groups = {},
		Count = 0,
	}
	self._layers[kind] = layer
	table.insert(
		layer.Connections,
		folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(plant)
			if kind == "near" then
				self:_bindGroup(layer, plant)
			else
				self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
			end
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		layer.Connections,
		folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(plant)
			if kind == "near" then
				self:_removeGroup(layer, plant)
			else
				self:_remove(layer, plant)
			end
		end)
	)
	for _, attribute in
		{
			"corn_project_id",
			if kind == "near" then "CornClientRendererOwned" else "CornClientBackdropOwned",
			"Ready",
		}
	do
		table.insert(
			layer.Connections,
			folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
				if not self:_ownedLayer(folder, kind) then
					self:_detachLayer(kind)
				elseif kind == "far" and folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true then
					folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", 0)
					for entry in self._active do
						if entry.Layer == layer then
							self:_restore(entry)
							self._active[entry] = nil
						end
					end
				end
				self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
			end)
		)
	end
	for _, plant in folder:GetChildren() do
		if kind == "near" then
			self:_bindGroup(layer, plant)
		else
			self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:_clearMap()
	self:_detachLayer("near")
	self:_detachLayer("far")
	disconnect(self._mapConnections)
	self._map = nil
	self._pending, self._pendingHead, self._pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	self:_restoreActive()
end

function CornWindController:_resolveMap()
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models")
	then
		self:_clearMap()
		return
	end
	if map ~= self._map then
		self:_clearMap()
		self._map = map
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				if self._map == map and map.Parent ~= Workspace then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"):Connect(function()
				if self._map == map and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.ChildAdded:Connect(function(item)
				if item.Name == "CornClientPlants" then
					self:_bindLayer(item, "near")
				elseif item.Name == "CornClientBackdrop" then
					self:_bindLayer(item, "far")
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(item)
				for kind, layer in self._layers do
					if layer.Folder == item then
						self:_detachLayer(kind)
					end
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	self:_bindLayer(map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants"), "near")
	self:_bindLayer(map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop"), "far")
end

local function horizontalDistanceSquared(a: Vector3, b: Vector3): number
	local delta = a - b
	return delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z
end

local function visible(entry: any, camera: Camera): boolean
	if
		horizontalDistanceSquared(entry.Position, camera.CFrame.Position)
		> MONSTER_VIEW_RADIUS ^ 2
	then
		return false
	end
	local shown = false
	for _, saved in entry.Parts do
		if saved.Part.Transparency < 0.99 and saved.Part.LocalTransparencyModifier < 0.99 then
			shown = true
			break
		end
	end
	if not shown then
		return false
	end
	local screen, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(entry.Position)
	return onScreen and screen.Z > 0
end

function CornWindController:_actorCandidates(
	camera: Camera,
	position: Vector3,
	front: Vector3?,
	active: any
): { any }
	local result, scanned = {}, 0
	for _, kind in { "near", "far" } do
		local layer = self._layers[kind]
		if
			not layer
			or not self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, kind)
			or (kind == "far" and layer.Folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
		then
			continue
		end
		for x = math.floor((position.X - RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE), math.floor((position.X + RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE) do
			for z = math.floor((position.Z - RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE), math.floor((position.Z + RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE) do
				for entry in layer.Buckets[bucketKey(x, z)] or {} do
					scanned += 1
					if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
						break
					end
					local delta = entry.Position - position
					local distance = delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z
					local ahead = front == nil
						or distance <= 1.8 ^ 2
						or delta.X * front.X + delta.Z * front.Z >= 0
					if
						distance <= RADIUS ^ 2
						and ahead
						and not active[entry]
						and math.abs(position.Y - entry.Base.Y) <= 7
						and self:_validEntry(entry)
						and visible(entry, camera)
					then
						table.insert(result, { Entry = entry, Distance = distance })
					end
				end
				if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
					break
				end
			end
			if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
				break
			end
		end
		if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
			break
		end
	end
	self._lastScanned += math.min(scanned, SCAN_LIMIT)
	table.sort(result, function(a, b)
		return a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	local selected = {}
	for index = 1, math.min(ACTOR_LIMIT, #result) do
		table.insert(selected, result[index].Entry)
	end
	return selected
end

function CornWindController:_playerPosition(): Vector3?
	local character = self._player and self._player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		self._playerRoot, self._previousPlayer, self._playerTrail = nil, nil, 0
		return nil
	end
	if self._playerRoot ~= root then
		self:_restoreActive()
		self._playerRoot, self._previousPlayer, self._playerTrail = root, nil, 0
	end
	local position = root.Position
	if
		humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
		or (
			self._previousPlayer
			and horizontalDistanceSquared(position, self._previousPlayer) > 0.01
		)
	then
		self._playerTrail = self._time + TRAIL_SEC
	end
	self._previousPlayer = position
	return if self._playerTrail > self._time then position else nil
end

function CornWindController:_monsterPosition(): Vector3?
	local runtime = self._map and self._map:FindFirstChild("CornRoundRuntime")
	local monster = runtime
		and runtime:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
		and runtime:FindFirstChild("Monster")
	local root = monster
		and monster:GetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned") == true
		and monster:FindFirstChild("Root")
	local state = monster and monster:GetAttribute("HuntState")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or (state ~= "patrol" and state ~= "chase") then
		self._previousMonster, self._monsterTrail = nil, 0
		return nil
	end
	if self._monsterRoot ~= root then
		self._monsterRoot, self._previousMonster, self._monsterTrail = root, nil, 0
	end
	local position = root.Position
	if
		self._previousMonster
		and horizontalDistanceSquared(position, self._previousMonster) > 0.01
	then
		self._monsterTrail = self._time + TRAIL_SEC
	end
	self._previousMonster = position
	return if self._monsterTrail > self._time then position else nil
end

function CornWindController:_select(camera: Camera)
	local chosen, active = {}, {}
	self._lastScanned = 0
	local function add(position: Vector3?, front: Vector3?)
		if not position then
			return
		end
		for _, entry in self:_actorCandidates(camera, position, front, active) do
			active[entry] = true
			table.insert(chosen, entry)
		end
	end
	add(self:_playerPosition(), camera.CFrame.LookVector)
	if self._playerRoot then
		add(self:_monsterPosition(), nil)
	end
	for entry in self._active do
		if not active[entry] then
			self:_restore(entry)
		end
	end
	self._active, self._selected = active, chosen
end

function CornWindController:_diagnostics(near: number, far: number)
	for kind, layer in self._layers do
		if self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, kind) then
			local count = if kind == "near" then near else far
			if layer.Folder:GetAttribute("CornWindAnimated") ~= count then
				layer.Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", count)
			end
			if layer.Folder:GetAttribute("CornWindMode") ~= (self._mode or "off") then
				layer.Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindMode", self._mode or "off")
			end
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:_animate(camera: Camera)
	local writes, near, far = 0, 0, 0
	for _, entry in self._selected do
		if writes + #entry.Parts > PART_LIMIT then
			break
		end
		if
			not self._active[entry]
			or not self:_validEntry(entry)
			or (entry.Layer.Kind == "far" and entry.Layer.Folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
			or not visible(entry, camera)
		then
			self:_restore(entry)
			continue
		end
		local phase = entry.Phase
		local x = ANGLE * 0.75 * math.sin(self._time * 7 + phase)
		local z = ANGLE * 0.35 * math.sin(self._time * 5 + phase * 1.4)
		local transform = CFrame.new(entry.Base) * CFrame.Angles(x, 0, z) * CFrame.new(-entry.Base)
		for _, saved in entry.Parts do
			saved.Part.CFrame = transform * saved.Frame
		end
		entry.Moved = true
		writes += #entry.Parts
		if entry.Layer.Kind == "near" then
			near += 1
		else
			far += 1
		end
	end
	self._lastWrites, self._lastNear, self._lastFar = writes, near, far
	self:_diagnostics(near, far)
end

function CornWindController:SetMode(mode: string?)
	local nextMode = if mode == "easy" or mode == "medium" or mode == "hard" then mode else nil
	if self._mode == nextMode then
		return
	end
	self:_restoreActive()
	self._mode = nextMode
	self._previousPlayer, self._previousMonster = nil, nil
	self._playerTrail, self._monsterTrail = 0, 0
	self._updateElapsed, self._selectElapsed = UPDATE_SEC, SELECT_SEC
	self._lastWrites, self._lastNear, self._lastFar = 0, 0, 0
	self:_diagnostics(0, 0)
end

function CornWindController:_step(delta: number)
	self._time += math.clamp(delta, 0, 0.25)
	self._resolveElapsed += delta
	if self._resolveElapsed >= RESOLVE_SEC then
		self._resolveElapsed = 0
		self:_resolveMap()
	end
	self:_indexBatch()
	if not self._mode then
		return
	end
	self._updateElapsed += delta
	self._selectElapsed += delta
	if self._updateElapsed < UPDATE_SEC then
		return
	end
	self._updateElapsed = 0
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if
		not camera
		or not self._map
		or self._map.Parent ~= Workspace
		or self._map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_restoreActive()
		return
	end
	if self._selectElapsed >= SELECT_SEC then
		self._selectElapsed = 0
		self:_select(camera)
	end
	self:_animate(camera)
end

function CornWindController:Init(context: any)
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
	self._connection, self._player = nil, Players.LocalPlayer
	self._clock = os.clock
	self._map, self._mode = nil, nil
	self._layers, self._mapConnections, self._active, self._selected = {}, {}, {}, {}
	self._pending, self._pendingHead, self._pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	self._time, self._resolveElapsed, self._updateElapsed, self._selectElapsed =
		0, RESOLVE_SEC, UPDATE_SEC, SELECT_SEC
	self._lastWrites, self._lastNear, self._lastFar, self._lastScanned = 0, 0, 0, 0
	self._previousPlayer, self._previousMonster, self._playerRoot, self._monsterRoot =
		nil, nil, nil, nil
	self._playerTrail, self._monsterTrail = 0, 0
end

function CornWindController:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self:_resolveMap()
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function CornWindController:Destroy()
	self:SetMode(nil)
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearMap()
end

return CornWindController
--!strict
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local CornWindController = { Name = "CornWindController", Order = 55 }
local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"
local BUCKET_SIZE = 6
local RADIUS = 5
local MONSTER_VIEW_RADIUS = 70
local UPDATE_SEC = 1 / 12
local SELECT_SEC = 0.2
local RESOLVE_SEC = 0.5
local INDEX_BUDGET = 64
local INDEX_SECONDS = 0.001
local ACTOR_LIMIT = 2
local SCAN_LIMIT = 128
local PART_LIMIT = 32
local TRAIL_SEC = 0.3
local MAX_PARTS_PER_PLANT = 8
local ANGLE = math.rad(3)

local function disconnect(connections: { RBXScriptConnection })
	for _, connection in connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)
end

local function decorative(part: BasePart): boolean
	return part.Anchored and not part.CanCollide and not part.CanTouch and not part.CanQuery
end

local function bucketKey(x: number, z: number): string
	return tostring(x) .. ":" .. tostring(z)
end

function CornWindController:_ownedLayer(folder: Instance, kind: string): boolean
	return folder:IsA("Folder")
		and folder.Parent == self._map
		and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
		and (
			if kind == "near"
				then folder.Name == "CornClientPlants" and folder:GetAttribute(
					"CornClientRendererOwned"
				) == true
				else folder.Name == "CornClientBackdrop" and folder:GetAttribute(
					"CornClientBackdropOwned"
				) == true and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		)
end

function CornWindController:_validEntry(entry: any): boolean
	local layer = entry.Layer
	if
		self._layers[layer.Kind] ~= layer
		or not self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, layer.Kind)
		or entry.Plant.Parent ~= entry.Parent
	then
		return false
	end
	if layer.Kind == "near" then
		if
			entry.Parent.Parent ~= layer.Folder
			or entry.Plant.Name ~= "Corn"
			or entry.Plant:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		then
			return false
		end
	elseif
		entry.Plant:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") ~= true
		or entry.Plant:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		return false
	end
	for _, saved in entry.Parts do
		if not decorative(saved.Part) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function CornWindController:_restore(entry: any)
	if not entry.Moved then
		return
	end
	-- Removed copies can still be unparented Instances. Restore their exact frames
	-- before forgetting them; destroyed copies need no recovery.
	for _, saved in entry.Parts do
		pcall(function()
			saved.Part.CFrame = saved.Frame
		end)
	end
	entry.Moved = false
end

function CornWindController:_restoreActive()
	for entry in self._active do
		self:_restore(entry)
	end
	self._active = {}
	self._selected = {}
end

function CornWindController:_remove(layer: any, plant: Instance)
	local entry = layer.Entries[plant]
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	self:_restore(entry)
	self._active[entry] = nil
	layer.Entries[plant] = nil
	layer.Count -= 1
	local bucket = layer.Buckets[entry.Bucket]
	if bucket then
		bucket[entry] = nil
		if next(bucket) == nil then
			layer.Buckets[entry.Bucket] = nil
		end
	end
	local group = layer.Groups[entry.Parent]
	if group then
		group.Entries[plant] = nil
	end
	self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_enqueue(layer: any, plant: Instance, parent: Instance)
	self._pendingTail += 1
	self._pending[self._pendingTail] = { Layer = layer, Plant = plant, Parent = parent }
end

function CornWindController:_register(job: any)
	local layer, plant, parent = job.Layer, job.Plant, job.Parent
	if
		self._layers[layer.Kind] ~= layer
		or layer.Entries[plant]
		or not self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, layer.Kind)
		or plant.Parent ~= parent
	then
		return
	end
	if layer.Kind == "near" then
		if
			not layer.Groups[parent]
			or plant.Name ~= "Corn"
			or plant:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		then
			return
		end
	elseif
		not plant.Name:match("^Far_%-?%d+_%-?%d+$")
		or plant:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") ~= true
		or plant:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		return
	end
	if layer.Count >= (if layer.Kind == "near" then 4096 else 20000) then
		return
	end
	local parts, frame, size = {}, nil, nil
	if plant:IsA("BasePart") then
		if not decorative(plant) then
			return
		end
		table.insert(parts, { Part = plant, Frame = plant.CFrame })
		frame, size = plant.CFrame, plant.Size
	elseif plant:IsA("Model") then
		for _, part in plant:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				if not decorative(part) or #parts >= MAX_PARTS_PER_PLANT then
					return
				end
				table.insert(parts, { Part = part, Frame = part.CFrame })
			end
		end
		if #parts == 0 then
			return
		end
		frame, size = plant:GetBoundingBox()
	else
		return
	end
	local position = frame.Position
	local key =
		bucketKey(math.floor(position.X / BUCKET_SIZE), math.floor(position.Z / BUCKET_SIZE))
	local entry = {
		Layer = layer,
		Plant = plant,
		Parent = parent,
		Parts = parts,
		Position = position,
		Base = position - Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0),
		Bucket = key,
		Phase = (position.X * 0.17 + position.Z * 0.11) % (math.pi * 2),
		Moved = false,
	}
	layer.Entries[plant] = entry
	layer.Count += 1
	if not layer.Buckets[key] then
		layer.Buckets[key] = {}
	end
	layer.Buckets[key][entry] = true
	if layer.Kind == "near" then
		layer.Groups[parent].Entries[plant] = true
	end
	self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_indexBatch()
	local began, count = self._clock(), 0
	while
		self._pendingHead <= self._pendingTail
		and count < INDEX_BUDGET
		and self._clock() - began < INDEX_SECONDS
	do
		local job = self._pending[self._pendingHead]
		self._pending[self._pendingHead] = nil
		self._pendingHead += 1
		self:_register(job)
		count += 1
	end
	if self._pendingHead > self._pendingTail then
		self._pending, self._pendingHead, self._pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	end
end

function CornWindController:_removeGroup(layer: any, folder: Instance)
	local group = layer.Groups[folder]
	if not group then
		return
	end
	disconnect(group.Connections)
	for plant in group.Entries do
		self:_remove(layer, plant)
	end
	layer.Groups[folder] = nil
end

function CornWindController:_bindGroup(layer: any, folder: Instance)
	if
		layer.Groups[folder]
		or not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or folder.Parent ~= layer.Folder
		or not folder.Name:match("^Chunk_")
	then
		return
	end
	local group = { Connections = {}, Entries = {} }
	layer.Groups[folder] = group
	table.insert(
		group.Connections,
		folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(plant)
			self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		group.Connections,
		folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(plant)
			self:_remove(layer, plant)
		end)
	)
	for _, plant in folder:GetChildren() do
		self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
	end
end

function CornWindController:_detachLayer(kind: string)
	local layer = self._layers[kind]
	if not layer then
		return
	end
	for _, group in layer.Groups do
		disconnect(group.Connections)
	end
	disconnect(layer.Connections)
	for _, entry in layer.Entries do
		self:_restore(entry)
		self._active[entry] = nil
	end
	self._layers[kind] = nil
	self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_bindLayer(folder: Instance?, kind: string)
	local previous = self._layers[kind]
	if previous and previous.Folder == folder and self:_ownedLayer(previous.Folder, kind) then
		return
	end
	self:_detachLayer(kind)
	if not folder or not self:_ownedLayer(folder, kind) then
		return
	end
	local layer = {
		Kind = kind,
		Folder = folder,
		Connections = {},
		Entries = {},
		Buckets = {},
		Groups = {},
		Count = 0,
	}
	self._layers[kind] = layer
	table.insert(
		layer.Connections,
		folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(plant)
			if kind == "near" then
				self:_bindGroup(layer, plant)
			else
				self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
			end
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		layer.Connections,
		folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(plant)
			if kind == "near" then
				self:_removeGroup(layer, plant)
			else
				self:_remove(layer, plant)
			end
		end)
	)
	for _, attribute in
		{
			"corn_project_id",
			if kind == "near" then "CornClientRendererOwned" else "CornClientBackdropOwned",
			"Ready",
		}
	do
		table.insert(
			layer.Connections,
			folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
				if not self:_ownedLayer(folder, kind) then
					self:_detachLayer(kind)
				elseif kind == "far" and folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true then
					folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", 0)
					for entry in self._active do
						if entry.Layer == layer then
							self:_restore(entry)
							self._active[entry] = nil
						end
					end
				end
				self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
			end)
		)
	end
	for _, plant in folder:GetChildren() do
		if kind == "near" then
			self:_bindGroup(layer, plant)
		else
			self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:_clearMap()
	self._monsterSamples = {}
	self:_detachLayer("near")
	self:_detachLayer("far")
	disconnect(self._mapConnections)
	self._map = nil
	self._pending, self._pendingHead, self._pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	self:_restoreActive()
end

function CornWindController:_resolveMap()
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models")
	then
		self:_clearMap()
		return
	end
	if map ~= self._map then
		self:_clearMap()
		self._map = map
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				if self._map == map and map.Parent ~= Workspace then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"):Connect(function()
				if self._map == map and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.ChildAdded:Connect(function(item)
				if item.Name == "CornClientPlants" then
					self:_bindLayer(item, "near")
				elseif item.Name == "CornClientBackdrop" then
					self:_bindLayer(item, "far")
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(item)
				for kind, layer in self._layers do
					if layer.Folder == item then
						self:_detachLayer(kind)
					end
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	self:_bindLayer(map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants"), "near")
	self:_bindLayer(map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop"), "far")
end

local function horizontalDistanceSquared(a: Vector3, b: Vector3): number
	local delta = a - b
	return delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z
end

local function visible(entry: any, camera: Camera): boolean
	if
		horizontalDistanceSquared(entry.Position, camera.CFrame.Position)
		> MONSTER_VIEW_RADIUS ^ 2
	then
		return false
	end
	local shown = false
	for _, saved in entry.Parts do
		if saved.Part.Transparency < 0.99 and saved.Part.LocalTransparencyModifier < 0.99 then
			shown = true
			break
		end
	end
	if not shown then
		return false
	end
	local screen, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(entry.Position)
	return onScreen and screen.Z > 0
end

function CornWindController:_actorCandidates(
	camera: Camera,
	position: Vector3,
	front: Vector3?,
	active: any
): { any }
	local result, scanned = {}, 0
	for _, kind in { "near", "far" } do
		local layer = self._layers[kind]
		if
			not layer
			or not self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, kind)
			or (kind == "far" and layer.Folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
		then
			continue
		end
		for x = math.floor((position.X - RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE), math.floor((position.X + RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE) do
			for z = math.floor((position.Z - RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE), math.floor((position.Z + RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE) do
				for entry in layer.Buckets[bucketKey(x, z)] or {} do
					scanned += 1
					if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
						break
					end
					local delta = entry.Position - position
					local distance = delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z
					local ahead = front == nil
						or distance <= 1.8 ^ 2
						or delta.X * front.X + delta.Z * front.Z >= 0
					if
						distance <= RADIUS ^ 2
						and ahead
						and not active[entry]
						and math.abs(position.Y - entry.Base.Y) <= 7
						and self:_validEntry(entry)
						and visible(entry, camera)
					then
						table.insert(result, { Entry = entry, Distance = distance })
					end
				end
				if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
					break
				end
			end
			if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
				break
			end
		end
		if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
			break
		end
	end
	self._lastScanned += math.min(scanned, SCAN_LIMIT)
	table.sort(result, function(a, b)
		return a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	local selected = {}
	for index = 1, math.min(ACTOR_LIMIT, #result) do
		table.insert(selected, result[index].Entry)
	end
	return selected
end

function CornWindController:_playerPosition(): Vector3?
	local character = self._player and self._player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		self._playerRoot, self._previousPlayer, self._playerTrail = nil, nil, 0
		return nil
	end
	if self._playerRoot ~= root then
		self:_restoreActive()
		self._playerRoot, self._previousPlayer, self._playerTrail = root, nil, 0
	end
	local position = root.Position
	if
		humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
		or (
			self._previousPlayer
			and horizontalDistanceSquared(position, self._previousPlayer) > 0.01
		)
	then
		self._playerTrail = self._time + TRAIL_SEC
	end
	self._previousPlayer = position
	return if self._playerTrail > self._time then position else nil
end

function CornWindController:_monsterPosition(): Vector3?
	local runtime = self._map and self._map:FindFirstChild("CornRoundRuntime")
	local nearest, nearestRoot, distance = nil, nil, math.huge
	for index = 1, 3 do
		local monster = runtime
			and runtime:IsA("Folder")
			and runtime:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
			and runtime:FindFirstChild(if index == 1 then "Monster" else "Monster" .. index)
		local root = monster and monster:FindFirstChild("Root")
		local state = monster and monster:GetAttribute("HuntState")
		if
			not monster
			or not monster:IsA("Model")
			or monster:GetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned") ~= true
			or monster:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
			or monster:GetAttribute("MonsterRigVersion") ~= 1
			or monster:GetAttribute("MonsterIndex") ~= index
			or not root
			or not root:IsA("BasePart")
			or (state ~= "patrol" and state ~= "chase")
		then
			self._monsterSamples[index] = nil
			continue
		end
		local sample = self._monsterSamples[index]
		if not sample or sample.root ~= root then
			sample = { root = root, previous = root.Position, untilAt = 0 }
			self._monsterSamples[index] = sample
		end
		local position = root.Position
		if horizontalDistanceSquared(position, sample.previous) > 0.01 then
			sample.untilAt = self._time + TRAIL_SEC
		end
		sample.previous = position
		local candidate = if self._playerRoot
			then horizontalDistanceSquared(position, self._playerRoot.Position)
			else math.huge
		if sample.untilAt > self._time and candidate < distance then
			nearest, nearestRoot, distance = sample, root, candidate
		end
	end
	self._monsterRoot = nearestRoot
	self._previousMonster = if nearest then nearest.previous else nil
	self._monsterTrail = if nearest then nearest.untilAt else 0
	return if nearest then nearest.previous else nil
end

function CornWindController:_select(camera: Camera)
	local chosen, active = {}, {}
	self._lastScanned = 0
	local function add(position: Vector3?, front: Vector3?)
		if not position then
			return
		end
		for _, entry in self:_actorCandidates(camera, position, front, active) do
			active[entry] = true
			table.insert(chosen, entry)
		end
	end
	add(self:_playerPosition(), camera.CFrame.LookVector)
	if self._playerRoot then
		add(self:_monsterPosition(), nil)
	end
	for entry in self._active do
		if not active[entry] then
			self:_restore(entry)
		end
	end
	self._active, self._selected = active, chosen
end

function CornWindController:_diagnostics(near: number, far: number)
	for kind, layer in self._layers do
		if self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, kind) then
			local count = if kind == "near" then near else far
			if layer.Folder:GetAttribute("CornWindAnimated") ~= count then
				layer.Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", count)
			end
			if layer.Folder:GetAttribute("CornWindMode") ~= (self._mode or "off") then
				layer.Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindMode", self._mode or "off")
			end
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:_animate(camera: Camera)
	local writes, near, far = 0, 0, 0
	for _, entry in self._selected do
		if writes + #entry.Parts > PART_LIMIT then
			break
		end
		if
			not self._active[entry]
			or not self:_validEntry(entry)
			or (entry.Layer.Kind == "far" and entry.Layer.Folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
			or not visible(entry, camera)
		then
			self:_restore(entry)
			continue
		end
		local phase = entry.Phase
		local x = ANGLE * 0.75 * math.sin(self._time * 7 + phase)
		local z = ANGLE * 0.35 * math.sin(self._time * 5 + phase * 1.4)
		local transform = CFrame.new(entry.Base) * CFrame.Angles(x, 0, z) * CFrame.new(-entry.Base)
		for _, saved in entry.Parts do
			saved.Part.CFrame = transform * saved.Frame
		end
		entry.Moved = true
		writes += #entry.Parts
		if entry.Layer.Kind == "near" then
			near += 1
		else
			far += 1
		end
	end
	self._lastWrites, self._lastNear, self._lastFar = writes, near, far
	self:_diagnostics(near, far)
end

function CornWindController:SetMode(mode: string?)
	local nextMode = if mode == "easy" or mode == "medium" or mode == "hard" then mode else nil
	if self._mode == nextMode then
		return
	end
	self:_restoreActive()
	self._mode = nextMode
	self._previousPlayer, self._previousMonster = nil, nil
	self._monsterSamples = {}
	self._playerTrail, self._monsterTrail = 0, 0
	self._updateElapsed, self._selectElapsed = UPDATE_SEC, SELECT_SEC
	self._lastWrites, self._lastNear, self._lastFar = 0, 0, 0
	self:_diagnostics(0, 0)
end

function CornWindController:_step(delta: number)
	self._time += math.clamp(delta, 0, 0.25)
	self._resolveElapsed += delta
	if self._resolveElapsed >= RESOLVE_SEC then
		self._resolveElapsed = 0
		self:_resolveMap()
	end
	self:_indexBatch()
	if not self._mode then
		return
	end
	self._updateElapsed += delta
	self._selectElapsed += delta
	if self._updateElapsed < UPDATE_SEC then
		return
	end
	self._updateElapsed = 0
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if
		not camera
		or not self._map
		or self._map.Parent ~= Workspace
		or self._map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_restoreActive()
		return
	end
	if self._selectElapsed >= SELECT_SEC then
		self._selectElapsed = 0
		self:_select(camera)
	end
	self:_animate(camera)
end

function CornWindController:Init(context: any)
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
	self._connection, self._player = nil, Players.LocalPlayer
	self._clock = os.clock
	self._map, self._mode = nil, nil
	self._layers, self._mapConnections, self._active, self._selected = {}, {}, {}, {}
	self._pending, self._pendingHead, self._pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	self._time, self._resolveElapsed, self._updateElapsed, self._selectElapsed =
		0, RESOLVE_SEC, UPDATE_SEC, SELECT_SEC
	self._lastWrites, self._lastNear, self._lastFar, self._lastScanned = 0, 0, 0, 0
	self._previousPlayer, self._previousMonster, self._playerRoot, self._monsterRoot =
		nil, nil, nil, nil
	self._playerTrail, self._monsterTrail = 0, 0
	self._monsterSamples = {}
end

function CornWindController:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self:_resolveMap()
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function CornWindController:Destroy()
	self:SetMode(nil)
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearMap()
end

return CornWindController

		"Verified mesh positions required"

		"Verified mesh triangles required"

		#data.triangle_uvs == #data.triangles
			and #data.triangle_normals == #data.triangles
			and #data.triangle_colors == #data.triangles,
		"Per-corner channel counts differ"
	)

		assert(type(values) == "table" and #values == 3, "Triangle index triple required")
		for _, n in values do
			assert(
				type(n) == "number" and n % 1 == 0 and n >= 1 and n <= size,
				"Out-of-range mesh index"

		end
		if colorCount > 0 then
			indices(data.triangle_colors[i], colorCount)
		end

		game:GetService("AssetService"):CreateEditableMesh(),
		"EditableMesh memory budget unavailable"

	local operations = 0
	local function tick()
		operations += 1

			operations = 0
			task.wait()

		local vertices, uvs, normals, colors = {}, {}, {}, {}

			tick()
		end
		for i, value in data.uvs_roblox_flip_v do
			assert(
				type(value) == "table"
					and #value == 2
					and value[1] == value[1]
					and value[2] == value[2],
				"Finite UV pair required"

			tick()

			tick()
		end

			assert(type(value) == "table" and #value == 4, "RGBA color required")

			tick()
		end
		for i, triangle in data.triangles do
			local face = mesh:AddTriangle(
				vertices[triangle[1]],
				vertices[triangle[2]],
				vertices[triangle[3]]
			)
			tick()
			local uv = data.triangle_uvs[i]
			mesh:SetFaceUVs(face, { uvs[uv[1]], uvs[uv[2]], uvs[uv[3]] })
			tick()
			if normalCount > 0 then
				local n = data.triangle_normals[i]

			end
			if colorCount > 0 then
				local c = data.triangle_colors[i]

	-- then places MeshPart at modelFrame * CFrame.new(center * scale).
	return mesh,
		center,
		{
			Min = low,
			Max = high,
			Size = high - low,
			SourceName = data.name,
			VertexCount = vertexCount,
			TriangleCount = #data.triangles,
		}
end

			and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT

--!strict
-- Shared peer-local construction/restoration; never uploads or authors placements.
local KEYS =
	{ "SM_Bld_Barn_03", "SM_Prop_Truck_Rusted_01", "SM_Prop_Tyre_01", "SM_Prop_Rubbish_Pile_05" }
local DataFolder = script.Parent:WaitForChild("FarmGeometryData")
local Catalog = {}
local total = 0
for _, key in KEYS do
	local data = require(DataFolder:WaitForChild(key))
	assert(
		type(data) == "table"
			and data.index_base == 1
			and type(data.meshes) == "table"
			and #data.meshes == (if key == "SM_Bld_Barn_03" then 7 else 1),
		"Unknown neutral farm catalog: " .. key
	)
	Catalog[key] = data
	total += #data.meshes
end
assert(total == 10, "Expected ten verified original farm meshes")
local function finite(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < 10000000
end
local function validate(data: any)
	assert(
		type(data) == "table" and type(data.world_bounds) == "table",
		"Neutral mesh/bounds required"
	)
	local operations = 0
	local function tick()
		operations += 1
		if operations >= 500 then
			operations = 0
			task.wait()
		end
	end
	local function tuples(values: any, width: number, limit: number)
		assert(type(values) == "table" and #values <= limit, "Invalid/oversized mesh channel")
		for _, tuple in values do
			assert(type(tuple) == "table" and #tuple == width, "Mesh channel tuple width mismatch")
			for _, value in tuple do
				assert(finite(value), "Nonfinite mesh channel coordinate")
			end
			tick()
		end
	end
	tuples(data.positions, 3, 60000)
	assert(#data.positions > 0, "Mesh vertices required")
	tuples(data.uvs_roblox_flip_v, 2, 120000)
	assert(#data.uvs_roblox_flip_v > 0, "Mesh UVs required")
	tuples(data.normals, 3, 120000)
	tuples(data.colors, 4, 120000)
	tuples({ data.world_bounds.min, data.world_bounds.max }, 3, 2)
	local low, high = data.world_bounds.min, data.world_bounds.max
	for axis = 1, 3 do
		assert(high[axis] > low[axis], "Positive mesh bounds required")
	end
	assert(
		type(data.triangles) == "table" and #data.triangles > 0 and #data.triangles <= 20000,
		"Triangle count outside supported limits"
	)
	local function corner(indices: any, limit: number)
		assert(type(indices) == "table" and #indices == 3, "Triangle corner triple required")
		for _, index in indices do
			assert(
				finite(index) and index % 1 == 0 and index >= 1 and index <= limit,
				"Invalid triangle/corner index"
			)
		end
	end
	for _, name in { "triangle_uvs", "triangle_normals", "triangle_colors" } do
		assert(
			type(data[name]) == "table" and #data[name] == #data.triangles,
			"Triangle channel count mismatch"
		)
	end
	for index, triangle in data.triangles do
		corner(triangle, #data.positions)
		corner(data.triangle_uvs[index], #data.uvs_roblox_flip_v)
		if #data.normals > 0 then
			corner(data.triangle_normals[index], #data.normals)
		end
		if #data.colors > 0 then
			corner(data.triangle_colors[index], #data.colors)
		end
		tick()
	end
end

-- Pure EditableMesh construction from verified neutral FBX data.
-- Never uploads, parents instances, changes Workspace, or reads/writes a place.
local function rawBuild(data, batchSize)
	assert(
		type(data) == "table" and type(data.positions) == "table" and #data.positions > 0,
		"Verified mesh positions required"
	)
	assert(
		type(data.triangles) == "table" and #data.triangles > 0,
		"Verified mesh triangles required"
	)
	assert(type(data.world_bounds) == "table", "Baked world bounds required")
	local limit = batchSize or 500
	assert(type(limit) == "number" and limit >= 1 and limit % 1 == 0, "Integer batch size required")
	local function vector(v)
		assert(type(v) == "table" and #v == 3, "Vector3 triple required")
		for _, n in v do
			assert(
				type(n) == "number" and n == n and math.abs(n) < math.huge,
				"Finite mesh coordinates required"
			)
		end
		return Vector3.new(v[1], v[2], v[3])
	end
	local low, high = vector(data.world_bounds.min), vector(data.world_bounds.max)
	local center = (low + high) / 2
	local vertexCount, uvCount, normalCount, colorCount =
		#data.positions, #data.uvs_roblox_flip_v, #data.normals, #data.colors
	assert(
		#data.triangle_uvs == #data.triangles
			and #data.triangle_normals == #data.triangles
			and #data.triangle_colors == #data.triangles,
		"Per-corner channel counts differ"
	)
	local function indices(values, size)
		assert(type(values) == "table" and #values == 3, "Triangle index triple required")
		for _, n in values do
			assert(
				type(n) == "number" and n % 1 == 0 and n >= 1 and n <= size,
				"Out-of-range mesh index"
			)
		end
	end
	for i, triangle in data.triangles do
		indices(triangle, vertexCount)
		indices(data.triangle_uvs[i], uvCount)
		if normalCount > 0 then
			indices(data.triangle_normals[i], normalCount)
		end
		if colorCount > 0 then
			indices(data.triangle_colors[i], colorCount)
		end
	end
	local mesh = assert(
		game:GetService("AssetService"):CreateEditableMesh(),
		"EditableMesh memory budget unavailable"
	)
	local operations = 0
	local function tick()
		operations += 1
		if operations >= limit then
			operations = 0
			task.wait()
		end
	end
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		local vertices, uvs, normals, colors = {}, {}, {}, {}
		for i, value in data.positions do
			vertices[i] = mesh:AddVertex(vector(value) - center)
			tick()
		end
		for i, value in data.uvs_roblox_flip_v do
			assert(
				type(value) == "table"
					and #value == 2
					and value[1] == value[1]
					and value[2] == value[2],
				"Finite UV pair required"
			)
			uvs[i] = mesh:AddUV(Vector2.new(value[1], value[2]))
			tick()
		end
		for i, value in data.normals do
			normals[i] = mesh:AddNormal(vector(value))
			tick()
		end
		for i, value in data.colors do
			assert(type(value) == "table" and #value == 4, "RGBA color required")
			colors[i] = mesh:AddColor(Color3.new(value[1], value[2], value[3]), value[4])
			tick()
		end
		for i, triangle in data.triangles do
			local face = mesh:AddTriangle(
				vertices[triangle[1]],
				vertices[triangle[2]],
				vertices[triangle[3]]
			)
			tick()
			local uv = data.triangle_uvs[i]
			mesh:SetFaceUVs(face, { uvs[uv[1]], uvs[uv[2]], uvs[uv[3]] })
			tick()
			if normalCount > 0 then
				local n = data.triangle_normals[i]
				mesh:SetFaceNormals(face, { normals[n[1]], normals[n[2]], normals[n[3]] })
				tick()
			end
			if colorCount > 0 then
				local c = data.triangle_colors[i]
				mesh:SetFaceColors(face, { colors[c[1]], colors[c[2]], colors[c[3]] })
				tick()
			end
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		mesh:Destroy()
		error("Neutral mesh construction failed: " .. tostring(problem))
	end
	-- Center and Size remain raw cm. Parent applies one uniform scale to size and center,
	-- then places MeshPart at modelFrame * CFrame.new(center * scale).
	return mesh,
		center,
		{
			Min = low,
			Max = high,
			Size = high - low,
			SourceName = data.name,
			VertexCount = vertexCount,
			TriangleCount = #data.triangles,
		}
end

local function build(data: any, batchSize: number?)
	validate(data)
	return rawBuild(data, batchSize)
end
local PROPERTIES = {
	"CFrame",
	"Size",
	"PivotOffset",
	"TextureID",
	"TextureContent",
	"Color",
	"Material",
	"MaterialVariant",
	"Transparency",
	"Reflectance",
	"Anchored",
	"CanCollide",
	"CanTouch",
	"CanQuery",
	"CastShadow",
	"DoubleSided",
	"CollisionGroup",
	"Massless",
	"CustomPhysicalProperties",

local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local Runtime = {}
Runtime.__index = Runtime
local function assetKeyForName(name: string): string?
	if table.find({ "HouseWest", "HouseEast", "HouseNorthWest" }, name) then
		return KEYS[1]
	elseif name == "RustedTruck" then
		return KEYS[2]
	elseif name:match("^Tyre_%d+$") then
		return KEYS[3]
	elseif name:match("^RubbishPile_%d+$") then
		return KEYS[4]
	end

end
local function modelKey(model: Instance, source: boolean): string?

		return nil
	end
	if source then

end
local function contentObject(part: MeshPart): any

	assert(
		content.SourceType == Enum.ContentSourceType.None
			or content.SourceType == Enum.ContentSourceType.Object,
		"Unsupported owned farm content type"

end
function Runtime:_collect(): ({ any }, number)
	local world = game:GetService("Workspace")
	local map = world:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	assert(
		map
			and map:IsA("Model")
			and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
			and not world:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
			and not world:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models"),
		"Farm geometry requires Children_of_corn"
	)
	local props = map:FindFirstChild("Props")
	assert(props and props:IsA("Folder"), "CornMap Props missing")
	local roots = { { Root = props, Source = false } }
	if self._scope == "server" then
		local source = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild("CornFarmAssets")
		if source then
			assert(
				source:IsA("Folder")
					and source:GetAttribute("CornFarmAssetsOwned") == true
					and source:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT,
				"Foreign CornFarmAssets was preserved"

			table.insert(roots, { Root = source, Source = true })
		end
	end
	local targets, pending = {}, 0
	for _, root in roots do
		for _, model in root.Root:GetChildren() do
			local owned = model:GetAttribute("CornFarmAssetOwned") == true
			if not owned then
				local pendingOwner = false
				for _, item in model:GetDescendants() do
					if item:GetAttribute("CornFarmMeshOwned") == true then
						if
							self._scope == "client"
							and model:IsA("Model")
							and assetKeyForName(model.Name)
						then
							pendingOwner = true
						else
							error("Owned farm mesh outside recognized model")
						end
					end
				end
				if pendingOwner then
					pending += 1
				end
				continue
			end
			assert(model:IsA("Model"), "Malformed owned farm model")
			local project, declaredKey =
				model:GetAttribute("corn_project_id"), model:GetAttribute("AssetKey")
			if
				self._scope == "client"
				and (project == nil or declaredKey == nil)
				and assetKeyForName(model.Name)
			then
				pending += 1
				continue
			end
			assert(project == PROJECT, "Malformed owned farm model")
			local key = modelKey(model, root.Source)
			assert(key, "Unknown owned farm model/key; preserving metadata")
			local indices, modelTargets, incomplete = {}, {}, false
			for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
				if part:GetAttribute("CornFarmMeshOwned") ~= true then
					continue
				end
				assert(
					part:IsA("MeshPart") and part.Parent == model,
					"Malformed/outside owned farm MeshPart"
				)
				local partProject, partKey, index =
					part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id"),
					part:GetAttribute("AssetKey"),
					part:GetAttribute("MeshIndex")
				if
					self._scope == "client"
					and (partProject == nil or partKey == nil or index == nil)
				then
					incomplete = true
					continue
				end
				assert(
					partProject == PROJECT and partKey == key,
					"Malformed/outside owned farm MeshPart"
				)
				assert(
					finite(index)
						and index % 1 == 0
						and index >= 1
						and index <= #Catalog[key].meshes
						and not indices[index],
					"Invalid/duplicate owned farm MeshIndex"
				)
				indices[index] = true
				contentObject(part)
				assert(
					finite(part.Size.X)
						and finite(part.Size.Y)
						and finite(part.Size.Z)
						and part.Size.X > 0
						and part.Size.Y > 0
						and part.Size.Z > 0,
					"Invalid authored mesh Size"
				)
				assert(
					finite(part.CFrame.Position.X)
						and finite(part.CFrame.Position.Y)
						and finite(part.CFrame.Position.Z),
					"Invalid authored mesh CFrame"
				)
				table.insert(modelTargets, {
					Part = part,
					Model = model,
					Root = root.Root,
					Map = map,
					Source = root.Source,
					AssetKey = key,
					MeshIndex = index,
					Key = key .. ":" .. tostring(index),
				})
			end
			for index = 1, #Catalog[key].meshes do
				if not indices[index] then
					incomplete = true
				end
			end
			if incomplete then
				assert(self._scope == "client", "Owned farm asset is incomplete: " .. model.Name)

		end
	end

end
function Runtime:_validateTarget(target: any)
	local world = game:GetService("Workspace")
	local map, root = target.Map, target.Root
	assert(
		map.Parent == world
			and world:FindFirstChild("CornMap") == map
			and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
			and not world:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
			and not world:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models"),
		"Farm map binding changed during construction"
	)
	if target.Source then
		local storage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
		assert(
			root.Parent == storage
				and storage:FindFirstChild("CornFarmAssets") == root
				and root:GetAttribute("CornFarmAssetsOwned") == true
				and root:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT,
			"Farm source folder binding changed during construction"
		)
	else
		assert(
			root.Parent == map and map:FindFirstChild("Props") == root,
			"Farm Props binding changed during construction"
		)
	end
	local part, model = target.Part, target.Model
	assert(
		model.Parent == target.Root
			and model:GetAttribute("CornFarmAssetOwned") == true
			and model:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
			and modelKey(model, target.Source) == target.AssetKey,
		"Farm binding changed during construction"
	)
	assert(
		part.Parent == model
			and part:GetAttribute("CornFarmMeshOwned") == true
			and part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
			and part:GetAttribute("AssetKey") == target.AssetKey
			and part:GetAttribute("MeshIndex") == target.MeshIndex,
		"Farm mesh metadata changed during construction"
	)

local function dispose(entry: any)
	if entry.Part then

	end
	if entry.Mesh then

	end
end
local function snapshot(part: MeshPart): any

end

function Runtime:Ensure(): any
	assert(not self._destroyed, "Farm geometry runtime is destroyed")
	assert(not self._busy, "Farm geometry restoration is already running")
	self._busy = true
	local generation = self._generation
	local created, snapshots, applied = {}, {}, {}
	local report = { targets = 0, built = 0, applied = 0, pending = 0, scope = self._scope }
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local targets, pending = self:_collect()
		report.targets = #targets
		report.pending = pending
		local requested = {}
		for _, target in targets do
			local part = target.Part
			local prior = requested[target.Key]
			local collision, render = part.CollisionFidelity, part.RenderFidelity
			if prior then
				assert(
					prior.Collision == collision and prior.Render == render,
					"One farm mesh has incompatible authored fidelity settings"
				)
			else
				requested[target.Key] = { Target = target, Collision = collision, Render = render }
			end
		end
		for key, request in requested do
			local target = request.Target
			local cached = self._cache[key]
			if cached then
				assert(
					cached.Collision == request.Collision and cached.Render == request.Render,
					"Authored fidelity changed; preserving manual settings"
				)
			else
				validate(Catalog[target.AssetKey].meshes[target.MeshIndex])
			end
		end
		local service = game:GetService("AssetService")
		for key, request in requested do
			if self._cache[key] then
				continue
			end
			assert(
				not self._destroyed and self._generation == generation,
				"Farm restoration cancelled"
			)
			local data = Catalog[request.Target.AssetKey].meshes[request.Target.MeshIndex]
			local mesh, center, bounds = rawBuild(data, 500)
			local entry = {
				Mesh = mesh,
				Center = center,
				Bounds = bounds,
				Collision = request.Collision,
				Render = request.Render,
			}
			created[key] = entry
			if self._scope == "client" then
				local fixed = assert(
					service:CreateEditableMeshAsync(Content.fromObject(mesh), { FixedSize = true }),
					"Fixed-size farm EditableMesh memory budget unavailable"
				)
				entry.Mesh = fixed
				mesh:Destroy()
				mesh = fixed
				assert(fixed.FixedSize, "Client farm cache requires fixed-size geometry")
				assert(
					not self._destroyed and self._generation == generation,
					"Farm restoration cancelled"
				)
			end
			entry.Part = assert(
				service:CreateMeshPartAsync(
					Content.fromObject(mesh),
					{ CollisionFidelity = request.Collision, RenderFidelity = request.Render }
				),
				"Canonical farm MeshPart unavailable"
			)
			entry.Part.Parent = nil
			report.built += 1
		end
		assert(not self._destroyed and self._generation == generation, "Farm restoration cancelled")
		for _, target in targets do
			self:_validateTarget(target)
			local entry = self._cache[target.Key] or created[target.Key]
			assert(
				target.Part.CollisionFidelity == entry.Collision
					and target.Part.RenderFidelity == entry.Render,
				"Fidelity changed during construction"
			)
			assert(
				target.Part.FluidFidelity == entry.Part.FluidFidelity,
				"Unsupported authored fluid fidelity was preserved"
			)
			if contentObject(target.Part) ~= entry.Mesh then
				local saved = snapshot(target.Part)
				saved.Entry = entry
				table.insert(snapshots, saved)
			end
		end
		for _, saved in snapshots do
			table.insert(applied, saved)
			saved.Part:ApplyMesh(saved.Entry.Part)
			restoreProperties(saved)
			assert(
				contentObject(saved.Part) == saved.Entry.Mesh,
				"EditableMesh application did not produce current local Object content"
			)
			report.applied += 1
		end
		for key, entry in created do
			self._cache[key] = entry
		end
		for _, saved in snapshots do
			saved.Clone:Destroy()
		end
		return report
	end)
	self._busy = false
	if not ok then
		local rollbackErrors = {}
		for index = #applied, 1, -1 do
			local saved = applied[index]
			local restored, problem = pcall(function()
				saved.Part:ApplyMesh(saved.Clone)
				restoreProperties(saved)
			end)
			if not restored then
				table.insert(rollbackErrors, tostring(problem))
			end
		end
		for _, saved in snapshots do
			saved.Clone:Destroy()
		end
		for _, entry in created do
			dispose(entry)
		end
		error(
			"Farm geometry restoration failed; preserved authored placement: "
				.. tostring(result)
				.. (
					if #rollbackErrors > 0
						then "; rollback errors: " .. table.concat(rollbackErrors, "; ")
						else ""
				)
		)
	end
	self._lastReport = result
	return result
end
function Runtime:Destroy()
	self._destroyed = true
	self._generation += 1
	for _, entry in self._cache do
		dispose(entry)
	end
	self._cache = {}
end
local function newRuntime(scope: string): any
	assert(scope == "server" or scope == "client", "Farm runtime peer scope required")
	return setmetatable(

		Runtime
	)
end
return setmetatable({
	Build = build,
	Validate = validate,
	newRuntime = newRuntime,
	AssetKeyForName = assetKeyForName,
}, {
	__call = function(_, data, batchSize)
		return build(data, batchSize)
	end,
})

	if not self._enabled then
		return

	if self._running then
		self._pending = true
		return
	end
	if self._queued then
		return
	end
	self._queued = true
	task.defer(function()
		self._queued = false
		if self._enabled then
			self:_ensure()
		end
	end)
end
function Controller:_watch(part: Instance)
	if
		self._parts[part]
		or not part:IsA("MeshPart")
		or part:GetAttribute("CornFarmMeshOwned") ~= true
	then
		return
	end
	local connection = part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MeshContent"):Connect(function()
		self:_schedule()
	end)
	self._parts[part] = connection
end
function Controller:_ensure()
	self._running = true
	self._pending = false
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		self._runtime:Ensure()
	end)
	self._running = false
	if not ok then
		error("[FarmGeometryController] local rendering restoration failed: " .. tostring(problem))
	end
	if self._pending then
		self:_schedule()
	end
end

	local props = map and map:FindFirstChild("Props")
	assert(props and props:IsA("Folder"), "Farm geometry client Props unavailable")
	for _, part in props:GetDescendants() do
		self:_watch(part)
	end
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		props.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
			self:_watch(part)
			self:_schedule()
		end)
	)

		props.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(part)
			local connection = self._parts[part]
			if connection then

			end
		end)
	)
	self:_ensure()
end
function Controller:Destroy()
	self._enabled = false
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	for _, connection in self._parts do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self._connections = {}
	self._parts = {}
	self._runtime:Destroy()
end
