local Builder = require(
	storage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("FarmEditableMeshBuilder")
)
local Controller = { Name = "FarmGeometryController", Order = 40 }
local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
function Controller:Init(context: any)
	self._enabled = run:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
	self._runtime = Builder.newRuntime("client")
	self._connections = {}
	self._parts = {}
	self._running = false
	self._queued = false
	self._pending = false
	self._started = false
	self._map = nil
	self._props = nil
	self._lastError = nil
end
function Controller:_status(status: string, pending: number, problem: string?)
	local map = self._map
	if not map or map.Parent ~= world or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT then
		return
	end
	map:SetAttribute("CornFarmGeometryStatus", status)
	map:SetAttribute("CornFarmGeometryPending", pending)
	map:SetAttribute("CornFarmGeometryError", if problem then problem:sub(1, 1200) else "")
end
function Controller:_schedule()
	if not self._enabled then
		return
	end
	if self._running then
		self._pending = true
		return
	end
	if self._queued then
		return
	end
	self._queued = true
	task.defer(function()
		self._queued = false
		if self._enabled then
			self:_ensure()
		end
	end)
end
function Controller:_watch(item: Instance): boolean
	if self._parts[item] then
		return true
	end
	local isModel = item:IsA("Model") and item.Parent == self._props
	local model = if isModel then item else item.Parent
	if
		not model
		or (not isModel and (not item:IsA("MeshPart") or model.Parent ~= self._props))
		or not (
			model:GetAttribute("CornFarmAssetOwned") == true or Builder.AssetKeyForName(model.Name)
		)
	then
		return false
	end
	local connections = {}
	local attributes = if isModel
		then { "CornFarmAssetOwned", "corn_project_id", "AssetKey" }
		else { "CornFarmMeshOwned", "corn_project_id", "AssetKey", "MeshIndex" }
	for _, attribute in attributes do
		table.insert(
			connections,
			item:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
				self:_schedule()
			end)
		)
	end
	if isModel then
		table.insert(
			connections,
			item:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"):Connect(function()
				self:_schedule()
			end)
		)
	else
		table.insert(
			connections,
			item:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MeshContent"):Connect(function()
				-- ApplyMesh and rollback also fire this signal. During Ensure, current
				-- server content is captured after construction; our own writes need no retry.
				if not self._running then
					self:_schedule()
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	self._parts[item] = connections
	return true
end
function Controller:_bind()
	if self._props then
		return
	end
	local map = world:WaitForChild("CornMap", 10)
	self._map = map
	local props = map and map:WaitForChild("Props", 10)
	assert(props and props:IsA("Folder"), "Farm geometry client Props unavailable")
	if not self._enabled then
		return
	end
	self._props = props
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		props.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(item)
			if self:_watch(item) or item:GetAttribute("CornFarmMeshOwned") == true then
				self:_schedule()
			end
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		props.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(item)
			local connections = self._parts[item]
			if connections then
				for _, connection in connections do
					connection:Disconnect()
				end
				self._parts[item] = nil
				self:_schedule()
			end
		end)
	)
	for _, item in props:GetDescendants() do
		self:_watch(item)
	end
end
function Controller:_ensure()
	if not self._enabled then
		return
	end
	self._running = true
	self._pending = false
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		self:_bind()
		if not self._enabled then
			return nil
		end
		self:_status("building", 0)
		return self._runtime:Ensure()
	end)
	self._running = false
	if not self._enabled then
		return
	end
	if not ok then
		local problem = "[FarmGeometryController] local rendering restoration failed: "
			.. tostring(result)
		self:_status("error", 0, problem)
		if self._lastError ~= problem then
			warn(problem)
		end
		self._lastError = problem
	else
		self._lastError = nil
		self:_status(if result.pending > 0 then "waiting" else "ready", result.pending)
	end
	if self._pending then
		self:_schedule()
	end
end
function Controller:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._started then
		return
	end
	self._started = true
	-- Streaming and EditableMesh allocation must not interrupt other controllers.
	self:_schedule()
end
function Controller:Destroy()
	self._enabled = false
	self:_status("stopped", 0)
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	for _, connections in self._parts do
		for _, connection in connections do
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
	end
	self._connections = {}
	self._parts = {}
	self._runtime:Destroy()
end
return Controller

function GateHintController:_gatePosition(): Vector3?
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
	then

	end
	local gate = map:FindFirstChild("EscapeGate")
	if not gate or not gate:IsA("Model") or not gate:HasTag("corn_gate") then
		return nil
	end
	local anchor = gate:FindFirstChild("InteractionAnchor")
	return if anchor and anchor:IsA("BasePart") then anchor.Position else nil
end

function GateHintController:_canShow(position: Vector3?, anchor: Vector3?, alive: boolean): boolean
	if not eligible(self._snapshot) or not alive or not position or not anchor then
		return false
	end
	local delta = position - anchor
	local radius = if self._shown then EXIT_RADIUS else ENTER_RADIUS
	return math.abs(delta.Y) <= HEIGHT_TOLERANCE
		and delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z <= radius * radius
end

	local position = nil
	local alive = false
	local character = player.Character
	local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		position = root.Position
		alive = true
	end
	self:_show(self:_canShow(position, self:_gatePosition(), alive))
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		local topLeft, bottomRight = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
		local viewport = camera.ViewportSize - topLeft - bottomRight
		self._scale.Scale = math.min(1, math.max(0.1, (viewport.X - 24) / PANEL_WIDTH))
	end
end

function GateHintController:Start(_context: any)
	if self._connection then
		return
	end
	self._connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
		self._elapsed += dt
		if self._elapsed >= UPDATE_INTERVAL then
			self._elapsed = 0
			self:_update()
		end
	end)
end

function GateHintController:Destroy()
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_show(false)
	if self._gui then
		self._gui:Destroy()
		self._gui = nil
	end
	self._snapshot = nil
end

return GateHintController

		self:_restoreBeacon()
		self._beaconRefused = nil
	end
end

local function beaconOwned(state: any): boolean
	return workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap") == state.map
		and state.props.Parent == state.map
		and state.road.Parent == state.props
		and state.sign.Parent == state.road
		and state.surface.Parent == state.sign
		and state.map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		and state.road:GetAttribute("CornRoadExitOwned") == true
		and state.road:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		and state.sign:GetAttribute("CornRoadExitOwned") == true
		and state.sign:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		and state.surface:GetAttribute("CornRoadExitOwned") == true
		and state.surface:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
end

function GateHintController:_restoreBeacon()
	local state = self._beacon
	if not state then
		return
	end
	if beaconOwned(state) and state.sign.LocalTransparencyModifier == state.lastLtm then
		state.sign.LocalTransparencyModifier = state.originalLtm
	end
	if beaconOwned(state) and state.surface.Enabled == state.lastEnabled then
		state.surface.Enabled = state.originalEnabled
	end
	self._beacon = nil
end

function GateHintController:_blinkBeacon(now: number)
	if not self._snapshot or self._snapshot.phase == "ready" then
		return
	end
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local props = if map and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		then map:FindFirstChild("Props")
		else nil
	local road = if props then props:FindFirstChild("VillageRoad") else nil
	local sign = if road then road:FindFirstChild("ExitSign") else nil
	local surface = if sign then sign:FindFirstChild("ExitTextSurface") else nil
	local refused = self._beaconRefused
	if refused and refused.sign == sign and refused.surface == surface then
		return
	end
	self._beaconRefused = nil
	if
		not sign
		or not sign:IsA("BasePart")
		or not surface
		or not surface:IsA("SurfaceGui")
		or sign:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
		or sign:GetAttribute("CornRoadExitOwned") ~= true
		or sign:GetAttribute("RoadExitRole") ~= "ExitSign"
		or not road
		or road:GetAttribute("CornRoadExitOwned") ~= true
		or road:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
		or surface:GetAttribute("CornRoadExitOwned") ~= true
		or surface:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
	then
		self:_restoreBeacon()
		return
	end
	if self._beacon and (self._beacon.sign ~= sign or self._beacon.surface ~= surface) then
		self:_restoreBeacon()
	end
	if not self._beacon then
		self._beacon = {
			map = map,
			props = props,
			road = road,
			sign = sign,
			surface = surface,
			originalLtm = sign.LocalTransparencyModifier,
			originalEnabled = surface.Enabled,
			lastLtm = sign.LocalTransparencyModifier,
			lastEnabled = surface.Enabled,
		}
	end
	local state = self._beacon
	-- Stop owning a property if somebody else changed it between our writes.
	if sign.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= state.lastLtm or surface.Enabled ~= state.lastEnabled then
		self:_restoreBeacon()
		self._beaconRefused = { sign = sign, surface = surface }
		return
	end
	local visible = now % 1.6 < 1.05
	state.lastLtm = if visible then state.originalLtm else 1
	state.lastEnabled = visible and state.originalEnabled
	sign.LocalTransparencyModifier = state.lastLtm
	surface.Enabled = state.lastEnabled
end

	for _, item in gui:GetDescendants() do
		if not overlayOwned(item) and item.Parent and overlayOwned(item.Parent) then
			item.Parent = gui.Parent
		end
	end
	gui:Destroy()
end

function GateHintController:_projectBeacon(sign: BasePart): (Vector3?, number, number)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local field = self._beacon.map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone")
	if not camera or not field or not field:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil, 0, 0
	end
	local delta = camera.CFrame.Position - sign.Position
	if
		delta.Magnitude > 1300
		or sign.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(delta) <= 0
		or sign.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(field.Position - sign.Position) <= 0
	then
		return nil, 0, 0
	end
	local point, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(sign.Position)
	if not onScreen or point.Z <= 0 or camera.ViewportSize.Y <= 0 then
		return nil, 0, 0
	end
	local focal = camera.ViewportSize.Y / (2 * math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView) / 2))
	return point,
		math.clamp(sign.Size.X * focal / point.Z, 96, 600),
		math.clamp(sign.Size.Y * focal / point.Z, 26, 160)
end

function GateHintController:_restoreBeacon()
	self:_clearBeaconGui()
	local state = self._beacon
	if not state then
		return
	end
	if beaconOwned(state) and state.sign.LocalTransparencyModifier == state.lastLtm then
		state.sign.LocalTransparencyModifier = state.originalLtm
	end
	if beaconOwned(state) and state.surface.Enabled == state.lastEnabled then
		state.surface.Enabled = state.originalEnabled
	end
	self._beacon = nil
end

function GateHintController:_blinkBeacon(now: number)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	local capture = self._snapshot and self._snapshot.capture
	if
		not self._snapshot
		or (self._snapshot.phase ~= "active" and self._snapshot.phase ~= "caught")
		or not humanoid
		or humanoid.Health <= 0
		or not root
		or not root:IsA("BasePart")
		or (type(capture) == "table" and type(capture.remaining) == "number" and capture.remaining > 0)
		or GuiService.MenuIsOpen
	then
		self:_restoreBeacon()
		return
	end
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local props = if map and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		then map:FindFirstChild("Props")
		else nil
	local road = if props then props:FindFirstChild("VillageRoad") else nil
	local sign = if road then road:FindFirstChild("ExitSign") else nil
	local surface = if sign then sign:FindFirstChild("ExitTextSurface") else nil
	local refused = self._beaconRefused
	if refused and refused.sign == sign and refused.surface == surface then
		return
	end
	self._beaconRefused = nil
	if
		not sign
		or not sign:IsA("BasePart")
		or not surface
		or not surface:IsA("SurfaceGui")
		or sign:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
		or sign:GetAttribute("CornRoadExitOwned") ~= true
		or sign:GetAttribute("RoadExitRole") ~= "ExitSign"
		or not road
		or road:GetAttribute("CornRoadExitOwned") ~= true
		or road:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
		or surface:GetAttribute("CornRoadExitOwned") ~= true
		or surface:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
	then
		self:_restoreBeacon()
		return
	end
	if self._beacon and (self._beacon.sign ~= sign or self._beacon.surface ~= surface) then
		self:_restoreBeacon()
	end
	if not self._beacon then
		self._beacon = {
			map = map,
			props = props,
			road = road,
			sign = sign,
			surface = surface,
			originalLtm = sign.LocalTransparencyModifier,
			originalEnabled = surface.Enabled,
			lastLtm = sign.LocalTransparencyModifier,
			lastEnabled = surface.Enabled,
		}
	end
	local state = self._beacon
	-- Stop owning a property if somebody else changed it between our writes.
	if sign.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= state.lastLtm or surface.Enabled ~= state.lastEnabled then
		self:_restoreBeacon()
		self._beaconRefused = { sign = sign, surface = surface }
		return
	end
	if not self:_buildBeaconGui() then
		self:_restoreBeacon()
		return
	end
	local visible = now % 1.6 < 1.05
	local point, width, height = self:_projectBeacon(sign)
	local overlay = point ~= nil and state.originalEnabled
	self._beaconGui.Enabled = overlay and visible
	if point then
		self._beaconLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(point.X, point.Y)
		self._beaconLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
	end
	state.lastLtm = if visible then state.originalLtm else 1
	state.lastEnabled = not overlay and visible and state.originalEnabled
	sign.LocalTransparencyModifier = state.lastLtm
	surface.Enabled = state.lastEnabled
end

function GateHintController:_gatePosition(): Vector3?
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
	then
		return nil
	end
	local gate = map:FindFirstChild("EscapeGate")
	if not gate or not gate:IsA("Model") or not gate:HasTag("corn_gate") then
		return nil
	end
	local anchor = gate:FindFirstChild("InteractionAnchor")
	return if anchor and anchor:IsA("BasePart") then anchor.Position else nil
end

function GateHintController:_canShow(position: Vector3?, anchor: Vector3?, alive: boolean): boolean
	if not eligible(self._snapshot) or not alive or not position or not anchor then
		return false
	end
	local delta = position - anchor
	local radius = if self._shown then EXIT_RADIUS else ENTER_RADIUS
	return math.abs(delta.Y) <= HEIGHT_TOLERANCE
		and delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z <= radius * radius
end

function GateHintController:_update()
	self:_blinkBeacon(os.clock())
	local position = nil
	local alive = false
	local character = player.Character
	local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		position = root.Position
		alive = true
	end
	self:_show(self:_canShow(position, self:_gatePosition(), alive))
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		local topLeft, bottomRight = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
		local viewport = camera.ViewportSize - topLeft - bottomRight
		self._scale.Scale = math.min(1, math.max(0.1, (viewport.X - 24) / PANEL_WIDTH))
	end
end

function GateHintController:Start(_context: any)
	if self._connection then
		return
	end
	self._connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
		self._elapsed += dt
		if self._elapsed >= UPDATE_INTERVAL then
			self._elapsed = 0
			self:_update()
		end
	end)
end

function GateHintController:Destroy()
	self:_restoreBeacon()
	self._beaconRefused = nil
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_show(false)
	if self._gui then
		self._gui:Destroy()
		self._gui = nil
	end
	self._snapshot = nil
end

return GateHintController

	for _, segment in NEON_CYCLE do

		end
		phase -= segment[1]
	end
	return true
end

InventoryWorld.__index = InventoryWorld
function InventoryWorld.new(world: any, random: Random, keySlot: BasePart, onPickup: any): any
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "InventoryItems"
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_inventory_owned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	folder.Parent = world.Runtime
	local self = setmetatable(
		{ world = world, folder = folder, pickups = {}, traps = {}, connections = {} },
		InventoryWorld
	)
	local slots = table.clone(world.Slots)
	for index = #slots, 2, -1 do
		local other = random:NextInteger(1, index)
		slots[index], slots[other] = slots[other], slots[index]
	end
	local used = 0
	for _, slot in slots do
		if slot == keySlot then
			continue
		end
		used += 1
		local kind = if used <= 2 then "energy" else "trap"
		local position = Vector3.new(
			slot.Position.X + 3.6,
			world.Ground.Position.Y + world.Ground.Size.Y / 2,
			slot.Position.Z
		)
		local frame =
			CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, if kind == "energy" then 3.08 else 0.22, 0))
		local object, anchor
		if kind == "energy" then
			object, anchor = Models.Energy(frame)
		else
			object, anchor = Models.Trap(frame)
		end
		object.Name = "Pickup" .. used
		object:SetAttribute("item_kind", kind)
		object:SetAttribute("item_id", tostring(used))
		object:AddTag("corn_item_pickup")
		if kind == "energy" then
			Models.Stump(object, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)))
		end
		local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.Name = "CornItemPrompt"
		prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
		prompt.ActionText = "Подобрать"
		prompt.ObjectText = if kind == "energy" then "Энергетик" else "Капкан"
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = world.Radius
		prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true
		prompt.Parent = anchor
		local entry = { model = object, anchor = anchor, prompt = prompt, kind = kind }
		table.insert(self.pickups, entry)
		table.insert(
			self.connections,
			prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				onPickup(player, entry)
			end)
		)
		object.Parent = folder
		if used == 4 then
			break
		end
	end
	return self
end
function InventoryWorld:SetEnabled(enabled: boolean)
	for _, entry in self.pickups do
		if entry.model.Parent then
			entry.prompt.Enabled = enabled
		end
	end
end
function InventoryWorld:Take(entry: any): boolean
	if not table.find(self.pickups, entry) or entry.model.Parent ~= self.folder then
		return false
	end
	entry.prompt.Enabled = false
	entry.model:Destroy()
	return true
end
function InventoryWorld:Place(root: BasePart, character: Model): boolean
	if #self.traps >= 2 then
		return false
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, self.world.Runtime }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local hit = Workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -9, 0), params)
	local props = self.world.Root:FindFirstChild("Props")
	local road = if props then props:FindFirstChild("VillageRoad") else nil
	if
		not hit
		or (hit.Instance ~= self.world.Ground and not (road and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(road)))
		or not self.world:IsOnPlayground(hit.Position)
	then
		return false
	end
	local object, anchor = Models.Trap(CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0)))
	object.Name = "PlacedTrap" .. (#self.traps + 1)
	object:AddTag("corn_placed_trap")
	object:SetAttribute("item_kind", "trap")
	object.Parent = self.folder
	table.insert(self.traps, { model = object, position = anchor.Position, spent = false })
	return true
end
function InventoryWorld:CheckTraps(hunt: any, from: Vector3?, now: number): boolean
	local at = hunt:GetPosition()
	if not at or hunt.state == "trapped" then
		return false
	end
	local start = from or at
	local segment = Vector3.new(at.X - start.X, 0, at.Z - start.Z)
	for _, trap in self.traps do
		if trap.spent then
			continue
		end
		local offset = Vector3.new(trap.position.X - start.X, 0, trap.position.Z - start.Z)
		local t = if segment.Magnitude > 0
			then math.clamp(offset:Dot(segment) / segment:Dot(segment), 0, 1)
			else 0
		local closest = start + (at - start) * t
		if
			Vector3.new(closest.X - trap.position.X, 0, closest.Z - trap.position.Z).Magnitude
				<= 2.3
			and math.abs(closest.Y - trap.position.Y) <= 5
			and hunt:Stun(now, 10)
		then
			trap.spent = true
			trap.model:SetAttribute("Triggered", true)
			local closed = Models.Trap(CFrame.new(trap.position), true)
			closed.Name = "SpentTrap"
			closed.Parent = self.folder
			trap.model:Destroy()
			task.delay(10, function()
				closed:Destroy()
			end)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
function InventoryWorld:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self.connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self.folder:Destroy()
	table.clear(self.pickups)
	table.clear(self.traps)
end
return InventoryWorld

--!strict
local ItemModels = {}
local function part(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	size: Vector3,
	frame: CFrame,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material?
): Part
	local item = Instance.new("Part")
	item.Name = name
	item.Size = size
	item.CFrame = frame
	item.Color = color
	item.Material = material or Enum.Material.Metal
	item.Anchored = true
	item.CanCollide = false
	item.CanTouch = false
	item.CanQuery = false
	item.Parent = parent
	return item
end
local function model(name: string): (Model, Part)
	local object = Instance.new("Model")
	object.Name = name
	object:SetAttribute("corn_inventory_owned", true)
	object:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	local anchor =
		part(object, "Anchor", Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1), CFrame.identity, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	anchor.Transparency = 1
	object.PrimaryPart = anchor
	return object, anchor
end
function ItemModels.Key(frame: CFrame): (Model, Part)
	local object, anchor = model("GateKeyModel")
	local gold = Color3.fromRGB(235, 192, 60)
	anchor.CFrame = frame
	for index = 1, 12 do
		local angle = index * math.pi / 6
		part(
			object,
			"Ring" .. index,
			Vector3.new(0.26, 0.15, 0.42),
			frame
				* CFrame.new(math.cos(angle) * 0.65, 0, -1 + math.sin(angle) * 0.65)
				* CFrame.Angles(0, -angle, 0),
			gold
		)
	end
	part(object, "Shaft", Vector3.new(0.23, 0.17, 1.95), frame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.58), gold)
	for index = 1, 2 do
		part(
			object,
			"Tooth" .. index,
			Vector3.new(0.58, 0.17, 0.22),
			frame * CFrame.new(0.2, 0, 0.75 + index * 0.36),
			gold
		)
	end
	return object, anchor
end
function ItemModels.Energy(frame: CFrame): (Model, Part)
	local object, anchor = model("EnergyCan")
	anchor.CFrame = frame
	local body = part(
		object,
		"Can",
		Vector3.new(1.25, 0.72, 0.72),
		frame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2),
		Color3.fromRGB(38, 116, 65)
	)
	body.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	for _, offset in { -0.62, 0.62 } do
		local lid = part(
			object,
			"Lid",
			Vector3.new(0.07, 0.74, 0.74),
			frame * CFrame.new(0, offset, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2),
			Color3.fromRGB(180, 192, 185)
		)
		lid.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	end
	local label = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	label.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
	label.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(256, 256)
	label.Parent = body
	local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	text.Text = "⚡"
	text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 255, 133)
	text.TextScaled = true
	text.Parent = label
	return object, anchor
end
function ItemModels.Trap(frame: CFrame, closed: boolean?): (Model, Part)
	local object, anchor = model("BearTrap")
	anchor.CFrame = frame
	local steel = Color3.fromRGB(91, 100, 99)
	local base = part(
		object,
		"Plate",
		Vector3.new(0.16, 2.2, 2.2),
		frame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2),
		steel
	)
	base.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	for side = -1, 1, 2 do
		local jaw = frame * CFrame.new(side * 0.95, 0.18, 0)
		if closed then
			jaw = jaw * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, side * math.rad(65))
		end
		part(object, "Jaw", Vector3.new(0.18, 0.2, 2.15), jaw, steel)
		for tooth = -2, 2 do
			part(
				object,
				"Tooth",
				Vector3.new(0.16, 0.32, 0.18),
				jaw * CFrame.new(0, 0.2, tooth * 0.4),
				Color3.fromRGB(163, 170, 164)
			)
		end
	end
	part(
		object,
		"Trigger",
		Vector3.new(0.65, 0.13, 0.65),
		frame * CFrame.new(0, 0.15, 0),
		Color3.fromRGB(154, 118, 62)
	)
	return object, anchor
end
function ItemModels.Stump(parent: Instance, frame: CFrame): Part
	local stump = part(
		parent,
		"Stump",
		Vector3.new(2.4, 3, 3),
		frame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2),
		Color3.fromRGB(94, 70, 43),
		Enum.Material.Wood
	)
	stump.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	stump.CanCollide = true
	stump.CanQuery = true
	local top = part(
		parent,
		"CutWood",
		Vector3.new(0.12, 2.85, 2.85),
		frame * CFrame.new(0, 1.21, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2),
		Color3.fromRGB(171, 143, 95),
		Enum.Material.Wood
	)
	top.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	return stump
end
return ItemModels

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local Endpoints = require(
	ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
		:WaitForChild("Network")
		:WaitForChild("EndpointNames")
)
local Inventory = require(ReplicatedStorage.GameShared.Game:WaitForChild("Inventory"))
local Hud = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("InventoryHud"))
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local KEY_SLOTS = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.One] = 1,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Two] = 2,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Three] = 3,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Four] = 4,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Five] = 5,
}
local Controller = { Name = "InventoryController", Order = 96 }

function Controller:Init(_context: any)
	self._snapshot = nil
	self._remote = nil
	self._minimap = nil
	self._prompts = {}
	self._connections = {}
	self._elapsed = 0
	self._lastUse = -math.huge
	self._hud = Hud.new(player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"), UserInputService.TouchEnabled)
	self._hud:SetOnAction(function(action: string, slot: number)
		self:_request(action, slot)
	end)
	self._backpackWasEnabled = nil
	local ok, enabled = pcall(function()
		return StarterGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack)
	end)
	if ok then
		self._backpackWasEnabled = enabled
	end
	pcall(function()
		StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, false)
	end)
end

function Controller:SetSnapshot(snapshot: any)
	if not snapshot or not Inventory.IsValidSnapshot(snapshot.inventory) then
		return
	end
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	self._hud:Render(snapshot.inventory, snapshot.phase, os.clock())
end

function Controller:_canAct(): boolean
	return self._snapshot ~= nil
		and self._snapshot.phase == "active"
		and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
		and not (self._minimap and self._minimap._expanded)
end

function Controller:_hasPrompt(): boolean
	for item in self._prompts do
		if item.Parent and item.Enabled and item.KeyboardKeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function Controller:_request(action: string, slot: number)
	if not self:_canAct() or not self._remote or slot < 1 or slot > Inventory.Capacity then
		return
	end
	if action == "use" then
		local kind = self._snapshot.inventory.slots[slot]
		if self:_hasPrompt() or (kind ~= "energy" and kind ~= "trap") then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - self._lastUse < 0.25 then
			return
		end
		self._lastUse = now
	elseif action ~= "select" then
		return
	end
	self._remote:FireServer(action, slot)
end

function Controller:_input(input: InputObject, processed: boolean)
	if processed or not self:_canAct() then
		return
	end
	local slot = KEY_SLOTS[input.KeyCode]
	if slot then
		self:_request("select", slot)
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
		self:_request("use", self._snapshot.inventory.selected)
	end
end

function Controller:Start(context: any)
	self._minimap = context.Controllers.MinimapController
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameRemotes", 10)
	assert(folder, "Inventory remotes are unavailable")
	local remote = folder:WaitForChild(Endpoints.RequestInventoryAction, 10)
	assert(remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent"), "Inventory action remote is unavailable")
	self._remote = remote
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
			self:_input(input, processed)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		ProximityPromptService.PromptShown:Connect(function(item: ProximityPrompt)
			self._prompts[item] = true
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		ProximityPromptService.PromptHidden:Connect(function(item: ProximityPrompt)
			self._prompts[item] = nil
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
			self._elapsed += dt
			if self._elapsed >= 0.1 then
				self._elapsed = 0
				self._hud:Update(os.clock())
			end
		end)
	)
	-- CoreGui can be unavailable during the first Init; repeat once after startup.
	pcall(function()
		StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, false)
	end)
end

function Controller:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	table.clear(self._prompts)
	self._hud:Destroy()
	self._snapshot = nil
	self._remote = nil
	self._minimap = nil
	if self._backpackWasEnabled ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, self._backpackWasEnabled)
		end)
	end
end

return Controller

local InventoryHud = {}

local CAPACITY = 5

local GAP = 8

local ITEM_NAMES =
	{ empty = "", key = "Ключ", energy = "Энергетик", trap = "Капкан" }

local function frame(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2,
	color: Color3
): Frame
	local item = Instance.new("Frame")
	item.Name = name
	item.Size = size
	item.Position = position
	item.BackgroundColor3 = color
	item.BorderSizePixel = 0
	item.Parent = parent
	return item
end

local function corner(parent: Instance, radius: number)
	local item = Instance.new("UICorner")
	item.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	item.Parent = parent
end

local function label(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2,
	textSize: number
): TextLabel
	local item = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	item.Name = name
	item.Size = size
	item.Position = position
	item.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	item.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	item.TextSize = textSize
	item.TextColor3 = TEXT
	item.Text = ""
	item.Parent = parent
	return item
end

local function icon(parent: Instance, kind: string): Frame
	local root = frame(parent, kind, UDim2.fromOffset(42, 32), UDim2.fromOffset(13, 16), PANEL)
	root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	root.Visible = false
	if kind == "key" then
		local gold = Color3.fromRGB(246, 211, 112)
		local ring = frame(root, "Bow", UDim2.fromOffset(17, 17), UDim2.fromOffset(2, 4), gold)
		corner(ring, 9)
		local hollow = frame(ring, "Hole", UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9), UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), PANEL)
		corner(hollow, 5)
		frame(root, "Shaft", UDim2.fromOffset(24, 5), UDim2.fromOffset(15, 10), gold)
		frame(root, "Tooth1", UDim2.fromOffset(5, 7), UDim2.fromOffset(26, 14), gold)
		frame(root, "Tooth2", UDim2.fromOffset(5, 10), UDim2.fromOffset(34, 14), gold)
	elseif kind == "energy" then
		local can = frame(root, "Can", UDim2.fromOffset(20, 30), UDim2.fromOffset(11, 1), GREEN)
		corner(can, 4)
		frame(can, "Top", UDim2.fromOffset(18, 3), UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1), MUTED)
		frame(can, "Bottom", UDim2.fromOffset(18, 3), UDim2.fromOffset(1, 26), MUTED)
		local mark = label(can, "Mark", UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), UDim2.fromOffset(0, 4), 20)
		mark.Text = "+"
		mark.TextColor3 = PANEL
	elseif kind == "trap" then
		local steel = Color3.fromRGB(180, 190, 197)
		local base = frame(root, "Base", UDim2.fromOffset(38, 15), UDim2.fromOffset(2, 13), steel)
		corner(base, 7)
		local opening =
			frame(base, "Opening", UDim2.fromOffset(28, 7), UDim2.fromOffset(5, 4), PANEL)
		corner(opening, 4)
		for index = 0, 4 do
			local tooth = frame(
				root,
				"Tooth" .. index,
				UDim2.fromOffset(4, 8),
				UDim2.fromOffset(5 + index * 7, 7),
				steel
			)
			tooth.Rotation = if index % 2 == 0 then -15 else 15
		end
		frame(root, "Plate", UDim2.fromOffset(9, 5), UDim2.fromOffset(17, 18), steel)
	end
	return root
end

function InventoryHud.new(playerGui: PlayerGui, touch: boolean)
	local root = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

	root.DisplayOrder = 25
	root.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	root.Enabled = false
	root.Parent = playerGui
	local bar =
		frame(root, "Inventory", UDim2.fromOffset(WIDTH, 94), UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -20), PANEL)
	bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	bar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Parent = bar
	local caption = label(bar, "Controls", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), 12)
	caption.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	caption.TextColor3 = MUTED
	local buttons, strokes, names, icons = {}, {}, {}, {}
	for index = 1, CAPACITY do
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.Name = "Slot" .. index
		button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SLOT_SIZE, SLOT_SIZE)
		button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((index - 1) * (SLOT_SIZE + GAP), 24)
		button.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL
		button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
		button.BorderSizePixel = 0

		button.Parent = bar
		corner(button, 7)
		local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Thickness = 2
		stroke.Parent = button
		local number = label(button, "Number", UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), UDim2.fromOffset(5, 3), 11)
		number.Text = tostring(index)
		number.TextColor3 = MUTED
		local name = label(button, "ItemName", UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 18), UDim2.fromOffset(2, 48), 10)
		buttons[index], strokes[index], names[index] = button, stroke, name
		icons[index] = {
			key = icon(button, "key"),
			energy = icon(button, "energy"),
			trap = icon(button, "trap"),
		}
	end
	local use = Instance.new("TextButton")
	use.Name = "UseItem"
	use.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(176, 38)
	use.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	use.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, -8)
	use.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(65, 109, 73)
	use.BorderSizePixel = 0
	use.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	use.TextSize = 14
	use.TextColor3 = TEXT
	use.Visible = touch
	use.Parent = bar
	corner(use, 7)
	local energy =
		frame(root, "EnergyTimer", UDim2.fromOffset(174, 82), UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, -124), PANEL)
	energy.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	energy.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	energy.Visible = false
	local circle = frame(energy, "Circle", UDim2.fromOffset(76, 76), UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), PANEL)
	circle.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
	corner(circle, 38)
	local segments = {}
	for index = 1, SEGMENTS do
		local angle = (index - 1) / SEGMENTS * 2 * math.pi
		local segment = frame(
			circle,
			"Progress" .. index,
			UDim2.fromOffset(3, 8),
			UDim2.fromOffset(38 + math.sin(angle) * 29, 38 - math.cos(angle) * 29),
			GREEN
		)
		segment.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		segment.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
		segments[index] = segment
	end
	local seconds = label(circle, "Seconds", UDim2.fromOffset(48, 32), UDim2.fromOffset(14, 22), 24)
	seconds.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	local boost = label(energy, "Boost", UDim2.fromOffset(90, 28), UDim2.fromOffset(84, 12), 15)
	boost.Text = "Скорость ×2"
	local suffix = label(energy, "Suffix", UDim2.fromOffset(90, 20), UDim2.fromOffset(84, 40), 12)
	suffix.Text = "Энергетик"
	suffix.TextColor3 = MUTED
	local self = setmetatable({
		_root = root,
		_bar = bar,
		_scale = scale,
		_caption = caption,
		_buttons = buttons,
		_strokes = strokes,
		_names = names,
		_icons = icons,
		_use = use,
		_energy = energy,
		_segments = segments,
		_seconds = seconds,
		_boost = boost,
		_suffix = suffix,
		_touch = touch,
		_phase = "ready",
		_inventory = nil,
		_energyUntil = 0,
		_onAction = nil,
		_connections = {} :: { RBXScriptConnection },
	}, InventoryHud)
	for index, button in buttons do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			button.Activated:Connect(function()
				if self._phase == "active" and self._onAction then
					self._onAction("select", index)
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		use.Activated:Connect(function()
			if self._phase == "active" and self._inventory and self._onAction and use.Active then
				self._onAction("use", self._inventory.selected)
			end
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			self:SetViewport(root.AbsoluteSize)
		end)
	)
	self:SetViewport(root.AbsoluteSize)
	return self
end

function InventoryHud:SetOnAction(callback: (string, number) -> ())
	self._onAction = callback
end

function InventoryHud:SetViewport(viewport: Vector2)
	if viewport.X <= 0 or viewport.Y <= 0 then
		return
	end
	self._scale.Scale = math.min(1, math.max(0.6, (viewport.X - 40) / WIDTH))
	local narrow = viewport.X < 840
	self._bar.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, if narrow then -120 else -20)
	self._energy.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(if narrow then 82 else 174, 82)
	self._energy.Position =
		UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, if viewport.X < 500 then -234 elseif narrow then -120 else -124)
	self._boost.Visible = not narrow
	self._suffix.Visible = not narrow
end

function InventoryHud:Render(inventory: any, phase: string, now: number)
	self._phase = phase
	self._inventory = inventory
	self._energyUntil = now + inventory.energy_remaining
	self._root.Enabled = phase == "active" or phase == "caught"
	local count = 0
	for index = 1, CAPACITY do
		local kind = inventory.slots[index]
		if kind ~= "empty" then
			count += 1
		end
		self._names[index].Text = ITEM_NAMES[kind] or ""
		for iconKind, item in self._icons[index] do
			item.Visible = iconKind == kind
		end
		local selected = inventory.selected == index
		self._strokes[index].Color = if selected then GREEN else MUTED
		self._strokes[index].Transparency = if selected then 0 else 0.65
		self._buttons[index].Active = phase == "active"
		self._buttons[index].AutoButtonColor = phase == "active"
	end
	local selectedKind = inventory.slots[inventory.selected]
	local canUse = selectedKind == "energy" or selectedKind == "trap"
	self._use.Active = phase == "active" and canUse
	self._use.AutoButtonColor = self._use.Active
	self._use.BackgroundTransparency = if self._use.Active then 0 else 0.45
	self._use.Text = if selectedKind == "key"
		then "Ключ · к воротам"
		elseif selectedKind == "energy" then "Выпить"
		elseif selectedKind == "trap" then "Поставить капкан"
		else "Выбери предмет"
	self._caption.Text = string.format(
		"С собой %d/5 · %s",
		count,
		if selectedKind == "key"
			then "ключ для ворот"
			elseif self._touch then "коснись слота"
			else "1–5 · E использовать"
	)
	self:Update(now)
end

function InventoryHud:Update(now: number)
	local remaining = math.max(0, self._energyUntil - now)
	self._energy.Visible = self._phase == "active" and remaining > 0
	if not self._energy.Visible then
		return
	end
	local urgent = remaining <= 5
	local color = if urgent then RED else GREEN
	local blinking = urgent and math.floor(now * 4) % 2 == 1
	self._seconds.Text = tostring(math.ceil(remaining))
	self._seconds.TextColor3 = color
	self._seconds.TextTransparency = if blinking then 0.65 else 0
	self._boost.TextColor3 = color
	for index, segment in self._segments do
		segment.BackgroundColor3 = color
		segment.BackgroundTransparency = if index > math.ceil(remaining / 30 * SEGMENTS)
			then 0.86
			elseif blinking then 0.65
			else 0
	end
end

function InventoryHud:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._onAction = nil
	self._root:Destroy()
end

return InventoryHud

--!strict
local Capture = { Duration = 1, ApproachDuration = 0.7 }

local function finite(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
end

function Capture.IsValidSnapshot(value: any): boolean
	if
		type(value) ~= "table"
		or not finite(value.id)
		or value.id % 1 ~= 0
		or value.id < 0
		or value.id > 2
	then
		return false
	end
	if
		not finite(value.remaining)
		or value.remaining < 0
		or value.remaining > Capture.Duration
		or typeof(value.frame) ~= "CFrame"
	then
		return false
	end
	if value.id == 0 and value.remaining ~= 0 then
		return false
	end
	for _, component in { value.frame:GetComponents() } do
		if not finite(component) or math.abs(component) > 1000000 then
			return false
		end
	end
	local x, y, z = value.frame.XVector, value.frame.YVector, value.frame.ZVector
	return math.abs(x.Magnitude - 1) < 0.001
		and math.abs(y.Magnitude - 1) < 0.001
		and math.abs(z.Magnitude - 1) < 0.001
		and math.abs(x:Dot(y)) < 0.001
		and math.abs(x:Dot(z)) < 0.001
		and math.abs(y:Dot(z)) < 0.001
		and x:Cross(y):Dot(z) > 0.999
end

function Capture.NewState(): any
	return {
		roundId = -1,
		lastId = 0,
		active = false,
		deadline = 0,
		started = 0,
		frame = CFrame.identity,
	}
end

function Capture.Cancel(state: any)
	state.active = false
end

-- Incoming snapshots may shorten a running deadline, but cannot extend or replay it.
function Capture.Observe(state: any, roundId: any, value: any, phase: any, now: number): string
	local wasActive = state.active
	if
		not finite(roundId)
		or roundId < 0
		or roundId % 1 ~= 0
		or not finite(now)
		or not Capture.IsValidSnapshot(value)
	then
		Capture.Cancel(state)
		return if wasActive then "cancel" else "none"
	end
	if roundId < state.roundId then
		Capture.Cancel(state)
		return if wasActive then "cancel" else "none"
	end
	if roundId ~= state.roundId then
		state.roundId, state.lastId, state.active = roundId, 0, false
	end
	if phase ~= "caught" or value.id == 0 or value.remaining <= 0 then
		state.lastId = math.max(state.lastId, value.id)
		Capture.Cancel(state)
		return if wasActive then "cancel" else "none"
	end
	if state.active and value.id == state.lastId then
		state.deadline = math.min(state.deadline, now + value.remaining)
		if now >= state.deadline then
			Capture.Cancel(state)
			return "cancel"
		end
		return "keep"
	end
	if value.id <= state.lastId then
		return if wasActive and not state.active then "cancel" else "none"
	end
	state.lastId = value.id
	state.active = true
	state.started = now - (Capture.Duration - value.remaining)
	state.deadline = now + value.remaining
	state.frame = value.frame
	return "begin"
end

function Capture.Progress(state: any, now: number): number
	return math.clamp((now - state.started) / Capture.ApproachDuration, 0, 1)
end

return table.freeze(Capture)

		or value.id < 0
		or value.id > 2
	then
		return false
	end
	if
		not finite(value.remaining)
		or value.remaining < 0
		or value.remaining > Capture.Duration
		or typeof(value.frame) ~= "CFrame"
	then
		return false
	end
	if value.id == 0 and value.remaining ~= 0 then
		return false
	end
	for _, component in { value.frame:GetComponents() } do
		if not finite(component) or math.abs(component) > 1000000 then
			return false
		end
	end
	local x, y, z = value.frame.XVector, value.frame.YVector, value.frame.ZVector
	return math.abs(x.Magnitude - 1) < 0.001
		and math.abs(y.Magnitude - 1) < 0.001
		and math.abs(z.Magnitude - 1) < 0.001
		and math.abs(x:Dot(y)) < 0.001
		and math.abs(x:Dot(z)) < 0.001
		and math.abs(y:Dot(z)) < 0.001
		and x:Cross(y):Dot(z) > 0.999
end

function Capture.NewState(): any
	return {
		roundId = -1,
		lastId = 0,
		active = false,
		deadline = 0,
		started = 0,
		frame = CFrame.identity,
	}
end

function Capture.Cancel(state: any)
	state.active = false
end

-- Incoming snapshots may shorten a running deadline, but cannot extend or replay it.
function Capture.Observe(state: any, roundId: any, value: any, phase: any, now: number): string
	local wasActive = state.active
	if
		not finite(roundId)
		or roundId < 0
		or roundId % 1 ~= 0
		or not finite(now)
		or not Capture.IsValidSnapshot(value)
	then
		Capture.Cancel(state)
		return if wasActive then "cancel" else "none"
	end
	if roundId < state.roundId then
		Capture.Cancel(state)
		return if wasActive then "cancel" else "none"
	end
	if roundId ~= state.roundId then
		state.roundId, state.lastId, state.active = roundId, 0, false
	end
	if phase ~= "caught" or value.id == 0 or value.remaining <= 0 then
		state.lastId = math.max(state.lastId, value.id)
		Capture.Cancel(state)
		return if wasActive then "cancel" else "none"
	end
	if state.active and value.id == state.lastId then
		state.deadline = math.min(state.deadline, now + value.remaining)
		if now >= state.deadline then
			Capture.Cancel(state)
			return "cancel"
		end
		return "keep"
	end
	if value.id <= state.lastId then
		return if wasActive and not state.active then "cancel" else "none"
	end
	state.lastId = value.id
	state.active = true
	state.started = now - (Capture.Duration - value.remaining)
	state.deadline = now + value.remaining
	state.frame = value.frame
	return "begin"
end

function Capture.Progress(state: any, now: number): number
	return math.clamp((now - state.started) / Capture.ApproachDuration, 0, 1)
end

local function elapsedTime(elapsed: number): number
	return if finite(elapsed) then math.clamp(elapsed, 0, Capture.Duration) else 0
end

function Capture.HeadShake(elapsed: number): CFrame
	local time = elapsedTime(elapsed)
	local strength = math.clamp(time / 0.13, 0, 1)
	return CFrame.Angles(
		math.sin(time * 2 * math.pi * 13) * math.rad(6) * strength,
		math.sin(time * 2 * math.pi * 11) * math.rad(14) * strength,
		math.sin(time * 2 * math.pi * 9) * math.rad(7) * strength
	)
end

function Capture.CameraShake(elapsed: number): CFrame
	local time = elapsedTime(elapsed)
	local strength = math.clamp(time / 0.3, 0, 1)
	return CFrame.new(
		math.sin(time * 2 * math.pi * 7) * 0.028 * strength,
		math.sin(time * 2 * math.pi * 9) * 0.020 * strength,
		0
	) * CFrame.Angles(
		math.sin(time * 2 * math.pi * 6) * math.rad(0.35) * strength,
		math.sin(time * 2 * math.pi * 8) * math.rad(0.45) * strength,
		math.sin(time * 2 * math.pi * 5) * math.rad(0.65) * strength
	)
end

function Capture.MouthOpen(elapsed: number): number
	local progress = math.clamp(elapsedTime(elapsed) / 0.22, 0, 1)
	return 0.3 + 0.7 * progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress)
end

function Capture.PaintOpacity(elapsed: number): number
	local time = elapsedTime(elapsed)
	return math.clamp((time - 0.42) / 0.09, 0, 1)
		* (1 - math.clamp((time - 0.9) / 0.1, 0, 1))
		* 0.88
end

return table.freeze(Capture)

--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game")
local Capture = require(Shared:WaitForChild("CapturePresentation"))
local Pose = require(Shared:WaitForChild("MonsterPose"))
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local VISUAL_NAME = "CornCaptureVisual"
local CAMERA_OWNER = "CornCaptureCameraOwner"
local BINDING = "CornCaptureCamera"
local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local Controller = { Name = "CaptureController", Order = 92 }

function Controller:Init(_context: any)
	self._state = Capture.NewState()
	self._snapshot = nil
	self._movement = nil
	self._minimap = nil
	self._round = nil
	self._visual = nil
	self._parts = {}
	self._hiddenServer = {}
	self._saved = nil
	self._token = nil
	self._generation = 0
	self._bound = false
	self._connections = {}
	self._deathConnection = nil
end

local function knownMonster(model: Instance?): boolean
	return model ~= nil
		and model:IsA("Model")
		and model:GetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned") == true
		and model:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		and model:GetAttribute("MonsterRigVersion") == 1
end

function Controller:_hideServerRig()
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local runtime = if map and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		then map:FindFirstChild("CornRoundRuntime")
		else nil
	local model = if runtime and runtime:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		then runtime:FindFirstChild("Monster")
		else nil
	if not knownMonster(model) then
		return
	end
	local children = model:GetChildren()
	if #children ~= #Pose.Parts + 1 then
		return
	end
	local allowed = { Root = true }
	for _, definition in Pose.Parts do
		allowed[definition.Name] = true
		local part = model:FindFirstChild(definition.Name)
		if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") or part.Size ~= definition.Size then
			return
		end
	end
	for _, child in children do
		if not allowed[child.Name] or not child:IsA("BasePart") then
			return
		end
		allowed[child.Name] = nil
	end
	for _, definition in Pose.Parts do
		local part = model:FindFirstChild(definition.Name) :: BasePart
		table.insert(
			self._hiddenServer,
			{ part = part, previous = part.LocalTransparencyModifier, model = model }
		)
		part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
	end
end

function Controller:_restoreServerRig()
	for _, entry in self._hiddenServer do
		if
			knownMonster(entry.model)
			and entry.part.Parent == entry.model
			and entry.part.LocalTransparencyModifier == 1
		then
			entry.part.LocalTransparencyModifier = entry.previous
		end
	end
	table.clear(self._hiddenServer)
end

function Controller:_livingCharacter(): (Model?, Humanoid?, BasePart?)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	if character and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return character, humanoid, root
	end
	return nil, nil, nil
end

function Controller:_presentation(active: boolean)
	if self._minimap and active then
		self._minimap:SetExpanded(false)
	end
	if self._movement then
		self._movement:SetCaptureActive(active)
	end
	local hud = if self._round then self._round._hud else nil
	if hud then
		hud:SetCaptureActive(active)
	end
end

function Controller:_buildVisual(frame: CFrame): boolean
	if workspace:FindFirstChild(VISUAL_NAME) then
		warn("[CaptureController] Existing capture visual refused; unknown ownership/state")
		return false
	end
	assert(#Pose.Parts == 9, "Capture pose requires exactly nine decorative parts")
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = VISUAL_NAME
	model:SetAttribute("CornCaptureOwned", true)
	model:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT)
	model:SetAttribute("CaptureRigVersion", 1)
	local parts = {}
	for _, definition in Pose.Parts do
		assert(
			not parts[definition.Name] and typeof(Pose.Rest[definition.Name]) == "CFrame",
			"Invalid capture rig definition"
		)
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = definition.Name
		part.Size = definition.Size
		part.Color = definition.Color
		part.Material = definition.Material
		part.CFrame = frame * Pose.Rest[definition.Name]
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CastShadow = false
		part.Parent = model
		parts[definition.Name] = part
	end
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Name = "CaptureFaceLight"
	light.Brightness = 1
	light.Range = 12
	light.Shadows = false
	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 206, 154)
	light.Parent = assert(parts.Head, "Capture face missing")
	self._visual, self._parts = model, parts
	model.Parent = workspace
	return true
end

function Controller:_restoreCamera()
	local saved = self._saved
	self._saved = nil
	if not saved or saved.camera:GetAttribute(CAMERA_OWNER) ~= self._token then
		return
	end
	local camera = saved.camera
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	camera.FieldOfView = saved.fieldOfView
	camera.CameraSubject = if character ~= saved.character and humanoid
		then humanoid
		else saved.subject
	if
		root
		and self._snapshot
		and (self._snapshot.phase == "active" or self._snapshot.phase == "caught")
	then
		local direction = self._snapshot.start_look
		if typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" or direction.Magnitude < 0.9 then
			direction = saved.frame.LookVector
		end
		local eye = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(eye, eye + direction)
	else
		camera.CFrame = saved.frame
	end
	camera.Focus = saved.focus
	camera.CameraType = saved.cameraType
	camera:SetAttribute(CAMERA_OWNER, nil)
end

function Controller:Cancel(_reason: string?)
	Capture.Cancel(self._state)
	self._generation += 1
	if self._bound then
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BINDING)
		self._bound = false
	end
	local visual = self._visual
	self._visual = nil
	self._parts = {}
	self:_restoreServerRig()
	if visual then
		if
			visual:GetAttribute("CornCaptureOwned") == true
			and visual:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
			and visual:GetAttribute("CaptureRigVersion") == 1
		then
			visual:Destroy()
		else
			warn("[CaptureController] Changed capture visual preserved during cleanup")
		end
	end
	self:_restoreCamera()
	self._token = nil
	self:_presentation(false)
end

function Controller:_step(now: number)
	if self._minimap and self._minimap._expanded then
		self._minimap:SetExpanded(false)
	end
	local saved = self._saved
	if
		not self._state.active
		or now >= self._state.deadline
		or GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		or not saved
	then
		self:Cancel("deadline/menu")
		return
	end
	local _, humanoid = self:_livingCharacter()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if
		not humanoid
		or camera ~= saved.camera
		or camera:GetAttribute(CAMERA_OWNER) ~= self._token
		or camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	then
		self:Cancel("camera/death")
		return
	end
	local elapsed = math.max(0, now - self._state.started)
	local pose = Pose.Get("capturing", elapsed, false)
	local frame = self._state.frame
	for name, part in self._parts do
		part.CFrame = frame * pose[name]
	end
	local progress = Capture.Progress(self._state, now)
	local eased = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress)
	local head = (frame * pose.Head).Position
	local distance = 8 - 4.2 * eased
	local position = head + frame.LookVector * distance + frame.UpVector * 0.15
	local target = head + frame.LookVector * 1.05
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, target, frame.UpVector)
	camera.Focus = CFrame.new(target)
	camera.FieldOfView = 70 - 8 * eased
end

function Controller:_scheduleDeadline()
	local generation = self._generation
	task.delay(math.max(0, self._state.deadline - os.clock()), function()
		if
			self._generation == generation
			and self._state.active
			and os.clock() >= self._state.deadline
		then
			self:Cancel("wall-clock deadline")
		end
	end)
end

function Controller:_begin(): boolean
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local character, humanoid = self:_livingCharacter()
	if
		GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		or not camera
		or not humanoid

function Controller:_restoreCamera()

	if camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
		-- Another camera controller changed the type without our token handshake.
		camera:SetAttribute(CAMERA_OWNER, nil)
		return
	end
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	camera.FieldOfView = saved.fieldOfView
	camera.CameraSubject = if character ~= saved.character and humanoid
		then humanoid
		else saved.subject

	local visual = self._visual

			and visual:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
			and visual:GetAttribute("CaptureRigVersion") == 1
		then

function Controller:_step(now: number)

	gui.DisplayOrder = 60
	gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	local drops = {}
	for index, definition in Capture.PaintDrops do
		local drop = Instance.new("Frame")
		drop.Name = "PaintDrop" .. index
		annotatePaint(drop)
		drop.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		drop.Position = UDim2.fromScale(definition.x, definition.y)
		drop.Size = UDim2.fromScale(definition.w, definition.h)
		drop.Rotation = definition.rotation
		drop.BackgroundColor3 = PAINT_COLORS[definition.color]
		drop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		drop.BorderSizePixel = 0
		drop.Active = false
		drop.Selectable = false
		drop.Parent = gui
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		annotatePaint(corner)
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		corner.Parent = drop
		table.insert(drops, drop)
	end
	self._paint, self._paintDrops = gui, drops
	gui.Parent = playerGui
end

function Controller:_clearPaint()
	local gui = self._paint
	self._paint, self._paintDrops = nil, {}
	if not gui then
		return
	end
	if not paintOwned(gui) then
		warn("[CaptureController] Changed paint overlay preserved during cleanup")
		return
	end
	-- A foreign insertion must survive even when its temporary owned parent ends.
	for _, item in gui:GetDescendants() do
		if not paintOwned(item) and item.Parent and paintOwned(item.Parent) then
			item.Parent = gui.Parent
		end
	end
	gui:Destroy()
end

function Controller:_restoreCamera()
	local saved = self._saved
	self._saved = nil
	if not saved or saved.camera:GetAttribute(CAMERA_OWNER) ~= self._token then
		return
	end
	local camera = saved.camera
	if camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
		-- Another camera controller changed the type without our token handshake.
		camera:SetAttribute(CAMERA_OWNER, nil)
		return
	end
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	camera.FieldOfView = saved.fieldOfView
	camera.CameraSubject = if character ~= saved.character and humanoid
		then humanoid
		else saved.subject
	if
		root
		and self._snapshot
		and (self._snapshot.phase == "active" or self._snapshot.phase == "caught")
	then
		local direction = self._snapshot.start_look
		if typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" or direction.Magnitude < 0.9 then
			direction = saved.frame.LookVector
		end
		local eye = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(eye, eye + direction)
	else
		camera.CFrame = saved.frame
	end
	camera.Focus = saved.focus
	camera.CameraType = saved.cameraType
	camera:SetAttribute(CAMERA_OWNER, nil)
end

function Controller:Cancel(_reason: string?)
	Capture.Cancel(self._state)
	self._generation += 1
	if self._bound then
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BINDING)
		self._bound = false
	end
	local visual = self._visual
	self._visual = nil
	self._parts = {}
	self._mouthParts = {}
	self:_clearPaint()
	self:_restoreServerRig()
	if visual then
		if
			visual:GetAttribute("CornCaptureOwned") == true
			and visual:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
			and visual:GetAttribute("CaptureRigVersion") == 1
		then
			visual:Destroy()
		else
			warn("[CaptureController] Changed capture visual preserved during cleanup")
		end
	end
	self:_restoreCamera()
	self._token = nil
	self:_presentation(false)
end

function Controller:_step(now: number)
	if self._minimap and self._minimap._expanded then
		self._minimap:SetExpanded(false)
	end
	local saved = self._saved
	if
		not self._state.active
		or now >= self._state.deadline
		or GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		or not saved
	then
		self:Cancel("deadline/menu")
		return
	end
	local _, humanoid = self:_livingCharacter()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if
		not humanoid
		or camera ~= saved.camera
		or camera:GetAttribute(CAMERA_OWNER) ~= self._token
		or camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	then
		self:Cancel("camera/death")
		return
	end
	local elapsed = math.max(0, now - self._state.started)
	local pose = Pose.Get("capturing", elapsed, false)
	local frame = self._state.frame * PRESENTATION_OFFSET
	local headShake = pose.Head * Capture.HeadShake(elapsed) * pose.Head:Inverse()
	for name, part in self._parts do
		part.CFrame = frame * (if HEAD_PARTS[name] then headShake * pose[name] else pose[name])
	end
	local face = self._parts.Head.CFrame
	local opening = Capture.MouthOpen(elapsed)
	local height = 1.3 * opening
	self._mouthParts.OpenMouth.Size = Vector3.new(1.85, height, 0.14)
	self._mouthParts.OpenMouth.CFrame = face * CFrame.new(0, -0.15 - height / 2, -1.34)
	self._mouthParts.LowerJaw.CFrame = face * CFrame.new(0, -0.3 - height, -1.34)
	self._mouthParts.UpperTeeth.CFrame = face * CFrame.new(0, -0.19, -1.44)
	self._mouthParts.LowerTeeth.CFrame = face * CFrame.new(0, -0.08 - height, -1.44)
	local opacity = Capture.PaintOpacity(elapsed)
	for _, drop in self._paintDrops do
		if
			self._paint
			and paintOwned(self._paint)
			and drop.Parent == self._paint
			and paintOwned(drop)
		then
			drop.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - opacity
		end
	end
	local progress = Capture.Progress(self._state, now)
	local eased = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress)
	local head = (frame * pose.Head).Position
	local distance = 8 - 5.35 * eased
	local position = head + frame.LookVector * distance - frame.UpVector * (0.25 * eased)
	local target = head + frame.LookVector * 1.05 - frame.UpVector * (0.6 * eased)
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, target, frame.UpVector) * Capture.CameraShake(elapsed)
	camera.Focus = CFrame.new(target)
	camera.FieldOfView = 70 - 8 * eased
end

function Controller:_scheduleDeadline()
	local generation = self._generation
	task.delay(math.max(0, self._state.deadline - os.clock()), function()
		if
			self._generation == generation
			and self._state.active
			and os.clock() >= self._state.deadline
		then
			self:Cancel("wall-clock deadline")
		end
	end)
end

function Controller:_begin(): boolean
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local character, humanoid = self:_livingCharacter()
	if
		GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		or not camera
		or not humanoid
		or camera:GetAttribute(CAMERA_OWNER) ~= nil
	then
		return false
	end
	if not self:_buildVisual(self._state.frame) then
		return false
	end
	self:_hideServerRig()
	self:_buildPaint()
	self._generation += 1
	self._token = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	self._saved = {
		camera = camera,
		cameraType = camera.CameraType,
		subject = camera.CameraSubject,
		fieldOfView = camera.FieldOfView,
		frame = camera.CFrame,
		focus = camera.Focus,
		character = character,
	}
	camera:SetAttribute(CAMERA_OWNER, self._token)
	self:_presentation(true)
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	RunService:BindToRenderStep(BINDING, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
		self:_step(os.clock())
	end)
	self._bound = true
	self:_step(os.clock())
	self:_scheduleDeadline()
	return true
end

function Controller:SetSnapshot(snapshot: any)
	local previousDeadline = self._state.deadline
	local roundId = if type(snapshot) == "table" and type(snapshot.minimap) == "table"
		then snapshot.minimap.round_id
		else nil
	local capture = if type(snapshot) == "table" then snapshot.capture else nil
	local phase = if type(snapshot) == "table" then snapshot.phase else nil
	local action = Capture.Observe(self._state, roundId, capture, phase, os.clock())
	self._snapshot = if type(snapshot) == "table" then snapshot else nil
	if action == "cancel" then
		self:Cancel("snapshot")
	elseif action == "begin" then
		-- Release the previous owned effect before replacing its confirmed identity.
		if self._saved then
			local confirmedState = self._state
			self._state = Capture.NewState()
			self:Cancel("new capture")
			self._state = confirmedState
		end
		if not self:_begin() then
			self:Cancel("unavailable")
		end
	elseif action == "keep" and self._state.deadline < previousDeadline - 0.001 then
		self:_scheduleDeadline()
	end
end

function Controller:_watchDeath(character: Model?)
	if self._deathConnection then
		self._deathConnection:Disconnect()
		self._deathConnection = nil
	end
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	if humanoid then
		self._deathConnection = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			self:Cancel("death")
		end)
	end
end

function Controller:Start(context: any)
	self._movement = context.Controllers.MovementController
	self._minimap = context.Controllers.MinimapController
	self._round = context.Controllers.RoundController
	self:_watchDeath(player.Character)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		GuiService.MenuOpened:Connect(function()
			self:Cancel("menu")
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
			self:Cancel("reset")
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			self:Cancel("respawn")
			self:_watchDeath(character)
		end)
	)
end

function Controller:Destroy()
	self:Cancel("destroy")
	if self._deathConnection then
		self._deathConnection:Disconnect()
		self._deathConnection = nil
	end
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._snapshot = nil
	self._movement, self._minimap, self._round = nil, nil, nil
end

return Controller

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local Capture = require(Shared:WaitForChild("CapturePresentation"))
local Pose = require(Shared:WaitForChild("MonsterPose"))

local PAINT_NAME = "CornCapturePaint"
local CAMERA_OWNER = "CornCaptureCameraOwner"
local BINDING = "CornCaptureCamera"
local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
-- Lift only the decorative shot above nearby corn; server catch geometry stays exact.
local PRESENTATION_OFFSET = CFrame.new(0, 4, 0)
local Controller = { Name = "CaptureController", Order = 92 }
local HEAD_PARTS = { Head = true, Hat = true, LeftEye = true, RightEye = true }

function Controller:Init(_context: any)
	self._state = Capture.NewState()
	self._snapshot = nil
	self._movement = nil
	self._minimap = nil
	self._round = nil
	self._visual = nil
	self._parts = {}
	self._mouthParts = {}
	self._paint = nil
	self._paintDrops = {}
	self._hiddenServer = {}
	self._saved = nil
	self._token = nil
	self._generation = 0
	self._bound = false
	self._connections = {}
	self._deathConnection = nil
end

local function knownMonster(model: Instance?): boolean
	local index = if model then model:GetAttribute("MonsterIndex") else nil
	return model ~= nil
		and model:IsA("Model")
		and (index == 1 or index == 2 or index == 3)
		and model.Name == (if index == 1 then "Monster" else "Monster" .. index)
		and model:GetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned") == true
		and model:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		and model:GetAttribute("MonsterRigVersion") == 1
end

function Controller:_hideServerRig()
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local runtime = if map and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		then map:FindFirstChild("CornRoundRuntime")
		else nil
	if
		not runtime
		or not runtime:IsA("Folder")
		or runtime:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
	then
		return
	end
	for index = 1, 3 do
		self:_hideRig(runtime:FindFirstChild(if index == 1 then "Monster" else "Monster" .. index))
	end
end

function Controller:_hideRig(model: Instance?)
	if not knownMonster(model) then
		return
	end
	local children = model:GetChildren()
	if #children ~= #Pose.Parts + 1 then
		return
	end
	local allowed = { Root = true }
	for _, definition in Pose.Parts do
		allowed[definition.Name] = true
		local part = model:FindFirstChild(definition.Name)
		if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") or part.Size ~= definition.Size then
			return
		end
	end
	for _, child in children do
		if not allowed[child.Name] or not child:IsA("BasePart") then
			return
		end
		allowed[child.Name] = nil
	end
	for _, definition in Pose.Parts do
		local part = model:FindFirstChild(definition.Name) :: BasePart
		table.insert(self._hiddenServer, {
			part = part,
			previous = part.LocalTransparencyModifier,
			model = model,
			index = model:GetAttribute("MonsterIndex"),
			name = model.Name,
		})
		part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
	end
end

function Controller:_restoreServerRig()
	for _, entry in self._hiddenServer do
		if
			knownMonster(entry.model)
			and entry.model.Name == entry.name
			and entry.model:GetAttribute("MonsterIndex") == entry.index
			and entry.part.Parent == entry.model
			and entry.part.LocalTransparencyModifier == 1
		then
			entry.part.LocalTransparencyModifier = entry.previous
		end
	end
	table.clear(self._hiddenServer)
end

function Controller:_livingCharacter(): (Model?, Humanoid?, BasePart?)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	if character and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return character, humanoid, root
	end
	return nil, nil, nil
end

function Controller:_presentation(active: boolean)
	if self._minimap and active then
		self._minimap:SetExpanded(false)
	end
	if self._movement then
		self._movement:SetCaptureActive(active)
	end
	local hud = if self._round then self._round._hud else nil
	if hud then
		hud:SetCaptureActive(active)
	end
end

function Controller:_buildVisual(frame: CFrame): boolean
	frame *= PRESENTATION_OFFSET
	if workspace:FindFirstChild(VISUAL_NAME) then
		warn("[CaptureController] Existing capture visual refused; unknown ownership/state")
		return false
	end
	assert(#Pose.Parts == 9, "Capture pose requires exactly nine decorative parts")
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = VISUAL_NAME
	model:SetAttribute("CornCaptureOwned", true)
	model:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT)
	model:SetAttribute("CaptureRigVersion", 1)
	model:SetAttribute("MonsterHeightScale", Pose.HeightScale)
	local parts = {}
	for _, definition in Pose.Parts do
		assert(
			not parts[definition.Name] and typeof(Pose.Rest[definition.Name]) == "CFrame",
			"Invalid capture rig definition"
		)
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = definition.Name
		part.Size = definition.Size
		part.Color = definition.Color
		part.Material = definition.Material
		part.CFrame = frame * Pose.Rest[definition.Name]
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CastShadow = false
		part.Parent = model
		parts[definition.Name] = part
	end
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Name = "CaptureFaceLight"
	light.Brightness = 1
	light.Range = 12
	light.Shadows = false
	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 206, 154)
	light.Parent = assert(parts.Head, "Capture face missing")
	local mouthParts = {}
	for _, definition in
		{
			{
				name = "OpenMouth",
				size = Vector3.new(1.85, 1.3, 0.14),
				color = Color3.fromRGB(9, 7, 5),
			},
			{ name = "LowerJaw", size = Vector3.new(2.12, 0.3, 0.28), color = parts.Head.Color },
			{
				name = "UpperTeeth",
				size = Vector3.new(1.6, 0.16, 0.2),
				color = Color3.fromRGB(238, 229, 201),
			},
			{
				name = "LowerTeeth",
				size = Vector3.new(1.6, 0.16, 0.2),
				color = Color3.fromRGB(238, 229, 201),
			},
		}
	do
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = definition.name
		part.Size = definition.size
		part.Color = definition.color
		part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		part.CFrame = parts.Head.CFrame
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CastShadow = false
		part.Parent = model
		mouthParts[definition.name] = part
	end
	self._visual, self._parts = model, parts
	self._mouthParts = mouthParts
	model.Parent = workspace
	return true
end

local function paintOwned(item: Instance): boolean
	return item:GetAttribute("CornCaptureOwned") == true
		and item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		and item:GetAttribute("CaptureOverlayVersion") == 1

	local distance = 8 - 5.35 * eased
	local position = head + frame.LookVector * distance - frame.UpVector * (0.25 * eased)
	local target = head + frame.LookVector * 1.05 - frame.UpVector * (0.6 * eased)
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, target, frame.UpVector) * Capture.CameraShake(elapsed)
	camera.Focus = CFrame.new(target)
	camera.FieldOfView = 70 - 8 * eased
end

function Controller:_scheduleDeadline()
	local generation = self._generation
	task.delay(math.max(0, self._state.deadline - os.clock()), function()
		if
			self._generation == generation
			and self._state.active
			and os.clock() >= self._state.deadline
		then
			self:Cancel("wall-clock deadline")
		end
	end)
end

function Controller:_begin(): boolean
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local character, humanoid = self:_livingCharacter()
	if
		GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		or not camera
		or not humanoid
		or camera:GetAttribute(CAMERA_OWNER) ~= nil
	then
		return false
	end
	if not self:_buildVisual(self._state.frame) then
		return false
	end
	self:_hideServerRig()
	self:_buildPaint()
	self._generation += 1
	self._token = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	self._saved = {
		camera = camera,
		cameraType = camera.CameraType,
		subject = camera.CameraSubject,
		fieldOfView = camera.FieldOfView,
		frame = camera.CFrame,
		focus = camera.Focus,
		character = character,
	}
	camera:SetAttribute(CAMERA_OWNER, self._token)
	self:_presentation(true)
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	RunService:BindToRenderStep(BINDING, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
		self:_step(os.clock())
	end)
	self._bound = true
	self:_step(os.clock())
	self:_scheduleDeadline()
	return true
end

function Controller:SetSnapshot(snapshot: any)
	local previousDeadline = self._state.deadline
	local roundId = if type(snapshot) == "table" and type(snapshot.minimap) == "table"
		then snapshot.minimap.round_id
		else nil
	local capture = if type(snapshot) == "table" then snapshot.capture else nil
	local phase = if type(snapshot) == "table" then snapshot.phase else nil
	local action = Capture.Observe(self._state, roundId, capture, phase, os.clock())
	self._snapshot = if type(snapshot) == "table" then snapshot else nil
	if action == "cancel" then
		self:Cancel("snapshot")
	elseif action == "begin" then
		-- Release the previous owned effect before replacing its confirmed identity.
		if self._saved then
			local confirmedState = self._state
			self._state = Capture.NewState()
			self:Cancel("new capture")
			self._state = confirmedState
		end
		if not self:_begin() then
			self:Cancel("unavailable")
		end
	elseif action == "keep" and self._state.deadline < previousDeadline - 0.001 then
		self:_scheduleDeadline()
	end
end

function Controller:_watchDeath(character: Model?)
	if self._deathConnection then
		self._deathConnection:Disconnect()
		self._deathConnection = nil
	end
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	if humanoid then
		self._deathConnection = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			self:Cancel("death")
		end)
	end
end

function Controller:Start(context: any)
	self._movement = context.Controllers.MovementController
	self._minimap = context.Controllers.MinimapController
	self._round = context.Controllers.RoundController
	self:_watchDeath(player.Character)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		GuiService.MenuOpened:Connect(function()
			self:Cancel("menu")
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
			self:Cancel("reset")
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			self:Cancel("respawn")
			self:_watchDeath(character)
		end)
	)
end

function Controller:Destroy()
	self:Cancel("destroy")
	if self._deathConnection then
		self._deathConnection:Disconnect()
		self._deathConnection = nil
	end
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._snapshot = nil
	self._movement, self._minimap, self._round = nil, nil, nil
end

return Controller
