local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Pose = require(
	ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("MonsterPose")
)

local Controller = { Name = "MonsterAnimationController", Order = 80 }
local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local UPDATE_SEC, RESOLVE_SEC = 1 / 30, 0.5

local function disconnect(connections: { RBXScriptConnection })
	for _, connection in connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)
end

local function decorative(part: Instance?): boolean
	return part ~= nil
		and part:IsA("BasePart")
		and part.Anchored
		and not part.CanCollide
		and not part.CanTouch
		and not part.CanQuery
end

function Controller:_restore()
	local root = self._root
	if not root then
		return
	end
	for name, part in self._parts do
		pcall(function()
			part.CFrame = root.CFrame * Pose.Rest[name]
		end)
	end
	self._restored = true
end

function Controller:_unbindMonster()
	self:_restore()
	disconnect(self._monsterConnections)
	self._model, self._root, self._parts = nil, nil, {}
	self._previousPosition, self._movingUntil = nil, 0
	self._state, self._stateAt, self._lastWrites = nil, self._time, 0
end

function Controller:_valid(): boolean
	local model, root, runtime, map = self._model, self._root, self._runtime, self._map
	if
		not map
		or map.Parent ~= Workspace
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
		or not runtime
		or runtime.Parent ~= map
		or runtime:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
		or not model
		or model.Parent ~= runtime
		or model:GetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned") ~= true
		or model:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
		or model:GetAttribute("MonsterRigVersion") ~= 1
		or not decorative(root)
		or root.Parent ~= model
		or model.PrimaryPart ~= root
	then
		return false
	end
	for name, part in self._parts do
		if part.Parent ~= model or part.Name ~= name or not decorative(part) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function Controller:_resolveMonster()
	local model = self._runtime and self._runtime:FindFirstChild("Monster")
	if model == self._model and self:_valid() then
		return
	end
	self:_unbindMonster()
	if
		not model
		or not model:IsA("Model")
		or model:GetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned") ~= true
		or model:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
		or model:GetAttribute("MonsterRigVersion") ~= 1
	then
		return
	end
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("Root")
	if not decorative(root) or model.PrimaryPart ~= root then
		return
	end
	local parts, count = {}, 0
	for _, item in model:GetChildren() do
		if item ~= root then
			if not Pose.Rest[item.Name] or parts[item.Name] or not decorative(item) then
				return
			end
			parts[item.Name], count = item, count + 1
		end
	end
	if count ~= #Pose.Parts then
		return
	end
	self._model, self._root, self._parts = model, root, parts
	self._previousPosition = root.Position
	self._state, self._stateAt = model:GetAttribute("HuntState"), self._time
	self._restored = false
	local function topologyChanged()
		self:_unbindMonster()
	end
	table.insert(self._monsterConnections, model.ChildAdded:Connect(topologyChanged))
	table.insert(self._monsterConnections, model.ChildRemoved:Connect(topologyChanged))
	table.insert(
		self._monsterConnections,
		model.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			if not self:_valid() then
				self:_unbindMonster()
			end
		end)
	)
	for _, attribute in { "CornMonsterOwned", "corn_project_id", "MonsterRigVersion" } do
		table.insert(
			self._monsterConnections,
			model:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
				if not self:_valid() then
					self:_unbindMonster()
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	table.insert(
		self._monsterConnections,
		model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("HuntState"):Connect(function()
			self._state, self._stateAt = model:GetAttribute("HuntState"), self._time
			self._updateElapsed = UPDATE_SEC
			if
				self._state ~= "patrol"
				and self._state ~= "chase"
				and self._state ~= "trapped"
				and self._state ~= "capturing"
			then
				self:_restore()
			end
		end)
	)
end

function Controller:_clearRuntime()
	self:_unbindMonster()
	disconnect(self._runtimeConnections)
	self._runtime = nil
end

function Controller:_resolveRuntime()
	local runtime = self._map and self._map:FindFirstChild("CornRoundRuntime")
	if
		not runtime
		or not runtime:IsA("Folder")
		or runtime:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
	then
		self:_clearRuntime()
		return
	end
	if runtime ~= self._runtime then
		self:_clearRuntime()
		self._runtime = runtime
		table.insert(
			self._runtimeConnections,
			runtime.ChildAdded:Connect(function(item)
				if item.Name == "Monster" then
					self:_resolveMonster()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._runtimeConnections,
			runtime.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(item)
				if item == self._model then
					self:_unbindMonster()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._runtimeConnections,
			runtime.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				if runtime.Parent ~= self._map then
					self:_clearRuntime()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._runtimeConnections,
			runtime:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"):Connect(function()
				if runtime:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT then
					self:_clearRuntime()
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	self:_resolveMonster()
end

function Controller:_clearMap()
	self:_clearRuntime()
	disconnect(self._mapConnections)
	self._map = nil
end

function Controller:_resolveMap()
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models")
	then
		self:_clearMap()
		return
	end
	if map ~= self._map then
		self:_clearMap()
		self._map = map
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.ChildAdded:Connect(function(item)
				if item.Name == "CornRoundRuntime" then
					self:_resolveRuntime()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(item)
				if item == self._runtime then
					self:_clearRuntime()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				if map.Parent ~= Workspace then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"):Connect(function()
				if map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	self:_resolveRuntime()
end

function Controller:_step(delta: number)
	self._time += math.clamp(delta, 0, 0.25)
	self._resolveElapsed += delta
	if self._resolveElapsed >= RESOLVE_SEC then
		self._resolveElapsed = 0
		self:_resolveMap()
	end
	self._updateElapsed += delta
	if self._updateElapsed < UPDATE_SEC or not self._model then
		return
	end
	self._updateElapsed %= UPDATE_SEC
	self._lastWrites = 0
	if not self:_valid() then
		self:_unbindMonster()
		return
	end
	local position = self._root.Position
	if self._previousPosition and (position - self._previousPosition).Magnitude > 0.015 then
		self._movingUntil = self._time + 0.15
	end
	self._previousPosition = position
	local pose = Pose.Get(self._state, self._time - self._stateAt, self._movingUntil > self._time)
	if pose == Pose.Rest and self._restored then
		return
	end
	local frame = self._root.CFrame
	for name, part in self._parts do
		part.CFrame = frame * pose[name]
		self._lastWrites += 1
	end
	self._restored = pose == Pose.Rest
end

function Controller:Init(context: any)
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
	self._map, self._runtime, self._model, self._root = nil, nil, nil, nil
	self._parts = {}
	self._topConnections, self._mapConnections, self._runtimeConnections, self._monsterConnections =
		{}, {}, {}, {}
	self._time, self._stateAt, self._movingUntil, self._lastWrites = 0, 0, 0, 0
	self._updateElapsed, self._resolveElapsed = UPDATE_SEC, RESOLVE_SEC
	self._state, self._previousPosition, self._restored = nil, nil, true
	self._connection = nil
end

function Controller:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self:_resolveMap()
	table.insert(
		self._topConnections,
		Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(item)
			if item.Name == "CornMap" then
				self:_resolveMap()
			end
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._topConnections,
		Workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(item)
			if item == self._map then
				self:_clearMap()
			end
		end)
	)
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function Controller:Destroy()
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearMap()
	disconnect(self._topConnections)
	self._enabled = false
end

return Controller

local function finite(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
end

function Handheld.Definitions(kind: string): { Definition }
	return definitions[kind] or empty
end

function Handheld.Duration(kind: string): number
	return if kind == "energy" then 0.9 elseif kind == "trap" then 0.55 else 0
end

function Handheld.IsFinished(kind: string, elapsed: number): boolean
	return not finite(elapsed) or Handheld.Duration(kind) == 0 or elapsed >= Handheld.Duration(kind)
end

local function ease(progress: number): number
	local value = math.clamp(progress, 0, 1)
	return value * value * (3 - 2 * value)
end

local function held(kind: string, aspect: number): CFrame
	-- Narrow screens move the hand toward the centre without bringing it nearer.
	local right = 0.59 * math.clamp(aspect / 1.5, 0.45, 1)
	if kind == "key" then
		return cf(right, -0.6, -1.7) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(65), math.rad(-8), math.rad(-18))
	elseif kind == "trap" then
		return cf(right, -0.68, -1.8) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(55), math.rad(-8), math.rad(-12))
	end
	return cf(right, -0.6, -1.55) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-5), math.rad(-8), math.rad(-12))
end

function Handheld.GetPose(kind: string, elapsed: number, using: boolean, aspect: number?): CFrame
	local ratio = if finite(aspect) then math.clamp(aspect :: number, 0.3, 4) else 16 / 9
	local start = held(kind, ratio)
	if not using or Handheld.Duration(kind) == 0 or not finite(elapsed) then
		return start
	end
	local time = math.max(elapsed, 0)
	if kind == "energy" then
		local mouth = cf(0.16, -0.23, -1.45)
			* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(70), math.rad(-8), math.rad(-12))
		if time <= 0.27 then
			return start:Lerp(mouth, ease(time / 0.27))
		end
		if time <= 0.63 then
			return mouth
		end
		local lowered = cf(start.Position.X, -1.3, -1.7)
			* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(30), math.rad(-8), math.rad(-12))
		return mouth:Lerp(lowered, ease((time - 0.63) / 0.27))
	end
	local placed = cf(start.Position.X * 0.7, -1.85, -2.25)
		* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(8), 0, math.rad(-6))
	return start:Lerp(placed, ease(time / 0.55))
end

return table.freeze(Handheld)

--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game")
local Inventory = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Inventory"))
local Presentation = require(Shared:WaitForChild("HandheldPresentation"))
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local MODEL_NAME = "CornHandheld"
local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local BINDING = "CornHandheldPresentation"
local Controller = { Name = "HandheldController", Order = 97 }

function Controller:Init(_context: any)
	self._snapshot = nil
	self._roundId = -1
	self._useId = 0
	self._endedRound = nil
	self._gesture = nil
	self._visual = nil
	self._camera = nil
	self._character = nil
	self._kind = nil
	self._minimap = nil
	self._capture = nil
	self._connections = {}
	self._bound = false
	self._generation = 0
	self._refused = nil
end

function Controller:_clearVisual()
	local model = self._visual
	self._visual = nil
	self._kind = nil
	self._character = nil
	self._camera = nil
	if model then
		if
			model:GetAttribute("CornHandheldOwned") == true
			and model:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
			and model:GetAttribute("HandheldVersion") == 1
		then
			model:Destroy()
		else
			warn("[HandheldController] Changed held model preserved")
		end
	end
end

function Controller:_cancelGesture()
	self._gesture = nil
	self._generation += 1
end

function Controller:Clear(_reason: string?)
	self._snapshot = nil
	self:_cancelGesture()
	self:_clearVisual()
end

function Controller:_livingCharacter(): (Model?, Humanoid?)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	if character and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return character, humanoid
	end
	return nil, nil
end

function Controller:_canShow(camera: Camera?, humanoid: Humanoid?): boolean
	return self._snapshot ~= nil
		and self._snapshot.phase == "active"
		and camera ~= nil
		and humanoid ~= nil
		and camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom
		and camera.CameraSubject == humanoid
		and camera:GetAttribute("CornCaptureCameraOwner") == nil
		and player.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
		and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		and not (self._minimap and self._minimap._expanded)
		and not (self._capture and self._capture._state.active)
end

local function skin(character: Model, side: string): Color3
	for _, name in { side .. "Hand", side .. " Arm", side .. "LowerArm" } do
		local part = character:FindFirstChild(name)
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			return part.Color
		end
	end
	return Color3.fromRGB(191, 145, 110)
end

function Controller:_buildVisual(kind: string, camera: Camera, character: Model): boolean
	local existing = camera:FindFirstChild(MODEL_NAME)
	if existing then
		if self._refused ~= existing then
			self._refused = existing
			warn("[HandheldController] Existing held model refused; unknown ownership/state")
		end
		return false
	end
	local definitions = Presentation.Definitions(kind)
	if #definitions == 0 then
		return false
	end
	assert(#definitions + #Presentation.Hands + 1 <= 24, "Held geometry exceeds24parts")
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = MODEL_NAME
	model:SetAttribute("CornHandheldOwned", true)
	model:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT)
	model:SetAttribute("HandheldVersion", 1)
	model:SetAttribute("ItemKind", kind)
	local function part(
		name: string,
		size: Vector3,
		frame: CFrame,
		color: Color3,
		material: Enum.Material,
		shape: Enum.PartType?
	): Part
		local item = Instance.new("Part")
		item.Name = name
		item.Size = size
		item.CFrame = frame
		item.Color = color
		item.Material = material
		if shape then
			item.Shape = shape
		end
		item.Anchored = true
		item.CanCollide = false
		item.CanTouch = false
		item.CanQuery = false
		item.CastShadow = false
		item.Parent = model
		return item
	end
	local anchor = part(
		"Anchor",
		Vector3.new(0.08, 0.08, 0.08),
		CFrame.identity,
		Color3.new(),
		Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		nil
	)
	anchor.Transparency = 1
	model.PrimaryPart = anchor
	for _, definition in definitions do
		part(
			definition.name,
			definition.size,
			definition.localFrame,
			definition.color,
			definition.material,
			definition.shape
		)
	end
	for _, hand in Presentation.Hands do
		part(
			hand.name,
			hand.size,
			hand.localFrame,
			skin(character, if string.find(hand.name, "Left", 1, true) then "Left" else "Right"),
			Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			nil
		)
	end
	self._visual, self._camera, self._character, self._kind = model, camera, character, kind
	self._refused = nil
	model.Parent = camera
	return true
end

function Controller:_step(now: number)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local character, humanoid = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not self:_canShow(camera, humanoid) then
		self:_cancelGesture()
		self:_clearVisual()
		return
	end
	if self._camera and camera ~= self._camera then
		self:_cancelGesture()
		self:_clearVisual()
		return
	end
	local gesture = self._gesture
	if gesture and now >= gesture.deadline then
		self:_cancelGesture()
		gesture = nil
	end
	local inventory = self._snapshot.inventory
	local kind = if gesture then gesture.kind else inventory.slots[inventory.selected]
	if kind == "empty" then
		self:_clearVisual()
		return
	end
	if
		self._visual
		and (self._kind ~= kind or self._character ~= character or self._visual.Parent ~= camera)
	then
		self:_clearVisual()
	end
	if
		self._visual
		and (
			self._visual:GetAttribute("CornHandheldOwned") ~= true
			or self._visual:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
			or self._visual:GetAttribute("HandheldVersion") ~= 1
			or self._visual:GetAttribute("ItemKind") ~= kind
		)
	then
		self:_cancelGesture()
		self:_clearVisual()
		return
	end
	if not self._visual and not self:_buildVisual(kind, camera :: Camera, character :: Model) then
		return
	end
	local elapsed = if gesture then math.max(0, now - gesture.started) else 0
	local viewport = (camera :: Camera).ViewportSize
	local aspect = if viewport.Y > 0 then viewport.X / viewport.Y else 16 / 9
	self._visual:PivotTo(
		(camera :: Camera).CFrame * Presentation.GetPose(kind, elapsed, gesture ~= nil, aspect)
	)
end

function Controller:_beginGesture(kind: string, selected: number, now: number)
	local duration = Presentation.Duration(kind)
	if duration <= 0 then
		return
	end
	self:_cancelGesture()
	self._gesture = { kind = kind, selected = selected, started = now, deadline = now + duration }
	local generation = self._generation
	task.delay(duration, function()
		if
			self._generation == generation
			and self._gesture
			and os.clock() >= self._gesture.deadline
		then
			self:_cancelGesture()
			self:_step(os.clock())
		end
	end)
end

function Controller:SetSnapshot(snapshot: any)
	if
		type(snapshot) ~= "table"
		or type(snapshot.minimap) ~= "table"
		or not Inventory.IsValidSnapshot(snapshot.inventory)
	then
		self:Clear("malformed")
		return
	end
	local roundId = snapshot.minimap.round_id
	local use = snapshot.inventory.use
	if
		type(roundId) ~= "number"
		or roundId % 1 ~= 0
		or roundId < self._roundId
		or type(use) ~= "table"
		or type(use.id) ~= "number"
		or use.id % 1 ~= 0
		or use.id < 0
		or use.id == math.huge
	then
		return
	end
	if
		roundId == self._roundId
		and snapshot.phase == "active"
		and (use.id < self._useId or self._endedRound == roundId)
	then
		return
	end
	local first = roundId ~= self._roundId
	local previous = self._snapshot
	if first then
		self:_cancelGesture()
		self:_clearVisual()
		self._roundId, self._useId = roundId, use.id
		self._endedRound = nil
	end
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	if
		snapshot.phase == "escaped"
		or snapshot.phase == "aborted"
		or snapshot.phase == "caught_out"
	then
		self._endedRound = roundId
	end
	local selected = snapshot.inventory.selected
	if
		self._gesture
		and previous
		and (
			previous.inventory.selected ~= selected
			or (
				previous.inventory.slots[selected] ~= snapshot.inventory.slots[selected]
				and snapshot.inventory.slots[selected] ~= "empty"
			)
		)
	then
		self:_cancelGesture()
	end
	if not first and use.id > self._useId then
		self._useId = use.id
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local _, humanoid = self:_livingCharacter()
		if (use.kind == "energy" or use.kind == "trap") and self:_canShow(camera, humanoid) then
			self:_beginGesture(use.kind, selected, os.clock())
		end
	end
	self:_step(os.clock())
end

function Controller:Start(context: any)
	self._minimap = context.Controllers.MinimapController
	self._capture = context.Controllers.CaptureController
	RunService:BindToRenderStep(BINDING, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function()
		self:_step(os.clock())
	end)
	self._bound = true
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		GuiService.MenuOpened:Connect(function()
			self:_cancelGesture()
			self:_clearVisual()
		end)
	)
	for _, signal in { player.CharacterAdded, player.CharacterRemoving } do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			signal:Connect(function()
				self:Clear("character changed")
			end)
		)
	end
end

function Controller:Destroy()
	self:Clear("destroy")
	if self._bound then
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BINDING)
		self._bound = false
	end
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._minimap, self._capture = nil, nil
end

return Controller

--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game")
local Inventory = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Inventory"))
local Presentation = require(Shared:WaitForChild("HandheldPresentation"))
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local MODEL_NAME = "CornHandheld"
local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local BINDING = "CornHandheldPresentation"
local Controller = { Name = "HandheldController", Order = 97 }

function Controller:Init(_context: any)
	self._snapshot = nil
	self._roundId = -1
	self._useId = 0
	self._endedRound = nil
	self._gesture = nil
	self._visual = nil
	self._camera = nil
	self._character = nil
	self._kind = nil
	self._minimap = nil
	self._capture = nil
	self._connections = {}
	self._bound = false
	self._generation = 0
	self._refused = nil
end

function Controller:_clearVisual()
	local model = self._visual
	self._visual = nil
	self._kind = nil
	self._character = nil
	self._camera = nil
	if model then
		if
			model:GetAttribute("CornHandheldOwned") == true
			and model:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
			and model:GetAttribute("HandheldVersion") == 1
		then
			model:Destroy()
		else
			warn("[HandheldController] Changed held model preserved")
		end
	end
end

function Controller:_cancelGesture()
	self._gesture = nil
	self._generation += 1
end

function Controller:Clear(_reason: string?)
	self._snapshot = nil
	self:_cancelGesture()
	self:_clearVisual()
end

function Controller:_livingCharacter(): (Model?, Humanoid?)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	if character and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return character, humanoid
	end
	return nil, nil
end

function Controller:_canShow(camera: Camera?, humanoid: Humanoid?): boolean
	return self._snapshot ~= nil
		and self._snapshot.phase == "active"
		and camera ~= nil
		and humanoid ~= nil
		and camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom
		and camera.CameraSubject == humanoid
		and camera:GetAttribute("CornCaptureCameraOwner") == nil
		and player.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
		and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		and not (self._minimap and self._minimap._expanded)
		and not (self._capture and self._capture._state.active)
end

local function skin(character: Model, side: string): Color3
	for _, name in { side .. "Hand", side .. " Arm", side .. "LowerArm" } do
		local part = character:FindFirstChild(name)
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			return part.Color
		end
	end
	return Color3.fromRGB(191, 145, 110)
end

function Controller:_buildVisual(kind: string, camera: Camera, character: Model): boolean
	local existing = camera:FindFirstChild(MODEL_NAME)
	if existing then
		if self._refused ~= existing then
			self._refused = existing
			warn("[HandheldController] Existing held model refused; unknown ownership/state")
		end
		return false
	end
	local definitions = Presentation.Definitions(kind)
	if #definitions == 0 then
		return false
	end
	assert(#definitions + #Presentation.Hands + 1 <= 24, "Held geometry exceeds24parts")
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = MODEL_NAME
	model:SetAttribute("CornHandheldOwned", true)
	model:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT)
	model:SetAttribute("HandheldVersion", 1)
	model:SetAttribute("ItemKind", kind)
	local function part(
		name: string,
		size: Vector3,
		frame: CFrame,
		color: Color3,
		material: Enum.Material,
		shape: Enum.PartType?
	): Part
		local item = Instance.new("Part")
		item.Name = name
		item.Size = size
		item.CFrame = frame
		item.Color = color
		item.Material = material
		if shape then
			item.Shape = shape
		end
		item.Anchored = true
		item.CanCollide = false
		item.CanTouch = false
		item.CanQuery = false
		item.CastShadow = false
		item.Parent = model
		return item
	end
	local anchor = part(
		"Anchor",
		Vector3.new(0.08, 0.08, 0.08),
		CFrame.identity,
		Color3.new(),
		Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		nil
	)
	anchor.Transparency = 1
	model.PrimaryPart = anchor
	for _, definition in definitions do
		local item = part(
			definition.name,
			definition.size,
			definition.localFrame,
			definition.color,
			definition.material,
			definition.shape
		)
		if kind == "energy" and definition.name == "Can" then
			local label = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
			label.Name = "EnergyLabel"
			label.Face = Enum.NormalId.Back
			label.AlwaysOnTop = false
			label.LightInfluence = 0
			label.Active = false
			label.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize
			label.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(256, 256)
			label.Parent = item
			local paper = Instance.new("Frame")
			paper.Name = "Paper"
			paper.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			paper.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			paper.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8)
			paper.Rotation = 90
			paper.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(33, 135, 69)
			paper.BorderSizePixel = 0
			paper.Parent = label
			local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
			corner.Parent = paper
			local logo = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			logo.Name = "Logo"
			logo.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.6)
			logo.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.04)
			logo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			logo.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			logo.TextSize = 100
			logo.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			logo.Text = "+"
			logo.Parent = paper
			local name = logo:Clone()
			name.Name = "Name"
			name.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.22)
			name.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.68)
			name.TextSize = 30
			name.Text = "ENERGY"
			name.Parent = paper
		end
	end
	for _, hand in Presentation.Hands do
		part(
			hand.name,
			hand.size,
			hand.localFrame,
			skin(character, if string.find(hand.name, "Left", 1, true) then "Left" else "Right"),
			Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			nil
		)
	end
	self._visual, self._camera, self._character, self._kind = model, camera, character, kind
	self._refused = nil
	model.Parent = camera
	return true
end

function Controller:_step(now: number)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local character, humanoid = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not self:_canShow(camera, humanoid) then
		self:_cancelGesture()
		self:_clearVisual()
		return
	end
	if self._camera and camera ~= self._camera then
		self:_cancelGesture()
		self:_clearVisual()
		return
	end
	local gesture = self._gesture
	if gesture and now >= gesture.deadline then
		self:_cancelGesture()
		gesture = nil
	end
	local inventory = self._snapshot.inventory
	local kind = if gesture then gesture.kind else inventory.slots[inventory.selected]
	if kind == "empty" then
		self:_clearVisual()
		return
	end
	if
		self._visual
		and (self._kind ~= kind or self._character ~= character or self._visual.Parent ~= camera)
	then
		self:_clearVisual()
	end
	if
		self._visual
		and (
			self._visual:GetAttribute("CornHandheldOwned") ~= true
			or self._visual:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
			or self._visual:GetAttribute("HandheldVersion") ~= 1
			or self._visual:GetAttribute("ItemKind") ~= kind
		)
	then
		self:_cancelGesture()
		self:_clearVisual()
		return
	end
	if not self._visual and not self:_buildVisual(kind, camera :: Camera, character :: Model) then
		return
	end
	local elapsed = if gesture then math.max(0, now - gesture.started) else 0
	local viewport = (camera :: Camera).ViewportSize
	local aspect = if viewport.Y > 0 then viewport.X / viewport.Y else 16 / 9
	self._visual:PivotTo(
		(camera :: Camera).CFrame * Presentation.GetPose(kind, elapsed, gesture ~= nil, aspect)
	)
end

function Controller:_beginGesture(kind: string, selected: number, now: number)
	local duration = Presentation.Duration(kind)
	if duration <= 0 then
		return
	end
	self:_cancelGesture()
	self._gesture = { kind = kind, selected = selected, started = now, deadline = now + duration }
	local generation = self._generation
	task.delay(duration, function()
		if
			self._generation == generation
			and self._gesture

	end)
end

ServerScriptService/GameServer/Game/Roun:
--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game")
local Assets = require(Shared:WaitForChild("AudioAssets"))
local Rules = require(Shared:WaitForChild("AudioRules"))
local Layout = require(Shared:WaitForChild("CornLayout"))

local RoundAudio = {}
RoundAudio.__index = RoundAudio

local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local CORN_KEYS = Rules.CornKeys
local VOICE_KEYS = Rules.VoiceKeys

local function finite(value: number): boolean
	return value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

local function owned(item: Instance): boolean
	return item:GetAttribute("CornAudioOwned") == true
		and item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
end

local function annotate(item: Instance, role: string)
	item:SetAttribute("CornAudioOwned", true)
	item:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT)
	item:SetAttribute("audio_role", role)
end

local function stop(sound: Sound)
	if sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") ~= false then
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", false)
		sound:Stop()
	end
end

local function request(sound: Sound, playing: boolean)
	if not playing then
		stop(sound)
	elseif sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") ~= true then
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", true)
		-- An empty ID is configuration awaiting import, not loaded audio.
		if sound.SoundId ~= "" then
			sound:Play()
		end
	end
end

-- Preserve an inserted foreign child even when its owned parent is removed.
local function destroyOwned(item: Instance)
	if not owned(item) then
		return
	end
	local safeParent = item.Parent
	while safeParent and owned(safeParent) do
		safeParent = safeParent.Parent
	end
	local descendants = item:GetDescendants()
	for _, child in descendants do
		if not owned(child) and child.Parent and owned(child.Parent) then
			child.Parent = safeParent
		end
	end
	item:Destroy()
end

function RoundAudio:_remember(item: Instance, role: string)
	annotate(item, role)
	table.insert(self.created, item)
	return item
end

function RoundAudio:_remove(item: Instance)
	if item:IsA("Sound") then
		stop(item)
	end
	destroyOwned(item)
	local index = table.find(self.created, item)
	if index then
		table.remove(self.created, index)
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_sound(
	parent: Instance,
	key: string,
	role: string,
	volume: number,
	category: string,
	range: any,
	looped: boolean
): Sound
	local definition = Assets.Get(key)
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = "CornAudio_" .. role
	self:_remember(sound, role)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioAssetKey", key)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", false)
	sound.SoundId = definition.Id
	sound.Volume = math.clamp(volume * definition.Gain, 0, 1)
	sound.Looped = looped
	sound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
	sound.RollOffMinDistance = range.Min
	sound.RollOffMaxDistance = range.Max
	sound.SoundGroup = self.groups[category]
	sound.Parent = parent
	return sound
end

function RoundAudio.new(world: any, ownerPlayer: Player, hunt: any, random: Random?)
	assert(world.Root and world.Root:IsA("Model"), "Round audio requires a bound map")
	assert(world.Field and world.Field:IsA("BasePart"), "Round audio requires Field")
	assert(world.Runtime and world.Ground, "Round audio requires runtime and Ground")
	local self = setmetatable({
		world = world,
		ownerPlayer = ownerPlayer,
		random = random or Random.new(),
		created = {} :: { Instance },
		groups = {} :: { [string]: SoundGroup },
		crickets = {},
		fires = {} :: { Sound },
		actors = {} :: { [Player]: any },
		npc = nil :: any,
		voices = {} :: { Sound },
		voiceBag = {} :: { number },
		voiceLast = 0,
		voiceUntil = 0,
		voiceAt = 0,
		chasing = false,
		startedAt = nil :: number?,
		pollAt = -math.huge,
		destroyed = false,
		exclusions = Layout.ReadExclusions(world.Root, world.Field),
	}, RoundAudio)
	local id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "CornRoundAudio_" .. id
	self:_remember(folder, "runtime")
	folder.Parent = world.Runtime
	self.folder = folder
	local groupsFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	groupsFolder.Name = "CornRoundAudio_" .. id
	self:_remember(groupsFolder, "groups")
	groupsFolder.Parent = SoundService
	for _, category in { "Music", "Ambience", "Effects" } do
		local group = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
		group.Name = category
		self:_remember(group, "group_" .. category)
		group.Volume = math.clamp(Rules.Mix.Master * Rules.Mix[category], 0, 1)
		group.Parent = groupsFolder
		self.groups[category] = group
	end
	local half = world.Field.Size / 2
	for index, offset in
		{
			Vector2.new(-0.62, -0.62),
			Vector2.new(0.62, -0.62),
			Vector2.new(0, 0),
			Vector2.new(-0.62, 0.62),
			Vector2.new(0.62, 0.62),
		}
	do
		local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
		anchor.Name = "Crickets" .. index
		self:_remember(anchor, "crickets_emitter")
		anchor:AddTag("corn_audio_emitter")
		anchor.Size = Vector3.one
		anchor.Transparency = 1
		anchor.Anchored = true
		anchor.CanCollide = false
		anchor.CanTouch = false
		anchor.CanQuery = false
		anchor.CastShadow = false
		anchor.Position = world.Field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
			Vector3.new(offset.X * half.X, -half.Y + 1, offset.Y * half.Z)
		)
		anchor.Parent = folder
		local sound = self:_sound(
			anchor,
			"COC_Crickets_15s",
			"crickets",
			Rules.Volume.Crickets,
			"Ambience",
			Rules.Ranges.Crickets,
			true
		)
		table.insert(self.crickets, { sound = sound, offset = (index - 1) * Rules.Cycle / 5 })
	end
	local markers = world.Root:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
	if
		markers
		and markers:GetAttribute("CornTorchMarkersOwned") == true
		and markers:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
	then
		for _, torch in markers:GetChildren() do
			if
				torch:IsA("Model")
				and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true
				and torch:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
				and torch:HasTag("corn_torch")
			then
				local flame = torch:FindFirstChild("Flame")
				if flame and flame:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(
						self.fires,
						self:_sound(
							flame,
							"COC_Fire",
							"fire",
							Rules.Volume.Fire,
							"Ambience",
							Rules.Ranges.Fire,
							true
						)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt)
	return self
end

function RoundAudio:_setHunt(hunt: any)
	local root = if hunt and not hunt.destroyed then hunt.root else nil
	if root and not root.Parent then
		root = nil
	end
	if self.npc and self.npc.root == root then
		return
	end
	if self.npc then
		self:_remove(self.npc.sound)
	end
	for _, sound in self.voices do
		self:_remove(sound)
	end
	self.voices = {}
	self.npc = nil
	self.chasing = false
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and root.Parent then
		self.npc = self:_actor(root)
		for index, key in VOICE_KEYS do
			self.voices[index] = self:_sound(
				root,
				key,
				"monster_voice_" .. index,
				Rules.Volume.Monster,
				"Effects",
				Rules.Ranges.Monster,
				false
			)
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_actor(root: BasePart): any
	return {
		root = root,
		sound = self:_sound(
			root,
			CORN_KEYS[1],
			"corn_rustle",
			Rules.Volume.Rustle,
			"Effects",
			Rules.Ranges.Rustle,
			false
		),
		lastPosition = nil,
		lastAt = nil,
		lastClip = 0,
		untilAt = 0,
		nextAt = 0,
	}
end

function RoundAudio:_inCorn(point: Vector3): boolean
	local field = self.world.Field
	local at = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = field.Size / 2
	return math.abs(at.X) <= half.X
		and math.abs(at.Z) <= half.Z
		and not Layout.IsExcluded(point, self.exclusions)
end

function RoundAudio:_stepActor(actor: any, now: number, eligible: boolean)
	local root = actor.root
	local point = root.Position
	local before = actor.lastPosition
	local beforeAt = actor.lastAt
	actor.lastPosition = point
	actor.lastAt = now
	local dt = if beforeAt then now - beforeAt else 0
	local delta = if before then point - before else Vector3.zero
	local distance = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
	-- Clear discontinuities instead of turning spawn/teleport into a loud footstep.
	local moving = dt > 0
		and dt <= 1
		and distance >= 0.05
		and distance <= 12
		and distance / dt <= 45
		and math.abs(delta.Y) < 4
	if not eligible or not moving or not self:_inCorn(point) then
		stop(actor.sound)
		actor.untilAt = 0
		actor.nextAt = now
		return
	end
	if now >= actor.untilAt then
		stop(actor.sound)
	end
	if now < actor.nextAt then
		return
	end
	local index = self.random:NextInteger(1, #CORN_KEYS - 1)
	if index >= actor.lastClip then
		index += 1
	end
	if index > #CORN_KEYS then
		index = 1
	end
	actor.lastClip = index
	local definition = Assets.Get(CORN_KEYS[index])
	actor.sound.SoundId = definition.Id
	actor.sound:SetAttribute("AudioAssetKey", CORN_KEYS[index])
	actor.sound.Volume = math.clamp(Rules.Volume.Rustle * definition.Gain, 0, 1)
	local duration = math.max(0.1, definition.Duration)
	actor.untilAt = now + duration
	actor.nextAt = actor.untilAt + self.random:NextNumber(0.08, 0.22)
	request(actor.sound, true)
end

function RoundAudio:_grounded(character: Model, humanoid: Humanoid, root: BasePart): boolean
	if humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
		return false
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local length = math.max(3, humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 2)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -length, 0), params)
	return hit ~= nil and hit.Instance == self.world.Ground
end

function RoundAudio:_players(now: number, phase: string)
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	table.sort(players, function(a, b)
		if a == b then
			return false
		elseif a == self.ownerPlayer then
			return true
		elseif b == self.ownerPlayer then
			return false
		end
		return a.UserId < b.UserId
	end)
	local alive: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
	for index, player in players do
		if index > Rules.ActorLimit then
			break
		end
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if
			not character
			or not humanoid
			or not root
			or not root:IsA("BasePart")
			or humanoid.Health <= 0
		then
			continue
		end
		alive[player] = true
		local actor = self.actors[player]
		if actor and actor.root ~= root then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			actor = nil
		end
		if not actor then
			actor = self:_actor(root)
			self.actors[player] = actor
		end
		self:_stepActor(
			actor,
			now,
			(phase == "active" or player ~= self.ownerPlayer)
				and self:_grounded(character, humanoid, root)
		)
	end
	for player, actor in self.actors do
		if not alive[player] then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			self.actors[player] = nil
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_voice(now: number)
	if now >= self.voiceUntil then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	end
	if now < self.voiceAt or #self.voices ~= 3 then
		return
	end
	if #self.voiceBag == 0 then
		self.voiceBag = { 1, 2, 3 }
		for index = #self.voiceBag, 2, -1 do
			local other = self.random:NextInteger(1, index)
			self.voiceBag[index], self.voiceBag[other] = self.voiceBag[other], self.voiceBag[index]
		end
		if self.voiceBag[1] == self.voiceLast then
			self.voiceBag[1], self.voiceBag[2] = self.voiceBag[2], self.voiceBag[1]
		end
	end
	local index = table.remove(self.voiceBag, 1)
	self.voiceLast = index
	local sound = self.voices[index]
	local definition = Assets.Get(VOICE_KEYS[index])
	self.voiceUntil = now + math.max(0.1, definition.Duration, sound.TimeLength)
	self.voiceAt = self.voiceUntil + self.random:NextNumber(Rules.VoiceMin, Rules.VoiceMax)
	request(sound, true)
end

function RoundAudio:Step(now: number, phase: string, mode: string, hunt: any)
	if self.destroyed or not finite(now) then
		return
	end
	if phase ~= "active" and phase ~= "caught" then
		self:Destroy()
		return
	end
	if not self.startedAt then
		self.startedAt = now
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt)
	for _, entry in self.crickets do
		request(entry.sound, Rules.CricketIsOn(now, self.startedAt, entry.offset))
	end
	for _, sound in self.fires do
		request(sound, mode == "medium" or mode == "hard")
	end
	local chasing = phase == "active" and hunt and not hunt.destroyed and hunt.state == "chase"
	if not chasing then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	elseif not self.chasing then
		self.voiceAt = now + self.random:NextNumber(Rules.VoiceMin, Rules.VoiceMax)
		self.voiceUntil = now
	end
	self.chasing = chasing == true
	if phase == "caught" then
		local owner = self.actors[self.ownerPlayer]
		if owner then
			stop(owner.sound)
		end
	end
	if
		self.npc
		and (phase ~= "active" or not hunt or (hunt.state ~= "patrol" and hunt.state ~= "chase"))
	then
		stop(self.npc.sound)
	end
	if now < self.pollAt then
		return
	end
	self.pollAt = now + 0.1
	if self.chasing then
		self:_voice(now)
	end
	if self.npc then
		local floor = self.world.Ground.Position.Y + self.world.Ground.Size.Y / 2
		self:_stepActor(
			self.npc,
			now,
			phase == "active"
				and hunt
				and (hunt.state == "patrol" or hunt.state == "chase")
				and math.abs(self.npc.root.Position.Y - floor - 3) <= 3
		)
	end
	self:_players(now, phase)
end

function RoundAudio:Destroy()
	if self.destroyed then

	end
	self.destroyed = true
	for index = #self.created, 1, -1 do
		local item = self.created[index]
		if item:IsA("Sound") then
			stop(item)
		end
		destroyOwned(item)
	end
	self.created = {}
	self.actors = {}
	self.voices = {}
	self.fires = {}
	self.crickets = {}
	self.npc = nil
end

local function request(sound: Sound, playing: boolean)
	if not playing then
		stop(sound)

-- Preserve an inserted foreign child even when its owned parent is removed.

	if not owned(item) then

	while safeParent and owned(safeParent) do

function RoundAudio.new(world: any, ownerPlayer: Player, hunt: any, random: Random?)

	assert(world.Field and world.Field:IsA("BasePart"), "Round audio requires Field")

		world = world,

		created = {} :: { Instance },
		groups = {} :: { [string]: SoundGroup },
		crickets = {},
		fires = {} :: { Sound },
		actors = {} :: { [Player]: any },
		npc = nil :: any,
		voices = {} :: { Sound },
		voiceBag = {} :: { number },
		voiceLast = 0,
		voiceUntil = 0,
		voiceAt = 0,
		chasing = false,
		startedAt = nil :: number?,
		pollAt = -math.huge,
		destroyed = false,
		exclusions = Layout.ReadExclusions(world.Root, world.Field),
	}, RoundAudio)
	local id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "CornRoundAudio_" .. id
	self:_remember(folder, "runtime")
	folder.Parent = world.Runtime
	self.folder = folder
	local groupsFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	groupsFolder.Name = "CornRoundAudio_" .. id
	self:_remember(groupsFolder, "groups")
	groupsFolder.Parent = SoundService
	for _, category in { "Music", "Ambience", "Effects" } do
		local group = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
		group.Name = category
		self:_remember(group, "group_" .. category)
		group.Volume = math.clamp(Rules.Mix.Master * Rules.Mix[category], 0, 1)
		group.Parent = groupsFolder
		self.groups[category] = group
	end
	local half = world.Field.Size / 2
	for index, offset in
		{
			Vector2.new(-0.62, -0.62),
			Vector2.new(0.62, -0.62),
			Vector2.new(0, 0),
			Vector2.new(-0.62, 0.62),
			Vector2.new(0.62, 0.62),
		}
	do
		local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
		anchor.Name = "Crickets" .. index
		self:_remember(anchor, "crickets_emitter")
		anchor:AddTag("corn_audio_emitter")
		anchor.Size = Vector3.one
		anchor.Transparency = 1
		anchor.Anchored = true
		anchor.CanCollide = false
		anchor.CanTouch = false
		anchor.CanQuery = false
		anchor.CastShadow = false
		anchor.Position = world.Field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
			Vector3.new(offset.X * half.X, -half.Y + 1, offset.Y * half.Z)
		)
		anchor.Parent = folder
		local sound = self:_sound(
			anchor,
			"COC_Crickets_15s",
			"crickets",
			Rules.Volume.Crickets,
			"Ambience",
			Rules.Ranges.Crickets,
			true
		)
		table.insert(self.crickets, { sound = sound, offset = (index - 1) * Rules.Cycle / 5 })
	end
	local markers = world.Root:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
	if
		markers
		and markers:GetAttribute("CornTorchMarkersOwned") == true
		and markers:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
	then
		for _, torch in markers:GetChildren() do
			if
				torch:IsA("Model")
				and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true
				and torch:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
				and torch:HasTag("corn_torch")
			then
				local flame = torch:FindFirstChild("Flame")
				if flame and flame:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(
						self.fires,
						self:_sound(
							flame,
							"COC_Fire",
							"fire",
							Rules.Volume.Fire,
							"Ambience",
							Rules.Ranges.Fire,
							true
						)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt)
	return self
end

function RoundAudio:_setHunt(hunt: any)
	local root = if hunt and not hunt.destroyed then hunt.root else nil
	if root and not root.Parent then
		root = nil
	end
	if self.npc and self.npc.root == root then
		return
	end
	if self.npc then
		self:_remove(self.npc.sound)
	end
	for _, sound in self.voices do
		self:_remove(sound)
	end
	self.voices = {}
	self.npc = nil
	self.chasing = false
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and root.Parent then
		self.npc = self:_actor(root)
		for index, key in VOICE_KEYS do
			self.voices[index] = self:_sound(
				root,
				key,
				"monster_voice_" .. index,
				Rules.Volume.Monster,
				"Effects",
				Rules.Ranges.Monster,
				false
			)
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_actor(root: BasePart): any
	return {
		root = root,
		sound = self:_sound(
			root,
			CORN_KEYS[1],
			"corn_rustle",
			Rules.Volume.Rustle,
			"Effects",
			Rules.Ranges.Rustle,
			false
		),
		lastPosition = nil,
		lastAt = nil,
		lastClip = 0,
		untilAt = 0,
		nextAt = 0,
	}
end

function RoundAudio:_inCorn(point: Vector3): boolean
	local field = self.world.Field
	local at = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = field.Size / 2
	return math.abs(at.X) <= half.X
		and math.abs(at.Z) <= half.Z
		and not Layout.IsExcluded(point, self.exclusions)
end

function RoundAudio:_stepActor(actor: any, now: number, eligible: boolean)
	local root = actor.root
	local point = root.Position
	local before = actor.lastPosition
	local beforeAt = actor.lastAt
	actor.lastPosition = point
	actor.lastAt = now
	local dt = if beforeAt then now - beforeAt else 0
	local delta = if before then point - before else Vector3.zero
	local distance = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
	-- Clear discontinuities instead of turning spawn/teleport into a loud footstep.
	local moving = dt > 0
		and dt <= 1
		and distance >= 0.05
		and distance <= 12
		and distance / dt <= 45
		and math.abs(delta.Y) < 4
	if not eligible or not moving or not self:_inCorn(point) then
		stop(actor.sound)
		actor.untilAt = 0
		actor.nextAt = now
		return
	end
	if now >= actor.untilAt then
		stop(actor.sound)
	end
	if now < actor.nextAt then
		return
	end
	local index = self.random:NextInteger(1, #CORN_KEYS - 1)
	if index >= actor.lastClip then
		index += 1
	end
	if index > #CORN_KEYS then
		index = 1
	end
	actor.lastClip = index
	local definition = Assets.Get(CORN_KEYS[index])
	actor.sound.SoundId = definition.Id
	actor.sound:SetAttribute("AudioAssetKey", CORN_KEYS[index])
	actor.sound.Volume = math.clamp(Rules.Volume.Rustle * definition.Gain, 0, 1)
	local duration = math.max(0.1, definition.Duration)
	actor.untilAt = now + duration
	actor.nextAt = actor.untilAt + self.random:NextNumber(0.08, 0.22)
	request(actor.sound, true)
end

function RoundAudio:_grounded(character: Model, humanoid: Humanoid, root: BasePart): boolean
	if humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
		return false
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local length = math.max(3, humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 2)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -length, 0), params)
	return hit ~= nil and hit.Instance == self.world.Ground
end

function RoundAudio:_players(now: number, phase: string)
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	table.sort(players, function(a, b)
		if a == b then
			return false
		elseif a == self.ownerPlayer then
			return true
		elseif b == self.ownerPlayer then
			return false
		end
		return a.UserId < b.UserId
	end)
	local alive: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
	for index, player in players do
		if index > Rules.ActorLimit then
			break
		end
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if
			not character
			or not humanoid
			or not root
			or not root:IsA("BasePart")
			or humanoid.Health <= 0
		then
			continue
		end
		alive[player] = true
		local actor = self.actors[player]
		if actor and actor.root ~= root then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			actor = nil
		end
		if not actor then
			actor = self:_actor(root)
			self.actors[player] = actor
		end
		self:_stepActor(
			actor,
			now,
			(phase == "active" or player ~= self.ownerPlayer)
				and self:_grounded(character, humanoid, root)
		)
	end
	for player, actor in self.actors do
		if not alive[player] then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			self.actors[player] = nil
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_voice(now: number)
	if now >= self.voiceUntil then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	end
	if now < self.voiceAt or #self.voices ~= 3 then
		return
	end
	if #self.voiceBag == 0 then
		self.voiceBag = { 1, 2, 3 }
		for index = #self.voiceBag, 2, -1 do
			local other = self.random:NextInteger(1, index)
			self.voiceBag[index], self.voiceBag[other] = self.voiceBag[other], self.voiceBag[index]
		end
		if self.voiceBag[1] == self.voiceLast then
			self.voiceBag[1], self.voiceBag[2] = self.voiceBag[2], self.voiceBag[1]
		end
	end
	local index = table.remove(self.voiceBag, 1)
	self.voiceLast = index
	local sound = self.voices[index]
	local definition = Assets.Get(VOICE_KEYS[index])
	self.voiceUntil = now + math.max(0.1, definition.Duration, sound.TimeLength)
	self.voiceAt = self.voiceUntil + self.random:NextNumber(Rules.VoiceMin, Rules.VoiceMax)
	request(sound, true)
end

function RoundAudio:Step(now: number, phase: string, mode: string, hunt: any)
	if self.destroyed or not finite(now) then
		return
	end
	if phase ~= "active" and phase ~= "caught" then
		self:Destroy()
		return
	end
	if not self.startedAt then
		self.startedAt = now
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt)
	for _, entry in self.crickets do
		request(entry.sound, Rules.CricketIsOn(now, self.startedAt, entry.offset))
	end
	for _, sound in self.fires do
		request(sound, mode == "medium" or mode == "hard")
	end
	local chasing = phase == "active" and hunt and not hunt.destroyed and hunt.state == "chase"
	if not chasing then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	elseif not self.chasing then
		self.voiceAt = now + Rules.FirstVoiceDelay
		self.voiceUntil = now
	end
	self.chasing = chasing == true
	if phase == "caught" then
		local owner = self.actors[self.ownerPlayer]
		if owner then
			stop(owner.sound)
		end
	end
	if
		self.npc
		and (phase ~= "active" or not hunt or (hunt.state ~= "patrol" and hunt.state ~= "chase"))
	then
		stop(self.npc.sound)
	end
	if now < self.pollAt then
		return
	end
	self.pollAt = now + 0.1
	if self.chasing then
		self:_voice(now)
	end
	if self.npc then
		local floor = self.world.Ground.Position.Y + self.world.Ground.Size.Y / 2
		self:_stepActor(
			self.npc,
			now,
			phase == "active"
				and hunt
				and (hunt.state == "patrol" or hunt.state == "chase")
				and math.abs(self.npc.root.Position.Y - floor - 3) <= 3
		)
	end
	self:_players(now, phase)
end

function RoundAudio:Destroy()
	if self.destroyed then
		return
	end
	self.destroyed = true
	for index = #self.created, 1, -1 do
		local item = self.created[index]
		if item:IsA("Sound") then
			stop(item)
		end
		destroyOwned(item)
	end
	self.created = {}
	self.actors = {}
	self.voices = {}
	self.fires = {}
	self.crickets = {}
	self.npc = nil

			Vector2.new(-0.62, -0.62),
			Vector2.new(0.62, -0.62),
			Vector2.new(0, 0),
			Vector2.new(-0.62, 0.62),
			Vector2.new(0.62, 0.62),
		}
	do
		local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
		anchor.Name = "Crickets" .. index
		self:_remember(anchor, "crickets_emitter")
		anchor:AddTag("corn_audio_emitter")
		anchor.Size = Vector3.one
		anchor.Transparency = 1
		anchor.Anchored = true
		anchor.CanCollide = false
		anchor.CanTouch = false
		anchor.CanQuery = false
		anchor.CastShadow = false
		anchor.Position = world.Field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
			Vector3.new(offset.X * half.X, -half.Y + 1, offset.Y * half.Z)
		)
		anchor.Parent = folder
		local sound = self:_sound(
			anchor,
			"COC_Crickets_15s",
			"crickets",
			Rules.Volume.Crickets,
			"Ambience",
			Rules.Ranges.Crickets,
			true
		)
		table.insert(self.crickets, { sound = sound, offset = (index - 1) * Rules.Cycle / 5 })
	end
	local markers = world.Root:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
	if
		markers
		and markers:GetAttribute("CornTorchMarkersOwned") == true
		and markers:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
	then
		for _, torch in markers:GetChildren() do
			if
				torch:IsA("Model")
				and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true
				and torch:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
				and torch:HasTag("corn_torch")
			then
				local flame = torch:FindFirstChild("Flame")
				if flame and flame:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(
						self.fires,
						self:_sound(
							flame,
							"COC_Fire",
							"fire",
							Rules.Volume.Fire,
							"Ambience",
							Rules.Ranges.Fire,
							true
						)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt)
	return self
end

function RoundAudio:_setHunt(hunt: any)
	local root = if hunt and not hunt.destroyed then hunt.root else nil
	if root and not root.Parent then
		root = nil
	end
	if self.npc and self.npc.root == root then
		return
	end
	if self.npc then
		self:_remove(self.npc.sound)
	end
	for _, sound in self.voices do
		self:_remove(sound)
	end
	self.voices = {}
	self.npc = nil
	self.chasing = false
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and root.Parent then
		self.npc = self:_actor(root)
		for index, key in VOICE_KEYS do
			self.voices[index] = self:_sound(
				root,
				key,
				"monster_voice_" .. index,
				Rules.Volume.Monster,
				"Effects",
				Rules.Ranges.Monster,
				false
			)
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_actor(root: BasePart): any
	return {
		root = root,
		sound = self:_sound(
			root,
			CORN_KEYS[1],
			"corn_rustle",
			Rules.Volume.Rustle,
			"Effects",
			Rules.Ranges.Rustle,
			false
		),
		lastPosition = nil,
		lastAt = nil,
		lastClip = 0,
		untilAt = 0,
		nextAt = 0,
	}
end

function RoundAudio:_inCorn(point: Vector3): boolean
	local field = self.world.Field
	local at = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = field.Size / 2
	return math.abs(at.X) <= half.X
		and math.abs(at.Z) <= half.Z
		and not Layout.IsExcluded(point, self.exclusions)
end

function RoundAudio:_stepActor(actor: any, now: number, eligible: boolean)
	local root = actor.root
	local point = root.Position
	local before = actor.lastPosition
	local beforeAt = actor.lastAt
	actor.lastPosition = point
	actor.lastAt = now
	local dt = if beforeAt then now - beforeAt else 0
	local delta = if before then point - before else Vector3.zero
	local distance = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
	-- Clear discontinuities instead of turning spawn/teleport into a loud footstep.
	local moving = dt > 0
		and dt <= 1
		and distance >= 0.05
		and distance <= 12
		and distance / dt <= 45
		and math.abs(delta.Y) < 4
	if not eligible or not moving or not self:_inCorn(point) then
		stop(actor.sound)
		actor.untilAt = 0
		actor.nextAt = now
		return
	end
	if now >= actor.untilAt then
		stop(actor.sound)
	end
	if now < actor.nextAt then
		return
	end
	local index = self.random:NextInteger(1, #CORN_KEYS - 1)
	if index >= actor.lastClip then
		index += 1
	end
	if index > #CORN_KEYS then
		index = 1
	end
	actor.lastClip = index
	local definition = Assets.Get(CORN_KEYS[index])
	-- The cadence can cut a long clip short. Stop before replacing its URI,
	-- so one actor never layers an old rustle under the next one.
	stop(actor.sound)
	actor.sound.SoundId = definition.Id
	actor.sound:SetAttribute("AudioAssetKey", CORN_KEYS[index])
	actor.sound.Volume = math.clamp(Rules.Volume.Rustle * definition.Gain, 0, 1)
	local duration = math.max(0.1, definition.Duration)
	actor.untilAt = now + duration
	actor.nextAt = now + math.min(Rules.RustleInterval, duration)
	request(actor.sound, true)
end

function RoundAudio:_grounded(character: Model, humanoid: Humanoid, root: BasePart): boolean
	if humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
		return false
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local legHeight = 0
	if humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
		local leg = character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
		if leg and leg:IsA("BasePart") then
			legHeight = leg.Size.Y
		end
	end
	local length = math.max(3, legHeight + humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 2)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -length, 0), params)
	return hit ~= nil and hit.Instance == self.world.Ground
end

function RoundAudio:_players(now: number, phase: string)
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	table.sort(players, function(a, b)
		if a == b then
			return false
		elseif a == self.ownerPlayer then
			return true
		elseif b == self.ownerPlayer then
			return false
		end
		return a.UserId < b.UserId
	end)
	local alive: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
	for index, player in players do
		if index > Rules.ActorLimit then
			break
		end
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if
			not character
			or not humanoid
			or not root
			or not root:IsA("BasePart")
			or humanoid.Health <= 0
		then
			continue
		end
		alive[player] = true
		local actor = self.actors[player]
		if actor and actor.root ~= root then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			actor = nil
		end
		if not actor then
			actor = self:_actor(root)
			self.actors[player] = actor
		end
		self:_stepActor(
			actor,
			now,
			(phase == "active" or player ~= self.ownerPlayer)
				and self:_grounded(character, humanoid, root)
		)
	end
	for player, actor in self.actors do
		if not alive[player] then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			self.actors[player] = nil
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_voice(now: number)
	if now >= self.voiceUntil then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	end
	if now < self.voiceAt or #self.voices ~= 3 then
		return
	end
	if #self.voiceBag == 0 then
		self.voiceBag = { 1, 2, 3 }
		for index = #self.voiceBag, 2, -1 do
			local other = self.random:NextInteger(1, index)
			self.voiceBag[index], self.voiceBag[other] = self.voiceBag[other], self.voiceBag[index]
		end
		if self.voiceBag[1] == self.voiceLast then
			self.voiceBag[1], self.voiceBag[2] = self.voiceBag[2], self.voiceBag[1]
		end
	end
	local index = table.remove(self.voiceBag, 1)
	self.voiceLast = index
	local sound = self.voices[index]
	local definition = Assets.Get(VOICE_KEYS[index])
	self.voiceUntil = now + math.max(0.1, definition.Duration, sound.TimeLength)
	self.voiceAt = self.voiceUntil + self.random:NextNumber(Rules.VoiceMin, Rules.VoiceMax)
	request(sound, true)
end

function RoundAudio:Step(now: number, phase: string, mode: string, hunt: any)
	if self.destroyed or not finite(now) then
		return
	end
	if phase ~= "active" and phase ~= "caught" then
		self:Destroy()
		return
	end
	if not self.startedAt then
		self.startedAt = now
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt)
	for _, entry in self.crickets do
		request(entry.sound, Rules.CricketIsOn(now, self.startedAt, entry.offset))
	end
	for _, sound in self.fires do
		request(sound, mode == "medium" or mode == "hard")
	end
	local chasing = phase == "active" and hunt and not hunt.destroyed and hunt.state == "chase"
	if not chasing then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	elseif not self.chasing then
		self.voiceAt = now + Rules.FirstVoiceDelay
		self.voiceUntil = now
	end
	self.chasing = chasing == true
	if phase == "caught" then
		local owner = self.actors[self.ownerPlayer]
		if owner then
			stop(owner.sound)
		end
	end
	if
		self.npc
		and (phase ~= "active" or not hunt or (hunt.state ~= "patrol" and hunt.state ~= "chase"))
	then
		stop(self.npc.sound)
	end
	if now < self.pollAt then
		return
	end
	self.pollAt = now + 0.1
	if self.chasing then
		self:_voice(now)
	end
	if self.npc then
		local floor = self.world.Ground.Position.Y + self.world.Ground.Size.Y / 2
		self:_stepActor(
			self.npc,
			now,
			phase == "active"
				and hunt
				and (hunt.state == "patrol" or hunt.state == "chase")
				and math.abs(self.npc.root.Position.Y - floor - 3) <= 3
		)
	end
	self:_players(now, phase)
end

function RoundAudio:Destroy()
	if self.destroyed then
		return
	end
	self.destroyed = true
	for index = #self.created, 1, -1 do
		local item = self.created[index]
		if item:IsA("Sound") then
			stop(item)
		end
		destroyOwned(item)
	end
	self.created = {}
	self.actors = {}
	self.voices = {}
	self.fires = {}
	self.crickets = {}
	self.npc = nil
end

RoundAudio.Stop = RoundAudio.Destroy

return RoundAudio

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game")
local Assets = require(Shared:WaitForChild("AudioAssets"))

local RoundAudio = {}
RoundAudio.__index = RoundAudio

local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local CORN_KEYS = Rules.CornKeys
local VOICE_KEYS = Rules.VoiceKeys

local function finite(value: number): boolean
	return value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

local function owned(item: Instance): boolean
	return item:GetAttribute("CornAudioOwned") == true
		and item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
end

local function annotate(item: Instance, role: string)
	item:SetAttribute("CornAudioOwned", true)
	item:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT)
	item:SetAttribute("audio_role", role)
end

local function stop(sound: Sound)
	if sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") ~= false then
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", false)
		sound:Stop()
	end
end

local function request(sound: Sound, playing: boolean)
	if not playing then
		stop(sound)
	elseif sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") ~= true then
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", true)
		-- An empty ID is configuration awaiting import, not loaded audio.
		if sound.SoundId ~= "" then
			sound:Play()
		end
	end
end

-- Preserve an inserted foreign child even when its owned parent is removed.
local function destroyOwned(item: Instance)
	if not owned(item) then
		return
	end
	local safeParent = item.Parent
	while safeParent and owned(safeParent) do
		safeParent = safeParent.Parent
	end
	local descendants = item:GetDescendants()
	for _, child in descendants do
		if not owned(child) and child.Parent and owned(child.Parent) then
			child.Parent = safeParent
		end
	end
	item:Destroy()
end

function RoundAudio:_remember(item: Instance, role: string)
	annotate(item, role)
	table.insert(self.created, item)
	return item
end

function RoundAudio:_remove(item: Instance)
	if item:IsA("Sound") then
		stop(item)
	end
	destroyOwned(item)
	local index = table.find(self.created, item)
	if index then
		table.remove(self.created, index)
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_sound(
	parent: Instance,
	key: string,
	role: string,
	volume: number,
	category: string,
	range: any,
	looped: boolean
): Sound
	local definition = Assets.Get(key)
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = "CornAudio_" .. role
	self:_remember(sound, role)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioAssetKey", key)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", false)
	sound.SoundId = definition.Id
	sound.Volume = math.clamp(volume * definition.Gain, 0, 1)
	sound.Looped = looped
	sound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
	sound.RollOffMinDistance = range.Min
	sound.RollOffMaxDistance = range.Max
	sound.SoundGroup = self.groups[category]
	sound.Parent = parent
	return sound
end

	local id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)

	local half = world.Field.Size / 2
	for index, offset in

			Vector2.new(0, 0),
			Vector2.new(-0.62, 0.62),
			Vector2.new(0.62, 0.62),

	do

		self:_remember(anchor, "crickets_emitter")
		anchor:AddTag("corn_audio_emitter")
		anchor.Size = Vector3.one
		anchor.Transparency = 1
		anchor.Anchored = true
		anchor.CanCollide = false
		anchor.CanTouch = false
		anchor.CanQuery = false
		anchor.CastShadow = false
		anchor.Position = world.Field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
			Vector3.new(offset.X * half.X, -half.Y + 1, offset.Y * half.Z)
		)
		anchor.Parent = folder
		local sound = self:_sound(
			anchor,
			"COC_Crickets_15s",
			"crickets",
			Rules.Volume.Crickets,
			"Ambience",

	end
	local markers = world.Root:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
	if
		markers
		and markers:GetAttribute("CornTorchMarkersOwned") == true
		and markers:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
	then
		for _, torch in markers:GetChildren() do

		end
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt)

		elseif a == self.ownerPlayer then
			return true
		elseif b == self.ownerPlayer then
			return false
		end
		return a.UserId < b.UserId
	end)
	local alive: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
	for index, player in players do
		if index > Rules.ActorLimit then
			break
		end
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if
			not character
			or not humanoid
			or not root
			or not root:IsA("BasePart")
			or humanoid.Health <= 0
		then
			continue
		end
		alive[player] = true
		local actor = self.actors[player]
		if actor and actor.root ~= root then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			actor = nil
		end
		if not actor then
			actor = self:_actor(root)
			self.actors[player] = actor
		end
		self:_stepActor(
			actor,
			now,
			(phase == "active" or player ~= self.ownerPlayer)
				and self:_grounded(character, humanoid, root)
		)
	end
	for player, actor in self.actors do
		if not alive[player] then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			self.actors[player] = nil
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_voice(now: number)
	if now < self.wakeUntil then
		return
	end
	if now >= self.voiceUntil then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	end
	if now < self.voiceAt or #self.voices ~= 3 then
		return
	end
	if #self.voiceBag == 0 then
		self.voiceBag = { 1, 2, 3 }
		for index = #self.voiceBag, 2, -1 do
			local other = self.random:NextInteger(1, index)
			self.voiceBag[index], self.voiceBag[other] = self.voiceBag[other], self.voiceBag[index]
		end
		if self.voiceBag[1] == self.voiceLast then
			self.voiceBag[1], self.voiceBag[2] = self.voiceBag[2], self.voiceBag[1]
		end
	end
	local index = table.remove(self.voiceBag, 1)
	self.voiceLast = index
	local sound = self.voices[index]
	local definition = Assets.Get(VOICE_KEYS[index])
	self.voiceUntil = now + math.max(0.1, definition.Duration, sound.TimeLength)
	self.voiceAt = self.voiceUntil + self.random:NextNumber(Rules.VoiceMin, Rules.VoiceMax)
	request(sound, true)
end

function RoundAudio:Step(now: number, phase: string, mode: string, hunt: any)
	if self.destroyed or not finite(now) then
		return
	end
	if phase ~= "active" and phase ~= "caught" then
		self:Destroy()
		return
	end
	if not self.startedAt then
		self.startedAt = now
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt)
	if phase == "caught" then
		stop(self.wakeSound)
		self.wakeUntil = 0
	elseif
		not self.wakePlayed
		and self.wakeObservedDormant
		and hunt
		and not hunt.destroyed
		and hunt.state ~= "dormant"
		and hunt.state ~= "stopped"
	then
		self.wakePlayed = true
		self.wakeUntil = now
			+ math.max(Assets.Get("COC_Monster_03").Duration, self.wakeSound.TimeLength)
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
		request(self.wakeSound, true)
	elseif self.wakePlayed and now >= self.wakeUntil then
		stop(self.wakeSound)
	end
	for _, entry in self.crickets do
		request(entry.sound, Rules.CricketIsOn(now, self.startedAt, entry.offset))
	end
	for _, sound in self.fires do
		request(sound, mode == "medium" or mode == "hard")
	end
	local chasing = phase == "active" and hunt and not hunt.destroyed and hunt.state == "chase"
	if not chasing then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	elseif not self.chasing then
		self.voiceAt = now + Rules.FirstVoiceDelay
		self.voiceUntil = now
	end
	self.chasing = chasing == true
	if phase == "caught" then
		local owner = self.actors[self.ownerPlayer]
		if owner then
			stop(owner.sound)
		end
	end
	if
		self.npc
		and (phase ~= "active" or not hunt or (hunt.state ~= "patrol" and hunt.state ~= "chase"))
	then
		stop(self.npc.sound)
	end
	if now < self.pollAt then
		return
	end
	self.pollAt = now + 0.1
	if self.chasing then
		self:_voice(now)
	end
	if self.npc then
		local floor = self.world.Ground.Position.Y + self.world.Ground.Size.Y / 2
		self:_stepActor(
			self.npc,
			now,
			phase == "active"
				and hunt
				and (hunt.state == "patrol" or hunt.state == "chase")
				and math.abs(self.npc.root.Position.Y - floor - 3) <= 3
		)
	end
	self:_players(now, phase)
end

function RoundAudio:Destroy()
	if self.destroyed then
		return
	end
	self.destroyed = true
	for index = #self.created, 1, -1 do
		local item = self.created[index]
		if item:IsA("Sound") then
			stop(item)
		end
		destroyOwned(item)
	end
	self.created = {}
	self.actors = {}
	self.voices = {}
	self.fires = {}
	self.crickets = {}
	self.npc = nil
end

RoundAudio.Stop = RoundAudio.Destroy

return RoundAudio
