		}
	do
		local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
		anchor.Name = "Crickets" .. index
		self:_remember(anchor, "crickets_emitter")
		anchor:AddTag("corn_audio_emitter")
		anchor.Size = Vector3.one
		anchor.Transparency = 1
		anchor.Anchored = true
		anchor.CanCollide = false
		anchor.CanTouch = false
		anchor.CanQuery = false
		anchor.CastShadow = false
		anchor.Position = world.Field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
			Vector3.new(offset.X * half.X, -half.Y + 1, offset.Y * half.Z)
		)
		anchor.Parent = folder
		local sound = self:_sound(
			anchor,
			"COC_Crickets_15s",
			"crickets",
			Rules.Volume.Crickets,
			"Ambience",
			Rules.Ranges.Crickets,
			true
		)
		table.insert(self.crickets, { sound = sound, offset = (index - 1) * Rules.Cycle / 5 })
	end
	local markers = world.Root:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
	if
		markers
		and markers:GetAttribute("CornTorchMarkersOwned") == true
		and markers:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
	then
		for _, torch in markers:GetChildren() do
			if
				torch:IsA("Model")
				and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true
				and torch:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
				and torch:HasTag("corn_torch")
			then
				local flame = torch:FindFirstChild("Flame")
				if flame and flame:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(
						self.fires,
						self:_sound(
							flame,
							"COC_Fire",
							"fire",
							Rules.Volume.Fire,
							"Ambience",
							Rules.Ranges.Fire,
							true
						)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt)
	return self
end

function RoundAudio:_setHunt(hunt: any)
	if not self.wakePlayed and hunt and hunt.state == "dormant" then
		self.wakeObservedDormant = true
	end
	local root = if hunt and not hunt.destroyed then hunt.root else nil
	if root and not root.Parent then
		root = nil
	end
	if self.npc and self.npc.root == root then
		return
	end
	if self.npc then
		self:_remove(self.npc.sound)
	end
	for _, sound in self.voices do
		self:_remove(sound)
	end
	self.voices = {}
	self.npc = nil
	self.chasing = false
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and root.Parent then
		self.npc = self:_actor(root)
		for index, key in VOICE_KEYS do
			self.voices[index] = self:_sound(
				root,
				key,
				"monster_voice_" .. index,
				Rules.Volume.Monster,
				"Effects",
				Rules.Ranges.Monster,
				false
			)
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_actor(root: BasePart): any
	local sound = self:_sound(
		root,
		CORN_KEYS[1],
		"corn_rustle",
		Rules.Volume.Rustle,
		"Effects",
		Rules.Ranges.Rustle,
		false
	)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRustleId", 0)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRustleStart", "")
	return {
		root = root,
		sound = sound,
		rustleId = 0,
		lastPosition = nil,
		lastAt = nil,
		lastClip = 0,
		untilAt = 0,
		nextAt = 0,
		loadDeadline = 0,
	}
end

function RoundAudio:_inCorn(point: Vector3): boolean
	local field = self.world.Field
	local at = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = field.Size / 2
	return math.abs(at.X) <= half.X
		and math.abs(at.Z) <= half.Z
		and not Layout.IsExcluded(point, self.exclusions)
end

function RoundAudio:_stepActor(actor: any, now: number, eligible: boolean)
	local root = actor.root
	local point = root.Position
	local before = actor.lastPosition
	local beforeAt = actor.lastAt
	actor.lastPosition = point
	actor.lastAt = now
	local dt = if beforeAt then now - beforeAt else 0
	local delta = if before then point - before else Vector3.zero
	local distance = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
	-- Clear discontinuities instead of turning spawn/teleport into a loud footstep.
	local moving = dt > 0
		and dt <= 1
		and distance >= 0.05
		and distance <= 12
		and distance / dt <= 45
		and math.abs(delta.Y) < 4
	local sound = actor.sound
	if sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") == true then
		-- Motion only controls new starts. A short step, a jump or a trap must
		-- not cut the current clip, including a late-loading or longer decode.
		if sound.SoundId ~= "" and not sound.IsLoaded then
			if now < actor.loadDeadline or sound.TimePosition > 0 then
				return
			end
			-- Cancel only an unavailable, unplayed request. A failed ID must
			-- not silence the remaining clips for the rest of the round.
			stop(sound)
		elseif now < actor.untilAt or sound.IsPlaying then
			return
		else
			-- Natural completion needs no Stop (which resets playback position).
			sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", false)
		end
	end
	if not eligible or not moving or not self:_inCorn(point) then
		return
	end
	if now < actor.nextAt then
		return
	end
	local index = self.random:NextInteger(1, #CORN_KEYS - 1)
	if index >= actor.lastClip then
		index += 1
	end
	if index > #CORN_KEYS then
		index = 1
	end
	actor.lastClip = index
	local definition = Assets.Get(CORN_KEYS[index])
	sound.SoundId = definition.Id
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioAssetKey", CORN_KEYS[index])
	sound.Volume = math.clamp(Rules.Volume.Rustle * definition.Gain, 0, 1)
	local duration = math.max(0.1, definition.Duration)
	actor.untilAt = now + duration
	actor.nextAt = now + math.max(Rules.RustleInterval, duration)
	actor.loadDeadline = now + Rules.RustleLoadTimeout
	request(sound, true)
	actor.rustleId += 1
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRustleId", actor.rustleId)
	-- One replicated value commits the sequence and key together. A client
	-- decoder can finish later than this server Sound; it schedules its own
	-- full tails from accepted commits without trusting URI replication order.
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRustleStart", tostring(actor.rustleId) .. ":" .. CORN_KEYS[index])
end

function RoundAudio:_grounded(character: Model, humanoid: Humanoid, root: BasePart): boolean
	if humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
		return false
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local legHeight = 0
	if humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
		local leg = character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
		if leg and leg:IsA("BasePart") then
			legHeight = leg.Size.Y
		end
	end
	local length = math.max(3, legHeight + humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 2)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -length, 0), params)
	return hit ~= nil and hit.Instance == self.world.Ground
end

function RoundAudio:_players(now: number, phase: string)
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	table.sort(players, function(a, b)
		if a == b then
			return false
		elseif a == self.ownerPlayer then
			return true
		elseif b == self.ownerPlayer then
			return false
		end
		return a.UserId < b.UserId
	end)
	local alive: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
	for index, player in players do
		if index > Rules.ActorLimit then
			break
		end
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if
			not character
			or not humanoid
			or not root
			or not root:IsA("BasePart")
			or humanoid.Health <= 0
		then
			continue
		end
		alive[player] = true
		local actor = self.actors[player]
		if actor and actor.root ~= root then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			actor = nil
		end
		if not actor then
			actor = self:_actor(root)
			self.actors[player] = actor
		end
		self:_stepActor(
			actor,
			now,
			(phase == "active" or player ~= self.ownerPlayer)
				and self:_grounded(character, humanoid, root)
		)
	end
	for player, actor in self.actors do
		if not alive[player] then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			self.actors[player] = nil
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_voice(now: number)
	if now < self.wakeUntil then
		return
	end
	if now >= self.voiceUntil then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	end
	if now < self.voiceAt or #self.voices ~= 3 then
		return
	end
	if #self.voiceBag == 0 then
		self.voiceBag = { 1, 2, 3 }
		for index = #self.voiceBag, 2, -1 do
			local other = self.random:NextInteger(1, index)
			self.voiceBag[index], self.voiceBag[other] = self.voiceBag[other], self.voiceBag[index]
		end
		if self.voiceBag[1] == self.voiceLast then
			self.voiceBag[1], self.voiceBag[2] = self.voiceBag[2], self.voiceBag[1]
		end
	end
	local index = table.remove(self.voiceBag, 1)
	self.voiceLast = index
	local sound = self.voices[index]
	local definition = Assets.Get(VOICE_KEYS[index])
	self.voiceUntil = now + math.max(0.1, definition.Duration, sound.TimeLength)
	self.voiceAt = self.voiceUntil + self.random:NextNumber(Rules.VoiceMin, Rules.VoiceMax)
	request(sound, true)
end

function RoundAudio:Step(now: number, phase: string, mode: string, hunt: any)
	if self.destroyed or not finite(now) then
		return
	end
	if phase ~= "active" and phase ~= "caught" then
		self:Destroy()
		return
	end
	if not self.startedAt then
		self.startedAt = now
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt)
	if phase == "caught" then
		stop(self.wakeSound)
		self.wakeUntil = 0
	elseif
		not self.wakePlayed
		and self.wakeObservedDormant
		and hunt
		and not hunt.destroyed
		and hunt.state ~= "dormant"
		and hunt.state ~= "stopped"
	then
		self.wakePlayed = true
		self.wakeUntil = now
			+ math.max(Assets.Get("COC_Monster_03").Duration, self.wakeSound.TimeLength)
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
		request(self.wakeSound, true)
	elseif self.wakePlayed and now >= self.wakeUntil then
		stop(self.wakeSound)
	end
	for _, entry in self.crickets do
		request(entry.sound, Rules.CricketIsOn(now, self.startedAt, entry.offset))
	end
	for _, sound in self.fires do
		request(sound, mode == "medium" or mode == "hard")
	end
	local chasing = phase == "active" and hunt and not hunt.destroyed and hunt.state == "chase"
	if not chasing then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	elseif not self.chasing then
		self.voiceAt = now + Rules.FirstVoiceDelay
		self.voiceUntil = now
	end
	self.chasing = chasing == true
	if now < self.pollAt then
		return
	end
	self.pollAt = now + 0.1
	if self.chasing then
		self:_voice(now)
	end
	if self.npc then
		local floor = self.world.Ground.Position.Y + self.world.Ground.Size.Y / 2
		self:_stepActor(
			self.npc,
			now,
			phase == "active"
				and hunt
				and (hunt.state == "patrol" or hunt.state == "chase")
				and math.abs(self.npc.root.Position.Y - floor - 3) <= 3
		)
	end
	self:_players(now, phase)
end

function RoundAudio:Destroy()
	if self.destroyed then
		return
	end
	self.destroyed = true
	for index = #self.created, 1, -1 do
		local item = self.created[index]
		if item:IsA("Sound") then
			stop(item)
		end
		destroyOwned(item)
	end
	self.created = {}
	self.actors = {}
	self.voices = {}
	self.fires = {}
	self.crickets = {}
	self.npc = nil
end

RoundAudio.Stop = RoundAudio.Destroy

return RoundAudio
--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game")
local Assets = require(Shared:WaitForChild("AudioAssets"))
local Rules = require(Shared:WaitForChild("AudioRules"))
local Layout = require(Shared:WaitForChild("CornLayout"))

local RoundAudio = {}
RoundAudio.__index = RoundAudio

local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local CORN_KEYS = Rules.CornKeys
local VOICE_KEYS = Rules.VoiceKeys

local function finite(value: number): boolean
	return value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

local function owned(item: Instance): boolean
	return item:GetAttribute("CornAudioOwned") == true
		and item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
end

local function annotate(item: Instance, role: string)
	item:SetAttribute("CornAudioOwned", true)
	item:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT)
	item:SetAttribute("audio_role", role)
end

local function stop(sound: Sound)
	if sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") ~= false then
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", false)
		sound:Stop()
	end
end

local function request(sound: Sound, playing: boolean)
	if not playing then
		stop(sound)
	elseif sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") ~= true then
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", true)
		-- An empty ID is configuration awaiting import, not loaded audio.
		if sound.SoundId ~= "" then
			sound:Play()
		end
	end
end

-- Preserve an inserted foreign child even when its owned parent is removed.
local function destroyOwned(item: Instance)
	if not owned(item) then
		return
	end
	local safeParent = item.Parent
	while safeParent and owned(safeParent) do
		safeParent = safeParent.Parent
	end
	local descendants = item:GetDescendants()
	for _, child in descendants do
		if not owned(child) and child.Parent and owned(child.Parent) then
			child.Parent = safeParent
		end
	end
	item:Destroy()
end

function RoundAudio:_remember(item: Instance, role: string)
	annotate(item, role)
	table.insert(self.created, item)
	return item
end

function RoundAudio:_remove(item: Instance)
	if item:IsA("Sound") then
		stop(item)
	end
	destroyOwned(item)
	local index = table.find(self.created, item)
	if index then
		table.remove(self.created, index)
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_sound(
	parent: Instance,
	key: string,
	role: string,
	volume: number,
	category: string,
	range: any,
	looped: boolean
): Sound
	local definition = Assets.Get(key)
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = "CornAudio_" .. role
	self:_remember(sound, role)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioAssetKey", key)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", false)
	sound.SoundId = definition.Id
	sound.Volume = math.clamp(volume * definition.Gain, 0, 1)
	sound.Looped = looped
	sound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
	sound.RollOffMinDistance = range.Min
	sound.RollOffMaxDistance = range.Max
	sound.SoundGroup = self.groups[category]
	sound.Parent = parent
	return sound
end

function RoundAudio:_stepCricket(entry: any, now: number)
	local sound = entry.sound
	local elapsed = now - self.startedAt - entry.offset
	local inSlot = Rules.CricketIsOn(now, self.startedAt, entry.offset)
	if sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") ~= inSlot then
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", inSlot)
	end
	if elapsed < 0 then
		sound.Volume = 0
		return
	end
	local cycle = math.floor(elapsed / Rules.Cycle)
	local slotAt = self.startedAt + entry.offset + cycle * Rules.Cycle
	if cycle ~= entry.cycle then
		-- A stalled/unavailable request stayed silent. Cancel only that
		-- never-decoded attempt before considering a later scheduled slot.
		if entry.requestedAt and not entry.playBeganAt and not entry.abandoned then
			if not sound.IsLoaded and sound.TimePosition == 0 then
				sound:Stop()
			end
		end
		entry.cycle = cycle
		entry.requestedAt, entry.playBeganAt = nil, nil
		entry.abandoned = false
		-- One attempt per slot; no replay of missed slots after a stall.
		if
			inSlot
			and now - slotAt <= Rules.CricketStartWindow
			and sound.SoundId ~= ""
			and not sound.IsPlaying
		then
			sound.Volume = 0
			sound.TimePosition = 0
			entry.requestedAt = now
			entry.startDeadline = slotAt + Rules.CricketStartWindow
			sound:Play()
		end
	end
	if entry.requestedAt and not entry.playBeganAt and not entry.abandoned then
		local progressed = finite(sound.TimePosition) and sound.TimePosition > 0
		if now <= entry.startDeadline and ((sound.IsLoaded and sound.IsPlaying) or progressed) then
			-- Fade from the first observed decode/playback, never jump to the
			-- historical gain of a partially elapsed slot after cold loading.
			entry.playBeganAt = now
		elseif now >= entry.startDeadline then
			entry.abandoned = true
			if not sound.IsLoaded and not progressed then
				sound:Stop()
			end
		end
	end
	local alpha = 0
	if inSlot and entry.playBeganAt and not entry.abandoned and sound.IsPlaying then
		local played = math.max(0, now - entry.playBeganAt)
		local length = entry.duration
		if finite(sound.TimeLength) and sound.TimeLength > 0 then
			length = math.min(length, sound.TimeLength)
		end
		local progress = if finite(sound.TimePosition)
			then math.max(played, sound.TimePosition)
			else played
		alpha = Rules.CricketEnvelope(played, slotAt + Rules.CricketOn - now, length - progress)
	end
	-- Normal off is silence followed by natural Ended, never a timer Stop.
	sound.Volume = entry.gain * alpha
end

function RoundAudio.new(world: any, ownerPlayer: Player, hunt: any, random: Random?)
	assert(world.Root and world.Root:IsA("Model"), "Round audio requires a bound map")
	assert(world.Field and world.Field:IsA("BasePart"), "Round audio requires Field")
	assert(world.Runtime and world.Ground, "Round audio requires runtime and Ground")
	local self = setmetatable({
		world = world,
		ownerPlayer = ownerPlayer,
		random = random or Random.new(),
		created = {} :: { Instance },
		groups = {} :: { [string]: SoundGroup },
		crickets = {},
		fires = {} :: { Sound },
		actors = {} :: { [Player]: any },
		npc = nil :: any,
		npcActors = {} :: { [BasePart]: any },
		primaryHunt = nil :: any,
		leadHunt = nil :: any,
		voiceRoot = nil :: BasePart?,
		voices = {} :: { Sound },
		voiceBag = {} :: { number },
		voiceLast = 0,
		voiceUntil = 0,
		voiceAt = 0,
		chasing = false,
		wakeObservedDormant = hunt and hunt.state == "dormant",
		wakePlayed = false,
		wakePrimaryRoot = nil :: BasePart?,
		wakeUntil = 0,
		startedAt = nil :: number?,
		pollAt = -math.huge,
		destroyed = false,
		exclusions = Layout.ReadExclusions(world.Root, world.Field),
	}, RoundAudio)
	local id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "CornRoundAudio_" .. id
	self:_remember(folder, "runtime")
	folder.Parent = world.Runtime
	self.folder = folder
	local wakeAnchor = Instance.new("Part")
	wakeAnchor.Name = "AwakeningEmitter"
	self:_remember(wakeAnchor, "awakening_emitter")
	wakeAnchor:AddTag("corn_audio_emitter")
	wakeAnchor.Size = Vector3.one
	wakeAnchor.Transparency = 1
	wakeAnchor.Anchored = true
	wakeAnchor.CanCollide = false
	wakeAnchor.CanTouch = false
	wakeAnchor.CanQuery = false
	wakeAnchor.CastShadow = false
	wakeAnchor.Position = if hunt and hunt.home then hunt.home else world.Field.Position
	wakeAnchor.Parent = folder
	local groupsFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	groupsFolder.Name = "CornRoundAudio_" .. id
	self:_remember(groupsFolder, "groups")
	groupsFolder.Parent = SoundService
	for _, category in { "Music", "Ambience", "Effects" } do
		local group = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
		group.Name = category
		self:_remember(group, "group_" .. category)
		group.Volume = math.clamp(Rules.Mix.Master * Rules.Mix[category], 0, 1)
		group.Parent = groupsFolder
		self.groups[category] = group
	end
	self.wakeSound = self:_sound(
		wakeAnchor,
		"COC_Monster_03",
		"awakening",
		Rules.Volume.Awakening,
		"Effects",
		Rules.Ranges.Awakening,
		false
	)
	self.wakeSound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
	local half = world.Field.Size / 2
	for index, offset in
		{
			Vector2.new(-0.62, -0.62),
			Vector2.new(0.62, -0.62),
			Vector2.new(0, 0),
			Vector2.new(-0.62, 0.62),
			Vector2.new(0.62, 0.62),
		}
	do
		local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
		anchor.Name = "Crickets" .. index
		self:_remember(anchor, "crickets_emitter")
		anchor:AddTag("corn_audio_emitter")
		anchor.Size = Vector3.one
		anchor.Transparency = 1
		anchor.Anchored = true
		anchor.CanCollide = false
		anchor.CanTouch = false
		anchor.CanQuery = false
		anchor.CastShadow = false
		anchor.Position = world.Field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
			Vector3.new(offset.X * half.X, -half.Y + 1, offset.Y * half.Z)
		)
		anchor.Parent = folder
		local sound = self:_sound(
			anchor,
			"COC_Crickets_15s",
			"crickets",
			Rules.Volume.Crickets,
			"Ambience",
			Rules.Ranges.Crickets,
			false
		)
		local gain = sound.Volume
		sound.Volume = 0
		table.insert(self.crickets, {
			sound = sound,
			offset = (index - 1) * Rules.Cycle / 5,
			gain = gain,
			duration = math.max(0.1, Assets.Get("COC_Crickets_15s").Duration),
			cycle = -1,
			requestedAt = nil,
			playBeganAt = nil,
			abandoned = false,
		})
	end
	local markers = world.Root:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
	if
		markers
		and markers:GetAttribute("CornTorchMarkersOwned") == true
		and markers:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
	then
		for _, torch in markers:GetChildren() do
			if
				torch:IsA("Model")
				and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true
				and torch:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
				and torch:HasTag("corn_torch")
			then
				local flame = torch:FindFirstChild("Flame")
				if flame and flame:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(
						self.fires,
						self:_sound(
							flame,
							"COC_Fire",
							"fire",
							Rules.Volume.Fire,
							"Ambience",
							Rules.Ranges.Fire,
							true
						)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt)
	return self
end

function RoundAudio:_setHunt(hunt: any, hunts: { any }?)
	local desired = {} :: { [BasePart]: any }
	self.primaryHunt = nil
	-- Exactly three authoritative sources, without a Workspace/field scan.
	for index = 1, 3 do
		local source = if hunts then hunts[index] else (if index == 1 then hunt else nil)
		local root = if source and not source.destroyed then source.root else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and root.Parent and not desired[root] then
			desired[root] = source
			if index == 1 then
				self.primaryHunt = source
			end
		end
	end
	if not self.wakePlayed then
		local primary = self.primaryHunt
		local root = if primary then primary.root else nil
		if self.wakePrimaryRoot ~= root then
			self.wakePrimaryRoot = root
			self.wakeObservedDormant = primary ~= nil and primary.state == "dormant"
			if primary then
				self.wakeSound.Parent.Position = primary.home or self.world.Field.Position
			end
		elseif primary and primary.state == "dormant" then
			self.wakeObservedDormant = true
		end
	end
	-- Remove only vanished NPCs before adding replacements; the live corn pool
	-- stays bounded at three and lead handoffs never cut another NPC's tail.
	for root, actor in self.npcActors do
		if not desired[root] then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			self.npcActors[root] = nil
		end
	end
	for root, source in desired do
		local actor = self.npcActors[root]
		if not actor then
			actor = self:_actor(root)
			self.npcActors[root] = actor
		end
		actor.hunt = source
	end
	local leadRoot = if hunt and not hunt.destroyed then hunt.root else nil
	local selected = if leadRoot then self.npcActors[leadRoot] else nil
	if not selected and self.primaryHunt then
		selected = self.npcActors[self.primaryHunt.root]
	end
	self.npc = selected -- Legacy alias for the selected voice/threat source.
	self.leadHunt = if selected then selected.hunt else nil
	local root = if selected then selected.root else nil
	if self.voiceRoot == root then
		return
	end
	for _, sound in self.voices do
		self:_remove(sound)
	end
	self.voices = {}
	self.voiceRoot = root
	self.voiceBag = {}
	self.voiceLast, self.voiceUntil, self.voiceAt = 0, 0, 0
	self.chasing = false
	if root then
		for index, key in VOICE_KEYS do
			self.voices[index] = self:_sound(
				root,
				key,
				"monster_voice_" .. index,
				Rules.Volume.Monster,
				"Effects",
				Rules.Ranges.Monster,
				false
			)
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_actor(root: BasePart): any
	local sound = self:_sound(
		root,
		CORN_KEYS[1],
		"corn_rustle",
		Rules.Volume.Rustle,
		"Effects",
		Rules.Ranges.Rustle,
		false
	)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRustleId", 0)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRustleStart", "")
	return {
		root = root,
		sound = sound,
		rustleId = 0,
		lastPosition = nil,
		lastAt = nil,
		lastClip = 0,
		untilAt = 0,
		nextAt = 0,
		loadDeadline = 0,
	}
end

function RoundAudio:_inCorn(point: Vector3): boolean
	local field = self.world.Field
	local at = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = field.Size / 2
	return math.abs(at.X) <= half.X
		and math.abs(at.Z) <= half.Z
		and not Layout.IsExcluded(point, self.exclusions)
end

function RoundAudio:_stepActor(actor: any, now: number, eligible: boolean)
	local root = actor.root
	local point = root.Position
	local before = actor.lastPosition
	local beforeAt = actor.lastAt
	actor.lastPosition = point
	actor.lastAt = now
	local dt = if beforeAt then now - beforeAt else 0
	local delta = if before then point - before else Vector3.zero
	local distance = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
	-- Clear discontinuities instead of turning spawn/teleport into a loud footstep.
	local moving = dt > 0
		and dt <= 1
		and distance >= 0.05
		and distance <= 12
		and distance / dt <= 45
		and math.abs(delta.Y) < 4
	local sound = actor.sound
	if sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") == true then
		-- Motion only controls new starts. A short step, a jump or a trap must
		-- not cut the current clip, including a late-loading or longer decode.
		if sound.SoundId ~= "" and not sound.IsLoaded then
			if now < actor.loadDeadline or sound.TimePosition > 0 then
				return
			end
			-- Cancel only an unavailable, unplayed request. A failed ID must
			-- not silence the remaining clips for the rest of the round.
			stop(sound)
		elseif now < actor.untilAt or sound.IsPlaying then
			return
		else
			-- Natural completion needs no Stop (which resets playback position).
			sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", false)
		end
	end
	if not eligible or not moving or not self:_inCorn(point) then
		return
	end
	if now < actor.nextAt then
		return
	end
	local index = self.random:NextInteger(1, #CORN_KEYS - 1)
	if index >= actor.lastClip then
		index += 1
	end
	if index > #CORN_KEYS then
		index = 1
	end
	actor.lastClip = index
	local definition = Assets.Get(CORN_KEYS[index])
	sound.SoundId = definition.Id
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioAssetKey", CORN_KEYS[index])
	sound.Volume = math.clamp(Rules.Volume.Rustle * definition.Gain, 0, 1)
	local duration = math.max(0.1, definition.Duration)
	actor.untilAt = now + duration
	actor.nextAt = now + math.max(Rules.RustleInterval, duration)
	actor.loadDeadline = now + Rules.RustleLoadTimeout
	request(sound, true)
	actor.rustleId += 1
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRustleId", actor.rustleId)
	-- One replicated value commits the sequence and key together. A client
	-- decoder can finish later than this server Sound; it schedules its own
	-- full tails from accepted commits without trusting URI replication order.
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRustleStart", tostring(actor.rustleId) .. ":" .. CORN_KEYS[index])
end

function RoundAudio:_grounded(character: Model, humanoid: Humanoid, root: BasePart): boolean
	if humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
		return false
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local legHeight = 0
	if humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
		local leg = character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
		if leg and leg:IsA("BasePart") then
			legHeight = leg.Size.Y
		end
	end
	local length = math.max(3, legHeight + humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 2)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -length, 0), params)
	return hit ~= nil and hit.Instance == self.world.Ground
end

function RoundAudio:_players(now: number, phase: string)
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	table.sort(players, function(a, b)
		if a == b then
			return false
		elseif a == self.ownerPlayer then
			return true
		elseif b == self.ownerPlayer then
			return false
		end
		return a.UserId < b.UserId
	end)
	local alive: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
	for index, player in players do
		if index > Rules.ActorLimit then
			break
		end
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if
			not character
			or not humanoid
			or not root
			or not root:IsA("BasePart")
			or humanoid.Health <= 0
		then
			continue
		end
		alive[player] = true
		local actor = self.actors[player]
		if actor and actor.root ~= root then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			actor = nil
		end
		if not actor then
			actor = self:_actor(root)
			self.actors[player] = actor
		end
		self:_stepActor(
			actor,
			now,
			(phase == "active" or player ~= self.ownerPlayer)
				and self:_grounded(character, humanoid, root)
		)
	end
	for player, actor in self.actors do
		if not alive[player] then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			self.actors[player] = nil
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_voice(now: number)
	if now < self.wakeUntil then
		return
	end
	if now >= self.voiceUntil then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	end
	if now < self.voiceAt or #self.voices ~= 3 then
		return
	end
	if #self.voiceBag == 0 then
		self.voiceBag = { 1, 2, 3 }
		for index = #self.voiceBag, 2, -1 do
			local other = self.random:NextInteger(1, index)
			self.voiceBag[index], self.voiceBag[other] = self.voiceBag[other], self.voiceBag[index]
		end
		if self.voiceBag[1] == self.voiceLast then
			self.voiceBag[1], self.voiceBag[2] = self.voiceBag[2], self.voiceBag[1]
		end
	end
	local index = table.remove(self.voiceBag, 1)
	self.voiceLast = index
	local sound = self.voices[index]
	local definition = Assets.Get(VOICE_KEYS[index])
	self.voiceUntil = now + math.max(0.1, definition.Duration, sound.TimeLength)
	self.voiceAt = self.voiceUntil + self.random:NextNumber(Rules.VoiceMin, Rules.VoiceMax)
	request(sound, true)
end

function RoundAudio:Step(now: number, phase: string, mode: string, hunt: any, hunts: { any }?)
	if self.destroyed or not finite(now) then
		return
	end
	if phase ~= "active" and phase ~= "caught" then
		self:Destroy()
		return
	end
	if not self.startedAt then
		self.startedAt = now
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt, hunts)
	local primary = self.primaryHunt
	if phase == "caught" then
		stop(self.wakeSound)
		self.wakeUntil = 0
	elseif
		not self.wakePlayed
		and self.wakeObservedDormant
		and primary
		and not primary.destroyed
		and primary.state ~= "dormant"
		and primary.state ~= "stopped"
	then
		self.wakePlayed = true
		self.wakeUntil = now
			+ math.max(Assets.Get("COC_Monster_03").Duration, self.wakeSound.TimeLength)
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
		request(self.wakeSound, true)
	elseif self.wakePlayed and now >= self.wakeUntil then
		stop(self.wakeSound)
	end
	for _, entry in self.crickets do
		self:_stepCricket(entry, now)
	end
	for _, sound in self.fires do
		request(sound, mode == "medium" or mode == "hard")
	end
	local lead = self.leadHunt
	local chasing = phase == "active" and lead and not lead.destroyed and lead.state == "chase"
	if not chasing then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	elseif not self.chasing then
		self.voiceAt = now + Rules.FirstVoiceDelay
		self.voiceUntil = now
	end
	self.chasing = chasing == true
	if now < self.pollAt then
		return
	end
	self.pollAt = now + 0.1
	if self.chasing then
		self:_voice(now)
	end
	for _, actor in self.npcActors do
		local source = actor.hunt
		local floor = self.world.Ground.Position.Y + self.world.Ground.Size.Y / 2
		self:_stepActor(
			actor,
			now,
			phase == "active"
				and source
				and (source.state == "patrol" or source.state == "chase")
				and math.abs(actor.root.Position.Y - floor - 3) <= 3
		)
	end
	self:_players(now, phase)
end

function RoundAudio:Destroy()
	if self.destroyed then
		return
	end
	self.destroyed = true
	for index = #self.created, 1, -1 do
		local item = self.created[index]
		if item:IsA("Sound") then
			stop(item)
		end
		destroyOwned(item)
	end
	self.created = {}
	self.actors = {}
	self.voices = {}
	self.fires = {}
	self.crickets = {}
	self.npc = nil
	self.npcActors = {}
	self.primaryHunt, self.leadHunt, self.voiceRoot = nil, nil, nil
	self.wakePrimaryRoot = nil
end

RoundAudio.Stop = RoundAudio.Destroy

return RoundAudio
--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game")
local Assets = require(Shared:WaitForChild("AudioAssets"))
local Rules = require(Shared:WaitForChild("AudioRules"))
local Layout = require(Shared:WaitForChild("CornLayout"))

local RoundAudio = {}
RoundAudio.__index = RoundAudio

local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local CORN_KEYS = Rules.CornKeys
local VOICE_KEYS = Rules.VoiceKeys

local function finite(value: number): boolean
	return value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

local function owned(item: Instance): boolean
	return item:GetAttribute("CornAudioOwned") == true
		and item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
end

local function annotate(item: Instance, role: string)
	item:SetAttribute("CornAudioOwned", true)
	item:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT)
	item:SetAttribute("audio_role", role)
end

local function stop(sound: Sound)
	if sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") ~= false then
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", false)
		sound:Stop()
	end
end

local function request(sound: Sound, playing: boolean)
	if not playing then
		stop(sound)
	elseif sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") ~= true then
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", true)
		-- An empty ID is configuration awaiting import, not loaded audio.
		if sound.SoundId ~= "" then
			sound:Play()
		end
	end
end

-- Preserve an inserted foreign child even when its owned parent is removed.
local function destroyOwned(item: Instance)
	if not owned(item) then
		return
	end
	local safeParent = item.Parent
	while safeParent and owned(safeParent) do
		safeParent = safeParent.Parent
	end
	local descendants = item:GetDescendants()
	for _, child in descendants do
		if not owned(child) and child.Parent and owned(child.Parent) then
			child.Parent = safeParent
		end
	end
	item:Destroy()
end

function RoundAudio:_remember(item: Instance, role: string)
	annotate(item, role)
	table.insert(self.created, item)
	return item
end

function RoundAudio:_remove(item: Instance)
	if item:IsA("Sound") then
		stop(item)
	end
	destroyOwned(item)
	local index = table.find(self.created, item)
	if index then
		table.remove(self.created, index)
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_sound(
	parent: Instance,
	key: string,
	role: string,
	volume: number,
	category: string,
	range: any,
	looped: boolean
): Sound
	local definition = Assets.Get(key)
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = "CornAudio_" .. role
	self:_remember(sound, role)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioAssetKey", key)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", false)
	sound.SoundId = definition.Id
	sound.Volume = math.clamp(volume * definition.Gain, 0, 1)
	sound.Looped = looped
	sound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
	sound.RollOffMinDistance = range.Min
	sound.RollOffMaxDistance = range.Max
	sound.SoundGroup = self.groups[category]
	sound.Parent = parent
	return sound
end

function RoundAudio:_stepCricket(entry: any, now: number)
	local sound = entry.sound
	local elapsed = now - self.startedAt - entry.offset
	local inSlot = Rules.CricketIsOn(now, self.startedAt, entry.offset)
	if sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") ~= inSlot then
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", inSlot)
	end
	if elapsed < 0 then
		sound.Volume = 0
		return
	end
	local cycle = math.floor(elapsed / Rules.Cycle)
	local slotAt = self.startedAt + entry.offset + cycle * Rules.Cycle
	if cycle ~= entry.cycle then
		-- A stalled/unavailable request stayed silent. Cancel only that
		-- never-decoded attempt before considering a later scheduled slot.
		if entry.requestedAt and not entry.playBeganAt and not entry.abandoned then
			if not sound.IsLoaded and sound.TimePosition == 0 then
				sound:Stop()
			end
		end
		entry.cycle = cycle
		entry.requestedAt, entry.playBeganAt = nil, nil
		entry.abandoned = false
		-- One attempt per slot; no replay of missed slots after a stall.
		if
			inSlot
			and now - slotAt <= Rules.CricketStartWindow
			and sound.SoundId ~= ""
			and not sound.IsPlaying
		then
			sound.Volume = 0
			sound.TimePosition = 0
			entry.requestedAt = now
			entry.startDeadline = slotAt + Rules.CricketStartWindow
			sound:Play()
		end
	end
	if entry.requestedAt and not entry.playBeganAt and not entry.abandoned then
		local progressed = finite(sound.TimePosition) and sound.TimePosition > 0
		if now <= entry.startDeadline and ((sound.IsLoaded and sound.IsPlaying) or progressed) then
			-- Fade from the first observed decode/playback, never jump to the
			-- historical gain of a partially elapsed slot after cold loading.
			entry.playBeganAt = now
		elseif now >= entry.startDeadline then
			entry.abandoned = true
			if not sound.IsLoaded and not progressed then
				sound:Stop()
			end
		end
	end
	local alpha = 0
	if inSlot and entry.playBeganAt and not entry.abandoned and sound.IsPlaying then
		local played = math.max(0, now - entry.playBeganAt)
		local length = entry.duration
		if finite(sound.TimeLength) and sound.TimeLength > 0 then
			length = math.min(length, sound.TimeLength)
		end
		local progress = if finite(sound.TimePosition)
			then math.max(played, sound.TimePosition)
			else played
		alpha = Rules.CricketEnvelope(played, slotAt + Rules.CricketOn - now, length - progress)
	end
	-- Normal off is silence followed by natural Ended, never a timer Stop.
	sound.Volume = entry.gain * alpha
end

function RoundAudio.new(world: any, ownerPlayer: Player, hunt: any, random: Random?)
	assert(world.Root and world.Root:IsA("Model"), "Round audio requires a bound map")
	assert(world.Field and world.Field:IsA("BasePart"), "Round audio requires Field")
	assert(world.Runtime and world.Ground, "Round audio requires runtime and Ground")
	local self = setmetatable({
		world = world,
		ownerPlayer = ownerPlayer,
		random = random or Random.new(),
		created = {} :: { Instance },
		groups = {} :: { [string]: SoundGroup },
		crickets = {},
		fires = {} :: { Sound },
		actors = {} :: { [Player]: any },
		npc = nil :: any,
		npcActors = {} :: { [BasePart]: any },
		primaryHunt = nil :: any,
		leadHunt = nil :: any,
		voiceRoot = nil :: BasePart?,
		voices = {} :: { Sound },
		voiceBag = {} :: { number },
		voiceLast = 0,
		voiceUntil = 0,
		voiceAt = 0,
		chasing = false,
		wakeObservedDormant = hunt and hunt.state == "dormant",
		wakePlayed = false,
		wakePrimaryRoot = nil :: BasePart?,
		wakeUntil = 0,
		startedAt = nil :: number?,
		pollAt = -math.huge,
		destroyed = false,
		exclusions = Layout.ReadExclusions(world.Root, world.Field),
	}, RoundAudio)
	local id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "CornRoundAudio_" .. id
	self:_remember(folder, "runtime")
	folder.Parent = world.Runtime
	self.folder = folder
	local wakeAnchor = Instance.new("Part")
	wakeAnchor.Name = "AwakeningEmitter"
	self:_remember(wakeAnchor, "awakening_emitter")
	wakeAnchor:AddTag("corn_audio_emitter")
	wakeAnchor.Size = Vector3.one
	wakeAnchor.Transparency = 1
	wakeAnchor.Anchored = true
	wakeAnchor.CanCollide = false
	wakeAnchor.CanTouch = false
	wakeAnchor.CanQuery = false
	wakeAnchor.CastShadow = false
	wakeAnchor.Position = if hunt and hunt.home then hunt.home else world.Field.Position
	wakeAnchor.Parent = folder
	local groupsFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	groupsFolder.Name = "CornRoundAudio_" .. id
	self:_remember(groupsFolder, "groups")
	groupsFolder.Parent = SoundService
	for _, category in { "Music", "Ambience", "Effects" } do
		local group = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
		group.Name = category
		self:_remember(group, "group_" .. category)
		group.Volume = math.clamp(Rules.Mix.Master * Rules.Mix[category], 0, 1)
		group.Parent = groupsFolder
		self.groups[category] = group
	end
	self.wakeSound = self:_sound(
		wakeAnchor,
		"COC_Monster_03",
		"awakening",
		Rules.Volume.Awakening,
		"Effects",
		Rules.Ranges.Awakening,
		false
	)
	self.wakeSound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
	local half = world.Field.Size / 2
	for index, offset in
		{
			Vector2.new(-0.62, -0.62),
			Vector2.new(0.62, -0.62),
			Vector2.new(0, 0),
			Vector2.new(-0.62, 0.62),
			Vector2.new(0.62, 0.62),
		}
	do
		local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
		anchor.Name = "Crickets" .. index
		self:_remember(anchor, "crickets_emitter")
		anchor:AddTag("corn_audio_emitter")
		anchor.Size = Vector3.one
		anchor.Transparency = 1
		anchor.Anchored = true
		anchor.CanCollide = false
		anchor.CanTouch = false
		anchor.CanQuery = false
		anchor.CastShadow = false
		anchor.Position = world.Field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
			Vector3.new(offset.X * half.X, -half.Y + 1, offset.Y * half.Z)
		)
		anchor.Parent = folder
		local sound = self:_sound(
			anchor,
			"COC_Crickets_15s",
			"crickets",
			Rules.Volume.Crickets,
			"Ambience",
			Rules.Ranges.Crickets,
			false
		)
		local gain = sound.Volume
		sound.Volume = 0
		table.insert(self.crickets, {
			sound = sound,
			offset = (index - 1) * Rules.Cycle / 5,
			gain = gain,
			duration = math.max(0.1, Assets.Get("COC_Crickets_15s").Duration),
			cycle = -1,
			requestedAt = nil,
			playBeganAt = nil,
			abandoned = false,
		})
	end
	local markers = world.Root:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
	if
		markers
		and markers:GetAttribute("CornTorchMarkersOwned") == true
		and markers:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
	then
		for _, torch in markers:GetChildren() do
			if
				torch:IsA("Model")
				and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true
				and torch:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
				and torch:HasTag("corn_torch")
			then
				local flame = torch:FindFirstChild("Flame")
				if flame and flame:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(
						self.fires,
						self:_sound(
							flame,
							"COC_Fire",
							"fire",
							Rules.Volume.Fire,
							"Ambience",
							Rules.Ranges.Fire,
							true
						)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt)
	return self
end

function RoundAudio:_setHunt(hunt: any, hunts: { any }?)
	local desired = {} :: { [BasePart]: any }
	self.primaryHunt = nil
	-- Exactly three authoritative sources, without a Workspace/field scan.
	for index = 1, 3 do
		local source = if hunts then hunts[index] else (if index == 1 then hunt else nil)
		local root = if source and not source.destroyed then source.root else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and root.Parent and not desired[root] then
			desired[root] = source
			if index == 1 then
				self.primaryHunt = source
			end
		end
	end
	if not self.wakePlayed then
		local primary = self.primaryHunt
		local root = if primary then primary.root else nil
		if self.wakePrimaryRoot ~= root then
			self.wakePrimaryRoot = root
			self.wakeObservedDormant = primary ~= nil and primary.state == "dormant"
			if primary then
				self.wakeSound.Parent.Position = primary.home or self.world.Field.Position
			end
		elseif primary and primary.state == "dormant" then
			self.wakeObservedDormant = true
		end
	end
	-- Remove only vanished NPCs before adding replacements; the live corn pool
	-- stays bounded at three and lead handoffs never cut another NPC's tail.
	for root, actor in self.npcActors do
		if not desired[root] then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			self.npcActors[root] = nil
		end
	end
	for root, source in desired do
		local actor = self.npcActors[root]
		if not actor then
			actor = self:_actor(root)
			self.npcActors[root] = actor
		end
		actor.hunt = source
	end
	local leadRoot = if hunt and not hunt.destroyed then hunt.root else nil
	local selected = if leadRoot then self.npcActors[leadRoot] else nil
	if not selected and self.primaryHunt then
		selected = self.npcActors[self.primaryHunt.root]
	end
	self.npc = selected -- Legacy alias for the selected voice/threat source.
	self.leadHunt = if selected then selected.hunt else nil
	local root = if selected then selected.root else nil
	if self.voiceRoot == root then
		return
	end
	for _, sound in self.voices do
		self:_remove(sound)
	end
	self.voices = {}
	self.voiceRoot = root
	self.voiceBag = {}
	self.voiceLast, self.voiceUntil, self.voiceAt = 0, 0, 0
	self.chasing = false
	if root then
		for index, key in VOICE_KEYS do
			self.voices[index] = self:_sound(
				root,
				key,
				"monster_voice_" .. index,
				Rules.Volume.Monster,
				"Effects",
				Rules.Ranges.Monster,
				false
			)
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_actor(root: BasePart): any
	local sound = self:_sound(
		root,
		CORN_KEYS[1],
		"corn_rustle",
		Rules.Volume.Rustle,
		"Effects",
		Rules.Ranges.Rustle,
		false
	)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRustleId", 0)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRustleStart", "")
	return {
		root = root,
		sound = sound,
		rustleId = 0,
		lastPosition = nil,
		lastAt = nil,
		lastClip = 0,
		untilAt = 0,
		nextAt = 0,
		cueContinuous = false,
		loadDeadline = 0,
	}
end

function RoundAudio:_inCorn(point: Vector3): boolean
	local field = self.world.Field
	local at = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = field.Size / 2
	return math.abs(at.X) <= half.X
		and math.abs(at.Z) <= half.Z
		and not Layout.IsExcluded(point, self.exclusions)
end

function RoundAudio:_stepActor(actor: any, now: number, eligible: boolean)
	local root = actor.root
	local point = root.Position
	local before = actor.lastPosition
	local beforeAt = actor.lastAt
	actor.lastPosition = point
	actor.lastAt = now
	local dt = if beforeAt then now - beforeAt else 0
	local delta = if before then point - before else Vector3.zero
	local distance = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
	-- Clear discontinuities instead of turning spawn/teleport into a loud footstep.
	local moving = dt > 0
		and dt <= 1
		and distance >= 0.05
		and distance <= 12
		and distance / dt <= 45
		and math.abs(delta.Y) < 4
	local sound = actor.sound
	local busy = false
	if sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") == true then
		-- This server player retains its own full clip. More frequent cues
		-- below are metadata only while it is busy; no URI/Play/Stop rewrite.
		if sound.SoundId ~= "" and not sound.IsLoaded then
			if now < actor.loadDeadline or sound.TimePosition > 0 then
				busy = true
			else
				-- Only abandon an unavailable attempt that never began playing.
				stop(sound)
			end
		elseif now < actor.untilAt or sound.IsPlaying then
			busy = true
		else
			-- Natural completion needs no Stop (which resets playback position).
			sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", false)
		end
	end
	if not eligible or not moving or not self:_inCorn(point) then
		actor.cueContinuous = false
		return
	end
	if now < actor.nextAt then
		return
	end
	local index = self.random:NextInteger(1, #CORN_KEYS - 1)
	if index >= actor.lastClip then
		index += 1
	end
	if index > #CORN_KEYS then
		index = 1
	end
	actor.lastClip = index
	local definition = Assets.Get(CORN_KEYS[index])
	local duration = math.max(0.1, definition.Duration)
	-- Preserve at most one poll's timing remainder during continuous motion.
	-- Pauses/discontinuities reset the anchor, so there is no catch-up burst.
	local cueAt = if actor.cueContinuous then math.max(actor.nextAt, now - 0.1) else now
	actor.nextAt = cueAt + math.max(Rules.RustleInterval, duration / Rules.RustleVoices)
	actor.cueContinuous = true
	if not busy then
		sound.SoundId = definition.Id
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioAssetKey", CORN_KEYS[index])
		sound.Volume = math.clamp(Rules.Volume.Rustle * definition.Gain, 0, 1)
		actor.untilAt = now + duration
		actor.loadDeadline = now + Rules.RustleLoadTimeout
		request(sound, true)
	end
	actor.rustleId += 1
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRustleId", actor.rustleId)
	-- One replicated value commits the sequence and key together. A client
	-- decoder can finish later than this server Sound; it schedules its own
	-- full tails from accepted commits without trusting URI replication order.
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRustleStart", tostring(actor.rustleId) .. ":" .. CORN_KEYS[index])
end

function RoundAudio:_grounded(character: Model, humanoid: Humanoid, root: BasePart): boolean
	if humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
		return false
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local legHeight = 0
	if humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
		local leg = character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
		if leg and leg:IsA("BasePart") then
			legHeight = leg.Size.Y
		end
	end
	local length = math.max(3, legHeight + humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 2)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -length, 0), params)
	return hit ~= nil and hit.Instance == self.world.Ground
end

function RoundAudio:_players(now: number, phase: string)
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	table.sort(players, function(a, b)
		if a == b then
			return false
		elseif a == self.ownerPlayer then
			return true
		elseif b == self.ownerPlayer then
			return false
		end
		return a.UserId < b.UserId
	end)
	local alive: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
	for index, player in players do
		if index > Rules.ActorLimit then
			break
		end
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if
			not character
			or not humanoid
			or not root
			or not root:IsA("BasePart")
			or humanoid.Health <= 0
		then
			continue
		end
		alive[player] = true
		local actor = self.actors[player]
		if actor and actor.root ~= root then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			actor = nil
		end
		if not actor then
			actor = self:_actor(root)
			self.actors[player] = actor
		end
		self:_stepActor(
			actor,
			now,
			(phase == "active" or player ~= self.ownerPlayer)
				and self:_grounded(character, humanoid, root)
		)
	end
	for player, actor in self.actors do
		if not alive[player] then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			self.actors[player] = nil
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_voice(now: number)
	if now < self.wakeUntil then
		return
	end
	if now >= self.voiceUntil then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	end
	if now < self.voiceAt or #self.voices ~= 3 then
		return
	end
	if #self.voiceBag == 0 then
		self.voiceBag = { 1, 2, 3 }
		for index = #self.voiceBag, 2, -1 do
			local other = self.random:NextInteger(1, index)
			self.voiceBag[index], self.voiceBag[other] = self.voiceBag[other], self.voiceBag[index]
		end
		if self.voiceBag[1] == self.voiceLast then
			self.voiceBag[1], self.voiceBag[2] = self.voiceBag[2], self.voiceBag[1]
		end
	end
	local index = table.remove(self.voiceBag, 1)
	self.voiceLast = index
	local sound = self.voices[index]
	local definition = Assets.Get(VOICE_KEYS[index])
	self.voiceUntil = now + math.max(0.1, definition.Duration, sound.TimeLength)
	self.voiceAt = self.voiceUntil + self.random:NextNumber(Rules.VoiceMin, Rules.VoiceMax)
	request(sound, true)
end

function RoundAudio:Step(now: number, phase: string, mode: string, hunt: any, hunts: { any }?)
	if self.destroyed or not finite(now) then
		return
	end
	if phase ~= "active" and phase ~= "caught" then
		self:Destroy()
		return
	end
	if not self.startedAt then
		self.startedAt = now
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt, hunts)
	local primary = self.primaryHunt
	if phase == "caught" then
		stop(self.wakeSound)
		self.wakeUntil = 0
	elseif
		not self.wakePlayed
		and self.wakeObservedDormant
		and primary
		and not primary.destroyed
		and primary.state ~= "dormant"
		and primary.state ~= "stopped"
	then
		self.wakePlayed = true
		self.wakeUntil = now
			+ math.max(Assets.Get("COC_Monster_03").Duration, self.wakeSound.TimeLength)
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
		request(self.wakeSound, true)
	elseif self.wakePlayed and now >= self.wakeUntil then
		stop(self.wakeSound)
	end
	for _, entry in self.crickets do
		self:_stepCricket(entry, now)
	end
	for _, sound in self.fires do
		request(sound, mode == "medium" or mode == "hard")
	end
	local lead = self.leadHunt
	local chasing = phase == "active" and lead and not lead.destroyed and lead.state == "chase"
	if not chasing then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	elseif not self.chasing then
		self.voiceAt = now + Rules.FirstVoiceDelay
		self.voiceUntil = now
	end
	self.chasing = chasing == true
	if now < self.pollAt then
		return
	end
	self.pollAt = now + 0.1
	if self.chasing then
		self:_voice(now)
	end
	for _, actor in self.npcActors do
		local source = actor.hunt
		local floor = self.world.Ground.Position.Y + self.world.Ground.Size.Y / 2
		self:_stepActor(
			actor,
			now,
			phase == "active"
				and source
				and (source.state == "patrol" or source.state == "chase")
				and math.abs(actor.root.Position.Y - floor - 3) <= 3
		)
	end
	self:_players(now, phase)
end

function RoundAudio:Destroy()
	if self.destroyed then
		return
	end
	self.destroyed = true
	for index = #self.created, 1, -1 do
		local item = self.created[index]
		if item:IsA("Sound") then
			stop(item)
		end
		destroyOwned(item)
	end
	self.created = {}
	self.actors = {}
	self.voices = {}
	self.fires = {}
	self.crickets = {}
	self.npc = nil
	self.npcActors = {}
	self.primaryHunt, self.leadHunt, self.voiceRoot = nil, nil, nil
	self.wakePrimaryRoot = nil
end

RoundAudio.Stop = RoundAudio.Destroy

return RoundAudio
StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/GameC:
--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game")
local Inventory = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Inventory"))
local Assets = require(Shared:WaitForChild("AudioAssets"))
local Rules = require(Shared:WaitForChild("AudioRules"))
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local FOLDER_NAME = "CornPersonalAudio"
local RESOLVE_INTERVAL = 0.25
local PRELOAD_TIMEOUT = 8
local definitions = {
	Background = { key = "COC_Background_02", category = "Music", looped = true },
	Hunt = { key = "COC_Hunt", category = "Music", looped = true },
	Energy = { key = "COC_Energy_Open", category = "Effects", looped = false },
	Trap = { key = "COC_Trap_Place", category = "Effects", looped = false },
}
local Controller = { Name = "AudioController", Order = 98 }

local function owned(instance: Instance?): boolean
	return instance ~= nil
		and instance:GetAttribute("CornAudioOwned") == true
		and instance:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		and instance:GetAttribute("AudioVersion") == 1
end

local function annotate(instance: Instance, role: string)
	instance:SetAttribute("CornAudioOwned", true)
	instance:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT)
	instance:SetAttribute("AudioVersion", 1)
	instance:SetAttribute("audio_role", role)
end

function Controller:Init(_context: any)
	self._snapshot = nil
	self._roundId = -1
	self._useId = 0
	self._endedRound = nil
	self._folder = nil
	self._folderName = FOLDER_NAME
	self._groups = {}
	self._sounds = {}
	self._connections = {}
	self._monster = nil
	self._monsterRoot = nil
	self._resolveAt = 0
	self._capture = nil
	self._background = 0
	self._hunt = 0
	self._generation = 0
	self._preload = nil
	self._refused = nil
	self._started = false
end

function Controller:_soundValid(entry: any): boolean
	return entry ~= nil
		and owned(self._folder)
		and self._folder.Parent == SoundService
		and owned(entry.sound)
		and entry.sound.Parent == self._folder
		and owned(entry.group)
		and entry.group.Parent == self._folder
		and entry.sound.SoundGroup == entry.group
end

function Controller:_stop(entry: any)
	if self:_soundValid(entry) then
		entry.sound:Stop()
		entry.sound.Volume = 0
	end
	if entry then
		entry.playing = false
		entry.deadline = nil
	end
end

function Controller:_stopAll()
	self._background, self._hunt = 0, 0
	for _, entry in self._sounds do
		self:_stop(entry)
	end
end

function Controller:Clear(_reason: string?)
	self._snapshot = nil
	self._monster, self._monsterRoot = nil, nil
	self._resolveAt = 0
	self:_stopAll()
end

function Controller:_build(): boolean
	if self._folder then
		return owned(self._folder) and self._folder.Parent == SoundService
	end
	local existing = SoundService:FindFirstChild(self._folderName)
	if existing then
		if self._refused ~= existing then
			self._refused = existing
			warn("[AudioController] Existing personal audio folder preserved; ownership refused")
		end
		return false
	end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = self._folderName
	annotate(folder, "personal")
	self._folder = folder
	for _, category in { "Music", "Effects" } do
		local group = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
		group.Name = category
		group.Volume = math.clamp(Rules.Mix.Master * Rules.Mix[category], 0, 1)
		annotate(group, string.lower(category))
		group.Parent = folder
		self._groups[category] = group
	end
	for role, definition in definitions do
		local asset = Assets.Get(definition.key)
		if
			asset
			and type(asset.Id) == "string"
			and string.match(asset.Id, "^rbxassetid://[1-9]%d*$")
		then
			local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
			sound.Name = role
			sound.SoundId = asset.Id
			sound.Volume = 0
			sound.Looped = definition.looped
			sound.SoundGroup = self._groups[definition.category]
			annotate(sound, string.lower(role))
			sound.Parent = folder
			local entry = {
				sound = sound,
				group = sound.SoundGroup,
				gain = math.clamp(asset.Gain * Rules.Volume[role], 0, 1),
				duration = asset.Duration,
				playing = false,
				failed = false,
			}
			self._sounds[role] = entry
			if not definition.looped then
				table.insert(
					self._connections,
					sound.Ended:Connect(function()
						self:_stop(entry)
					end)
				)
			end
		end
	end
	folder.Parent = SoundService
	return true
end

function Controller:_preloadAssets()
	local sounds = {}
	local byId = {}
	for _, entry in self._sounds do
		table.insert(sounds, entry.sound)
		byId[entry.sound.SoundId] = entry
	end
	if #sounds == 0 then
		return
	end
	local generation = self._generation
	local pending = { thread = nil, active = true }
	self._preload = pending
	pending.thread = task.spawn(function()
		local ok, message = pcall(function()
			ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(sounds, function(id: string, status: Enum.AssetFetchStatus)
				local entry = byId[id]
				if
					self._generation == generation
					and entry
					and status ~= Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success
				then
					entry.failed = true
					self:_stop(entry)
					warn("[AudioController] Audio asset unavailable: " .. id)
				end
			end)
		end)
		if self._generation == generation then
			pending.active = false
			self._preload = nil
			if not ok then
				warn("[AudioController] Audio preload failed: " .. tostring(message))
			end
		end
	end)
	task.delay(PRELOAD_TIMEOUT, function()
		if self._generation == generation and self._preload == pending and pending.active then
			if pending.thread then
				pcall(task.cancel, pending.thread)
			end
			pending.active = false
			self._preload = nil
			warn("[AudioController] Audio preload timed out; gameplay continues")
		end
	end)
end

function Controller:_livingRoot(): BasePart?
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	return if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then root else nil
end

function Controller:_resolveMonster(now: number)
	if now < self._resolveAt then
		return
	end
	self._resolveAt = now + RESOLVE_INTERVAL
	self._monster, self._monsterRoot = nil, nil
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local runtime = if map and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		then map:FindFirstChild("CornRoundRuntime")
		else nil
	local monster = if runtime and runtime:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		then runtime:FindFirstChild("Monster")
		else nil
	local root = if monster then monster:FindFirstChild("Root") else nil
	if
		monster
		and monster:IsA("Model")
		and monster:GetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned") == true
		and monster:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		and monster:GetAttribute("MonsterRigVersion") == 1
		and root
		and root:IsA("BasePart")
	then
		self._monster, self._monsterRoot = monster, root
	end
end

function Controller:_huntGoal(root: BasePart, now: number): number
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	if
		not snapshot
		or snapshot.phase ~= "active"
		or snapshot.monster_state ~= "chase"
		or (self._capture and self._capture._state.active)
	then
		return 0
	end
	self:_resolveMonster(now)
	local monster, enemy = self._monster, self._monsterRoot
	if
		not monster
		or not enemy
		or enemy.Parent ~= monster
		or not monster.Parent
		or monster:GetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned") ~= true
		or monster:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
		or monster:GetAttribute("MonsterRigVersion") ~= 1
		or monster:GetAttribute("ChaseTargetUserId") ~= player.UserId
	then
		return 0
	end
	local distance = (enemy.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
	return if distance <= (Rules.HuntMaxDistance or 60) then Rules.ChaseIntensity(distance) else 0
end

function Controller:_music(role: string, alpha: number)
	local entry = self._sounds[role]
	if not self:_soundValid(entry) or entry.failed then
		return
	end
	if alpha <= 0 then
		if entry.playing then
			self:_stop(entry)
		end
		return
	end
	entry.sound.Volume = entry.gain * alpha
	if not entry.playing then
		entry.playing = true
		entry.sound:Play()
	end
end

function Controller:_playEffect(kind: string, now: number)
	local entry = self._sounds[if kind == "energy" then "Energy" else "Trap"]
	if not self:_soundValid(entry) or entry.failed then
		return
	end
	self:_stop(entry)
	entry.sound.Volume = entry.gain
	entry.playing = true
	entry.deadline = now + math.max(entry.duration, entry.sound.TimeLength) + 0.5
	entry.sound:Play()
end

function Controller:_step(dt: number, now: number)
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local root = self:_livingRoot()
	if
		not snapshot
		or not root
		or GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		or (snapshot.phase ~= "active" and snapshot.phase ~= "caught")
	then
		self:_stopAll()
		return
	end
	self._background = Rules.Fade(self._background, 1, dt, Rules.BackgroundFade)
	self:_music("Background", self._background)
	if snapshot.phase == "caught" or (self._capture and self._capture._state.active) then
		self._hunt = 0
		self:_stop(self._sounds.Hunt)
		self:_stop(self._sounds.Energy)
		self:_stop(self._sounds.Trap)
	else
		local goal = self:_huntGoal(root, now)
		self._hunt = Rules.Fade(
			self._hunt,
			goal,
			dt,
			if goal > self._hunt then Rules.HuntFadeIn else Rules.HuntFadeOut
		)
		self:_music("Hunt", self._hunt)
		for _, role in { "Energy", "Trap" } do
			local entry = self._sounds[role]
			if entry and entry.deadline and now >= entry.deadline then
				self:_stop(entry)
			end
		end
	end
end

function Controller:SetSnapshot(snapshot: any)
	if
		type(snapshot) ~= "table"
		or type(snapshot.minimap) ~= "table"
		or not Inventory.IsValidSnapshot(snapshot.inventory)
	then
		self:Clear("malformed snapshot")
		return
	end
	local roundId = snapshot.minimap.round_id
	local use = snapshot.inventory.use
	if
		type(roundId) ~= "number"
		or roundId < 0
		or roundId >= math.huge
		or roundId % 1 ~= 0
		or roundId < self._roundId
	then
		return
	end
	if
		roundId == self._roundId
		and snapshot.phase == "active"
		and (use.id < self._useId or self._endedRound == roundId)
	then
		return
	end
	local first = roundId ~= self._roundId
	if first then
		self:_stopAll()
		self._monster, self._monsterRoot = nil, nil
		self._resolveAt = 0
		self._roundId, self._useId = roundId, use.id
		self._endedRound = nil
	end
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	if
		snapshot.phase == "escaped"
		or snapshot.phase == "aborted"
		or snapshot.phase == "caught_out"
	then
		self._endedRound = roundId
	end
	if not first and use.id > self._useId then
		self._useId = use.id
		if
			snapshot.phase == "active"
			and self:_livingRoot()
			and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen
			and not (self._capture and self._capture._state.active)
			and (use.kind == "energy" or use.kind == "trap")
		then
			self:_playEffect(use.kind, os.clock())
		end
	end
	self:_step(0, os.clock())
end

function Controller:Start(context: any)
	if self._started then

	end
	self._started = true
	self._capture = context.Controllers.CaptureController
	if not self:_build() then

	self:_preloadAssets()
	table.insert(
		self._connections,

	table.insert(

		end)

	for _, event in { player.CharacterAdded, player.CharacterRemoving } do

			self._connections,
			event:Connect(function()
				self:Clear("character changed")
			end)
		)
	end
end

function Controller:Destroy()
	self:Clear("destroy")
	self._generation += 1
	if self._preload then
		if self._preload.thread then
			pcall(task.cancel, self._preload.thread)
		end
		self._preload = nil
	end
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	local folder = self._folder
	if folder and owned(folder) then
		-- A manually changed descendant must survive along with its parent folder.
		local allOwned = true
		for _, child in folder:GetDescendants() do
			if not owned(child) then

				break
			end
		end
		if allOwned then

		else
			warn("[AudioController] Changed personal audio children preserved")
		end

	end

	table.clear(self._sounds)
	table.clear(self._groups)
	self._started = false
end

local function owned(instance: Instance?): boolean

		and instance:GetAttribute("CornAudioOwned") == true

function Controller:_soundValid(entry: any): boolean

		and owned(self._folder)
		and self._folder.Parent == SoundService
		and owned(entry.sound)
		and entry.sound.Parent == self._folder
		and owned(entry.group)
		and entry.group.Parent == self._folder
		and entry.sound.SoundGroup == entry.group

	end

function Controller:_build(): boolean
	if self._folder then
		return owned(self._folder) and self._folder.Parent == SoundService
	end
	local existing = SoundService:FindFirstChild(self._folderName)
	if existing then
		if self._refused ~= existing then
			self._refused = existing
			warn("[AudioController] Existing personal audio folder preserved; ownership refused")
		end
		return false
	end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = self._folderName
	annotate(folder, "personal")
	self._folder = folder
	for _, category in { "Music", "Effects" } do
		local group = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
		group.Name = category
		group.Volume = math.clamp(Rules.Mix.Master * Rules.Mix[category], 0, 1)
		annotate(group, string.lower(category))
		group.Parent = folder
		self._groups[category] = group
	end
	for role, definition in definitions do
		local asset = Assets.Get(definition.key)
		if
			asset
			and type(asset.Id) == "string"
			and string.match(asset.Id, "^rbxassetid://[1-9]%d*$")
		then
			local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
			sound.Name = role
			sound.SoundId = asset.Id
			sound.Volume = 0
			sound.Looped = definition.looped
			sound.SoundGroup = self._groups[definition.category]
			annotate(sound, string.lower(role))
			sound.Parent = folder
			local entry = {
				sound = sound,
				group = sound.SoundGroup,
				gain = math.clamp(asset.Gain * Rules.Volume[role], 0, 1),
				duration = asset.Duration,
				playing = false,
				failed = false,
			}
			self._sounds[role] = entry
			if not definition.looped then
				table.insert(
					self._connections,
					sound.Ended:Connect(function()
						self:_stop(entry)
					end)
				)
			end
		end
	end
	folder.Parent = SoundService
	return true
end

function Controller:_preloadAssets()
	local ids = {}
	local seen = {}
	local byId = {}
	for _, entry in self._sounds do
		byId[entry.sound.SoundId] = entry
	end
	-- Prime short spatial clips too; their server playback can end before a cold fetch.
	for _, asset in Assets.List() do
		local id = asset.Id
		if
			type(id) == "string"
			and string.match(id, "^rbxassetid://[1-9]%d*$")
			and not seen[id]
		then
			seen[id] = true
			table.insert(ids, id)
			if #ids >= 15 then
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if #ids == 0 then
		return
	end
	local generation = self._generation
	local pending = { thread = nil, active = true }
	self._preload = pending
	pending.thread = task.spawn(function()
		local ok, message = pcall(function()
			ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(ids, function(id: string, status: Enum.AssetFetchStatus)
				local entry = byId[id]
				if self._generation == generation and status ~= Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
					if entry then
						entry.failed = true
						self:_stop(entry)
					end
					warn("[AudioController] Audio asset unavailable: " .. id)
				end
			end)
		end)
		if self._generation == generation then
			pending.active = false
			self._preload = nil
			if not ok then
				warn("[AudioController] Audio preload failed: " .. tostring(message))
			end
		end
	end)
	task.delay(PRELOAD_TIMEOUT, function()
		if self._generation == generation and self._preload == pending and pending.active then
			if pending.thread then
				pcall(task.cancel, pending.thread)
			end
			pending.active = false
			self._preload = nil
			warn("[AudioController] Audio preload timed out; gameplay continues")
		end
	end)
end

function Controller:_livingRoot(): BasePart?
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	return if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then root else nil
end

function Controller:_resolveMonster(now: number)
	if now < self._resolveAt then
		return
	end
	self._resolveAt = now + RESOLVE_INTERVAL
	self._monster, self._monsterRoot = nil, nil
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local runtime = if map and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		then map:FindFirstChild("CornRoundRuntime")
		else nil
	local monster = if runtime and runtime:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		then runtime:FindFirstChild("Monster")
		else nil
	local root = if monster then monster:FindFirstChild("Root") else nil
	if
		monster
		and monster:IsA("Model")
		and monster:GetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned") == true
		and monster:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		and monster:GetAttribute("MonsterRigVersion") == 1
		and root
		and root:IsA("BasePart")
	then
		self._monster, self._monsterRoot = monster, root
	end
end

function Controller:_huntGoal(root: BasePart, now: number): number
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	if
		not snapshot
		or snapshot.phase ~= "active"
		or snapshot.monster_state ~= "chase"
		or (self._capture and self._capture._state.active)
	then
		return 0
	end
	self:_resolveMonster(now)
	local monster, enemy = self._monster, self._monsterRoot
	if
		not monster
		or not enemy
		or enemy.Parent ~= monster
		or not monster.Parent
		or monster:GetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned") ~= true
		or monster:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
		or monster:GetAttribute("MonsterRigVersion") ~= 1
		or monster:GetAttribute("ChaseTargetUserId") ~= player.UserId
	then
		return 0
	end
	local distance = (enemy.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
	return if distance <= (Rules.HuntMaxDistance or 60) then Rules.ChaseIntensity(distance) else 0
end

function Controller:_music(role: string, alpha: number)
	local entry = self._sounds[role]
	if not self:_soundValid(entry) or entry.failed then
		return
	end
	if alpha <= 0 then
		if entry.playing then
			self:_stop(entry)
		end
		return
	end
	entry.sound.Volume = entry.gain * alpha
	if not entry.playing then
		entry.playing = true
		entry.sound:Play()
	end
end

function Controller:_playEffect(kind: string, now: number)
	local entry = self._sounds[if kind == "energy" then "Energy" else "Trap"]
	if not self:_soundValid(entry) or entry.failed then
		return
	end
	self:_stop(entry)
	entry.sound.Volume = entry.gain
	entry.playing = true
	entry.deadline = now + math.max(entry.duration, entry.sound.TimeLength) + 0.5
	entry.sound:Play()
end

function Controller:_step(dt: number, now: number)
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local root = self:_livingRoot()
	if
		not snapshot
		or not root
		or GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		or (snapshot.phase ~= "active" and snapshot.phase ~= "caught")
	then
		self:_stopAll()
		return
	end
	self._background = Rules.Fade(self._background, 1, dt, Rules.BackgroundFade)
	self:_music("Background", self._background)
	if snapshot.phase == "caught" or (self._capture and self._capture._state.active) then
		self._hunt = 0
		self:_stop(self._sounds.Hunt)
		self:_stop(self._sounds.Energy)
		self:_stop(self._sounds.Trap)
	else
		local goal = self:_huntGoal(root, now)
		self._hunt = Rules.Fade(
			self._hunt,
			goal,
			dt,
			if goal > self._hunt then Rules.HuntFadeIn else Rules.HuntFadeOut
		)
		self:_music("Hunt", self._hunt)
		for _, role in { "Energy", "Trap" } do
			local entry = self._sounds[role]
			if entry and entry.deadline and now >= entry.deadline then
				self:_stop(entry)
			end
		end
	end
end

function Controller:SetSnapshot(snapshot: any)
	if
		type(snapshot) ~= "table"
		or type(snapshot.minimap) ~= "table"
		or not Inventory.IsValidSnapshot(snapshot.inventory)
	then
		self:Clear("malformed snapshot")
		return
	end
	local roundId = snapshot.minimap.round_id
	local use = snapshot.inventory.use
	if
		type(roundId) ~= "number"
		or roundId < 0
		or roundId >= math.huge
		or roundId % 1 ~= 0
		or roundId < self._roundId
	then
		return
	end
	if
		roundId == self._roundId
		and snapshot.phase == "active"
		and (use.id < self._useId or self._endedRound == roundId)
	then
		return
	end
	local first = roundId ~= self._roundId
	if first then
		self:_stopAll()
		self._monster, self._monsterRoot = nil, nil
		self._resolveAt = 0
		self._roundId, self._useId = roundId, use.id
		self._endedRound = nil
	end
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	if
		snapshot.phase == "escaped"
		or snapshot.phase == "aborted"
		or snapshot.phase == "caught_out"
	then
		self._endedRound = roundId
	end
	if not first and use.id > self._useId then
		self._useId = use.id
		if
			snapshot.phase == "active"
			and self:_livingRoot()
			and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen
			and not (self._capture and self._capture._state.active)
			and (use.kind == "energy" or use.kind == "trap")
		then
			self:_playEffect(use.kind, os.clock())
		end
	end
	self:_step(0, os.clock())
end

	if self._started then
		return
	end
	self._started = true

		else nil
	local monster = if runtime and runtime:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		then runtime:FindFirstChild("Monster")
		else nil
	local root = if monster then monster:FindFirstChild("Root") else nil
	if
		monster
		and monster:IsA("Model")
		and monster:GetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned") == true
		and monster:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		and monster:GetAttribute("MonsterRigVersion") == 1
		and root
		and root:IsA("BasePart")
	then
		self._monster, self._monsterRoot = monster, root
	end
end

function Controller:_huntGoal(root: BasePart, now: number): number
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	if
		not snapshot
		or snapshot.phase ~= "active"
		or snapshot.monster_state ~= "chase"
		or (self._capture and self._capture._state.active)
	then
		return 0
	end
	self:_resolveMonster(now)
	local monster, enemy = self._monster, self._monsterRoot
	if
		not monster
		or not enemy
		or enemy.Parent ~= monster
		or not monster.Parent
		or monster:GetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned") ~= true
		or monster:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
		or monster:GetAttribute("MonsterRigVersion") ~= 1
		or monster:GetAttribute("ChaseTargetUserId") ~= player.UserId
	then
		return 0
	end
	local distance = (enemy.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
	return if distance <= (Rules.HuntMaxDistance or 60) then Rules.ChaseIntensity(distance) else 0
end

function Controller:_canPlay(entry: any): boolean
	if not self:_soundValid(entry) then
		return false
	end
	if entry.failed and entry.sound.IsLoaded then
		entry.failed = false
	end
	return not entry.failed
end

function Controller:_music(role: string, alpha: number)
	local entry = self._sounds[role]
	if not self:_canPlay(entry) then
		return
	end
	if alpha <= 0 then
		if entry.playing then
			self:_stop(entry)
		end
		return
	end
	entry.sound.Volume = entry.gain * alpha
	if not entry.playing then
		entry.playing = true
		entry.sound:Play()
	end
end

function Controller:_playEffect(kind: string, now: number)
	local entry = self._sounds[if kind == "energy" then "Energy" else "Trap"]
	if not self:_canPlay(entry) then
		return
	end
	self:_stop(entry)
	entry.sound.Volume = entry.gain
	entry.playing = true
	entry.deadline = now + math.max(entry.duration, entry.sound.TimeLength) + 0.5
	entry.sound:Play()
end

function Controller:_step(dt: number, now: number)
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local root = self:_livingRoot()
	if
		not snapshot
		or not root
		or GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		or (snapshot.phase ~= "active" and snapshot.phase ~= "caught")
	then
		self:_stopAll()
		return
	end
	self._background = Rules.Fade(self._background, 1, dt, Rules.BackgroundFade)
	self:_music("Background", self._background)
	if snapshot.phase == "caught" or (self._capture and self._capture._state.active) then
		self._hunt = 0
		self:_stop(self._sounds.Hunt)
		self:_stop(self._sounds.Energy)
		self:_stop(self._sounds.Trap)
	else
		local goal = self:_huntGoal(root, now)
		self._hunt = Rules.Fade(
			self._hunt,
			goal,
			dt,
			if goal > self._hunt then Rules.HuntFadeIn else Rules.HuntFadeOut
		)
		self:_music("Hunt", self._hunt)
		for _, role in { "Energy", "Trap" } do
			local entry = self._sounds[role]
			if entry and entry.deadline and now >= entry.deadline then
				self:_stop(entry)
			end
		end
	end
end

function Controller:SetSnapshot(snapshot: any)
	if
		type(snapshot) ~= "table"
		or type(snapshot.minimap) ~= "table"
		or not Inventory.IsValidSnapshot(snapshot.inventory)
	then
		self:Clear("malformed snapshot")
		return
	end
	local roundId = snapshot.minimap.round_id
	local use = snapshot.inventory.use
	if
		type(roundId) ~= "number"
		or roundId < 0
		or roundId >= math.huge
		or roundId % 1 ~= 0
		or roundId < self._roundId
	then
		return
	end
	if
		roundId == self._roundId
		and snapshot.phase == "active"
		and (use.id < self._useId or self._endedRound == roundId)
	then
		return
	end
	local first = roundId ~= self._roundId
	if first then
		self:_stopAll()
		self._monster, self._monsterRoot = nil, nil
		self._resolveAt = 0
		self._roundId, self._useId = roundId, use.id
		self._endedRound = nil
	end
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	if
		snapshot.phase == "escaped"
		or snapshot.phase == "aborted"
		or snapshot.phase == "caught_out"
	then
		self._endedRound = roundId
	end
	if not first and use.id > self._useId then
		self._useId = use.id
		if
			snapshot.phase == "active"
			and self:_livingRoot()
			and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen
			and not (self._capture and self._capture._state.active)
			and (use.kind == "energy" or use.kind == "trap")
		then
			self:_playEffect(use.kind, os.clock())
		end
	end
	self:_step(0, os.clock())
end

function Controller:Start(context: any)
	if self._started then
		return
	end
	self._started = true
	self._capture = context.Controllers.CaptureController
	if not self:_build() then
		return
	end
	self:_preloadAssets()
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
			self:_step(dt, os.clock())
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		GuiService.MenuOpened:Connect(function()
			self:_stopAll()
		end)
	)
	for _, event in { player.CharacterAdded, player.CharacterRemoving } do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
